f976c6bf55db.description: Are you in your first year of your Master's degree and looking for a working student role where you can contribute to real production systems, learn from experienced engineers, and explore the intersection of backend development, data engineering and AI? Then this could be the right role for you. About the Team The Product Creation & Assignment team at idealo builds the systems behind the automated expansion of our product catalogue. Products are the comparable entities users see on our platform — pages where offers from different shops are grouped, enriched and made comparable. We build the systems that identify and create new products from various data sources, and assign incoming shop offers to the right existing or newly created products. We work on a modern, cloud-native stack combining JVM-based backend services with data-intensive AWS workflows: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Kafka, MongoDB and EKS, as well as Python-based pipelines using MWAA, Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Glue Spark and S3. We integrate ML models and GenAI components into our production systems and actively use AI tools such as Claude Code in our daily development workflow. About your new role As a working student, you will contribute to meaningful work alongside a senior engineering team. Depending on your background and interests, your work may include: Supporting the development and improvement of backend services and data workflows for automated catalogue expansion. Working on product data quality — helping improve matching logic, data completeness and pipeline reliability. Exploring how ML models and GenAI components (such as LLM-based matchers) can be integrated into production systems. Contributing to tooling, observability and automation that makes the team more effective. Participating in code reviews, pairing sessions and team rituals — learning how a production-grade engineering team operates. Skills & Requirements Currently enrolled in a Master's programme in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related field — ideally in your first year. Solid programming foundation, ideally in Java, Kotlin or Python. Some experience with backend development, data pipelines or cloud services — through coursework, personal projects or a prior internship. Curiosity about data-intensive systems, ML integration or AI-assisted development. Good communication skills and comfortable working in English and German. b0120543c5d0.description: About Stenon GmbH At Stenon we are on a mission to democratize soil data. We have become the global market leader in real-time, digital soil data. Stenon has closed an $18 million Series B financing round to scale real-time nitrogen and soil data management and is expanding internationally. Position We seek a versatile and experienced Senior Data Scientist, that drives and expands our existing soil nutrient machine learning as well as new data-driven features that support our customers in making better agronomic decisions for their fields using real-time soil data. What you will do Be responsible for a core pillar of Stenon’s products Scale our soil nutrient modelling to support more and more regions across the world Oversee planning, execution and delivery of Data Science projects. Contribute to the Data Science strategy, vision and roadmap, enhancing Stenon’s agronomy intelligence layer to support additional features and enable new data sources Work with a variety of data from spectral sensor data via chemical lab analysis results to spatial fertilization maps. What you must have At least 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science products Advanced Degree in Engineering or Science Exceptional understanding of statistical and fundamental machine learning concepts Experience writing and maintaining python code , incl. common libraries like scikit, pytorch as well as ML-Ops infrastructure like MLflow, DVC High degree of autonomy Ability to translate complex statistical or machine learning concepts into digestible information for non-technical audiences Experience across the machine learning product lifecycle : defining success metrics, model evaluation and validation, deployment, monitoring and iteration, in collaboration with data engineers A strong sense for data and code quality and the ability to push for high standards High-dimensional sensor/signal data processing expertise Proven track record of managing complex projects from start to finish in a fast paced environment Experience leading or mentoring team members Good communication and English language skills - verbal and written You may have Experience in geo-spatial products Knowledge of agronomy or agriculture, sensor/IoT data, or field trials Understanding of sensor hardware, physical measurement principles and real world noise characteristics ML Ops or Data Engineering knowledge, like Docker, CI/ What we offer Ownership & Growth: A key role in a fast-growing scale-up where you own your area of responsibility with flat hierarchies and fast decision-making. Real-World Impact: Design products that go directly into the hands of farmers, solving global food production and climate challenges. Collaborative Culture: Work in a highly productive, international team that values hands-on development and mutual support. Work-Life Balance: A permanent full-time role offering adaptable schedules to accommodate your lifestyle. Flexible Location: Choose between hybrid or fully remote options across Germany, featuring one mandatory monthly collaboration day in Potsdam for team cohesion and alignment. Remote Setup Support: A dedicated financial allowance to help you optimize your home workspace Learning Budget: Invest in your professional growth with an annual allowance dedicated to courses, conferences, books and certifications Year-End Break: Enjoy a paid company-wide closure between Christmas and New Year to recharge and spend time with loved ones. Seamless Commuting: Choose between an ABC Berlin/Potsdam travel pass or a Deutschland-Ticket to keep you mobile. Team Spirit: Annual company retreats to warmer climates (last year we went to Gran Canaria), regular social events, and a fully stocked kitchen with coffee, tea, and snacks. Why Us? We are changing how farmers understand and manage their soil, moving from lab-based analysis to real-time insights directly in the field. Das änderst du: Als erste Marketing-Person baust du Inbound auf, bis Systembauer, Generalunternehmer und Bauträger von sich aus eine Demo anfragen. f096ae9aa7d2.description: Baue eine Marke von Anfang an. Mit guten Ideen – und einem Plan dahinter. Fortisana ist ein wissenschaftlich fundierter All-in-One-Drink für Menschen ab 40, die aktiv bleiben wollen. Das Produkt steht. Wie wir daraus eine unverwechselbare Marke machen, gestalten wir jetzt. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Hinter Fortisana stehen Piran, Leon und Max: Piran hat KoRo mitgegründet und über neun Jahre zu einer der erfolgreichsten Lebensmittelmarken Deutschlands aufgebaut. Leon ist Ernährungsberater und in der Welt der Nahrungsergänzung aufgewachsen. Seine Familie produziert seit über 25 Jahren Nahrungsergänzungsmittel in Deutschland. Max hat bereits mehr als sechs Startups begleitet und zuletzt bei 1KOMMA5° gelernt, wie aus einer Vision ein operativ exzellentes Unternehmen wird. Du gibst Fortisana auf Social Media Haltung, Sprache und einen eigenen Stil. Und du findest heraus, welche Botschaften bei welchen Menschen wirklich ankommen. Was du bei uns machst Du übersetzt Strategie in Inhalte. Aus unserer Positionierung entwickelst du Botschaften, Tonalität und Formate für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Kaufmotive. Du stellst gute Fragen und testest deine Antworten. Du formulierst Hypothesen, entwickelst passende Inhalte und legst fest, woran wir ihren Erfolg erkennen. Du setzt selbst um. Du wertest Ergebnisse aus, ziehst Schlüsse und priorisierst die nächsten Tests. Du hörst zu. Fragen und Rückmeldungen aus der Community bringst du ins Team zurück, damit wir Marke und Angebot weiterentwickeln. Was du mitbringst Du denkst in Zielgruppen und Wirkung. Du kannst erklären, wen ein Inhalt erreichen soll und warum du ihn genau so umsetzt. Du hast schon etwas ausprobiert. Zeig uns einen Kanal, eine Kampagne, ein Hochschulprojekt oder ein eigenes Projekt. Entscheidend ist, was du gemacht und gelernt hast. Du verbindest Kreativität mit Analyse. Du liest Zahlen und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab. Du kommunizierst sicher. Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung. Du formulierst in beiden Sprachen sicher, präzise und zielgruppengerecht. Du gehst sorgfältig mit Gesundheitsthemen um. Du machst komplexe Inhalte verständlich, ohne sie zu übertreiben. Du bist vor Ort. Du kannst sechs Monate in Vollzeit in Berlin mit uns arbeiten. Du arbeitest AI-native und mit Qualitätsanspruch. Du testest eigenständig neue KI-Tools und kreative Ansätze und integrierst sie sinnvoll in deine Workflows. Dabei prüfst du die Ergebnisse kritisch und hältst unseren Qualitätsstandard bei Inhalt, Gestaltung und Genauigkeit hoch. Ein Plus: Erfahrung in Marketing, Markenaufbau oder Kommunikation sowie mit Video und Schnitt. Was wir dir bieten Du prägst mit, wie Fortisana aussieht, klingt und sich anfühlt. Dafür bekommst du kreativen Freiraum, Verantwortung und direktes Feedback vom Gründerteam. Der Markt ist voll. Wir wollen auffallen – mit guten Ideen und dem Mut, sie auszuprobieren. In sechs Monaten entwickelst du deine Fähigkeiten in Markenstrategie, Storytelling und Produktion weiter und baust ein Portfolio auf, das deine Handschrift trägt. Nach einem erfolgreichen Praktikum besteht die Möglichkeit einer unbefristeten Vollzeitstelle mit Unternehmensbeteiligung. Zeig uns deine Arbeit 🤎 Schick uns drei Arbeiten, auf die du stolz bist. Sag bei jeder Arbeit konkret, was von dir stammt: Idee, Skript, Dreh, Schnitt oder Veröffentlichung – und ob sie im Job, für einen Kunden oder als eigenes Projekt entstanden ist. Wenn vorhanden, ergänze Ergebnisse und was du daraus gelernt hast. Dazu brauchen wir deinen Standort, deinen möglichen Starttermin und ein kurzes Profil oder einen Lebenslauf. ee6bcca3f402.title: Solutions Engineer
ee6bcca3f402.description:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Director, Solutions Engineering

What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will be responsible for all technical aspects of pre-sale customer engagement including actively driving and managing technology evaluations, working as a key advisor and advocate for our products and solutions, engaging with customers virtually or in person, performing engineering site or architecture assessments, and developing recommendations to assist customers with deployment of electric vehicle charging solutions infrastructure. You will also be responsible for developing RFP/Tender responses and providing training on our products. Key focus areas also encompasses electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE), infrastructure, and the operational needs of light, medium and heavy duty fleets, including vehicle,  energy management and battery storage solutions that consider the charging capabilities, dwell time, routing and scheduling of the vehicles, and integrations with 3rd party platforms. 

The applicant must be a critical thinker, self-motivated and able to effectively manage their time. 

Travel requirement: up to 50% travel across Europe, predominantly within the UK and Ireland.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

  • Maintain deep technical and business knowledge of electric vehicle and fleet directions and trends, and how to effectively integrate electric vehicles and charging infrastructure into fleet operations.
  • Develop and deliver presentations to partners and customers in support of the sales process, educating potential customers on the benefits of ChargePoint solutions.
  • Act as a technical consultant, learning and understanding customer needs and developing the right solutions; working with product management to help align product development with customer and market needs.
  • Maintain deep technical and business knowledge of market and industry trends, and how to effectively integrate electric vehicles and charging infrastructure into client business operations.
  • Responsible for identifying technical issues that may affect customer satisfaction and proactively work to resolve such issues.
  • Provide both general “best practice” and customer-specific engineering recommendations for ChargePoint software feature usage, API implementations and integrations with external systems.
  • Maintain knowledge of local electrical installation codes and relevant standards, specifically related to Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) and energy management solutions.
  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFPs/Tenders; assist in the development and execution of SoWs (statements of work) and other proposals.
  • Responsible for identifying technical issues that may affect customer satisfaction and proactively work to solve such issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor or Masters degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or equivalent
  • Minimum 8 years of combined experience in technical sales or technical consulting
  • Experience should include some: electrical engineering, telecommunications, information technology, software development, technical writing
  • Excellent presentation, oral and written communication skills
  • Strong customer facing and relationship building skill
  • Excellent written and oral language skills 
  • Fleet vehicle operations, High Power solutions, Battery Energy Storage or large facility experience desired. 

 

Location

UK- Remote

We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. 

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly.

a968abcd8f9e.description:
Web / Front End Developer - Research Participants - United Kingdom

 

 

Location: Remote (UK)
Type of contract: Freelance
Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time)

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Role
Do you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting web and front end developers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a web or front end developer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant
  • Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences
  • Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective
  • Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part

What you’ll bring

  • Residence in the UK
  • Fluent English
  • A device with a working microphone
  • No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.

Why join this project?
This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.

ccd3320fa0da.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. 555b67733891.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. Summary We are seeking an experienced Semiconductor Product Engineer to lead the development and deployment of manufacturing test solutions for next-generation AI accelerator devices. This role spans the full silicon lifecycle from first silicon bring-up through high-volume production, with responsibility for defining test strategy, developing ATE test content, debugging complex silicon issues, and optimizing yield, coverage, and test cost. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in DFT methodologies, high-speed interface testing, and advanced CMOS manufacturing, and will work closely with design, DFT, packaging, and manufacturing partners to ensure robust, scalable production of high-performance compute silicon. Key Responsibilities Define and develop test methods and strategies for an AI accelerator chip targeting high-volume manufacturing. Plan and manage manufacturing test content for advanced CMOS designs including high-speed logic, SRAM, DRAM, and high speed IO blocks. Develop and debug structural and functional test content such as scan/ATPG, LBIST, MBIST, JTAG, and HSIO tests. Bring up first silicon on ATE, including pattern debug, tester correlation, shmooing, and corner analysis. Support testing of high-speed interfaces such as PCIe Gen6 and multi-GHz LPDDR, including at-speed tests and margining features. Execute silicon characterization and failure analysis to identify yield limiters and defect mechanisms. Optimize test coverage, test time, and cost while maintaining manufacturing robustness. Work with DFT and design teams to improve testability and close coverage gaps. Collaborate with OSATs and external partners on test program deployment. Support advanced packaging test flows, including die-to-die interconnect testing and package-level thermal considerations. Contribute to documentation of test programs, debug procedures, and manufacturing release materials. Support qualification, reliability testing, and high-volume manufacturing ramp. Required Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on semiconductor test engineering experience. Experience developing ATE test programs (Advantest 93K, Teradyne, or similar). Solid understanding of DFT methodologies (scan, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST) and memory test techniques. Experience debugging silicon issues and correlating failures to design or process causes. Familiarity with advanced CMOS nodes and production test challenges. Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional engineering environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience testing AI accelerators, GPUs, networking ASICs, or other high-performance compute ICs. Experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6, LPDDR4/5/6, or other high-speed interfaces. Exposure to advanced packaging, chiplets, or multi-die test flows. Experience improving yield, reducing test time, or optimizing cost in high-volume manufacturing. How we work Ownership and execution: you will have full agency to drive your work forward Rapid iteration: we all work directly with top leadership to move from idea to hardware on ambitious timelines Full-stack engagement: hardware, software, silicon, and modelling teams all work closely together to create a product with generational impact Optimistic and pragmatic: we possess the will to win, and to do the hard work to get us there Team player mentality: the mission is bigger than any of us, and we have the curiosity and technical focus to see the best idea shipped, no matter who’s it is What We Offer Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role. 568f8c6ea8d6.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. The Role On the device, close to the metal, we write the runtime software that orchestrates work across the chip and runs performance-critical ML kernels. This is where performance gets real and the wins compound. Your work directly influences trade-offs for the silicon, system deployment, and the compiler. You'll drive the first accelerator compute runs, evaluating performance on silicon, running early benchmarks, and feeding results back into the hardware and software roadmap. What you’ll do Write and optimise performance-critical ML kernels in C, with assembly where it matters (RISC-V and our own ISA) Build the low-level control paths that feed those kernels, including scheduling, synchronisation, and data movement Write targeted validation workloads and microbenchmarks to keep simulation and hardware behaviour aligned and performance measurable. Profile, benchmark, and track regressions so performance improvements are real and repeatable Work closely with simulation, hardware, ML, compiler, firmware, and runtime engineers in a tight loop, turning profiling data into architecture feedback and real performance wins. What we’re looking for Proven deeply embedded software experience Strong performance instincts. You can reason about low-level architecture, memory behaviour, and where the cycles are spent Excellent C, and a pragmatic approach to building high-quality, maintainable low-level code Comfortable writing and debugging optimised assembly (RISC-V ideal) Collaborative and high-ownership. You communicate clearly, move fast, and enjoy working through hard problems with others Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Maths, Physics, or related degree and 3+ years of industry experience Nice to have Experience with GPUs or dedicated ML accelerators Rust and/or Python experience Experience with simulators (functional or performance) and writing validation or benchmarking workloads Familiarity with modern ML inference workloads If you want to build the software that turns cutting-edge hardware capability into real throughput and low latency, come build it with us. 902c2d676082.title: Senior Data Engineer
902c2d676082.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The role We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team. Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects. Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology. Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you. What you will do Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack. Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition. Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source. Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone. What you bring Must-haves 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production. Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience) Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries. Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage. Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database. Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files. Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line. You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers. A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away. Nice-to-haves Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines. Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect). Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database. LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration. A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians. What we offer Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research. Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day. Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes. Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission. Interview Process Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representativ

Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the DODO team in the Platform domain.
Your mission will be to build and maintain the common building blocks of Doctolib's system with a "Platform as a Product" mindset, abstracting and simplifying complex, critical data infrastructure so that product teams can focus on what matters: building faster, better products for healthcare professionals and patients. You will work closely with 600+ engineers across 70+ teams, owning the vision and strategy for data management products that form the foundation of everything we build.
Working in the product team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We operate in feature teams within an agile environment, collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business teams.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Define the product strategy and roadmap for data management products used by 600+ engineers, spanning multiple datastores (PostgreSQL/Aurora, Kafka, Debezium, Couchbase), file storage, data access, and data lifecycle solutions

0af34b9f281c.title: Senior AI Engineer
0af34b9f281c.description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. About AI Engineering at Rivia Given the highly complex nature of clinical trials and how they interface with our technology, the AI Engineering team at Rivia is pivotal in ensuring our clients achieve their desired outcomes and derive maximum value from our platform. The team designs and operates agentic, production-grade AI workflows that power critical monitoring, data quality, and insight-generation capabilities for clinical trial stakeholders.​ By building reliable, auditable, and scalable AI systems, AI Engineering helps transform fragmented clinical data into actionable intelligence and positions Rivia as the AI-first platform for clinical trial intelligence. The Role As a Senior AI Engineer at Rivia, you will architect and ship high-impact AI workflows that materially improve how clinical trial teams monitor studies, assess data quality, and make operational decisions.​ You will work as a key technical contributor embedded in product initiatives, owning AI features end-to-end from design and evaluation through to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.​ The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer who combines deep LLM and agentic systems expertise with strong software engineering skills, a bias to action, and a passion for turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, commercially impactful products in a complex, regulated domain. What excites you Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on the product, the business, and the team. Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials. Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential. Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape. Responsibilities Architect and ship production-grade agentic AI workflows, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, and structured outputs, for clinical trial intelligence use cases. Translate user workflows and product requirements into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production and optimize for user and business value. Design and maintain evaluation pipelines, including gold sets, metrics, and experiments, and use them to drive iteration with rigor. Implement robust LLMOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, cost and latency management, safe deployment, and continuous improvement of AI systems in production. Design high-quality retrieval and context pipelines with strong guarantees on correctness, provenance, and auditability, particularly in regulated environments such as clinical trials. Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, and Customer teams to ensure AI features are usable, trusted, and commercially impactful. Stay deeply current with the LLM ecosystem, actively experiment with new models and tools, and translate innovation into practical product advantage. What Excites us Product mindset, with a demonstrated ability to translate user workflows into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production Deep familiarity with the current LLM ecosystem and active experimentation with new models, tools, and techniques. Proven experience building and shipping production-grade AI or agentic systems, ideally in high-stakes or complex domains. Strong software engineering skills and comfort owning systems end-to-end, from design to deployment and maintenance. Experience going from 0→1 at a VC-backed startup or similarly fast-paced environment. Hiring Process Our hiring process takes 2-5 weeks over four distinct stages: Meet and greet: 30-minute call with the HR team to get to know each other. This is an informal chat. Technical Screening: 60-minute interview to delve into high-level technical concepts and your problem-solving approaches. Coding Interview: 60 mins with the team to assess your coding skills. Meet the team: 3-4 hours. Join us at our Zürich office for a visit that includes a team lunch and an in-depth technical interview to explore our mutual fit. Our Values At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you. In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions. bf5e9d4b20b2.title: Business Development Intern
bf5e9d4b20b2.description: Big changes start with people who want to achieve more. How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice? At Urban Connect , we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom. Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility. To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together. Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen? During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities. Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work. How you will make a difference Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions. Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts. Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected. Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes. Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships. Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions. Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps. Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team. What you bring An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject. Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative. An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply. Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things. Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us. An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team. Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus. Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it. What you can expect High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow. We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving. A view of the whole business. You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value. Direct access and room to take initiative. Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment. The opportunity to build a future with us. If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company. You will also benefit from: Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich. A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars. A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together! Ready to make a difference? Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself? We look forward to meeting you. d8f5bf8f3276.title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
d8f5bf8f3276.description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

  • Embedded Linux performance and system tuning
  • Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines
  • C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development
  • Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization
  • Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.
  • Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.

a3fdd820072d.title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
a3fdd820072d.description: About Stream Stream powers real-time Chat , Video , Activity Feeds , and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience. The role We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on. This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU. What you'll work on Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes. Job responsibilities: Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships. Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences. Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric. Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark. Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations. Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring. About you You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you. You have: Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java) A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production Bonus points: Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1) CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products Python or Rust alongside Go Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media What makes this role exciting Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships. Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company. Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use. Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached. Why join Stream? We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia). We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here. What we offer Company equity 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays Pension plan with a company contribution NS Business Card or a company bike, covered Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year Catered lunches in the office MacBook Pro Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice Highly sk

e6ab350907e7.title: Junior Accountmanager Software
e6ab350907e7.description: Wil jij jouw commerciële carrière een vliegende start geven en energie halen uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten? Opstellen, uitwerken en opvolgen van offertes. Begeleiden van het verkoopproces van eerste kennismaking tot opdracht. Onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van klantrelaties. Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en nieuwe commerciële kansen. Intensief samenwerken met consultants, productspecialisten en softwareontwikkelaars. Enige commerciële werkervaring of een sterke commerciële drive. Affiniteit met new business en acquisitie. Interesse in software, IT of digitale oplossingen. Een ondernemende, leergierige en resultaatgerichte instelling. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Een klantgerichte en enthousiaste uitstraling. Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Daarnaast zijn wij exclusief partner van Chemwatch binnen de Benelux en ondersteunen wij organisaties met internationale softwareoplossingen en actuele chemische informatie. Wat ITIS Products onderscheidt: Ontwikkelaar van de gespecialiseerde softwareoplossing SOFOS 360. Exclusief partner van Chemwatch binnen de Benelux. Een innovatieve organisatie waar ondernemerschap, ontwikkeling en samenwerking centraal staan. Veel ruimte om jezelf commercieel én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen. VDK Groep, de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland! ITIS Products is onderdeel van de VDK Groep: een familie van meer dan 115 zelfstandige bedrijven binnen de installatietechniek. Daardoor profiteer je van de slagkracht, ontwikkelmogelijkheden en zekerheid van een grote organisatie, terwijl je werkt binnen de ondernemende cultuur van een compact en innovatief softwarebedrijf. Zo krijg je volop kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en mee te groeien met een organisatie die blijft investeren in mensen, technologie en innovatie. Heb je interesse? 5ff4f2def8a9.title: Senior ML Engineer
5ff4f2def8a9.description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus! What you will do Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring. Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing. Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar). Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle. Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously. Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation. Support and mentor team members. Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc. Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team. Your profile 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field. Skills Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan. Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data. Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring. Experience in developing and deploying ML models for a consumer product (mature development processes), ideally in the healthcare space or a regulated environment. Ability to iterate quickly from ideas to experiments, learning from results and making data-driven decisions. Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the capacity to effectively convey technical concepts to diverse audiences. Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines. Experience with mentoring and leading team members. What we offer you A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam An enthusiastic, professional, and international team Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities Unlimited skin checks for you Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Kennis en ervaring hebt met netwerkvirtualisatie ingezet ten behoeve van selfservice. 96384d9862b3.title: AI Automation Intern (Sustainability)
96384d9862b3.description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. The Opportunity Join our global sustainability reporting team and help reinvent how we use technology and AI to bring greater transparency, efficiency, and accountability to ESG reporting. As stakeholder expectations and regulations evolve, we’re building the future of sustainability intelligence. We’re looking for someone passionate about the intersection of tech and sustainability, who’s eager to simplify systems and data by developing digital-first tools. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, global teams and wants to shape the next generation of ESG reporting. Who You Are You’re passionate about sustainability and innovation, always exploring how emerging tech—like AI—can drive real-world ESG impact. You enjoy coding, structuring data, and building automated solutions that solve complex problems. You thrive in global, cross-functional teams, communicate inclusively, and navigate diverse work cultures with ease. Analytical and solution-oriented, you turn regulatory complexity into clear, tech-driven actions. An entrepreneurial self-starter, you’re adaptable, results-focused, and eager to work on cutting-edge sustainability projects. You’re a recent graduate with a background in tech, strategy, data, economics or sustainability, based in the Netherlands (with the right to work here), passionate about using technology to solve sustainability challenges—and ready to grow in an international, dynamic setting. What you bring Strong interest in sustainability, ESG reporting, and emerging regulations (e.g., CSRD, ESRS, ISSB). Experience in application or through studies is a plus. Passion for technology and AI, with experience or interest in process automation, data integration, or reporting systems. Experience with data analysis, coding, building AI bots, or automating systems is a plus. Comfortable with systems such as G-suite, Microsoft Office, etc. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clarity. Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and present ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders. A self-starter mindset: proactive, adaptable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. Fluent in English; additional languages are a bonus. Bachelor’s degree or higher. Why Prosus? 8634fd504815.title: Lead Backend Engineer, Service Standards
8634fd504815.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.


You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.


The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.


You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.
  • Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.
  • Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.
  • Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.
  • Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.
  • Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.
  • Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.
  • Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.
  • Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

About you 

  • Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable services and frameworks.
  • Demonstrate a track record of driving cross-team technical alignment and leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering groups.
  • Possess expert knowledge in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Understand trade-offs in platform design and know how to build golden paths that engineers love to use.
  • Communicate technical vision and architectural choices clearly to both technical leads and engineering leadership.
  • Enjoy mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and sharing best practices to level up the backend engineering community.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Mont

072855fe16d5.description: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME) Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk Vakantiegeld 8% CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00 Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities Wat ga je doen: Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley. Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000 Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken. 👉 Is deze functie perfect voor jou? 40c575d77569.description: Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. About Priva Your Future Ecosystem Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s. What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide. Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably. With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong. Why this role matters At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability. As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance. This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform. Your role as Staff Engineer You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices. You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system. Your team You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology. What you’ll do Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks Contribute to software architecture and design decisions Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality gates Support application lifecycle management (ALM) Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA) What you bring 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux) Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles Experience with multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems) Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills Experience working in cross-functional and international teams Nice to have Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems Familiarity with Node-RED or control systems Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation What you get In numbers A competitive salary based on your experience; We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 8% holiday allowance; Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. For your own sustainability Be secured with our pension plan; Feel engaged and join our participation plan; Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football. Our values Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop. We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves. Apply Does this make you smile, and do you see yourself as our new Embedded Staff Engineer? Apply below or contact us for more information. We’ll get back to you within two weeks, we are keen to
