a883c70be939.title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
a883c70be939.description: At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services , and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. Your work will directly contribute to: Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) What You’ll Do Priva Digital Services & product engineering Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration Optimization & forecasting integration Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration Cloud infrastructure & DevOps Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring What you will NOT do This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective What We Offer You 💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience 🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price 🏦 Excellent pension contribution 🎓 €1,000 education budget per year ⏰ Flexible working hours, and location. 🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2) 🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer. 🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself 🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy 🍻 Twice-weekly drinks on Thursdays and Fridays Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

6e388b013cbf.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Large Molecules, Antibody Design)
6e388b013cbf.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist with deep expertise in therapeutic antibodies to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be an expert in antibody design and engineering who has taken antibodies through the whole process, from target selection and lead optimization to candidate selection and IND-enabling studies. Above all, you'll close the loop between AI-generated hypotheses and experimental data to share with the community. Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you'll drive antibody programs end to end and pressure-test AI-designed antibodies against the bar a real drug candidate has to clear. This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area. Key responsibilities Design and engineer therapeutic antibodies and oversee programs end to end, including target and epitope selection, choice of format (IgG, Fab, scFv, VHH, bispecific), humanization, affinity maturation, Fc engineering, and candidate selection Define the screening cascade for each program, from binding kinetics (SPR, BLI), epitope binning, and species cross-reactivity to cell-based functional assays and developability (expression, aggregation, polyreactivity, stability, viscosity, immunogenicity risk) Plan the path from lead to IND-enabling We build this as an access layer on the primitives the Gitaly team provides, for GitLab's own features and for the artificial intelligence agents now writing and pushing code alongside people. Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system. Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that control how code reaches a repository, who may change it, and how it is verified. Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews. Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency. Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you'll bring Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL. An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices. Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems. Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes. Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo. Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment. The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed. About the team Repository Services is a small backend team in the Create stage, formed in September 2026 when Source Code split into focused teams. As the split is finalized we expect to own repository mirroring, Git Large File Storage (LFS), protected branches and Branch Rules, push rules, Code Owners (shared with Code Review), and commit and tag signing. We build on Gitaly's primitives and meet regularly with the Gitaly team, and our work serves GitLab.com , self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. 7399abdb62c8.description:
About the Team

Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models, ensuring our models are deployed responsibly and have a positive impact on society. Our work spans diverse research and engineering initiatives—from system-level safeguards and model training to evaluation and red-teaming—all aimed at mitigating misuse and maintaining our high bar for safety. We lead OpenAI's commitment to developing and deploying safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), fostering a culture of trust, responsibility, and transparency.

Our goal is to continuously learn from deployments, distribute AI’s benefits widely, and ensure that powerful tools remain aligned with human values and safety considerations.

About the Role

The Safety Measurement Research Program Manager drives OpenAI’s strategy for safety measurement and evaluations, partnering closely with safety research, data science, and engineering to advance how we measure harm and safeguard efficacy across research and production.

You will work directly with researchers, data scientists, policy owners, and product teams who contribute to or use our measurement systems, identifying the most important problems to solve and shaping the data, dashboards, tools, and workflows we build for them. This role combines measurement expertise, product judgment, and cross-functional execution: you will engage with evaluation results and data workflows, make prioritization tradeoffs, and drive work from problem definition through rollout and iteration.

This position is based in San Francisco, CA, with relocation assistance available.

In this role, you will:

 - Define strategic priorities and product roadmaps to improve safety measurement and evaluation approaches and scale our measurement platform to new use cases, products, and the needs of cross-functional teams

 - Partner closely with research, data science, engineering, policy teams, and other stakeholders to craft a vision for understanding safety outcomes and prevalence across our products, and translate that vision into concrete programs of work.

 - Drive the integration of cutting-edge AI safety research into OpenAI’s safety measurement and evaluation platforms, working with researchers, data scientists, and engineers to navigate technical tradeoffs, coordinate dependencies, and resolve blockers.

 - Develop and continuously refine clear, actionable success criteria that effectively capture our ambitions with safety measurement and evals.

 - Represent quantitative progress on safety to senior leadership.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 6+ years of experience in research program management, technical program management, product management, or related roles, with expertise in AI safety, trust & safety, integrity, or related domains.

 - Have a strong foundation in data science, statistics, economics, or a related field, and hands-on experience with measurement or evaluations.

 - Enjoy working at the intersection of data science and AI safety research, translating evolving measurement needs into clear requirements, priorities, and roadmaps.

 - Can independently drive complex, cross-functional programs from problem definition through rollout, building alignment and unblocking decisions in ambiguous spaces.

 - Ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions, and exercise sound judgment about technical tradeoffs and the strengths and limitations of metrics and evaluations.

 - Build strong partnerships across research, data science, engineering, policy, and product, and communicate complex findings clearly to technical teams and leadership.

 - Are curious about AI safety and its societal impacts, learn new domains quickly, and adapt as research and priorities evolve.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. The loads involved are large enough — and arrive fast enough — that utility supply alone often can't meet the need on the timeline required, and the step-load behavior of large accelerator clusters creates power-quality and ride-through demands that conventional backup-generation designs weren't built for. Anthropic's Data Center Infrastructure team is responsible for solving that problem: delivering facilities that can be energized early, ride through grid disturbances, and present a well-behaved load at the point of interconnection (POI). As a Data Center Power Generation & Microgrids Engineer, you'll own the behind-the-meter generation and storage architecture for Anthropic's data center portfolio. That means the on-site generation fleet — reciprocating engine gensets, gas turbines, fuel cells — and the battery energy storage systems that buffer load steps and provide ride-through. It means the microgrid layer that ties them together: islanding and resynchronization, black-start, load-shedding, and generation dispatch. And it means the grid side: interconnection studies and agreements, IEEE 1547/2800 compliance, and power quality at the point of interconnection. You'll also own our temporary- and bridging-generation strategies — the plans that let a site energize and start serving load before permanent utility service is available, and transition cleanly once it is. This is a deeply cross-functional role. You'll work closely with colleagues across the infrastructure team on where and how generation and storage tie into the site electrical distribution, controls, and SCADA, and with our hardware and compute teams to understand the load characteristics you're designing against. At the scale we build, our campuses are typically served by dedicated high-voltage substations and a medium-voltage distribution network that may also integrate on-site generation and battery energy storage — and the protection, control, and automation layer is what keeps all of it selective, coordinated, and observable. As a Data Center Substation, Protection & Automation Engineer, you'll own the protection and automation architecture across Anthropic's US portfolio — from the utility point of interconnection (POI) through the HV/MV substation, the MV distribution loop, and down into LV switchgear. You'll develop and maintain our protection philosophy and reference relay settings, run and review the short-circuit, coordination, and arc-flash studies that underpin them, design the substation automation and SCADA architecture, and define how relays and meters integrate into the electrical power monitoring system (EPMS) — giving operators real-time visibility and sequence-of-events data when something trips. You'll also be our technical lead on the protection side of utility interconnection — working relay settings, transfer-trip, and ride-through requirements with transmission owners and ISOs/RTOs. Protection engineering and substation automation are the core of this role; substation physical design is a strong plus but not a prerequisite — we'd like to hear from protection and P&C engineers who have spent their careers on relays, schemes, and studies even if they haven't owned a substation general arrangement. You'll work closely with colleagues across the infrastructure team, our build partners' A/E firms, relay and switchgear vendors, and utility protection groups. Expect roughly 20–35% travel for witnessing factory acceptance and relay testing, and supporting site energization and commissioning. use findings to steer equipment selection, settings, and incident-energy mitigation Implement automatic transfer, load-shed, and restoration schemes in protection and automation logic, and make sure they stay secure and coordinated under every credible contingency Review protection and control design packages, relay settings calculations, and coordination studies from build partners and A/E firms against our basis of design, and drive closure on deviations and exceptions Substation automation & SCADA Design the substation automation architecture for each site — IEC 61850 station and process bus, GOOSE messaging, RTUs/gateways, local HMI, sequence-of-events recording, and time synchronization — and drive standardization of that architecture across the portfolio Integrate protective relays, meters, and switchgear controls into the electrical power monitoring system (EPMS) and substation SCADA; 1dbd50ec0d08.title: Research Operations Lead, Biology
1dbd50ec0d08.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the team Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a world-class research group focused on making fundamental biological discoveries. The team combines cutting-edge AI with hands-on biological research, positioning Anthropic at the forefront of AI-accelerated scientific discovery. About the role We are hiring a Research Operations Lead to be the operational backbone of our team: the person who makes sure scientists can walk in every morning and get straight to science. You'll take on the operational systems we've started — procurement, inventory, safety, equipment, space — make them better, and scale them as the lab and its needs grow. We're hiring for trajectory as much as for what you've already done: the scope of this role will grow with the size of the team, and we want someone who's excited by that. This role is a rare opportunity to build the operational foundation of Anthropic's biology team and to grow with it. The systems you put in place will shape how a frontier AI company does experimental biology for years to come. If you're energized by high-ownership operational work in the service of ambitious science, we'd love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Own day-to-day operations end to end: ordering and inventory, equipment scheduling and upkeep, consumables, shipping and receiving, and general space organization Build on and extend the operational systems a growing group needs: procurement workflows, inventory and sample tracking, equipment maintenance and calibration schedules, onboarding and training, SOPs Manage facilities and space: coordinate buildouts, moves, and equipment installs; act as the primary interface to building management, contractors, and Anthropic's central Workplace and IT teams Own the operating budget: track spend against plan, run the capital equipment purchasing process, and partner with Finance on forecasting and reporting Manage vendor and supplier relationships: including experience: sourcing suppliers, negotiating quotes and service contracts, and coordinating field-service and maintenance technicians Have tracked and managed an operating budget: purchase orders, invoices, spend-vs-plan, and capital requests Preferred qualifications Are the person everyone in your group already comes to when something is broken, missing, late, or unclear — and you like being 2a82399863d5.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
2a82399863d5.description: Software is eating the world, but AI is eating software. We live in unprecedented times – AI has the potential to exponentially augment human intelligence. Every person will have a personal tutor, coach, assistant, personal shopper, travel guide, and therapist throughout life. As the world adjusts to this new reality, leading platform companies are scrambling to build LLMs at billion scale, while large enterprises figure out how to add it to their products. To make them safe, aligned and actually useful, these models need human evaluation and reinforcement learning through human feedback (RLHF) during pre-training, fine-tuning, and production evaluations. This is the main innovation that’s enabled ChatGPT to get such a large headstart among competition. At Scale, our products include the Generative AI Data Engine, SGP, Donovan, and others that power the most advanced LLMs and generative models in the world through world-class RLHF, human data generation, model evaluation, safety, and alignment. The data we are producing is some of the most important work for how humanity will interact with AI. At the foundation of these products is the Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design and development of core data storage, streaming, caching, and indexing platforms and underlying systems. You’ll also get widespread exposure to the forefront of the AI race as Scale sees it in enterprises, startups, governments, and large tech companies. You will: Drive the architecture, design, implementation, and reliability of our foundational data platforms and systems, working closely with stakeholders and internal customers to understand and refine requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features. Proactively identify opportunities for, and driving improvements to, current programming practices, including process enhancements and tool upgrades. Present technical information to teams and stakeholders, providing guidance and insight on development processes and technologies. Provide technical leadership, including: upholding and upleveling engineering standards across the organization, mentoring junior engineers. Ideally you’d have: 8+ years of full-time engineering experience, post-graduation with specialties in back-end systems, specifically related to building large-scale data storage, streaming, and warehousing systems. Extensive experience in various database technologies (MongoDB, Postgres), streaming/processing solutions (Kinesis, Flink, Spark), indexing/caching (ElasticSearch, Redis), and various data query engines (Trino, Presto, Snowflake, etc.). Show a track record of mentoring and leading teams in successful projects. Possess excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Experience working fluently with standard containerization & deployment technologies like Kubernetes and various public cloud offerings. Extensive experience in software development and a deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud platforms and data systems. Experience driving cross functional collaboration and communication at an organizational or broader level. Nice to haves: Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices and CI/CD tooling (CircleCI). Experience with performance tuning and cost optimizations of cloud based data platforms. Experience defining a data lifecycle strategy and designing/implementing tooling for data privacy (i.e. GDPR) needs. Experience scaling products at hyper-growth startups. 57722a837386.title: Blockchain Security Engineer, Bridge
57722a837386.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward. We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement. What you'll do We're hiring a Security Engineer to build and scale the Bridge security foundation. This is a rare opportunity to design a security program from the ground up, while also leveraging the infrastructure, best practices, and tooling of one of the most mature security organizations in the industry. Responsibilities Design and implement the Bridge security roadmap from first principles to production. Identify and tackle the most important Bridge security risks quickly and pragmatically. Integrate with Stripe infrastructure where it makes sense, and find custom solutions where it doesn't. Lead threat modeling and hardening efforts for the Bridge money movement systems in collaboration with crypto and infra teams. Build key security capabilities, including monitoring, secrets management, incident response, access controls, and CI/CD hardening. Reinforce engineering best practices around secure development and infrastructure. Ensure Bridge meets compliance and audit expectations as we scale to more regulated markets. Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and the Stripe security organization to move fast without compromising safety. Who you are Minimum requirements 8+ years of experience in Security engineering. Experience building or scaling security programs at a startup or in an embedded role. Preferred qualifications Experience in fast-paced startup environments, building security practices from the ground up. Startup mindset—scrappy, pragmatic, and quick to solve the most critical problems. Comfort writing and debugging backend application code, with Ruby experience preferred. Comfort with ambiguity and ability to ruthlessly prioritize. Ability to balance security rigor with speed, especially in fast-moving environments. Clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders. Interest in the potential of crypto and stablecoins to power global financial infrastructure.

Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. What you’ll do About the internship Stripe's Applied ML, Data Science, Risk, and Payments organizations are excited to offer Master's machine learning engineering internships for the summer of 2027. This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to critical projects that directly enhance Stripe's suite of products, focusing on areas such as foundation models used for dozens of tasks e.g. fraud detection, enhanced support, and predicting user behavior. As an intern, you'll tackle challenging problems at the intersection of finance, technology, and data. You'll have the chance to work on creative projects like the Stripe Assistant and the Stripe Foundation Model, which leverage machine learning to revolutionize how businesses interact with financial services and data. Responsibilities Develop and deploy large-scale machine learning systems that drive significant business value across various domains. Engage in the end-to-end process of designing, training, improving, and launching machine learning models. Write production-scale ML models that will be deployed to help Stripe enable economic infrastructure access for a diverse range of businesses globally. Collaborate across teams to incorporate feedback and proactively seek solutions to challenges. Rapidly learn new technologies and approaches, demonstrating a strong ability to ask insightful questions and communicate the status of your work effectively. Who you are Minimum requirements A deep understanding of computer science, obtained through the pursuit of a Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related field, with the expectation of graduating in winter 2027 or spring/summer 2028. Practical experience with programming and machine learning, evidenced by projects, classwork, or research. Familiarity with languages such as Python, Scala, Spark and libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn. Expertise in areas of machine learning such as supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, ML operations, and possibly experience in Large Language Models or Reinforcement Learning. Demonstrated ability to work on collaborative projects, with experience in receiving and applying feedback from various stakeholders. A proactive approach to learning unfamiliar systems and a demonstrated ability to understand complex systems independently. Intent to return to the degree-program after the completion of the internship/co-op. Preferred qualifications You Might Also Have: Two years of university education or equivalent experience, with in-depth knowledge in specific domains of machine learning. Published and presented peer-reviewed articles in top-tier venues. Experience in writing high-quality pull requests, maintaining good test coverage, and completing projects with minimal defects. Familiarity with navigating new codebases and managing work across different programming languages. Excellent written communication skills to clearly articulate your work to both team members and wider Stripe audiences. Application requirements Please submit the following with your application: A detailed resume or LinkedIn profile showcasing your work history. Examples of relevant work and your approach to learning, such as GitHub repositories, StackOverflow contributions, or other project portfolios. Join us for an unforgettable summer internship and help shape the future of global commerce. At Stripe, you won't just be working on theoretical projects; you'll make a tangible impact on the world's economic infrastructure.

ABOUT THE ROLE

OpenAI’s largest and most strategic customers are turning AI ambition into deployments that change how their organizations work. As a Delivery Lead, you will own delivery of priority AI initiatives for these customers, leading complex, high-impact deployments from planning through launch and adoption.



You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth.



This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. Lead complex customer engagements from scoping and planning through deployment, launch, and initial adoption.

 - Build and drive an integrated delivery plan. Establish clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures across customer, OpenAI, and partner teams.

 - Resolve blockers and drive decisions. Identify risks early, work through dependencies and resource constraints, and bring the right stakeholders together to resolve tradeoffs and keep delivery moving.

 - Lead launch readiness and activation. Drive rollout and enablement planning, address technical and organizational readiness gaps, and remove barriers to initial adoption and usage.

 - Connect delivery to customer value. Define expected outcomes and measurement approaches with customers and account teams. Track adoption and consumption, assess results against agreed baselines, and communicate the value achieved.

 - Provide a clear view of delivery health. Lead customer and internal delivery reviews that drive decisions and action. Communicate progress, launch confidence, risks, and implications for expected consumption and revenue timing.

 - Improve how we deliver. Turn customer experience into repeatable playbooks, practical tools, and actionable feedback for product and delivery teams.






WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise technology deployments, customer delivery programs, or transformation initiatives involving multiple teams and partners.

 - A track record of driving programs from scope through launch and adoption, with accountability for delivery commitments and measurable customer outcomes.

 - Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand AI systems, APIs, integrations, enterprise architecture, security dependencies, and deployment risks.

 - The ability to translate customer priorities into actionable delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures.

 - Strong judgment under ambiguity, including the ability to identify material risks, navigate competing priorities, and drive timely decisions.

 - Experience building trust with customers and leading across teams outside your reporting line while holding stakeholders accountable to shared commitments.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, technical specialists, and customer operators and explain complex delivery issues clearly.

 - Commercial awareness and an understanding of how deployment, adoption, and consumption contribute to customer value and growth.

 - A practical approach to building repeatable delivery methods while adapting to the needs of individual

8e6f6385734f.description:
About the Team

Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models. We work across research, engineering, product, and policy to understand risks, develop and validate safeguards, and support responsible deployment.

Our work spans safeguards research and deployment, safety assessments, launch readiness, and trusted-access programs for advanced capabilities. We address risks including biological and cyber misuse and misalignment, with programs that strengthen safety across models and products.

About the Role

We’re hiring Research Program Managers across AI Safeguards and Frontier Risks Safety. You’ll lead programs that develop and improve the safeguards used across our models and products, or assess and mitigate risks associated with frontier capabilities, launches, and trusted-access programs.

You will partner with researchers, engineers, and other stakeholders to turn open safety questions into clear programs of work. You’ll shape technical roadmaps, coordinate execution, and use evidence to guide priorities and inform development and deployment decisions. We’re looking for people who combine strong technical judgment, experience managing complex research programs, and a commitment to AI safety.

These roles are based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Shape safety programs and technical roadmaps. Partner with research and engineering leads to define goals, milestones, dependencies, and success criteria. Prioritize intake and emerging findings, resolve blockers, and balance immediate safety needs with longer-term research and platform investments.

 - Drive safeguards development and deployment. Translate safety research into safeguards across models and products. Maintain an end-to-end view of safeguard coverage, effectiveness, and opportunities for improvement for one or more risk areas, and drive a roadmap that advances across launches.

 - Coordinate evaluations and safety assessments. Organize capability evaluations, alignment and control assessments, adversarial testing, and safeguard stress-testing, including risks from autonomous and multi-agent systems. Support embedded assessments throughout model development, internal use, and deployment.

 - Drive safety readiness and trusted-access programs. Coordinate safety requirements and execution across frontier model launches and deployments. Work with technical teams to define assessment scope and the evidence needed to inform safety and access decisions.

 - Turn findings into improvements. Triage safeguard gaps, jailbreaks, and overflagging with accountable teams. Establish owners and escalation paths, track remediation and regression testing, and turn recurring issues into research and engineering improvements.

 - Strengthen the evidence behind safety decisions. Support safety cases that connect claims to evaluations, safeguards, assumptions, and remaining uncertainty. Surface evidence gaps and unresolved risks, and communicate methods, results, limitations, and follow-up actions through assessment reports, system cards, and updates to decision-makers.

 - Build programs that scale across products. Coordinate shared tooling and feedback workflows, privacy and security requirements, and safeguard user experience and quality assurance. Help teams apply safeguards consistently across product surfaces and upcoming launches.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in technical safety work, owning technical programs, or related roles in fast-moving environments.

 - Have led complex research or technical programs involving researchers and engineers, particularly in AI, cybersecurity, biosafety, or another field where failures can have serious consequences.

 - Understand frontier AI safety concepts, including capability evaluations, alignment, control, monitoring, and safeguard robustness, and can engage substantively with technical teams.

 - Can assess what evaluation results do and do not establish, including methodological limitations, uncertainty, and the difference between model capability and real-world risk.

 - Can turn ambiguous questions into clear programs, make practical tradeoffs, and adjust priorities as evidence changes.

 - Have worked extensively across research, engineering, and product teams and can coordinate with policy and communications partners.

 - Exercise sound judgment when findings are concerning or incomplete, raise unresolved risks constructively, and communicate complex technical work clearly.

 - Are motivated to help ensure increasingly capable AI systems remain beneficial and under meaningful human control.

cc9648180222.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Infrastructure Specialist (North America)
cc9648180222.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


ABOUT NORTH:

North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.




WHY THIS ROLE?

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. Our esteemed clients include industry leaders like RBC, Dell, and LG CNS.

We are seeking engineers who deeply care about customers and want to work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI.



In this role, you will:

 - Lead end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout.

 - Partner with enterprise IT teams to assess infrastructure, security requirements, and data management practices.

 - Experiment at a high velocity and with a high level of quality to engage our customers and ultimately deliver solutions that exceed their expectations

 - Design and implement deployment strategies tailored to client needs, ensuring compliance with data privacy and security standards.

 - Troubleshoot and resolve deployment-related technical issues, providing timely solutions to minimize downtime.



You may be a good fit if:

 - You have experience with and enjoy working directly with customers

 - You have experience deploying enterprise software in private/hybrid cloud environments

 - You have proven experience administering production Kubernetes clusters and expertise with Helm

 - Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and tools like Git for version control

 - You have strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP), networking, and virtualization

 - You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities and objectives are a moving target




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

e3b083204ed8.title: Software QA Engineer II
e3b083204ed8.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon’s RF sensors detect and locate drones so public safety and critical infrastructure teams can protect airspace. You will own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor capabilities — spanning regression, integration, and real-world validation — so those systems are trustworthy in the lab and in the field. You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions.

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation.
  • Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility.
  • Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details.
  • Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling.
  • Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use.
  • Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders.
  • Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own.
  • Share knowledge with the wider team, give actionable feedback, and support newer engineers and interns through pairing, reviews, and onboarding.
  • Use approved agentic AI tools regularly to design tests, analyze results, and draft documentation and review AI output against quality, security, and performance standards before you rely on it.

 

What You Bring

  • A degree or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded systems, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience testing software that runs on or with hardware (embedded products, devices, sensors, or similar systems), including independently owning the test and quality approach for that work.
  • Experience with RF, embedded, sensor, or similarly hardware-integrated systems, with the technical aptitude and curiosity to develop deep expertise in RF sensor technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests or test tooling, ideally in Python pytest, with the ability to independently support hardware-backed regression testing.
  • Comfort working in Linux-based systems (SSH, Networking).
  • A collaborative, quality-focused working style: you Join Forces with others, Own It on the quality of the work you take on, and speak up with candor when something is unclear or broken.
  • It’s a plus if you have experience with drones or hardware-in-the-loop / continuous integration test setups and an interest in supporting others as they grow.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

274dd9f8916c.description: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot ) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the role Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions. This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction. You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy. What you'll be doing Own the mobile test strategy: Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests). Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app. Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it. Build reliable E2E automation: Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting. Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe. Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green. Bring AI into the SDLC: Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes. Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on. Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns. Prevent defects, not just catch them: Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written. Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact. Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call. What we're looking for Essential: Hands-on experience with Maestro or Detox. 6+ years in quality engineering or test automation , with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests. Experience introducing AI-assisted testing practices (test generation, failure clustering, coverage analytics) with sensible controls around review and trust. Strong TypeScript and JavaScript - not just writing test scripts, but building helpers, tooling, and debugging into the app when needed. Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control. Comfortable with mobile E2E automation , or strong E2E experience on another platform plus a credible plan for getting productive on mobile quickly. Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting). Desirable: Hands-on experience testing React Native apps. Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness). API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy. Our tech stack Mobile: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, EAS, GraphQL, Relay, Jest, React Testing Library, Maestro. Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes. Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana. Our system starts from what a customer already has: knowledge base articles, support conversations, tickets, system logs, and agent traces. From that evidence it reverse-engineers how the business actually runs and writes the process down as instructions a person can inspect and an agent can execute, with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input. We're looking for AI Research Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You'll work on our agentic learning environment: the loops that turn human corrections and agent outcomes into better knowledge and instructions over time. The job combines applied research with ownership of production systems. You find a failure, form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and ship the fix into real customer workflows. You'll spend most of your time advancing our core context-learning library and the harness that powers our agents across every customer. The work spans continuous learning, context engineering, agent orchestration, and evaluation. You'll contribute to our knowledge benchmarks and to the self-improving capabilities of the harness. What You'll Do Build and extend our core context-learning library, turning customer-informed problems into reusable platform capabilities. Design and implement LLM-powered systems and agentic workflows from concept to production. Build agentic features for knowledge management: agents that can edit, update, and maintain large knowledge bases autonomously. Build continuous learning loops that use human corrections and production outcomes to find knowledge gaps, detect changed procedures, and improve prompts and instructions. Build reliability and confidence systems: evaluation frameworks, confidence scoring, and logic for when to automate and when to escalate to a human. Architect async, scalable systems that handle complex AI orchestration. Contribute to the direction of our AI strategy and product capabilities. What We’re Looking For You've built a complex, production LLM system with real depth: multiple layers of engineering decisions you can walk through, including what changed after real users arrived. You have practical depth in one or more of context engineering, retrieval, agent orchestration, memory, evaluation, or learning from feedback. You have experimental judgment. 0bf755460675.title: Intern - Chief of Staff to the Group CMO - Paris
0bf755460675.description:
Artefact is an AI-native company fusing engineering-grade delivery with strategic consulting to drive high-impact results. We specialize in accelerating end-to-end data and AI transformation, helping enterprises turn marketing into a predictable engine for business growth across the value chain. From strategy to implementation, Artefact delivers bespoke, scalable AI solutions tailored to our clients' core business challenges.

Headquartered in Paris, Artefact operates across 27 countries with a global team of over 2,500 employees, partnering with leading international brands across luxury, retail, FMCG, industry, healthcare, and finance.

To support our rapid expansion, we are looking for a Chief of Staff to the Group CMO (Intern) to join our Global Marketing team starting in January 2027 for a minimum of 6 months.

The Role

Are you passionate about B2B marketing, tech innovation, and generative AI? Do you want to work in an environment where your contributions directly accelerate business growth?

As the Chief of Staff to the Group CMO (Intern), you will play a central role in driving Artefact’s flagship initiative: "AI-Augmented Marketing". This global project reshapes how our international marketing teams operate by embedding analytical rigor, agentic AI workflows, and operational excellence into everyday execution.

Working directly alongside the Group CMO, you will collaborate closely with regional marketing teams, data scientists, and business analysts worldwide. Fluency in English is essential, as you will lead international workshops, align stakeholders, and scale best practices across all Artefact entities.

What you will do

  1. Strategic orchestration: Support the Group CMO in executing the global AI-Augmented Marketing roadmap across three core pillars :
  • Analytics & strategy: Derive actionable insights from the marketing data platform to guide executive decision-making.
  • Agentic content workflows: Automate content operations by building and deploying an AI skill/agent library using tools such as Gemini Enterprise, Claude, and Lovable.
  • Global enablement: Scale adoption across international hubs by designing learning modules, documenting playbooks, and running hands-on training sessions in English.
  1. Go-to-market & revenue operations: Leverage AI tools and skills to optimize inbound and outbound funnels, drive pipeline velocity, and enhance Marketing-Sales alignment for sustained lead generation.
  2. Performance measurement & reporting: Build, maintain, and optimize full-funnel B2B performance dashboards (awareness, activation, ABM) to measure campaign ROI and surface continuous improvement opportunities.
  3. Operational excellence: Own and update cross-functional tracking tools, operational dashboards, and meeting cadences to maintain project momentum and organizational alignment.
  4. High-impact copywriting & editorial: Produce high-converting editorial assets (internal/external newsletters, landing pages, case studies, and thought leadership articles) while safeguarding brand tone and positioning.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s student from a top-tier Business School (Grande École de Commerce) or equivalent university program.
  • Analytical mindset: Strong data-driven problem-solving abilities; comfortable working with analytics platforms, data modeling, and reporting frameworks.
  • AI & Tech native: A genuine passion for emerging technologies, generative & agentic AI tools, and B2B growth marketing.
  • Communication & copywriting: Bilingual or fluent in English (both written and spoken) with exceptional writing skills across long-form, web, and newsletter formats.
  • Project management: High organizational agility, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mindset: Proactive, autonomous, results-oriented, and excited to collaborate with cross-functional, international teams.

Additional Details

  • Start date: January 2027
  • Duration: 6 months minimum
  • Location: Paris Headquarters (with hybrid flexibility)
  • Salary : 1200€
  • Opportunity: High potential for conversion into a permanent contract (CDI) based on mutual fit and performance.

Artefact is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit solely based on merit and business needs, fostering an inclusive environment free from discrimination of any kind.

443ec627110e.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société française de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. 

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. 

En tant que stagiaire Data Scientist, tu seras responsable de : 

  • La réalisation de projets de données (sécurisation de la livraison de vos projets)  
  • La communication de ton travail et réalisations au sein de l’équipe
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec ton homologue conseil pour établir et entretenir des relations solides avec vos clients et mieux comprendre leurs besoins 
  • S’assurer que tes solutions apportent des valeurs à la problématique client  
  • Rechercher et développer de nouvelles approches techniques pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes
  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer aux connaissances institutionnelles d’Artefact

  Tu es ?  

  • Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Mathématiques appliquées, Statistiques ou Informatique.
  • Tu es à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.
  • Tu possèdes une bonne compréhension de l'écosystème numérique et data et de ses technologies : web analytique, programmatique, DMP, Datalake, dataviz, data science, etc.
  • Tu as un fort intérêt pour les problématiques business. 
  • Tu as un esprit pratique et analytique, et possèdes d’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes, y compris la capacité de désagréger les problèmes, d’identifier les causes profondes et de recommander des solutions. 
  • Maîtrise du français (écrit/oral) obligatoire pour le bureau de Paris pour travailler en équipe et de l’anglais professionnel pour communiquer avec nos clients internationaux 

Le petit + : une première expérience (stage, projet scolaire, Junior Entreprise, etc.) en conseil et/ou écosystème de données est une valeur ajoutée ! 

     Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

  • Développement professionnel : CDI à la clé (85% de conversion) ; socle de formation (onboarding, retex, café tech, deep dive de use cases tech...) développement des compétences via des outils internes innovants.
  • Développement personnel : collaborez avec les experts dans leur domaine, tu apprendras des meilleurs ; feedbacks réguliers via counsellor, managers, équipes et RH.
  • Environnement de travail unique : flexibilité télétravail; évènements d’équipe et d’entreprise ; localisation idéale dans le 9ème arrondissement !
  • Socle de formation (training day, Retex, café tech) développement des compétences via des outils internes innovants 

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte. Le groupe s'engage à reconnaître et promouvoir tous les talents, quelles que soient leurs croyances, âge, handicap, parentalité, origine ethnique, nationalité, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle, appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité, ou toute autre caractéristique qui pourrait faire l'objet d'une discrimination.

4b04d7f989c1.description: As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com 's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build. This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments. Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office. About the Role Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com 's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes. You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption. This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com . What You'll Do Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout. Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there. Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself. Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim. Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion. What we promise This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts. a5a1ab8fd5fa.title: Senior Backend Developer
a5a1ab8fd5fa.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load. You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache. You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies. You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end. You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong. You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises. You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over. English is your working language. German is a plus. What makes you stand out You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax. You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model. You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama. You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it. The team We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action. We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you. The facts Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith Pensum: 100% Start: As soon as possible La
