b7ed4b2b6ed3.description:
About Doctolib

Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals.

More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. 

Since 2013, Doctolib has been striving for a healthier world by providing new-generation technology. With more than 2,800 employees across France, Italy, Germany and the Netherlands, Doctolib improves the daily lives of healthcare professionals and serves more than 80 million Europeans, offering a fast, frictionless, and secure journey for all their care needs.

What you'll do

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

As a Fullstack Engineer, your mission will be to work on web features for our secure medical communication solutions that enable healthcare professionals to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues both within and beyond their organizational walls. You will be working in a feature team developing a product that powers Europe's largest medical network with over 1M healthcare professionals.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Frontend (React): building and owning web features, reviewing code and setting quality standards
  • Backend and APIs (Java): API-focused work that supports the frontend and the features it owns
  • Technical leadership and delivery ownership: estimates, delivery plans, breaking down projects, giving the team context, accountability for results
  • Collaboration and team practices: working with the PM and Designer, supporting ways of working and processes, mentoring other engineers
  • Managing the full development lifecycle, including stakeholder communication and production issue debugging

About our tech environment

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. To address these challenges, we are modularizing our platform run in a distributed architecture through reusable components.
  • Our stack is composed of React, TypeScript, Java, Rails, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here and learn about our first AI hackathon here!

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

  • You have 5+ years experience working as fullstack software engineer on user facing applications
  • You have experience with React, Typescript and one or more of our backend technologies (Java, Rails...)
  • You have experience running software on cloud infrastructure, ideally AWS
  • You have experience working with database technologies, preferably JPA, MySQL, MongoDB and Elasticsearch/Opensearch
  • You enjoy figuring out why things work, not just that they work
  • You're fluent in English

What we offer

  • Company pension scheme through our partner Allianz
  • 27 days of annual leave per year (and the ability to accrue more days on your work anniversary!)
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • Free breakfast and lunch plan every day on-site
  • Bike lease scheme with our partner Lease a Bike, 35% price below the market
  • Discounted membership with Urban Sports Club
  • Continuous training programs on all key competencies (English, soft skills, expertise)
  • Reimbursement of public transportation if you live outside the Amsterdam highway ring
  • Parent Care Program:  Various initiatives supporting parenthood, including 100% paid parental leave up to 16 weeks, including bonuses, for mothers and up to 5 weeks for the co-parent, flexible return and 3 days of leave per year for child sickness
  • Relocation support for international mobilities

The interview process

  • Recruiter Interview
  • Coding Interview
  • System Design Interview
  • Behavioral Interview
  • Offer!

 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

1cfb04191eb8.title: Embedded Engineer
1cfb04191eb8.description: Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience About us AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. The role As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers. What you will do Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses. Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition. Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer. Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition. Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface. Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery. Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer. Take part in code review and help move the set-up from prototype to a reproducible, maintainable tool. Your profile MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field. ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation. Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux. Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ). Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware. Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks. Comfortable in the lab: reading schematics, using an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, and debugging where hardware and software meet. Experience with Git and collaborative code review. Full professional proficiency in English. We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you. Bonus Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition. Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig. Deine Schwerpunkte: Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren. Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran. Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen. Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases. Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt. Was wir suchen Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype. Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat. Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein. Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen. Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren. Remote führen. Du führst auch aus der Ferne wirksam. Du kommunizierst proaktiv, machst Entscheidungen schriftlich nachvollziehbar und bist für das Team gut erreichbar. Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich. Klar kommunizieren. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung. Ein großer Teil des Teams arbeitet gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Leipzig, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kocht fast jeden Tag zusammen. Du arbeitest remote von überall in Deutschland, dein Wohnsitz muss in Deutschland liegen. Zweimal im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Team-Events, und ab und zu gibt es Teamtage in Leipzig. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest. Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft Vergütung Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff. 37cd85c0e5ab.title: Senior Software Engineer
37cd85c0e5ab.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Autonomous Drone Software Engineer to join a swarming programme. As an engineer on a lean, high-impact team, you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects. 

You will not be siloed; this role spans the entire autonomy lifecycle, from developing autonomy capabilities to investigating real-world flight-test data. 

The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Take ownership and drive the development of new features across the autonomy stack and partner integrations
  • Collaborate closely with hardware engineers, product managers, and external partners to define system requirements and translate them into robust software architecture
  • Design and implement robust distributed state machines, leader election protocols, and fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Deliver clean, readable and maintainable code while confidently managing complex concurrency and contention scenarios
  • Develop and run rigorous tests utilizing SITL/HITL simulation environments to validate code prior to physical deployment
  • Actively participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical documentation to elevate the team's engineering standards
  • Act decisively during flight-test investigations, applying strong engineering judgment to physical failure modes and release safety

Qualifications and Skills

  • 3+ years of professional engineering experience in robotics, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
  • Deep proficiency in modern C++, with practical experience designing, reasoning about, and debugging highly concurrent systems.
  • Embedded systems experience working close to hardware on real-time or safety-critical platforms (e.g., avionics, automotive, robotics).
  • Strong architectural understanding of distributed systems, with the ability to deliberately evaluate and select consensus designs.
  • Familiarity with robust release management, versioned artifacts, and pinned dependencies.
  • Experience with PX4, MAVLink, and related drone software ecosystems is a plus
  • EU citizenship required 

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Wellpass membership

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

f322f49819bf.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
f322f49819bf.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Wellpass membership

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

e992dfb5d0fe.title: AI Systems - Senior Software Engineer
e992dfb5d0fe.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

 

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on our AI Systems team, you'll build the AI foundations and product experiences of Ledgy: the Ledgy Agent, the tools and skills it runs on, our MCP server, and the platform capabilities that let other teams embed AI safely in their domains. You'll collaborate with fellow engineers, product managers, and designers in a new and fast-moving product area where correctness matters as much as speed - our customers need equity data they can trust.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

The team you'll join:
AI Systems - Develops Ledgy's AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.

What You'll Work On

Help build the future of how companies manage equity.

  • Ledgy Agent. You'll design and build the system behind our in-app agent, so equity administrators can do through AI what they do manually in the app today. Ledgy Agent takes real actions and runs real analysis on live equity data, like onboarding a stakeholder end to end, and administrators depend on its accuracy and observability. You'll design the tools, skills, context, and orchestration behind it, and how it decides to handle each request.
  • Ledgy MCP. Not everyone wants to open Ledgy to get things done. Our MCP server lets customers bring equity into the AI agents and tools they already use. You'll shape it alongside the in-app agent, so a capability built once works in both places, and you'll decide what we expose and how we keep it safe.
  • Measuring and improving the agent. You'll design and build the system we use to measure the agent's quality and learn from how customers use it: evaluations, tracing, and feedback from real conversations. You decide what "good" means for customers, how we measure it, and how what we learn changes what we build next.
  • Scaling. The Ledgy web application, the agent, MCP, and surfaces we haven't built yet all need the same capabilities. You'll design the foundations that let us build AI features once and reuse them everywhere, and that let other teams add AI to their domains without compromising correctness. You'll also design how it runs as usage grows: the backend infrastructure, cost, and latency behind the agent and MCP, and how we keep them reliable and observable.

You'll own real parts of this and have a say in where we invest. You'll also spend time with customers to see how administrators actually use the agent, and use that to decide what to build next.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, with strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals across back end and front end
  • You've built and shipped agentic or LLM-based software to production, such as an agent, an assistant, or a chat product, and you've been the one running it. You've debugged failures in real conversations and kept cost and latency in check as usage and models changed.
  • You've designed the agent itself: tools and skills, context and prompt engineering, state, streaming, and the agent loop. You know at least one agent framework or runtime well and can say where it works and where it doesn't.
  • You improve these systems with evidence. Evals, regression sets, tracing, and feedback from real usage tell you whether a change helped, and you use them to decide what to do next.
  • You keep up with what the foundation labs and the wider community are learning about building agents. You try new techniques early and judge which ones make our product better and are worth adopting now, and which should wait.
  • You take part in deciding what we build. You read the data, talk to customers, and push for what you think matters most.

Our Tech Stack

We work in a TypeScript monorepo: React and Tailwind on the front end, tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. It runs on GCP with Kubernetes, managed through Terraform. The agent is currently built on the Vercel AI SDK, and we run an MCP server alongside it.

You don't need to know all of it, but hands-on experience building with LLMs is strongly preferred.

f57dd2e6c62c.title: Microwave Design Engineer
f57dd2e6c62c.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator. Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead. Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer. YOUR IMPACT As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator. WHAT YOU WILL DO Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints. Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs. Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core. Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market. At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Operations team at Stark builds and maintains the core data pipelines, sensor logging, and annotation workflows that feed our AI and perception models. Operating at the intersection of hardware testing, flight logs, and machine learning, the team ensures high-throughput, high-fidelity data availability. We work closely with ML Engineers, perception experts, and external labeling partners to scale training data for autonomous defence systems.

YOUR MISSION

You are the crucial bridge between our raw field data, our external labeling partners, and our internal Machine Learning teams. Your mission is to ensure our AI models are trained on the highest quality data possible. You will own the day-to-day operations of the data labeling lifecycle: curating raw data, preparing annotation batches, managing vendor communication, and rigorously assessing the quality of incoming labels. If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, and interested in the intersection of data operations and Computer Vision, this is the perfect place to start your career in AI.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Own the day-to-day data labeling lifecycle: curate raw field data, create annotation batches, and prepare deliveries for external labeling companies.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for external data annotation vendors, clarifying edge cases and providing feedback on labeling guidelines.
  • Conduct rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) assessments on incoming label deliveries, track error rates, and create performance reports.
  • Support data curation efforts, filtering and selecting the most valuable sensor data (images, video, lidar) for model training.
  • Work closely with ML Engineers to understand their data needs, edge cases, and specific Computer Vision requirements.
  • Help maintain the data catalog by ensuring incoming datasets are properly tagged and logged.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented: you can manage multiple data batches, vendor deliveries, and QA processes simultaneously without dropping the ball.
  • Strong communication skills: you are comfortable coordinating with external vendors and writing clear, unambiguous instructions/guidelines.
  • Basic understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning concepts (e.g., bounding boxes, segmentation masks, object tracking).
  • Comfortable with basic scripting (Python) and data querying (SQL) to automate small tasks or filter data batches.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver who enjoys bringing order to chaotic data deliveries.
  • Fluent in English.

 

 

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

Seit über 40 Jahren unterstützt AlixPartners seine Klienten – mit inzwischen knapp 4000 MitarbeiterInnen in 27 Büros weltweit.

Data Science:

  • Einsatz von Python oder R zur Analyse und Modellierung komplexer und umfangreicher Daten.

35acd503fdc1.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations
35acd503fdc1.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

What does the team work on?

Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico with 70+ million active accounts. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The depth of query, content, and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness on the search and discovery journey, and this team owns the models that power it across the Roku platform.

What is the role?

The depth of query, content and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness in their search journey. Solving this customer problem is why we’re actively looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations to drive further innovation in search and discovery. The person in this role will leverage their technical skills, business intuition, and analytical thinking to build best-of-class AI-powered products. Communication and presentation skills are important. The role requires both high technical acumen and problem-solving abilities, motivation, and exceptional attention to detail. Every day, you’ll look at what exists and find ways to make it better.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Apply state of the art ML on search using techniques in deep learning, bandits, transformers, LLMs, causal inference, and optimisations to make our users more delighted and engaged on the platform
  • Run online AB tests and analyse them against the critical business KPIs
  • Collaborate with US engineering teams as well as cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Nurture our ML ecosystem to make it withstand scale, developer velocity and future business shifts
  • Provide technical leadership to drive technical and ML roadmap for search ranking and monetisation

The Company You’ll Join

Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

We're looking for talented Solutions Consultants  to join our  EU Investors team. Our customers are primarily Venture Capital, Private Equity and Private Credit Funds.  Carta's platform allows these clients to track and manage their portfolios while liaising with their investors.

As a member of the Solutions Consultant team, you will collaborate with the Go-To-Market team in their sales process with investment firms to identify and build the best solution for the customer.  Our offering includes fund administration services, portfolio management, investor management, investor portal, digital KYC and data collection.  We offer a tech-focused platform for investment managers to manage their investment portfolio, fundraise and manage investor relationships. They are supported by a best in class team of fund accountants that they will work with on a day to day basis.  

You will partner closely with the Fund Administration and Product teams to be an expert on our product and service offerings.

You will work with new venture capital funds as they navigate the process of forming a new fund.  That process involves advising them on best practices and referring them to additional vendors which may include fund formation lawyers and tax professionals. You will also work with established and upmarket fund managers, providing consultative advice to help them improve their fund operations and LP communications with Carta’s industry leading technology.

The Problems You’ll Solve 

  • Impart confidence and gain trust and faith of the prospects in Carta’s holistic fund administration solutions. Tactically, entails accompanying the Go-To-Market team on calls with investment firms to understand in depth the customer needs and pain points, “connect the dots” to scope a solution and communicate the business impact to key decision makers
  • Partner closely with all team members of the Fund Admin team (in particular Delivery and Product teams) to lead the technical aspects of sales cycles and partnership conversations. ‘Technical’ refers to product and fund accounting knowledge (such as financial and equity technicalities including but not limited to waterfall, financial reporting, analytics, etc.).
  • Interface (pre sales) with prospects and strategic channel partners to scope requirements and build confidence in Carta’s products. Lead technical demos of Carta products. Communication fluency with executives particularly in finance and legal domain is required.
  • Provide product and technical financial expertise to drive meaningful progress towards a team quarterly revenue goal. Be a key contributor to the Carta product roadmap based on holding in-depth conversations with prospects. Partner closely with R&D ,sales and delivery leadership to achieve this.Provide technical coaching to all members of the Go-To-Market team as needed
  • Support BD team at partner offsite seminars and events

About You

(Even if you don’t have all of the qualifications we’ve listed, please apply if you believe you could be impactful in this role!)

  • You are a qualified accountant with 7+ years of experience in accounting or another relevant area such as corporate finance.
  • In-depth understanding  of fund structures (Private Equity, Venture Capital, or Private Credit)
  • A strong understanding of Venture Capital or Private Equity, ideally with regards to back office fund operations and fund administration. 
  • Experience working in private markets within Luxembourg, including familiarity with Luxembourg fund structures and the local regulatory environment. 
  • Proven track record of stakeholder management or client relationship management and excellent communication skills. 
  • You will have an interest in software products built to solve technical financial problems. You will be interested in talking to prospective customers,helping them to build and solve their operational problems. 

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working in a SAAS customer facing role 
  • Experience in a Fund Accounting / Fund Administration role. 
  • Knowledge and experience of European Alternative Funds regulations.

28d92ab649df.title: Lead / Principal Engineer - Full Stack
28d92ab649df.description:
A different kind of organisation

  • High trust, transparency, and autonomy
  • Small teams, high ownership, flat structures
  • Radical compensation transparency
  • Sense of ownership in collective success
  • Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft

The role

As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role  and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.

What the work looks like

We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:

  • Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.
  • Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.
  • Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.
  • Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.

What you'll do

Frame Problems & Propose Solutions

  • Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.
  • Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Lead Through Technical Excellence

  • Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.
  • Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems  and the practices that keep them that way.

Influence, Advise, and align

  • Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.
  • Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams
  • Converge competing priorities into a path forward.
  • Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.

Operate Across Technology Domains

Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.

You'll thrive here if

  • You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity.
  • You think in systems, not isolated parts.
  • You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you.
  • You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail.
  • You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast.
  • You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem.

What we're looking for

  • Demonstrable building software systems in complex environments.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot.
  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale.
  • Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs.
  • Direct experience working with customers and business stakeholders.

What will you experience in terms of culture at Sahaj?

  • A culture of trust, respect and transparency
  • Opportunity to collaborate with some of the finest minds in the industry
  • Work across multiple domains

What are the benefits of being at Sahaj?

  • Unlimited leaves
  • Life insurance & private health insurance
  • No hierarchy
  • Open Salaries

5657ea1e562e.description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

Are you excited about solving real, hard problems? Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. You will learn to write copy that makes elite investors act, map the entire market of investors, decide who to target, and deploy AI to outperform a teams of 20+ people.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career, apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way
  • Unlimited growth potential. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our conferences

Your Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will vary; however, some of them will be to:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value to the client.

What we expect from you

You possess an unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency. You have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, are proactive and follow through on commitments. Moreover, you’re humble and you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. Furthermore, we expect that you:

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

 

Practical details

 

Role is full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week.

Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year.

The start date is flexible.

Essential skills and experience

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with excellent attention to detail
  • Comfortable working under pressure, both independently and as part of a team
  • Proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for data analysis, reporting and presentations

8aba03936c60.description:
At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level.

Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights. 

At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level. Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights.  

The Lightcast platform is a benchtop laboratory instrument that uses microfluidics to allow precise and highly flexible control of thousands of aqueous microdroplets using software-generated light patterns. Control systems enable the integrated optical, mechanical, and fluidic sub-systems to perform complex workflows and assays used in the search for drug candidates. 

We are seeking a Senior Mechatronics Engineer to join our team and take a leading role in system design and engineering activities. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience delivering complex systems within a product business through a background in Electronics, Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering, with an emphasis on designing and debugging systems at the intersection of hardware, firmware and control. You will have: 

  • A strong technical track record in designing complex mechatronic products for function, reliability, manufacture, serviceability and cost  
  • Hands-on and analytical approach to debugging complex systems, problem solving and resolution ownership 
  • Full end-to-end development experience in mechatronic and electronic systems, having worked with development and manufacturing teams to engineer and improve product designs 
  • Deep subject matter expertise and extensive experience in developing and delivering complex measurement systems and instrumentation  

Your responsibilities: 

  • Working with our development, manufacturing and support teams to design, develop, deliver and maintain our platform and microfluidic products 
  • A strong focus on delivering electro-mechanical system architecture designs

9d8ed236029b.title: Staff AI Engineer, Developer Productivity
9d8ed236029b.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. 

About the role

Oura is rebuilding how it builds software. Every engineer has agentic tooling, and our own pipeline already takes a well-formed ticket to a reviewed, tested commit stack. It runs interactively, headless, and on a cloud sandbox fleet, with its own evals and tracing. We are looking for engineers who use AI as a fundamental building block of both the products we ship and the way we build them.

That is a strong start on one stage of the lifecycle. The next step is the whole loop. As a Staff Engineer on the AI Transformation team, you will architect and own the system that turns agentic development from something power users do into the way hundreds of engineers across iOS, Android, backend and AI services ship every day. That means spec and intake, planning, implementation, review, testing, CI/CD, release, observability and incident follow-up, each with agents doing real work and humans keeping judgment where it matters.

This is a fast-moving, LLM-forward team. We prioritize rapid prototyping, iterative loops and AI-native development, with the speed of a startup and the reach of a product used by millions of members. You can work hybrid from our UK office in London. You will need the existing right to work in the UK; we are not able to sponsor a visa for this role. 

You will build the pipeline, measure it, and make it trustworthy enough that teams choose it. Success is measured in validated changes reaching members faster and safer: time to a trustworthy signal, escaped defects, cost per merged change, and how many squads run on the paved path because it is better, not because they were told to.

What you will do

You don't need to do all of these on day one, but these are the kinds of problems you'll own:

  • Set the technical direction for the agentic pipeline: Make our existing ticket-to-PR pipeline dependable infrastructure. Own its architecture, including agent orchestration, context management and tool calling, and improve its reliability, throughput, cost and developer experience across mobile, backend and web repositories. Run it unattended where the risk allows.
  • Close the loop across the SDLC: Extend agentic workflows beyond code generation into spec quality checks, test generation, automated review, CI failure triage and repair, release verification, and post-deploy signals, so the system improves from what happens after merge.
  • Prototype fast, then harden: Get a new workflow running in days, prove it on real tickets with real squads, and turn what holds up into production infrastructure.
  • Run AI in production properly: Agents in production take more than an API call. Own the eval sets, LLM-as-a-judge grading, versioning, tracing and dashboards that tell us whether a workflow change made things better, including the hardest case: a change that passes CI and is still wrong. Track the numbers that matter (merge rate, rework, time-to-signal, cost per change, escaped defects) and make them visible to engineers and leadership.
  • Make autonomy safe: Design sandboxing, permissions, human checkpoints and guardrails proportional to risk, with privacy by design as the default. Health data, security and infrastructure changes get stronger controls; low-risk, easily verified work runs hands-off.
  • Lead AI-native engineering by example: Set the bar for AI-augmented engineering across the organization. Show in your own work what a pipeline-first engineer ships, and raise the craft of the engineers around you.
  • Drive adoption with the teams: Embed with squads and their AI DRIs, find where the pipeline breaks on real work, fix the system rather than the single output, and turn what works into paved paths, skills, templates and docs other engineers can extend.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work with platform, developer productivity, security and privacy, AI infrastructure, mobile and backend squads, product and design, and engineering leadership to make trade-offs explicit and keep everyone moving on one system instead of five parallel ones.

Requirements

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

  • An experienced builder: Building and operating production systems that other engineers depend on, including developer tooling, internal platforms, or AI infrastructure at scale. We weigh demonstrated outcomes over years.
  • Proven with agentic loops in production: You have built and operated agentic coding workflows or autonomous loops in a real engineering organization, beyond demos: background agents producing PRs, automated review, CI repair, test generation, or similar, with adoption and measured results.
  • A whole-lifecycle thinker: You reason about specification, review, testing, CI/CD, release and operations as one system, and you know where the bottleneck moves when code generation gets cheap.
  • A technical leader: You

e38def184040.title: Senior Software Engineer
e38def184040.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This role is for builders who thrive in 0→1. In Axon’s Global Artificial Intelligence pillar, you’ll build a stealth product with a small team and a big mission: deliver something the market hasn’t seen, and do it with pace.

As a Senior Software Engineer I, you’ll lead key areas of the product from concept through launch. You’ll make pragmatic architecture decisions, keep quality high while moving fast, and help the team turn prototypes into a scalable product. 

This is an AI-native delivery role: AI is a primary lever for how you ship, not an add-on and you have true Product acumen and ability to craft and build products end to end. 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the build of major product surfaces and services; own features end-to-end from design to operations.
  • Drive product clarity in ambiguity: define the problem, shape MVP scope, set success metrics, and align stakeholders on what “done” means.
  • Build and ship software AI-natively across the SDLC (planning, implementation, testing, code review, debugging, and operations), with clear validation practices to maintain correctness and quality.
  • Measure and improve delivery outcomes using engineering metrics (lead time, PR throughput, defect rates, test coverage, incident load) and iterate on how the team ships.
  • Make architecture choices that balance speed and scalability—knowing when “temporary” becomes “permanent.”
  • Build and enforce engineering hygiene that doesn’t slow you down (testing strategy, CI/CD, observability, sensible release practices).
  • Partner tightly with Product and Design (and operate effectively when they’re not in the room) to prioritise, sequence, and ship the highest-value increments.
  • Mentor engineers and help establish a high-trust, high-ownership culture.

Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: SVP, AI

What You Bring

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including ownership of product capabilities in production.
  • Demonstrated, heavy AI-native delivery: consistent use of AI across the SDLC with concrete examples of faster delivery and maintained/improved quality.
  • Strong engineering judgement under uncertainty; ability to simplify and still build something great.
  • Experience building cloud-native services and/or modern user experiences that scale.
  • Comfort working across boundaries: product, design, customers, and platform dependencies.
  • Product judgement sufficient to ship: ability to frame problems, define MVP scope, make trade-offs, and drive to measurable customer outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Startup or internal incubation experience.
  • Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into product experiences responsibly.
  • Track record of accelerating teams through strong technical leadership.
  • Experience operating in PM-light environments where engineers help drive prioritisation and discovery alongside delivery.

Benefits that benefit you

  • Competitive base salary and RSUs
  • Comprehensive pension plan with matching contribution
  • Private health insurance & cash plans
  • 30 days paid holiday + UK public holidays
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave
  • GymPass subscription
  • Life assurance & income protection
  • Career growth support and wellness resources

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

 

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

2df517de09bf.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer
2df517de09bf.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

 

About the role

As a Mid-level Software Engineer at Ledgy, you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.

This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

Teams we are hiring for:

  • Core Equity — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.
  • Workflows & Automation — Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.
  • Reporting — Transforms Ledgy’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.
  • Tax — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.

You will thrive in the role if you

  • You have 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer
  • You are comfortable building and shipping production-quality features across the stack
  • You enjoy learning complex domains and turning them into simple, maintainable product experiences
  • You care about clean, tested, readable code and thoughtful collaboration
  • You are curious about equity, financial workflows, and their real-world impact on companies and employees
  • You’re excited to grow your technical judgement through code reviews, pairing, and architecture discussions
  • You take ownership of your work while asking for input early when trade-offs are unclear

Our Tech Stack*:

We have a modern, cohesive stack that lets us move fast while maintaining quality:

  • Language: TypeScript
  • Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC
  • Backend: tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal
  • Infrastructure: GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions

*We don’t expect proficiency in this specific stack

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Be paired with an onboarding buddy who will introduce you to the world of equity management
  • Get to know your engineering team, product managers, and designers
  • Learn how your team’s domain connects to the broader Ledgy platform
  • Set up your development environment and start contributing small, well-scoped changes
  • Build familiarity with our codebase, product workflows, and engineering practices

First 3 months:

  • Ship product features and improvements with increasing independence
  • Work with teammates to break down problems, understand trade-offs, and deliver reliable solutions
  • Participate actively in code reviews and team discussions
  • Develop a deeper understanding of how companies manage and automate equity
  • Contribute to improving quality, maintainability, and user experience in your team’s domain

First 6–12 months:

  • Own medium-sized features from implementation through release
  • Collaborate with Product and Design to shape pragmatic, user-centric solutions
  • Contribute to technical discussions around data models, workflows, and scalabi

7170b4cf5a68.title: AI Systems - Senior Software Engineer
7170b4cf5a68.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

 

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on our AI Systems team, you'll build the AI foundations and product experiences of Ledgy: the Ledgy Agent, the tools and skills it runs on, our MCP server, and the platform capabilities that let other teams embed AI safely in their domains. You'll collaborate with fellow engineers, product managers, and designers in a new and fast-moving product area where correctness matters as much as speed - our customers need equity data they can trust.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

The team you'll join:
AI Systems - Develops Ledgy's AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.

What You'll Work On

Help build the future of how companies manage equity.

  • Ledgy Agent. You'll design and build the system behind our in-app agent, so equity administrators can do through AI what they do manually in the app today. Ledgy Agent takes real actions and runs real analysis on live equity data, like onboarding a stakeholder end to end, and administrators depend on its accuracy and observability. You'll design the tools, skills, context, and orchestration behind it, and how it decides to handle each request.
  • Ledgy MCP. Not everyone wants to open Ledgy to get things done. Our MCP server lets customers bring equity into the AI agents and tools they already use. You'll shape it alongside the in-app agent, so a capability built once works in both places, and you'll decide what we expose and how we keep it safe.
  • Measuring and improving the agent. You'll design and build the system we use to measure the agent's quality and learn from how customers use it: evaluations, tracing, and feedback from real conversations. You decide what "good" means for customers, how we measure it, and how what we learn changes what we build next.
  • Scaling. The Ledgy web application, the agent, MCP, and surfaces we haven't built yet all need the same capabilities. You'll design the foundations that let us build AI features once and reuse them everywhere, and that let other teams add AI to their domains without compromising correctness. You'll also design how it runs as usage grows: the backend infrastructure, cost, and latency behind the agent and MCP, and how we keep them reliable and observable.

You'll own real parts of this and have a say in where we invest. You'll also spend time with customers to see how administrators actually use the agent, and use that to decide what to build next.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, with strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals across back end and front end
  • You've built and shipped agentic or LLM-based software to production, such as an agent, an assistant, or a chat product, and you've been the one running it. You've debugged failures in real conversations and kept cost and latency in check as usage and models changed.
  • You've designed the agent itself: tools and skills, context and prompt engineering, state, streaming, and the agent loop. You know at least one agent framework or runtime well and can say where it works and where it doesn't.
  • You improve these systems with evidence. Evals, regression sets, tracing, and feedback from real usage tell you whether a change helped, and you use them to decide what to do next.
  • You keep up with what the foundation labs and the wider community are learning about building agents. You try new techniques early and judge which ones make our product better and are worth adopting now, and which should wait.
  • You take part in deciding what we build. You read the data, talk to customers, and push for what you think matters most.

Our Tech Stack

We work in a TypeScript monorepo: React and Tailwind on the front end, tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. It runs on GCP with Kubernetes, managed through Terraform. The agent is currently built on the Vercel AI SDK, and we run an MCP server alongside it.

You don't need to know all of it, but hands-on experience building with LLMs is strongly preferred.

En tant qu’ alternant·e Sales Development Representative , tu es le premier point de contact et le premier maillon de notre chaîne commerciale. Ton rôle est stratégique : transformer l’intérêt d’un prospect en une opportunité commerciale réelle pour les Account Executives. Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Tes missions en soutien de l'équipe Sales En binôme avec nos commerciaux et sous la responsabilité de ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e pour découvrir le métier de Sales Development Representative (SDR). Ton parcours d'intégration & d'apprentissage : • Deux semaines d'immersion : Découverte de nos métiers, de nos équipes et de notre vision globale. • Intégration à la Sales Academy : Tout du long de ta formation, tu bénéficieras d'un accompagnement sur mesure (formations techniques sur la copropriété, ateliers pratiques sur les méthodes de vente). • Suivi régulier : Des échanges hebdomadaires avec ton/ta manager pour accompagner ta montée en compétences et lever tes blocages. • Perspective d'évolution : En fonction de ta progression et de ton projet, tu pourras élargir ton champ d'apprentissage en découvrant les étapes suivantes du cycle de vente auprès de nos Account Executives. Les avantages : Les plus : Salaire : selon grille syntec Une forte montée en compétence sur les métiers de Sales, la vente complexe, la connaissance de l’environnement start-up et immobilier, Poursuite possible en CDI avec évolution en Account Executive par la suite. Idéalement, tu : As un bon relationnel, tu es à l’écoute et tu te sens à l’aise au téléphone Aimes trouver des solutions pour tes clients et tu aimes convaincre ton audience As envie de monter en compétences et d’évoluer sur les métiers Sales Recherches une alternance d’un ou deux ans et tu parles français couramment Bonus : tu as déjà réalisé des jobs étudiant/ jobs d’été/ missions d’interim’ (restauration, vente, accueil, événementiel, animation, etc.) Tu hésites entre les challenges de la vente complexe en B2C et le plaisir de parler à des individus très différents pour les fédérer autour d’un projet ? Tu apprécies autant les outils digitaux que rencontrer tes prospects là où ils se trouvent ? Tu rêves d’une équipe où tout le monde s’entraide pour atteindre et dépasser ses objectifs, sans oublier de passer de bons moments ensemble, pendant ou après les heures de bureau ? De participer à la création d’un leader européen des services immobiliers ? Ne cherche plus et postule pour nous rejoindre ! Entretien téléphonique avec un.e recruteuse (15-20 min) Entretien technique avec deux Account Executive pour une mise en situation en visio (30 min) Rencontre nos Sales Manager, Inès , Justine Offre sous 24/48h 🎉 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Quality, excellence, and agility drive our delivery processes and you will help us level these up. Set and uphold higher quality standards and drive adoption of best practices in architecture, security, and DevOps. Volta has created a data collection and enrichment ecosystem for curated EP lab data which is fed into a physician validated, machine learning methodology to support complex AF solutions. Our newest technology, Volta AF-Xplorer II, is a data-driven AI decision support system that easily integrates into the standard physician workflow, providing a patient-tailored approach to complex AF and AT procedures. Our dynamic, innovative team is made up of 100+ collaborators in the EU and USA from a wide variety of backgrounds including engineers, business professionals and physicians, working together to develop AI solutions that help electrophysiologists help patients. Mission As Lead Data Science, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Volta's AI technology. You will lead a multidisciplinary Data Science team and contribute directly to the development of innovative machine learning solutions embedded in medical devices used daily in electrophysiology labs worldwide. Reporting to the VP Innovation, you will combine scientific expertise, technical leadership and people management to drive the development of next-generation AI algorithms while ensuring compliance with medical device quality and regulatory standards. Your Responsibilities Technical Leadership Define and drive the Data Science roadmap in alignment with product and business priorities. Lead the design, development and validation of state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms. Ensure scientific excellence and promote best practices in AI research and development. Stay up to date with the latest advances in AI and identify opportunities to integrate new technologies into Volta's products.
