Product Development Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Clinical, Regulatory and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle. Contribute to software architecture discussions involving AI components. Ensure production-ready, maintainable and high-quality code. Participate in the preparation of technical documentation required for regulatory submissions. Scientific & External Collaboration Represent Volta Medical at scientific conferences and technical events. Contribute to publications, patents and collaborations with academic partners. Communicate AI strategy and technical achievements to executive leadership, partners and investors. Your Profile Education & Experience PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or a related field. 10+ years of experience developing Machine Learning solutions in an industrial R&D environment. 5+ years of experience leading technical teams or mentoring Data Scientists. Technical Skills Strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and statistical modeling. Excellent understanding of model development, evaluation and deployment. bca1f7766cef.title: Solution Architect / Solution Engineer
bca1f7766cef.description: Une nouvelle vision de la billetterie, au service du monde de la culture, des événements en direct, des loisirs et du sport. Bienvenue chez vivenu, leader mondial de la billetterie événementielle et l'une des entreprises technologiques à la croissance la plus rapide au monde. Nous avons révolutionné la billetterie de sites et producteurs comme les Grammy Awards, les Golden Globes, Fondation Louis Vuitton, Fondation du Patrimoine, Le Mans FC transformant les process de billetterie et les données collectées lors des parcours de vente en avantage stratégique. Bénéficiant d’investissements à hauteur de 65 millions de dollars, vivenu permet aux organisateurs d'événements de mettre en avant leur identité, de transformer l’expérience client, et d'intégrer la billetterie de manière transparente dans leur écosystème numérique. vivenu s’engage auprès de ses partenaires pour assurer un support d’excellence et pour répondre de façon simple à leurs enjeux en créant des expériences exceptionnelles. Rejoignez-nous et participez à la transformation des métiers de la billetterie et du marketing. En tant que Solution Architect, vos responsabilités comprendront: Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations sur mesure (connexions API, systèmes d’authentification SSO, ERP, etc.) en vous appuyant sur les puissants outils proposés par vivenu. Accompagner nos grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs boutiques en ligne existantes vers une architecture moderne, entièrement pilotée par nos API. Collaborer avec les différentes parties prenantes techniques de nos clients — directeurs techniques, équipes informatiques, agences web externes, etc. — afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de définir des plans d’action clairs et concrets. Veiller à ce que les attentes et les besoins des clients soient alignés avec les capacités de vivenu. Vous serez également le principal interlocuteur technique en interne pour traiter les problématiques complexes qui surviennent vente en période d’exploitation. Utiliser des scripts, l’IA et le prototypage pour tester rapidement différentes solutions . Vous transformerez ensuite les solutions éprouvées en guides et modèles d’intégration réutilisables à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Vous immerger dans des secteurs d’activité variés afin de relever de nouveaux défis techniques, de la conception initiale jusqu’à la mise en œuvre de la solution. Intervenir en tant qu’expert technique aux côtés de nos équipes commerciales, en les conseillant sur l’architecture des solutions, la faisabilité des intégrations, les délais et les ressources nécessaires. Rester impliqué tout au long de la phase de mise en œuvre afin de garantir que la solution livrée corresponde pleinement aux engagements pris auprès du client, tout en identifiant et en anticipant les éventuelles contraintes techniques en amont de la livraison. Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir dans ce rôle : Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Solution Architect, Ingénieur ou dans un rôle technique similaire. Une expérience en développement ou une solide expertise technique, ainsi qu’une évolution assumée vers la relation client, les enjeux business et la conception de solutions. Une bonne compréhension du fonctionnement des applications web, des API REST, des webhooks, de la modélisation des données et des interactions entre les différents composants des écosystèmes logiciels modernes. Une capacité à lire et comprendre rapidement une documentation d’API, à écrire des scripts fonctionnels pour tester des solutions et à analyser ou déboguer du code généré par l’IA. Une réelle aisance dans les échanges avec des clients exigeants, ainsi que la capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et à cadrer les attentes avec assurance. Un diplôme universitaire en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine scientifique ou technique connexe. Français & Anglais courant (niveau C1/C2) requis afin d’assurer une communication fluide et professionnelle avec nos clients et partenaires francophones. Pourquoi rejoindre vivenu ? Pour être au cœur de l’exploitation de clients de renommée mondiale, en redéfinissant l’expérience utilisateur, grâce à une technologie de rupture. Une croissance durable Nous nous développons durablement en mettant l’accent sur la rentabilité et sommes soutenus par des fonds d’investissement de premier plan. Cela signifie un investissement continu dans nos employés, nos produits et notre vision à long terme. Une équipe engagée et mue par l’excellence Collaborez avec plus de 170 professionnels dévoués, comprenant des leaders venant de Google, Slack et Salesforce. Ensemble, nous façonnons l'avenir des technologies au service de la culture, des événements et des loisirs. Une emprise globale Nous sommes une équipe riche de sa diversité, axée sur le mérite — et répartie dans six bureaux dans le monde. Le talent et l'impact sont ce qui compte avant tout chez vivenu. Une croissance rapide Sifted classe vivenu parmi les scale-ups à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous sommes nourris par la volonté d’apprendre au quotidien et de nous améliorer continuement. Développer notre position de leaders et contribuer directement à la transformation de notre industrie Travaillez aux côtés de visionnaires — des fondateurs de Forbes 30 Under 30, aux lauréats du prix Executive of the Year. Chez vivenu, vous contribuerez à établir les nouvelles normes de l'industrie de la billetterie. Consultez la mission et les valeurs d'entreprise de vivenu ici . Chez vivenu, nous croyons que nos employés sont la clé de notre succès – et que l’esprit audacieux et la diversité de nos collaborateurs sont une richesse. Nous nous engageons à créer un cadre de travail qui offre à chaque collaborateur la possibilité de contribuer au succès de tous et de s'épanouir. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

6bc6660ad3df.title: CDI - Junior Digital & Data Marketing Consultant – Paris
6bc6660ad3df.description:
Qui sommes-nous?

Artefact est une nouvelle génération de société spécialisée dans le conseil en data et en marketing digital data-driven, dont les 2500 employés répartis sur 27 pays ont pour mission de transformer les données de nos clients en impact business tangible.

La société est née en France en 2014 et à connu une croissance forte, sur son métier historique, le conseil data marketing, mais aussi progressivement sur tous les cas d’usages data appliqués à l’entreprise. Artefact est soutenu par des investisseurs de premier plan (Cinven), européens, et qui visent à bâtir un leader mondial dans son secteur.

Le département Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact 

Au sein des bureaux parisiens, l’équipe Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact France est composée de 65 consultants dont le rôle est de construire les stratégies digital marketing les plus adaptées aux enjeux de nos clients, de les déployer et d’en mesurer la performance. 

En fonction des besoins des clients, nous aurons un rôle de conseil (stratégie, diagnostic de performance, modèle opérationnel, feuille de route, …) et/ou un rôle de mise en oeuvre avec les opérations de campagne et le déploiement de mesure du ROI (attribution/incrémentalité/MMM)

Ces projets s’appuient sur une expertise complète des canaux marketing et des plateformes en Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatique, Retail media, mais aussi sur une expertise et en plein développement du GEO.


Missions

Le/a consultant(e) marketing digital et data intervient dans le cadre de projets à forte valeur transformationnelle pour les équipes de nos clients. Épaulé de spécialistes du marketing digital et encadré par un manager/directeur, il est responsable de l’exécution des projets. Son objectif ultime est de concevoir des réponses marketing, média et data en réponse aux problématiques business de ses clients. Ses principales missions sont :

  • Cadrage et orchestration des projets : interviews clients et partenaires, mise en place de workshops,  préparation des uses cases
  • Construction de roadmaps et d'analyses marketing : performance média, business, études concurrentielles, créatives, analyses d’audience
  • Formulation et présentation de recommandations stratégiques pour le client, et mise en place avec les équipes clients ou internes (stratégie de mesure, campagne média, setup d’audience, audit de performance digitale, …)

Vous êtes ?

  • Issu(e) d’une formation école de commerce, vous bénéficiez d’un niveau bac +4/5 ou supérieur.
  • Vous avez une première expérience en stage ou en alternance
  • Vous possédez un fort intérêt pour le domaine du marketing digital
  • Vous êtes curieux/se, proactif/ve, autonome, à l’écoute. Vous avez une prise de parole structurée et synthétique ainsi qu’une facilité à travailler en équipe. 

Pourquoi postuler ?

  • Développement professionnel :  évaluation de performance semestrielle avec promotion potentielle ; trainings day mensuel ; développement des compétences via outils internes innovants.
  • Développement personnel : collaborez avec les experts dans leur domaine, vous apprendrez des meilleurs ; feedbacks réguliers via parrain, managers, équipes et HRBP.
  • Environnement de travail unique :  équipe jeune (moyenne d'âge 28 ans);  flexibilité télétravail ; séminaires d’équipe, entreprise ; localisation idéale dans Paris 9ème !
  • Package salarial compétitif, en adéquation avec vos compétences et expériences.

Package de rémunération : 35k€ fixe à 40k€ fixe + 3k de variable

Process de recrutement : 

  1. HR
  2. Entretien technique, un(e) Manager ou Directeur + Partner

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte, notamment de croyances, de genre, d’âge, de situation d'handicap, d’origine ethnique, d’orientation sexuelle, d’appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité.

cb418dea2f55.description:
Présentation du poste : 

Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Data Consultant(e) pour accompagner la transformation Data & IA de nos clients C-Level (COMEX, marketing, digital, supply-chain, opérations, customer support, IT...). Le/la consultant(e) pilote avec une large autonomie des projets complets de bout en bout, supervisé(e) par un n+1 (manager, directeur, partner), et encadre les consultants plus juniors. 

 

Missions : 

  • Piloter un ou plusieurs streams : garantir le delivery, identifier les points de blocage, proposer des solutions, assurer la gestion de projet (documentation, planning, comptes-rendus)
  • Encadrer et donner des feedbacks constructifs aux membres juniors de l'équipe
  • Produire de manière autonome les livrables de mission : présentations, benchmarks, études de cas, workshop decks, sections steerco
  • Rédiger des storylines et concevoir des slides percutantes
  • Animer les interviews et workshops clients
  • Construire une relation de confiance avec les clients et identifier des opportunités business
  • Contribuer au développement d'Artefact : développement d'une offre, d'une industrie, d'un chapter ou d'un partenariat école ; participation au recrutement et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants
  • Soutenir et développer une ou plusieurs expertises internes (stratégie, data governance, data marketing...) via la construction d'offres, la formation, ou des actions marketing

 

Profil recherché :

  • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle en cabinet de conseil
  • Double profil "business" et "data" : curieux(se), passionné(e) par la data et les évolutions technologiques
  • Esprit analytique, goût pour la résolution de problèmes
  • Expérience en gestion de clients et identification d'opportunités commerciales
  • Maîtrise de la Suite Google/Pack Office et des outils de workshop ; excellente communication en français et en anglais (écrit/oral)

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre : 

  • Localisation en plein cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)
  • Environnement pluridisciplinaire en forte croissance
  • Formations régulières et montée en compétences sur les méthodes de travail tech (product mindset, agilité)
  • Culture entrepreneuriale fondée sur l'innovation, la collaboration et l'action

 

Process de recrutement : 

  • HR Interview : 30/45' - entretien de motivation, culture et éligibilité avec un(e) Talent Acquisition Specialist
  • Consulting Manager : Business case - partie fit (motivation, soft skills, valeurs) puis use case avec synthèse de la solution (réponse, durée, équipe)
  • Consulting Director : Business case - partie fit (motivation, soft skills, valeurs) puis use case avec synthèse de la solution (réponse, durée, équipe)
  • Partner : Business case - partie fit (motivation, soft skills, valeurs) puis use case avec synthèse de la solution (réponse, durée, équipe)

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

 

Présentation entreprise : 

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

 

Inclusion et diversité : 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

573a4508a48c.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
573a4508a48c.description: As a Security Operations Engineer, you will help protect DiliTrust's SaaS platform, cloud infrastructure, networks and production environments. You will join the Infrastructure & Security team, a 12-person team spread across France, Canada and Spain, and work in an international context (Europe, North America and EMA). The infrastructure you will secure is managed in an automated way and counts more than 350 assets hosted across our cloud providers. You will contribute to the continuous improvement of our security posture through monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, hardening and automation, and you will work closely with infrastructure, DevOps, development and product teams so that security is embedded into our architectures, operations and delivery processes. Missions: In this role, your main responsibilities will include: Security monitoring & incident response · Monitor the security of networks, cloud infrastructure, systems, applications and endpoints. · Administer, configure and continuously improve our security tools, including CNAPP, SIEM, EDR, bastion, ZTNA, PKI, antivirus and WAF solutions. · Continuously evolve our detection mechanisms and threat-detection scenarios. · Investigate security alerts and incidents, support incident handling, and contribute to root-cause analysis, remediation and post-incident reviews. Hardening, vulnerabilities & secure architecture · Implement hardening measures and support vulnerability identification, prioritization, remediation and follow-up through action plans. · Validate the security aspects of IT architectures and application projects. · Actively participate in security audits and penetration tests: scoping, support during the exercise, remediation of findings and follow-up. · Test products and run technical validations on prototype environments before they reach production. Automation & Infrastructure as Code · Automate deployments and security / infrastructure operations using Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and scripting. · Create and maintain security procedures, incident-response playbooks, operational documentation and technical standards. Roadmap, watch & knowledge sharing · Define and deliver the team's security roadmap together with the Hiring Manager and your peers. · Keep an active watch on threats and security news, and share what you learn with the team. Candidate Profile: Experience & seniority · You have at least 5 years of professional experience in Security Operations, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security or a related field (network, systems or cloud engineering with a strong security component). · You have practical experience with security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, system hardening and operational security. Mindset & collaboration · You are passionate about cybersecurity and interested in automation and the DevOps culture; you would rather automate a process than repeat it. · You are analytical, autonomous, versatile and rigorous, with a strong sense of service and good synthesis skills. · You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and you are confident in your expertise without losing the team spirit. · You enjoy working collaboratively in an international, distributed team and have a good command of English. Technical Skills : Required · Good knowledge of Linux (Debian-based environments in particular), Docker and Kubernetes;. · Good knowledge of networking, enough to design, routing and firewall rules: TCP/IP, DNS and TLS; static routing, VLANs, segmentation and NAT; stateful and application-level firewall rule design; reverse proxies and load balancers; VPN and overlay technologies (WireGuard, IPsec); ZTNA principles (identity-aware access, device posture, micro-segmentation); cloud networking (VPC, peering, private endpoints). · Ability to manage network and security configurations as code, using Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible and AWX. · Good knowledge of PKI and certificate management: CA hierarchies, certificate lifecycle (issuance, renewal, revocation, automation), TLS / mTLS, key and secret management. · Administration of security tools: CNAPP, SIEM, EDR, bastion, ZTNA and PKI, including interpreting security events and alerts. · Hands-on experience with WAF (policy and rule tuning). · Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog. · Ability to script and automate repetitive operational or security tasks. Nice to have · Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform or an equivalent cloud environment. · An active interest in security news, emerging threats, conferences and meetups. Our Security & Infrastructure Environment : · Cloud: Google Cloud Platform and other cloud providers, with automated infrastructure management (700+ assets) · Systems & containers: Linux (Debian), Docker, Kubernetes · Automation: Ansible, AWX, Terraform · Network & access: ZTNA, bastion · Security tooling: SIEM, EDR, WAF, antivirus, PKI · Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog Process: · Interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team (30–45 minutes) · Technical interview with the SecOps Team Lead and the Team manager, including a practical case study (about 90 minutes) · Final interview with the CTO (30 minutes) Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

f7a4b9e1aaa1.title: Business Intelligence Data Architect
f7a4b9e1aaa1.description:
What is Contentstack?

Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.

While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.

Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.

Learn more at www.contentstack.com.

Who Are We?

At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Data Architect to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack.

In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making.

If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing:

  • Lead analytical architecture and governance: Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews.
  • Build governed data models and semantic layers: Design and implement reusable business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics that support consistent reporting, self-service analytics, applications, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Establish analytics engineering best practices: Set standards for dbt development, testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, deployment reliability, model performance, and observability to improve scalability and maintainability.
  • Enable secure, reliable data access: Design governed access patterns for applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data, including role-based access control (RBAC), APIs, service layers, and query optimization.
  • Partner across the business: Work closely with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions.
  • Mentor and enable the team: Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices.
  • Drive platform evolution: Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt.

What Really Gets Us Excited About You

  • 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including at least 3 years in an architect capacity with direct ownership of an analytical platform.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization.
  • Expert-level experience with dbt, including staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental models, testing, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, with the ability to select and justify approaches based on business and analytical needs.
  • Proven experience designing and deploying production semantic layers and governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based integrations.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python, along with familiarity with dbt Cloud, Fivetran

The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go. We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving. What You’ll Be Doing • Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work. • Keep our databases fast and reliable. • Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. • Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go. • Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required. • Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics. • Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code. • Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering. • Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed. Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of Den Bosch. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

Nice-to-Haves

  • OTA update experience. You’ve worked with over-the-air update frameworks.

  • Embedded platform experience. You’ve worked with SoC vendor BSPs, flashing tools or secure boot on platforms.
  • Low-level development. You’re comfortable reading and debugging C/C++ code, from user space down to kernel drivers.
  • Security vulnerability management. You have experience identifying, triaging and resolving security vulnerabilities in embedded Linux systems.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.

About the Role You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. 7046fa37a5e5.title: Software Engineer, Supportability Decisions
7046fa37a5e5.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Supportability Decisions is a Dublin-based engineering team within Supportability Engineering, part of Risk Engineering. We own the “how a business sells” side of Supportability: determining whether a user’s declared business, web presence, account configuration, and observed transaction behaviour align with Stripe’s standards. Our core domain includes transaction-laundering detection and decisioning, web-presence and URL-policy controls, and low-quality e-commerce detection. We consume the signals and evaluations that support decisions in these spaces and convert them into evidence-based and auditable determinations that can be shared with the rest of the Supportability platforms. The pitch is: join a high-ownership team solving some of Stripe’s hardest risk problems. We build technology that helps Stripe distinguish legitimate businesses from bad actors at scale, combining sophisticated engineering, AI-assisted investigation, and meaningful real-world impact. What you’ll do You will own a meaningful part of a risk-decisioning problem from investigation and design through implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. You will help build both the domain capabilities and the modern agentic infrastructure required to make Supportability decisions consistent, stateful, explainable, and appropriate to the business, product, and moment in time. Depending on team priorities and the candidate’s experience, this may include: Responsibilities Building the Supportability Decision Layer: a durable service and API through which automated systems, agents, and human reviewers can request, produce, retrieve, and understand canonical decisions. Developing the infrastructure that enables agentic investigations to synthesize policy, business identity and history, product context, risk appetite, and multiple assessment signals into explainable, confidence-calibrated decisions. Improving the transaction-laundering agent’s policy grounding, evidence quality, risk tiering, precision and recall, and use of behavioural, dispute, and other relevant signals. Designing durable decision state and history, including traceability from supporting evidence through reasoning and applied consequence, and validity and refresh policies that prevent stale outcomes from persisting. Building governed, reusable configuration and integration patterns that adapt decision capabilities across products, partners, countries, and permitted risk appetites without creating bespoke systems for each use case. Building reliable backend workflows on shared Supportability and Risk Platform infrastructure. Making complex risk decisions explainable to reviewers and affected users. Using data and feedback from outcomes, appeals, and corrections to improve decision quality while balancing the identification of bad actors against avoiding unnecessary harm to legitimate businesses. Modernising URL enforcement, including when and how URL checks run, reducing unnecessary review volume and user friction, and supporting migration away from legacy systems. Expanding shared SAE/SPO decisioning foundations, including due-diligence support and product-scoped remediation and appeal capabilities. Improving the Process Orchestration Framework and moving workflow code into more maintainable platform packages. Contributing to future work in automated LPM URL screening, low-quality e-commerce detection, wider web intelligence, and active test charges. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 2 - 7 years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops) You work effectively across the stack from top to bottom, comfortably navigating codebases with different languages and tools You're equally comfortable shipping user-facing experiences as you are writing custom queries to analyze experiment results Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job, so our interview process is language-agnostic) Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success Ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial Interest in working as a generalist across varying technologies and stacks to solve problems and delight both internal and external users Preferred qualifications Experience working in high-growth teams similar to Stripe Experience building financial systems or tools for financial experts

d77fcf71b428.title: Intermediate Data Engineer
d77fcf71b428.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Data Engineer at GitLab, you'll build, run, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure that bring data from our enterprise applications, internal systems, and GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) platform into our data platform. Your work will power company reporting, data science, and artificial intelligence (AI) self-service. You'll own features end to end, from source integration to tested, monitored, documented data ready for use. You'll focus on keeping the platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as data volumes and AI usage grow, and making governed data ready for AI tools, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based access. This is an AI-first role: you'll use AI coding agents every day while maintaining high standards for code review and testing. You'll report to the Director, Data Platform. What you’ll do Build, extend, and maintain extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines from enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Zuora, Zendesk, and Marketo, internal systems, and the GitLab SaaS platform. Integrate data through application programming interfaces (APIs) and event sources such as Snowplow. Manage and maintain the infrastructure behind the platform, including SaaS tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran, and Monte Carlo, and self-managed services such as Airflow and Kubernetes. Write maintainable, well-tested, performant Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) code that meets our internal standards, and review GitLab team members' merge requests. Own day-to-day platform operations: triage and resolve failed pipelines, infrastructure issues, and GitLab team member requests. Use monitoring, service-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, query and warehouse tuning, and data quality checks to keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient. Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Governance, and business partners so data lands in the shape they need for downstream use. Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, GitLab Duo, or similar tools to speed up development, debugging, testing, and documentation without compromising review rigor. Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and masking policies to make governed data available to AI tools and agents. Handle data subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls, material nonpublic information (MNPI), and personal data safely. Ship medium-sized features independently in small, iterative merge requests, and document architecture and runbooks in the handbook. What You'll Bring Professional experience shipping production data pipelines in Python. Deep, hands-on SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse; Snowflake is preferred. Hands-on experience with ELT or extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines at scale, including incremental loads, schema changes, backfills, and API ingestion. Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, familiarity with dbt, and solid data modeling fundamentals, including Kimball dimensional modeling. Experience running and troubleshooting data infrastructure, with comfort using Git-based workflows, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and code review. Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in your daily work, with an understanding of where they help and where they fall short. Clear written communication, the ability to use GitLab, and comfort working asynchronously in a fully remote organization in line with GitLab's values. Preferred, not required: experience with Snowflake; Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Terraform; SaaS application APIs such as Salesforce, Zuora, or Zendesk; data observability tooling; or Snowflake administration. About the team The Data Platform team within Enterprise Data is responsible for a scalable, reliable and secure data platform for data analytics at GitLab. That includes managing and maintaining the infrastructure we use, both SaaS and self-managed, and building and maintaining the data pipelines that bring data into it. We make data reliable, secure and ready for analytics, data science and AI tools. As more questions go straight to AI tools and agents, the platform underneath has to be more reliable, better governed and more cost-efficient than ever. We're fully remote and globally distributed, and work asynchronously through issues, merge requests and the handbook. How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave Please note

About the Team

OpenAI is building the infrastructure foundation for the next generation of AI. The Data Center Engineering team defines the strategy, reference architectures, technical requirements, and delivery standards for the large-scale data centers that support OpenAI research, products, and infrastructure partners.

As a Controls Engineer for BMS & EPMS, you will program, configure, integrate, and commission the controls systems that support high-density AI data centers. You will work hands-on with mechanical or electrical controls, partnering with mechanical, electrical, IT/networking, security, commissioning, operations, and external delivery teams.

About the Role

We are seeking hands-on, early-career controls engineers with practical experience in building management systems (BMS) and mechanical controls, or electrical power monitoring systems (EPMS) and electrical controls. This role focuses on implementing and commissioning control systems, including PLCs, field devices, instrumentation, and sequences of operation, rather than owning OT/IT network or cybersecurity architecture.

The ideal candidate has day-to-day experience programming and commissioning controls, ideally with a controls systems integrator. We welcome depth in either BMS/mechanical or EPMS/electrical controls; expertise in both is not required. You will work with experienced engineers and delivery partners to turn design requirements into reliable, tested systems.

Key Responsibilities

 - Program and configure PLCs and control systems for mechanical/BMS or electrical/EPMS applications in AI data center campuses.

 - Implement and test sequences of operation, control logic, alarms, and interlocks against approved functional requirements.

 - Review and maintain controls documentation, including control diagrams, I/O and point lists, instrumentation details, sequences of operation, and commissioning records.

 - Integrate field devices, sensors, instrumentation, equipment controllers, and supervisory systems; validate point mapping, communications, and data quality.

 - Maintain control programs, configuration backups, version history, change records, and rollback procedures to support safe commissioning and operations.

 - Partner with mechanical, electrical, IT/networking, cybersecurity, and operations teams to resolve integration issues and implement approved OT connectivity and security requirements.

 - Configure and troubleshoot relevant industrial communications, such as BACnet/IP, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA, or IEC 61850, according to the system and controls discipline.

 - Work directly with controls integrators, equipment vendors, contractors, and commissioning teams to resolve programming, installation, and functional performance issues.

 - Execute and document factory and site acceptance testing, point-to-point checks, sequence verification, and integrated systems testing; troubleshoot control logic, instrumentation, alarms, and device communication failures.

Qualifications

 - Practical hands-on experience programming, configuring, integrating, or commissioning control systems in data centers, industrial automation, buildings, or other critical infrastructure environments.

 - Working knowledge of PLC programming and control logic, with the ability to implement and troubleshoot sequences of operation.

 - Experience in either BMS/mechanical controls or EPMS/electrical controls, with an understanding of the equipment and operating sequences in that discipline.

 - Experience configuring field devices and instrumentation, validating I/O and point mapping, and diagnosing control system behavior.

 - Working knowledge of relevant industrial communication protocols and basic OT networking needed to connect and troubleshoot control systems.

 - Ability to read control diagrams, equipment documentation, I/O lists, and functional specifications, and keep implementation records accurate.

 - Hands-on experience with functional testing, commissioning, and systematic troubleshooting using trends, alarms, logs, and field observations.

 - Ability to work closely with integrators, vendors, construction teams, and operations, communicate issues clearly, and follow safe work and change-control practices.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Controls or Automation Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Skills

 - Experience at a controls systems integrator, with regular responsibility for programming, configuration, field integration, and commissioning.

 - Experience delivering BMS/mechanical or EPMS/electrical controls for data centers or other mission-critical facilities.

 - Familiarity with supervisory controls, HMI/SCADA configuration, telemetry, and historian integrations.

 - Familiarity with OT cybersecurity practices and working with networking or security specialists to implement approved access and connectivity requirements.

 - Experience with scripting, APIs, or automation tools that improve controls testing, integration, documentation, or troubleshooting.

Work Environment and Travel

 - This role requires periodic travel to data center campuses, vendors, labs, construction sites, commissioning activities, and controls/network cutovers.

 - The engineer should be comfortable working across office, lab, construction, and live data center environments, including PPE, lockout/tagout, cyber hygiene, and change-control requirements.

 - Work may include time-sensitive support during commissioning, startup, vendor testing, cutovers, network changes, telemetry issues, automation failures, and operational events.

Travel: 50%

274488694bc0.description:
About the Team

OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital and delivery partners, is building the infrastructure required to support frontier AI systems. The Data Center Engineering team defines repeatable technical standards and carries them through design, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness. The team works across data center facilities, power generation, compute infrastructure, construction, procurement, and operations to deliver reliable capacity at unprecedented scale and speed.

About the Role

We are seeking a Controls Engineer to design and integrate automation systems for on-site power generation serving large AI data center campuses. You will own control architecture and functional requirements across generation packages, balance-of-plant systems, electrical protection, microgrid controls, and data center monitoring. You will work from concept through factory testing, site commissioning, performance validation, and operational improvement.

Role focus: Control-system architecture, integration, and commissioning for on-site generation

Travel: 50%

Responsibilities

 - Define control-system architecture, functional design specifications, sequences of operation, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm philosophy, and interface requirements.

 - Integrate OEM controls, PLCs, DCS, SCADA, historian, microgrid controllers, protection systems, and data center BMS or EPMS platforms.

 - Develop and review I/O lists, network architecture, control narratives, graphics, alarm limits, interlocks, permissives, and fail-safe behavior.

 - Coordinate synchronization, load sharing, islanding, black start, load shedding, restoration, and generation-to-data-center operating modes.

 - Evaluate cybersecurity, redundancy, time synchronization, communications protocols, data quality, and remote-support requirements.

 - Lead or support software reviews, simulator testing, factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, commissioning, and tuning.

 - Troubleshoot control-system and plant-performance issues and convert findings into corrective actions and reusable standards.

 - Partner with electrical, mechanical, CSA, IT, security, operations, OEM, EPC, and data center controls teams.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of controls, automation, or instrumentation engineering experience in power generation, industrial plants, utilities, or mission-critical infrastructure.

 - Strong experience with PLC, DCS, SCADA, historian, industrial-networking, and control-system integration.

 - Knowledge of generation controls, synchronization, load sharing, protective interfaces, process control, and safety interlocks.

 - Experience developing functional specifications, sequences, I/O, alarms, graphics, and factory or site test procedures.

 - Ability to troubleshoot across software, instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, communications, and operating-process boundaries.

 - Understanding of industrial cybersecurity, redundancy, failover, and change-control practices.

 - Bachelor's degree in controls, electrical, mechanical, chemical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Skills

 - Experience with major turbine or reciprocating-engine control platforms and microgrid controllers.

 - Experience with IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC UA, DNP3, EtherNet/IP, or comparable industrial protocols.

 - Experience integrating generation controls with BMS, EPMS, DCIM, or utility systems.

 - Professional Engineer license, functional-safety training, or industrial-cybersecurity certification.

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

We’re seeking an experienced Engineering Program Manager to join Cohere’s customer-facing Engineering Program Management team. We need someone with curiosity, drive, independence, and leadership, who has hands-on experience working directly with customers and managing projects for enterprise-grade software or enterprise-focused machine learning solutions. In return, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape Cohere’s operations, collaborate with leading minds in the LLM space, work directly with our Strategic Customers as well as Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform , Product and Go-to-Market teams, and be the “technical” voice of Cohere for the customer. You will get a chance to create extremely high-impact contributions to our fast-growing company, product and culture.

Please Note: This role is open to candidates based in [Dammam]

As an Engineering Program Manager/ Technical Program Manager, you will:

 - Communicate: Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across the tech organization, Cohere teams, leadership, and most importantly - our strategic customers and external partners.

 - Optimize: Break down complex issues into strategies, driving engineering alignment with product, business, and marketing while fostering collaboration.

 - Plan: Create and manage program/project schedules, identify dependencies, manage risks, and drive organizational alignment.

 - Execute: Ensure on-time delivery, identify development needs, and establish checkpoints for status updates.

 - Problem solve: Proactively identify and resolve issues, coordinate cross-functional dependencies, and prioritize impacts to schedule and product quality.

You may be a good fit if:

 - You have at least 5 years of experience as an Engineering or Technical Program Manager, with at least 3 years in customer-facing technical delivery and operations focused on enterprise-grade AI software/solutions

 - Knowledge or experience with LLM training or optimization would be a key differentiator

 - You are problem-focused and making customers successful really excites you

39db0d72c7c2.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications
39db0d72c7c2.description: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications Enterprise Platform Group · Commercialization (Quote-to-Cash) · Mountain View, CA As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the Agentic Applications team, you will be the hands-on technical lead for how Databricks quotes, orders, bills and recognizes revenue. Your core function is to build bespoke first-party, agents-first applications built on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will own the technical architecture end to end, from quote to cash. You will design agents that work reliably inside revenue-critical workflows, set the engineering standards the team builds on, and make sure every agent-assisted decision can be observed, audited and trusted by Finance, Deal Desk and Sales. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management role. You will write code, review designs, and be the most senior technical voice in a domain that touches every dollar Databricks books. The impact you'll have Own the agentic architecture for Quote-to-Cash. Define and lead the target technical architecture across Configure-Price-Quote, deal management, ordering, subscriptions, investments, billing and revenue recognition. Drive the move from vendor-configured workflows to first-party, AI-native applications built on Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Unity Catalog and Mosaic AI. Build production agents that sellers and Deal Desk trust. Design and ship LLM-powered agents for deal guidance, quote generation and summarization, multi-option proposals, approval insights, and pricing and discount recommendations. Work directly with sales, Deal Desk and Finance to define what "good" looks like for each workflow. Make agent reliability a core system property. Own the eval and quality system for this domain: per-workflow quality criteria, offline eval suites, LLM-as-judge and human-labeled benchmarks, behavioral regression testing in CI/CD, online tracing, and feedback loops that improve agents based on what users approve, edit and reject. Design human-in-the-loop controls for revenue-critical decisions. Build the separation between what an agent proposes and what gets committed, plus diff-based review, approval routing, audit logging, and policy guardrails. Together these decide when an agent can act on its own and when a person has to approve, especially for pricing, discounting, contract terms and order creation. Treat systems of record as agent tools. Architect tool-calling and MCP-style interfaces that give agents governed, run-time access to pricing, product catalog, order, contract, subscription and billing data. Follow single-source-of-truth principles across CRM, ERP and billing systems. Protect financial integrity at scale. Make sure agent-assisted quoting and ordering produce accurate, compliance-grade outputs downstream: order validation, billing, invoicing and revenue recognition, where errors directly affect financial reporting. Lead the migration path. Act as the bridge between today's production quoting platform and the target agentic architecture. Sequence the migration so the business keeps scaling without disruption, and decide what to retire, rebuild or wrap. Raise the engineering bar. Lead architecture reviews, establish design patterns for agents (orchestration, memory, retrieval, tool use, multi-agent coordination), and mentor senior and mid-level engineers on production-grade agentic engineering. Earn cross-functional credibility. Partner with Finance, Deal Desk, Sales Ops, Legal and the broader Platform engineering org. Turn complex commercial processes into clear technical roadmaps and measurable business outcomes. What we look for 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership and ownership of large-scale production systems. 3+ years of hands-on experience building and running LLM-powered or agentic applications in production, such as agents, RAG pipelines, tool use, multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, DSPy or equivalent), and evaluation frameworks for generative outputs. Strong backend and distributed-systems skills: API and service design, data modeling, idempotency, consistency and transactional integrity, and observability. Proven experience designing human-in-the-loop systems: approval workflows, review interfaces, audit trails, and guardrails for probabilistic systems operating in regulated or high-stakes domains. Experience leading technical architecture for complex business domains, ideally Quote-to-Cash, Order-to-Revenue, billing, pricing or other revenue-critical enterprise systems. Full-stack fluency. You are comfortable across modern web frameworks (React/TypeScript), backend services (Python, Java, Scala or Go), and data platforms. Ability to work directly with non-engineering stakeholders and turn ambiguous business workflows into clear agent and system architecture. Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical execution across a team, without relying on positional authority. Nice to have Domain experience with CPQ, deal management, subscription management, or revenue recognition in a high-growth SaaS or consumption-based business. Experience building first-party applications on top of, or as replacements for, enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g., Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, NetSuite, Zuora). Platform-specific configuration expertise is a plus but not a requirement. Experience with the Databricks platform (Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI Agent Framework, MLflow tracing and evaluation). Familiarity with SOX controls, audit requirements, and financial-systems compliance. Pay Range Transparency Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candida

383b11a09085.title: Data Scientist, FX Quantitative Research
383b11a09085.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data scientists and data analysts learn and grow together. The Treasury Finance Data Science team builds the models, risk frameworks, and decision tools behind how Stripe manages money at global scale: liquidity, funding, counterparty risk, and foreign exchange. Stripe moves funds across 135+ currencies every day. That creates FX exposure from merchant flows, multi-currency balances, and entity funding. In this role, you'll be a thought partner and builder alongside Stripe's FX team. Together you'll develop the quantitative foundation for how Stripe measures, forecasts, and hedges FX exposure. What you'll do You'll be the senior quantitative lead for FX within Treasury Finance Data Science. You'll co-build with Treasury, the FX hedging team, Finance, and Engineering: shaping the research agenda, turning ideas into rigorous models, and building the systems that put those models to work. Data Science owns these systems. They produce the decision-critical outputs and analyses that the FX team and Treasury leadership rely on. This is a hands-on role. You'll design the methodology, write the code, and ship it into production. Responsibilities Partner with the FX team to build and evolve FX risk measurement: exposure aggregation across entities and currencies, VaR / Expected Shortfall, stress testing, and scenario analysis Develop forecasting models for FX exposures and multi-currency cash flows. Quantify forecast uncertainty so it can inform hedge sizing and timing. Co-design hedge optimization and decision frameworks with the FX team that weigh hedge cost, residual risk, P&L volatility, and liquidity constraints Build ML and statistical systems for trading and risk (signal research, anomaly detection on flows, execution and cost analytics), and take them from prototype to production Own the production systems that generate decision-critical FX outputs, partnering with Engineering on reliability, SLAs, monitoring, alerting, and incident response for risk-critical workflows Partner deeply with Treasury Finance stakeholders to turn business questions into quantitative frameworks. Anticipate needs and help shape FX risk strategy rather than reacting to requests. Produce clear, trusted analyses and reporting that inform Treasury and Finance leadership decisions, including leadership-level reporting such as MBRs and QBRs Use AI tools (code assistants, LLM-based agents) to speed up modeling, analysis, and automation, while maintaining rigor, validation, and auditability Raise the technical bar for FX quantitative work within Data Science: methodology standards, model validation, documentation, and mentoring other data scientists Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Location Requirement New York, NY required (50% in office - hybrid) Minimum requirements PhD with 1-3 years, MS or MA with 2-6 years, or BS or BA with 4-8 years of data science or quantitative modeling experience Hands-on quantitative experience at a bank, asset manager, hedge fund, trading firm, or similar financial institution, with direct exposure to FX, rates, or market risk Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and time-series modeling, plus working knowledge of risk measures (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress testing) and hedging instruments (forwards, swaps, options) Proficiency in Python and SQL. You write production-quality code, not just research scripts. Experience taking models or analytical systems from research into production Business acumen and the ability to turn complex analyses into clear, decision-ready insights Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact with cross-functional partners, including senior non-technical stakeholders Ability to manage multiple projects at once, with strong attention to detail Experience using AI tools to speed up modeling, analysis, and coding Preferred qualifications Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Quantitative / Mathematical Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Economics, Operations Research) Applied machine learning experience in trading or risk (e.g., forecasting, execution analytics, signal research, anomaly detection) Experience with corporate treasury or balance-sheet FX: multi-entity exposure management, hedge programs, and treasury concepts such as liquidity, funding, and cash positioning Experience building risk or decision systems with engineering standards: code review, testing, monitoring, and defined SLAs Experience with distributed data tools (e.g., Spark) and workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Flyte) Prior experience at a growth-stage internet, fintech, or payments company Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs and MBRs A builder's mindset, with a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom Interest in how data products enable automated and agentic workflows, and an understanding that model and data quality determine the reliability of every downstream decision

5a1d253851bd.title: Senior Product Manager - Data Integrations
5a1d253851bd.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models. Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources. This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there. What you'll do Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context. Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together. Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence. Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering. Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities. Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures. Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience. What you'll bring Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information. Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows. A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer. Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work. Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption. Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required. About the team We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit. GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above. e70e7b7d80e4.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Location: Austin, TX About the Role We are seeking a Data Center Design Engineer to design Cloudflare’s pending and future infrastructure deployments for generational improvement in cost, quality, and speed of deployment. In this role, you will lead electrical design and end-to-end execution for new sites, expansions, and infrastructure upgrades supporting compute, storage, and high-density liquid-cooled GPU deployments. We are looking for someone who excels at progressing many projects in parallel, managing dynamic day-to-day priorities with many stakeholders, and serving as Cloudflare's owner's representative to refine data center design best practices in a high-growth environment. Getting stuff done is a must! The Data Center Strategy team is part of Cloudflare’s global Infrastructure (INF) team. The INF team grows and manages Cloudflare’s global data center/PoP footprint, enabling Cloudflare’s tremendous growth with compute, network, and data center infrastructure, utilizing an extensive range of global partner vendors. What you'll do: Translate data center capacity requirements into actionable white space design and/or rack plans within individual data center contract constraints for power, coolingManage implementation phase of cage projects with data center providersDesign low voltage structured cabling, fiber, cross-connect & conveyance infrastructure as well as any supporting infrastructure on the data center ceiling/floorWork with supply chain team on rack integration plans and location deployment qualification Work cross-functionally with Cloudflare data center engineering team and other internal teams (capacity planning, network strategy, security) to verify scope and solution and create repeatable standard installation procedures Take ownership of and lead projects to design and implement data center expansions or new data centers on tight deadlines with minimal oversight Technical support in negotiations with external data center partners Assist in RFP preparation, review and cost/engineering analysis Review one-line diagrams and cooling equations for new and existing data centers (Data Center M&E) Power component (PDU) review/approval for Hardware sourcing team Implement, document and maintain power consumption tracking tools and fulfil ad-hoc reporting requests Research new and innovative power efficiency technologies and programs Travel up to 25% to perform infrastructure audits, validate data center construction work and buildouts, and participate in commercial processes. Develop and execute modular and prefabricated data center construction strategies to accelerate time-to-market and optimize cost efficiency Perform electrical short-circuit, coordination, arc flash, and load flow engineering studies to ensure system reliability and compliance Other duties as assigned Partner with Hardware Sourcing and SRE/Infrastructure teams to validate PDU specifications, rack integration plans, and power distribution topologies across global PoP footprints Lead electrical design and end-to-end execution for new sites, expansions, and infrastructure upgrades from site qualification and basis of design through energization, commissioning, and operational handover Serve as Cloudflare's electrical owner's representative, defining design criteria, scopes, deliverables, responsibility matrices, review gates, and acceptance requirements for data center operators, consulting engineers, contractors, commissioning agents, utilities, and vendors Design and review utility-to-rack infrastructure, including utility service, transformers, switchgear, generators, UPS systems, transfer systems, modular and prefabricated electrical assemblies, busway, feeders, whips, rack PDUs, grounding, and metering Define electrical interfaces and auxiliary-load requirements for direct-to-chip liquid cooling, coolant distribution units (CDUs), pumps, controls, leak detection, facility water systems, and heat-rejection equipment Develop and review basis-of-design documents, single-line diagrams, specifications, equipment schedules, calculations, sequences of operation, and interface control documents Oversee technical acceptance of FAT, SAT, Level 1–5 staged commissioning, integrated systems testing, failure-mode testing, deficiency closure, and turnover documentation Define EPMS, metering, telemetry, and capacity-tracking requirements for operational power and capacity management Requirements Bachelors

1f490ec8855c.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Strategic Finance Data Science helps OpenAI make consequential financial and operating decisions as the business grows. We connect customer behavior, product economics and business performance to the choices leaders make about goals, customer acquisition and investment.

The team works closely with Strategic Finance and partners across Data Science, Product, GTM and Data Engineering. Its work combines forecasting, analytical decision support and tools that make financial planning more effective.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a data science leader who can turn complex, uncertain business questions into clear recommendations. You will lead an established team, strengthen its technical and leadership capabilities, and help shape where it can have the greatest impact.

You will partner with Finance and business leaders on forecasts, customer lifetime value, acquisition economics and resource allocation. This role calls for someone who can challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs and follow the analysis through to a decision. You should be motivated by the opportunity to build a durable function during a period of rapid growth.

The role is based in San Francisco with three in-office days each week. Relocation assistance is available.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Build forecasting approaches that help leaders understand business trajectories, compare scenarios and make choices under uncertainty.

 - Develop customer lifetime value and acquisition-economics models that inform marketing investment and balance near-term performance with long-term value.

 - Partner with Strategic Finance on annual goals, budget decisions and resource allocation, including the economics of compute investment.

 - Translate model outputs into clear operating recommendations, making assumptions, uncertainty and implications understandable to executive stakeholders.

 - Strengthen the tools, metrics and recurring analyses that allow Finance partners to make decisions effectively and at scale.

 - Recruit, coach and develop a high-performing team; establish priorities and accountability across ongoing work and urgent business questions.

 - Work across consumer and business products, applying expertise in one business model while learning the dynamics of the other.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have partnered closely with a CFO, Finance leadership or a COO whose remit includes major financial and operating decisions. Your work has informed meaningful business choices, regardless of whether your title included Finance.

 - Have led data science work in a large technology business or a rapidly scaling company, with experience adapting methods and priorities as the business changes.

 - Bring deep forecasting judgment and can connect technical choices to business consequences, communicate limitations and respond constructively when a forecast misses.

 - Have built strong teams, developed talent and attracted excellent colleagues. You can set direction while staying close enough to the work to challenge its quality.

 - Communicate clearly with technical and business audiences and build trust through sound judgment, evidence and follow-through.

 - Are excited by OpenAI’s mission and this specific opportunity to improve financial decisions in an evolving environment.
