18a51e3b02c9.description:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

The Engine team develops and maintains core components of the Workato Recipe runtime. Scope includes recipe execution, DSL, event pulling, webhook processing, and job execution. The team owns trigger and event infrastructure that defines how integrations start and react to external events. Current focus: modernization of a high-throughput platform to improve reliability, scalability, and long-term evolvability. Work is platform-oriented and directly impacts runtime performance and system correctness.

In this role, you will also be responsible to:

  • Design and implement distributed backend systems in Go with deep consideration of performance and memory behavior.

  • Work on runtime-level components operating under high concurrency and throughput.

  • Apply in-depth knowledge of Go internals (scheduler, memory model, garbage collection behavior) to improve system efficiency.

  • Design and optimize concurrent workflows using goroutines, channels, synchronization primitives, and context propagation.

  • Analyze and optimize slice usage, memory allocations, and data structures for performance-critical paths.

  • Improve execution engine for custom third-party code (isolation, performance, feature extensions).

  • Modernize runtime components with focus on modularity, structured architecture, and observability.

  • Improve trigger configuration and execution across webhooks and polling mechanisms.

  • Integrate and optimize data storage solutions (Postgres, S3, DynamoDB, Kafka, ClickHouse).

  • Identify bottlenecks, race conditions, deadlocks, and performance degradation in distributed systems.

  • Own initiatives end-to-end, from design to rollout and production support.

  • Conduct code reviews with emphasis on correctness, concurrency safety, and performance characteristics.

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in building scalable distributed backend applications (7+ years).

  • Great understanding of all building blocks of large web applications: databases, load balancers, application servers, message brokers, caching, monitoring, etc.

  • Good understanding of network protocols and stacks.

12a2605f4ebf.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. YOUR IMPACT In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem. WHAT YOU WILL DO Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems. Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments. Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies. Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime. Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data. Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings. Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems. WHO YOU ARE You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent You have a strong background in electrical engineering, control systems, or a related field, with hands-on experience in industrial environments You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. 8157bff83c13.description: 👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️ At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core. Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market. You own the full chain from methodological question to working software solution and take ownership of the team's most complex methodological and technical challenges. You make sure each new product category, market and verification takes less time and effort, working with high autonomy and high accountability. As an early senior member of a fast-growing climate-tech company, your career trajectory is entirely in your hands. This role offers unparalleled visibility and growth. You can deepen your expertise as a technical expert in the team, or leverage your domain knowledge to pivot into high-impact roles across Customer Success, Sales, or Product. Exceptional early joiners are primed for future Team Lead and leadership positions. In the first 6 months, you will Lead strategic projects: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous projects such as new markets, program operators or complex product categories. Define requirements, navigate trade-offs, delegate across the team and drive delivery. Shape the product core: Work closely with our software engineers to translate environmental science and ISO/EN standards into clean, scalable software requirements, and propose complete implementation strategies for whole concepts, not individual features. Scale our LCA work: Reduce the time and effort for recurring work such as tool verifications, new product category implementations and matching, through automation, reusable standards and better processes. Turn verifier feedback into requirements that solve the issue for good. Scale tool verifications: Work with program operators and verifiers to establish processes that make tool verifications faster, more predictable and repeatable across markets and product categories. Set the standard: Define what clear requirements and architecturally sound solutions look like, and take ownership of refining our methodologies for PCFs, LCAs and EPDs. Improve how we work: Identify problems others don't see, turn them into actionable proposals, and solve recurring problems at the root instead of case by case. Grow the team: Mentor junior colleagues and give them regular, actionable feedback. Shape the industry: Help establish Emidat as a thought leader in LCA, e.g. by representing us in ECO Platform working groups and in the committees that author PCRs. What you will bring to this role Minimum requirements Extensive LCA expertise: You bring deep expertise and experience conducting Life Cycle Assessments, LCA calculation methodology, PCRs and ecoinvent/matching logic. You showcase ownership of complex, ambiguous methodological or technical challenges. Mastery of standards and regulation: You have comprehensive knowledge of the key LCA / EPD standards and program operator requirements (i.e ISO 14040/14044 and EN 15804+A2). You interpret these standards rigorously, and evaluate sources critically. From methodology to software: You have experience working with automated software solutions for LCA/EPD generation, with proven ability to translate regulatory and methodological logic into technical requirements. You bring a product mindset: you prioritise, scope and communicate requirements clearly. Verification and customer experience: You have created multiple EPDs that were successfully verified and published with a European program operator (e.g. EPD Global, EPD International, IBU). You have worked directly with customers, ideally in a consulting environment, and can represent methodological positions confidently towards customers and verifiers. Leadership and project management: You have a track record of leading large projects end-to-end: scoping, planning, delegating, coaching others and keeping quality high. You manage several projects at the same time and coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders. Language: Business fluent in English (C1+). Verifier: Qualification as a verifier for EPDs acc. to EN 15804+A2 Engineering partnership: Experience completing partnering with software engineers to develop implementation strategies. Tool Verifications: You have experience with EPD tool verifications. 4e6dee151ae5.description: Description QuantumDiamonds (QD) is entering its next phase: with the start of production, we are evolving from a startup into an industrial company. You will work closely with Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing, and your work will have a direct and visible impact on our daily operations. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. About us QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. 67a0bf621cd7.title: Business Development Intern
67a0bf621cd7.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. Customer Communication: Plan and execute weekly sales newsletters and updates for customers, ensuring clear and engaging outreach. Strategic Support: Assist our Growth Chief of Staff in strategic initiatives across the Sales organization. 2624d03a4123.title: Senior Product Engineer
2624d03a4123.description: About Adclear At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'. This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift. Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in. The Role This is a full-stack product role with real scope: you won't be handed a corner of a system, you'll own complete product slices end-to-end, from spec through to something live that customers depend on every day. Here's a taste of what that looks like in practice: A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. Built with Monzo as the design partner. Public on the Chrome Web Store. A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, the action runs. Not chat over a database. The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules. An integration surface that reaches into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com , Frame.io for video. A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue. You think in user outcomes and shipped work, not tickets closed. Your code handles edge cases, your APIs have clean contracts, and the work you ship stays shipped. Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day, and they'll tell you fast when something's wrong, which is exactly the kind of feedback loop that makes this job good. What you'll do Own product delivery. Take features from spec to production, frontend-first but covering backend and integration where needed. Build the product surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, the moments where model output meets human judgement. Work with AI in the critical path. Ship features where the model is genuinely part of the product, not a bolted-on feature. Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first week. We deploy continuously, so you'll feel the pace immediately. Have real input on what we build, how we build it, and which problems are worth solving next. Nobody here is precious about a roadmap someone else wrote. What we're looking for Independent delivery. You can own and ship end-to-end product slices with minimal supervision. Your track record shows features that shipped, stuck, and solved real user problems. Product trade-off judgement. You balance speed, quality and user impact under ambiguity. You push back when something is underspecified, and make pragmatic calls when it needs to ship anyway. Product taste. You notice when something feels wrong and aren't afraid to raise it. You care about the smaller details while still knowing when to ship at pace. Cross-functional pragmatism. About the position

We’re looking for compiler engineers to join a new ML Compilers Team at Jane Street. 

Machine learning is a critical pillar of our global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction. Our ML team is full of people with a shared love for the craft of software engineering, and for designing APIs and systems that are delightful to use.

ML compilers let us quickly turn research ideas and novel architectures into high-throughput training jobs and low-latency inference. To get the most out of our hardware resources and enable rapid model development and deployment, we are working to understand and improve the current ML compiler technologies and explore where it makes sense to build our own solutions. In this role, you would shape the development of our compiler stack.

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in.

About you

The ideal candidate has worked on an ML compiler in the past, but non-ML compiler experience is also valuable. Experience with any part of the stack is fine, be it high-level ML frameworks (PyTorch, Jax, TensorFlow), graph compilers (Inductor, XLA, TVM) or kernel DSLs (Triton, Helion, cuTile). You should understand how all those pieces fit together even if you are unfamiliar with specific parts. 

Some other things you might be excited about are:

  • Optimisations in ML compilers: algebraic rewriting, materialise vs recompute tradeoffs and fusion, equality saturation, scheduling languages, loop-level optimisation, autotuning
  • ML compiler frontends: graph capture, symbolic and dynamic shapes, control flow, automatic differentiation
  • GPU kernel programming and architecture: Triton, cuTile, CuTeDSL, CUDA, compute and memory hierarchies, programming with tensor cores
  • Compiler concepts: static analysis, intermediate representations like SSA and CFGs, instruction selection
  • ML inference: CUDA Graphs, KV caching, batching
  • ML training: Tensor/Sequence/Expert/Pipeline Parallelism, FSDP, NCCL, activation checkpointing
  • GPU debugging and optimisation: CUDA-GDB, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute
  • Formal methods: proof assistants, automated theorem provers, agentic proof systems
  • Programming languages and DSL design: embedded DSLs, staging and metaprogramming, type systems, functional programming
  • Fluency in English is required

bbe265a115ce.title: Staff Software Engineer (Agentic Search) - Index
bbe265a115ce.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building systems that ingest, process, and organise massive volumes of data into efficient, queryable structures. You will work primarily on offline and nearline pipelines, ensuring that data is fresh, complete, and efficiently accessible by downstream retrieval systems. You will operate in an environment where throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical; designing systems capable of handling tens of gigabytes per second across continuously evolving datasets.

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

  • Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines that sit at the core of our search infrastructure
  • Develop and optimise indexing strategies balancing performance, freshness, and resource efficiency
  • Work on storage formats, compaction strategies, and update mechanisms to keep data accessible and current
  • Ensure reliability and predictability of pipelines under high-throughput conditions
  • Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interaction contracts, while remaining flexible as the system evolves
  • Define and implement observability primitives, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals across offline and nearline pipelines
  • Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations when business needs require it
  • Collaborate with runtime and ML teams to ensure indexing outputs meet retrieval and ranking requirements
  • Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and data processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals

You may be a good fit if you:

  • 8+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems
  • Strong Go experience (C++/Rust is a plus)
  • Experience with large-scale data processing systems (10+ GiB/sec throughput, petabyte-scale datasets, etc.)
  • Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

#LI-MM1

We’re looking for a Software Engineer with strong C++ expertise to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.

Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

Built on top of the open-source YTsaurus ecosystem, we run and extend our own Nebius distribution and develop significant in-house functionality (core and platform-level). We can design, implement, and roll out features end-to-end on our clusters without waiting for upstream approvals and contribute upstream when it makes sense.

At scale today, this includes~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.

What’s inside the platform

You’ll work on a system that includes (and ties together):

  • Distributed Storage (Cypress): transactional semantics, tiered storage, erasure coding, replication, and strong reliability expectations.
  • Compute & ETL: a cluster-wide job scheduler (tens of thousands of cores), MapReduce, YQL for SQL-like data processing, and SPYT (Spark over YTsaurus) for modern data engineering.
  • Interactive analytics (CHYT): ClickHouse® instances spun up directly on compute nodes for fast SQL over data in-place.
  • Dynamic Tables: low-latency NoSQL KV with distributed ACID transactions for OLTP-style workloads and feature stores.
  • Orchestracto: workflow orchestration deeply integrated with the platform (Airflow-like, but platform-native).

What you’ll do

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong systems skills with product sense: understanding who uses the platform, why certain capabilities matter, and making pragmatic trade-offs to maximize impact. On our team, engineering work is expected to be connected to real users and outcomes — you’ll regularly align with internal stakeholders, clarify requirements, and help drive prioritization.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and implement new functionality in YTsaurus core (C++) with production reliability in mind.
  • Build and evolve platform-level capabilities: platform architecture and operating model—multi-cluster growth, shared primitives, and a consistent experience that scales with new teams and use cases.
  • Improve end-to-end platform experience for internal (and external-facing) users: APIs, guardrails, debugging workflows, and automation.
  • Own production quality: incident response / on-call rotation, root cause analysis, and turning learnings into durable fixes.

Above all, you care about building self-healing systems, thrive on debugging performance from kernel to application layer, and enjoy collaborating with software engineers to turn reliability into a feature users never have to think about.

89f6ae76eb67.title: AI-for-Hardware Engineer, Frontier Tech
89f6ae76eb67.description: About Hexa Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies. We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds. We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds. The hardware vertical at Hexa: Frontier Tech Frontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe. We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations. Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build. Why this role, why now AI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly. Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do. The mission We’re looking for an industrial hardware engineer who is 100% AI-pilled, with a dual objective: Adopt AI inside our startups. Make every Frontier Tech venture the fastest-moving hardware team in its category, using the best AI tools available today. Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow. Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two: 80%: deploy AI inside our ventures Hands-on, embedded in the teams, measured by weeks saved. Map the bottlenecks. Sit with each venture and map its engineering workflow, from requirements to design, simulation, electronics, firmware, test, manufacturing and documentation. Find the steps that cost the most weeks. Do the engineering. You are part of the team, not an advisor. You will run the CAD, set up the simulations, push the PCB, write the firmware agent, build the digital twin, produce the documentation, build the tools that automate technical pre-sales material that wins a contract. You ship parts and files, not slides. Run the shared AI infrastructure. Set up and maintain the agents, repos and connectors between tools (CAD, EDA, simulation, data), with a common setup across ventures, so founders spend their time engineering rather than configuring. Make it stick. Start with hands-on workshops on each team’s real problems, then train founders and engineers, write the playbooks, and track real adoption so tools are used every day rather than demoed once. 20%: studio radar and partnerships Keep the map alive. Track the AI-for-hardware landscape and what frontier labs ship, and maintain our living map of tools, maturity and pricing. See beyond the hype. Our founders want evidence, not promises. Benchmark tools on our own parts and problems, not on vendor demos, and tell the studio plainly where the value is and where it is not. Close partnerships. Negotiate studio-wide deals with key players (early access, design-partner status, credits, preferential pricing) so every Hexa hardware venture starts with better conditions than it could get alone. Build the default stack. Turn what works into a reusable AI toolkit that every new Frontier Tech venture gets on day one. Design AI-native companies. Work with founders from day one on where AI sits in the product, how the business model captures value as models improve, which data to capture and own, and which workflows run on agents so the team scales without headcount growing in step with revenue. Who we’re looking for An industrial hardware engineer. 3 to 7 years designing, building and testing physical products in aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, industrial equipment or a hardware startup. You have taken parts from CAD to the shop floor and know tolerancing, DFM, test campaigns and suppliers. 100% AI-pilled. You use AI agents every day, you have built your own automations, and you have already tried text-to-CAD, AI simulation or AI electronics tools on real work. You switch setups as soon as something better ships, and you have opinions on how a hardware company should be built when much of its engineering is done by agents. A skeptical builder. You judge tools by measured time saved, not by launch videos. You are as happy killing a tool as adopting one. High agency and fast. You figure it out and ship without waiting to be told how. You are comfortable jumping between projects in the same week. Commercial sense and pedagogy. Comfortable in front of founders, engineers and vendors, able to run a workshop that turns skeptics into users, and to negotiate a partnership that actually benefits our ventures. Qualités attendues

  • Ecoute, communication, transparence
  • Autonomie
  • Rigueur et organisation
  • Sens du service

 

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • 2 jours de télétravail par semaine ;

In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready. This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate . Key responsibilities Certification strategy and project management Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine) Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) Safety engineering and risk analysis Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882) Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports Compliance and technical documentation Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates Collaboration and continuous improvement Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations). 527ef814ddf9.title: Trainee Consultant Microsoft CE & AI (maart 2027 Program)
527ef814ddf9.description:
Afgestudeerd? What’s next? Stap in bij het HSO Young Professional Program! Kickstart je IT-carrière ! Klaar voor de reis? Join the journey to explore!

Start jouw carrière als Functioneel Consultant bij HSO en geef je toekomst een vliegende start op 1 maart 2027. In ons Young Professional Program ontwikkel je jezelf razendsnel tot een specialist in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), met AI als jouw versnellingsmotor. 

Jouw start bij HSO 
Je begint met een vijfweekse Masterclass waarin je alles leert over Dynamics 365 CE, Microsoft-technologie en de nieuwste ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en automatisering. Je traint op zowel technische vaardigheden als soft skills, zoals klantgericht adviseren, samenwerken en communiceren. Na afronding behaal je je officiële Microsoft-certificering. 

Snel aan de slag bij topklanten 
Na de Masterclass ga je direct aan de slag binnen een ervaren projectteam. Je werkt mee aan digitale transformaties bij klanten als Rituals, Royal BAM en Heineken. Als Functioneel Consultant analyseer je bedrijfsprocessen, vertaal je klantbehoeften naar slimme oplossingen, implementeer je Dynamics 365 CE en begeleid je klanten bij adoptie en optimalisatie van AI-tools zoals Copilot. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen business en technologie. 

Groei in je eigen tempo 
Je staat er nooit alleen voor. Je krijgt begeleiding van een senior consultant, ondersteuning van je manager en een leertraject via de HSO Academy. Je groeit van Trainee naar Junior Consultant en kunt daarna doorgroeien naar Medior of zelfs Lead Consultant – afhankelijk van jouw ambitie, bijvoorbeeld richting AI-integratie, procesoptimalisatie of klantstrategie. 

Wat breng jij mee? 

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding (bijv. in bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie of ICT);
  • Affiniteit met technologie en interesse in AI;
  • Sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden;
  • Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en ambitie;
  • Goede beheersing van zowel Nederlands als Engels;
  • Beschikbaarheid per 1 maart 2027. 

Wat krijg je van ons? 

  • Een goede startsalaris;
  • Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding van €675; 
  • Laptop en smartphone van de zaak; 
  • Hybride werken: thuis, op kantoor of zelfs tijdens een workation; 
  • Vitaliteitsbudget (€65 netto), deelname aan het leasefietsplan en 25 vakantiedagen (plus de optie om 10 extra dagen bij te kopen); 
  • Pensioenregeling bij BeFrank; 
  • Onbeperkte groeimogelijkheden via de HSO Academy en GoodHabitz. 

Waarom HSO? 
Bij HSO werk je in een internationale en innovatieve omgeving waar initiatief wordt gewaardeerd. Je leert verschillende sectoren kennen, werkt met collega’s van diverse nationaliteiten en bouwt aan échte impact. En natuurlijk is er ook ruimte voor plezier: teamuitjes, zomerborrels op het dakterras, sportactiviteiten en maatschappelijk betrokken initiatieven.

55a3c19cf9e4.title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
55a3c19cf9e4.description: Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten. Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten. Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk. Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken. Jouw rol Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten. Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties. Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren. Wat je doet Data- en AI-governance Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI. Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming. Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen. Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps. Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten. Data quality, metadata & AI Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage. Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden. Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen. Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren. Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act. Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen. Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten. Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier. Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren. Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team. Samenwerking & ontwikkeling Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is. a6f539c2e509.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - SAP Connectors
a6f539c2e509.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 

About the Role

Fivetran and dbt Labs are building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

Fivetran's SAP connectors move enterprise data out of SAP and into modern data platforms. We're looking for an all-round SAP specialist who combines strong ABAP skills with deep knowledge of SAP outbound interfacing. You'll work on the interfaces and data extraction mechanisms that let Fivetran reliably pull data from SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems, and you'll help customers and internal teams get the most out of them.

You will be the SAP specialist within a team of Java developers. Your knowledge and input is crucial to the success of this team. 

 

Technologies You’ll Use

  • ABAP programming using traditional SAPGUI as well as Eclipse (or other IDE).
  • Databases (HANA/Oracle/etc)
  • Cloud environments (AWS/GCP/MS)
  • AI tools Claude/Codex/

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance ABAP components (function modules, classes, CDS views, and enhancements) to drive scalable outbound data extraction from SAP systems.
  • Own and modernize internal SAP test environments to accelerate feature development for current connectors and upcoming public cloud / BTP integrations.
  • Architect robust outbound interfaces leveraging OData, standard and generic DataSources, ODP/ODQ delta frameworks, and RFC connections.

148f3008c582.description: Als Data Analist e-commerce ben jij dé analytics expert die data omzet in waardevolle commerciële inzichten. bccaa1158f26.title: Software Engineer - Optimisation Team
bccaa1158f26.description: Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy Location - Utrecht About iwell At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact. The Role The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day. Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems. Success in this role means being able to: Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code. Work with data and models (optimisation, forecasting or plain statistics) without losing sight of the engineering. What you will do Create charging schedules for EV fleets that minimise electricity costs while guaranteeing every vehicle is ready when it needs to be. This means modelling tariffs, grid limits and departure times, and handling what happens when reality deviates from the plan. Calculate the value of each kWh produced or consumed, so that batteries, solar and flexible loads are steered by what energy is actually worth at that moment, and customers can see where their savings come from. Build forecasting models that predict operational issues before they happen, to maximise asset uptime and reduce the number of support tickets our Operations team has to handle. Take your work all the way to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring and bugfixing. Work with the rest of the Optimisation team on the shared tooling, data pipelines and modelling conventions the team uses.. What are looking for 5+ years of production Python development experience, writing clean, tested, maintainable code. A proven ability to translate real-world problems into working code. A pragmatic mindset: you choose the boring, well-understood solution when it's the right one, and you know when it isn't. Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required. Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours Coming into the office 3-4 days per week Bonus points for None of these are required. We'd rather hire a strong engineer and teach the domain than the other way around. Experience with a modelling library such as cvxpy or Pyomo, or other operations research experience.. Time-series forecasting in production, or basic MLOps: keeping models trained, monitored and honest. Data analysis experience Energy, battery or electricity domain knowledge: tariffs, grid constraints, day-ahead and imbalance markets. The willingness to take on a People lead role in the team. Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future. What we offer A competitive salary within the range of EUR 4400-EUR6600 + 8% holiday allowance 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day Working remotely for 2 weeks per year We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport. A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc. iwell is a family-friendly company and employs many employees with care-taking responsibilities Interested? For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/ . Our application process Apply. Our People & Culture Team and the hiring manager will review your application and will respond within 2 weeks. Phone screening. Are you a true iweller-in-the-making? We will invite you for an introductory call. Are you the one? You will have two interviews. For the second interview,, you will also be asked to work on a case. The role

JDC Warehouse Specialist
Position Overview
The Warehouse Specialist runs day-to-day warehouse operations at a Nebius data center site. The role receives, stores and issues high-value hardware (GPU racks, servers, network equipment, spare parts), keeps stock and asset records accurate, and provides equipment to data center engineers on time.
The specialist is the site's hands-on link to the wider logistics function: Transportation and Transport Coordination for arrivals and pickups, Logistics Planning and 3PL Planning for schedules, Back Office for system records, and the Project Office for new processes and tools.
Key Responsibilities
1. Receiving & Dispatch
•    Receive inbound shipments per the delivery schedule; check seals, packaging and contents against ASN, packing list and PO.
•    Record damage and discrepancies with photos on arrival and hand them to Transport Coordination for insurance cases.
•    Prepare outbound shipments and RMA returns: picking, packing, labelling, documents; hand over to carriers at the agreed pickup time.
•    Follow handling standards for heavy, fragile and high-value equipment.
2. Provisioning to Data Center Operations
•    Issue equipment and spare parts to DC engineers on time, according to requests and project priorities.
•    Stage and kit hardware for rack deployments as agreed with ITDC and Project Managers.
•    Keep a clear view of what is available on site and flag shortages to the Team Lead and Logistics Planning.
3. Inventory & Asset Control
•    Post receipts, issues and transfers in ERP/WMS on the same day as the physical movement.
•    Create inventory and asset records for received equipment, including serial numbers.
•    Carry out cycle counts and annual stock takes; investigate and report discrepancies to Back Office.
•    Keep the warehouse tidy, labelled and organized by location.
4. Security, Safety & Compliance
•    Follow site security procedures for deliveries, access control and storage of high-value items.
•    Apply safety rules for handling equipment and operating material handling equipment.
•    Keep records complete and audit-ready (SOX, internal and external audits).
5. Process & Continuous Improvement
•    Work according to global SOPs and site-specific instructions.
•    Suggest improvements and report recurring issues to the Team Lead and the Project Office.
•    Take part in pilots and rollouts of new processes and tools (WMS/TMS, automations) at the site.
6. Local Expertise
•    Provide site-specific knowledge (access rules, dock limits, local carriers and customs specifics) to Transport, Planning and 3PL teams.
•    Identify local operational risks and propose practical mitigation.
7. Add-on Roles (when assigned)
•    + RMA: own RMA flows at the site — intake, documentation, return shipment, status tracking.
•    + Key User (IRG / NetSuite / Project44): first-line support and training for colleagues on the system, test changes, collect feedback for the Project Office.
Expectations
Autonomy: Independently runs daily warehouse tasks at the site within SOPs; escalates discrepancies, damage and security issues to the Team Lead.
Impact: Keeps DC engineers supplied with the right hardware on time and keeps site stock accurate.
Communication: Clear, timely updates to the Team Lead, DC engineers and logistics teams.
Travel: Occasional support to other sites during launches or peaks.
Work Mode: On site; remote work not expected.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Commercial Solutions Engineer, you will work with both commercial and some enterprise prospects and customers in Belgium, aligning their goals and requirements with SentinelOne's offerings across prevention, XDR, and threat hunting. You will play an instrumental role in accelerating our sales initiatives, partnering closely with the sales team to design and propose security solutions that address the unique challenges of our customers. If you are a self-starter who thrives in a high-paced environment and is energized by pitching revolutionary technology to executives and security practitioners alike, we'd love to hear from you.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Work closely with our sales team to design and propose security solutions that meet the unique needs of commercial and enterprise customers in Belgium, applying technical and commercial expertise to address diverse cybersecurity challenges and creatively resolve issues.
  • Lead the Proof of Concept lifecycle from delivering demos through to technical closing, demonstrating strong problem-solving and analytical skills, and provide first and second-level technical support throughout the sales cycle.
  • Develop and showcase a deep understanding of SentinelOne's products and solutions, aligning technical capabilities with customer needs and pain points, and deliver engaging security workshops and demonstrations to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Collaborate with the channel, covering partner networks and engaging with selected enterprise customers, while providing valuable feedback to product management on product features and market trends.
  • Demonstrate objection handling and competitive positioning skills across a range of customer engagements, communicating effectively with CxO-level, technical, and non-technical stakeholders as part of the broader EMEA team.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Fluency in English, Dutch or French, with 3 to 6 years of experience in pre-sales within the cybersecurity industry and a proven track record of successfully selling to large customers and managing complex, competitive sales cycles.
  • Strong technical depth across endpoint security, XDR, and threat hunting, with good knowledge of hacking and exploitation tools and methodologies, detection evasion techniques, and notable malware and anti-malware solutions.
  • Demonstrable experience speaking to both small and large audiences, with excellent presentation skills and the ability to lead business and technical presentations, demonstrations, and conversations with executives and technical practitioners alike.
  • A team-focused approach, positive attitude, and the ability to work effectively both

9bd21e2d39de.title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
9bd21e2d39de.description: Op zoek naar een werkplek waar jouw ideeën het verschil maken en waar je op niveau kan sparren met een team van ambitieuze developers? Als Software Engineer bij IXON werk je aan een modern cloudplatform dat door duizenden machinebouwers wereldwijd wordt gebruikt. Geen remote eilandjes of kortlopende projecten, maar samen bouwen aan een product waar onze klanten fan van zijn. Klaar om impact te maken? Hier krijg jij energie van Binnen jouw rol als Software Engineer werk je niet aan een statische applicatie, maar aan een continu evoluerend cloudplatform met een diversiteit aan functionaliteiten. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het hart van de IXON Cloud: van complexe autorisatiestructuren tot een naadloze gebruikerservaring. Het doel? Onze klanten hun beheerprocessen zo efficiënt mogelijk laten uitvoeren. Om dat voor elkaar te krijgen, werk je met een moderne tech stack die onder andere bestaat uit Angular en TypeScript. Je krijgt de vrijheid om actief mee te beslissen over technische keuzes die ervoor zorgen dat onze applicaties niet alleen vandaag snel en strak draaien, maar ook op de lange termijn schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar blijven. Wat je concreet gaat doen: Je pakt de verantwoordelijkheid, en draagt zorg voor jouw kwalitatief sterke code; Je bent een sparringpartner voor je collega’s en om features technisch uit te diepen; Je tilt graag ons front-end delivery proces naar een hoger niveau, op gebied van observability, testing en deployment Je krijgt de ruimte voor PoC’s en research spikes om de nieuwste technologieën te valideren voor ons platform. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol Jij bent een Software Engineer die gelooft dat een interface pas écht goed is wanneer de logica erachter vlekkeloos werkt. Frontend is jouw passie, maar je snapt ook wat er in de backend gebeurt. Dit maakt je een belangrijke schakel in ons multidisciplinaire Scrum team. Je werkt iteratief, leert van feedback en streeft voortdurend naar verbetering. Bovendien inspireer je jouw collega’s door best practices te delen en samen te groeien. Daarnaast zou het fijn zijn als je jezelf herkent in het volgende rijtje: Je beschikt over een WO werk en denk niveau Minimaal 5+ jaar relevante werkervaring; Sterke kennis van Typescript en Angular of een vergelijkbaar framework; Je hebt sterke affiniteit met User Experience en begrijpt hoe een gebruiker door een applicatie beweegt; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel in het Nederlands als Engels. Kennis en/of ervaring met Python en Docker. Dit hebben wij jou te bieden Streven naar topkwaliteit en een goede werksfeer gaan bij ons hand in hand. We streven naar ontwikkeling op hoog niveau, werken met een geavanceerde tech stack en dagen elkaar inhoudelijk uit. Tegelijkertijd is de sfeer open en informeel. Vragen stellen, kritisch meedenken of een nieuw concept pitchen? Dat hoort er bij ons gewoon bij. Daarnaast krijg je alle ruimte om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Leef je uit tijdens onze vrijdagmiddagprojecten, denk mee in de Frontend Guild en verbreed je horizon tijdens onze interne tech events. Dit vullen we graag aan met: Een goed salaris passend bij jouw niveau en ervaring; Uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden: Een 13e maand, 8% vakantiegeld, Vitaliteitsbudget, WIA-hiaat verzekering en een pensioenregeling; 30 vakantiedagen om op te laden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden; Persoonlijke groei: Een uitgebreide onboarding, ruim persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget en coaching; Een gezellige werkplek inclusief een volle kalender met teamactiviteiten, uitjes en spontane borrels. Wat wij doen? Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten. Naarmate machines complexer worden en de verwachtingen van klanten stijgen, moeten machinebouwers hun services continu professionaliseren om de concurrentie voor te blijven. En dat is precies waar wij in beeld komen. Wij helpen machinebouwers wereldwijd om hun activiteiten te stroomlijnen en hun service naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Dit doen we met een pakket aan innovatieve oplossingen: van veilige remote access tot klantenportalen en geavanceerde data dashboarding. Onze oplossingen zijn ontworpen om zonder beperkingen mee te schalen en naadloos te integreren, zodat onze klanten hun services maximaal kunnen optimaliseren. Klaar om impact te maken? We houden van een laagdrempelige aanpak. Na een korte eerste kennismaking laten we je graag een live demo van ons platform zien. Zo ontdek je precies hoe en wat wij bouwen. Daarnaast maken we graag ruimte voor een kennismaking met het team, zodat je zelf kunt ervaren hoe de sfeer is en met wie je gaat samenwerken. Interesse? Klik op de Apply knop hieronder! Liever eerst informeel sparren over de functie? Neem dan gerust contact op met onze recruitment team via Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. aedbc9346406.title: Eerste lijns system engineer
aedbc9346406.description: IT Medewerker – Eerste Lijns Service Engineer Ben jij die IT-held die energie krijgt van het helpen van mensen, houdt van virtuele omgevingen en SaaS-oplossingen, en een passie heeft voor techniek? Dan zouden we zomaar eens een match kunnen zijn. Wie zoeken we? We zijn op zoek naar een Eerste Lijns Service Engineer / Servicedesk Medewerker die klanten op een vriendelijke én deskundige manier verder helpt. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij IT-vragen of problemen . Zo weet je bijvoorbeeld wat het verschil is tussen een TAC en TAC 2 LAN netwerk of je kan rechten correct toewijzen in SharePoint. Je registreert en bewaakt meldingen in het systeem en zorgt voor een tijdige opvolging. Daarnaast weet precies hoe je iemand geruststelt, duidelijk communiceert en snel tot de kern van het probleem komt. Tot slot wordt je soms ook betrokken bij installatie van hardware en software migraties. Een diverse en uitdagende functie dus. Of je nu net van school komt of al wat meters hebt gemaakt in de IT: we horen graag van je. Wie zijn wij? Welkom bij Progression IT . Wij zijn een hecht en ambitieus IT-bedrijf uit Terneuzen, Zeeland. Al sinds 2005 helpen we onze klanten met slimme, veilige en toekomstgerichte IT-oplossingen. We doen dat met een enthousiast team van 25 collega’s – stuk voor stuk vakmensen met hart voor hun werk én voor elkaar. Onze focus ligt op cloud- en hybride omgevingen. We werken met moderne tools en technologieën en zijn ISO27001-gecertificeerd. Dat betekent dat veiligheid bij ons geen bijzaak is, maar standaard in alles wat we doen. En minstens zo belangrijk: naast hard werken, vinden we het ook belangrijk om lol te hebben. Zo lunchen we dagelijks samen (op kosten van de baas), ligt er altijd vers fruit klaar, en sporten we wekelijks onder begeleiding van een personal trainer. Een of twee keer per jaar trekken we eropuit voor een teamuitje – gewoon, omdat het gezellig is. Wat ga je doen? 🔹 Klanten telefonisch en op afstand ondersteunen (±70%) 🔹 Complexere IT-vraagstukken oplossen (±20%) 🔹 Meewerken aan migraties en installaties van hardware (±10%) Kortom, je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beantwoorden van vragen, het oplossen van incidenten en het uitvoeren van wijzigingen. Je zorgt voor een tevreden klant door je uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden (zowel mondeling als schriftelijk) met je goed humeur en klantgerichtheid. Wat neem je mee? ✔️ MBO niveau 3 of 4, of vergelijkbaar werk- en denkniveau ✔️ Kennis van Microsoft 365, Windows10/11, Windows Servers & Office 365 ✔️ Basiskennis in netwerkbeheer ✔️ Je bent leergierig, hands-on en denkt in oplossingen ✔️ Je hebt affiniteit met ICT en vindt het leuk mensen te helpen ✔️ Je communiceert helder, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk ✔️ Klantgerichtheid zit in je DNA ✔️ Schoolverlaters? Ook welkom! Wat bieden wij jou? 💼 Een uitdagende functie in een groeiend IT-bedrijf 🧑‍💻 Direct klantcontact en afwisselende werkomgeving 🏠 Mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken 💸 Een passend salaris + goede arbeidsvoorwaarden 📱 Laptop én maandelijkse vergoeding voor internet & telefonie 🔄 Vergoeding voor 24/7-diensten 🎯 Bonusregeling en ruimte om certificaten te behalen 🎉 Leuke collega’s met dezelfde passie voor IT 🍎 Gezonde lunches, fruit en wekelijks sporten met een personal trainer Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

64150737fab0.title: Data Quality & Operations Lead, Gen AI
64150737fab0.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
64150737fab0.description: Every AI model is shaped by its training data. Scale's Quality team helps decide whether that data is good enough to ship to the world's leading AI labs, and in this role you'll drive that decision for a portfolio of our highest-impact GenAI programs. As a Data Quality & Operations Lead, you'll operate in a GM-style role: you'll set the quality bar, manage your vertical's costs, and figure out why quality moved before anyone asks. You'll lead a large team of coding specialists who measure and improve data quality across these programs, from agentic RL environments to multilingual post-training data. These are frontier-level problems. The programs you support train the models people are talking about. You'll hold delivery teams accountable across these programs, helping solve nuanced quality issues and leading strategic initiatives that enable reliable, scalable operations across the organization. What you'll do Manage the quality system. Own day-to-day operations: plan and allocate workforce capacity, produce quality reporting, measure productivity and efficiency, and drive quality control policies. Lead a team of coding specialists. Oversee hiring, coaching, and performance management for a growing team. Turn unclear customer requirements into clear standards. Work with delivery teams to interpret and clarify customer requirements, then translate them into measurable signals of data quality. Control the QC budget. Make tradeoffs between coverage, cost, and risk, with real customers and real money on the line. Get ahead of quality trends. Identify, root-cause, and surface defect patterns that delivery teams can act on. Build the future of QC. Our team already uses agentic capabilities; you'll help decide what gets built next and lead the work to keep scaling and advancing quality operations. Ideally you'd have A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Engineering, Operations, or another STEM field 3+ years of experience leading teams and scaling large operational or technical processes Hands-on experience in top-tier management consulting, strategy & operations, product management, or program management Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly with SQL and AI development tools, and close attention to detail Experience building systems, processes, and teams across multiple customer segments or product lines Proven ability to take initiative in cross-functional technical environments Deep experience owning and improving operational metrics end to end Nice to have Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or Operations Experience leading teams in AI/ML services, data annotation, or model evaluation Experience in a fast-growing, less-structured startup environment Experience building teams from the ground up Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits.
