e68ca33e52cc.title: System Identification Engineer
e68ca33e52cc.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the role Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles. As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Lausanne, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust. Responsibilities Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the . Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller. Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects. Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting. Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C. New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles. Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data. Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for. Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs. Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun. Nice to have Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven. Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code. Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

b0efcd755afa.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. 8d85eb2332be.title: Manager Customer Data Engineering – Change & IT Customer Services
8d85eb2332be.description: Wil jij bouwen aan de datafundering van de Customer Services-organisatie van morgen? Als Manager Customer Data Engineering ontwikkel je een ervaren engineeringteam door naar een strategisch Data Product Team. Je brengt data, technologie en business samen en zorgt voor betrouwbare, herleidbare en AI-ready dataproducten. Zo maak je met jouw leiderschap direct impact op besluitvorming, klantbediening én de verdere digitale ontwikkeling van Athora. Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? De Manager Data Customer Engineering rapporteert aan de Director Change & IT Customer Services en geeft leiding aan een team van 10 data engineers en DevOps engineers. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor betrouwbare, herleidbare en bruikbare data voor interne bedrijfsvoering en sturing, operationele besluitvorming, externe verantwoordingsrapportages en toekomstige AI-toepassingen binnen het Customer Services en Commerce domein. De Manager Data Engineering is verantwoordelijk voor de doorontwikkeling van het huidige uitvoerende data- en rapportageteam naar een strategisch Data Product Team. De rol versterkt de data engineering capability binnen Customer Services door betrouwbare, herleidbare en AI-ready dataproducten te realiseren voor operationele sturing, besluitvorming, externe verantwoording en toekomstige data en AI-toepassingen. De manager borgt dat data een betrouwbare weergave vormt van businessprocessen en portalen, dat API's een robuuste en betrouwbare brug vormen tussen applicaties, en dat data-delivery plaatsvindt via Agile werkwijzen, schaalbare data engineering, gecontroleerde DevOps-processen en structurele datakwaliteitsborging. Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden: Ontwikkelen van het Data Engineering team naar een strategisch Data Product Team met end-to-end eigenaarschap voor betrouwbare en waardevolle dataproducten; Het doorvertalen van de Athora datastrategie binnen Customer Services, inclusief het verhogen van datamanagement maturity en het borgen van data lineage en traceerbaarheid. 5d0a25c3d1a0.title: Senior Frontend Engineer / Technical Lead
5d0a25c3d1a0.description: Wil jij niet alleen bouwen aan frontendoplossingen, maar ook richting geven aan hoe we onze websites en digitale platformen de komende jaren ontwikkelen? Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Voor ons Websites & Portals Platform team zoeken we een ervaren frontend engineer die technisch leiderschap combineert met sterke hands-on kennis van Angular. Iemand die vooruitkijkt, een frontend visie en roadmap kan neerzetten en andere teams kan meenemen in de technische richting. Je bent dus niet alleen degene die complexe frontend vraagstukken kan oplossen. Je helpt ook bepalen waar we naartoe gaan, welke technische keuzes we maken en hoe verschillende ontwikkelteams binnen die koers samenwerken. Als Senior Frontend Engineer / Technical Lead speel je een centrale rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons frontend platform. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: - het opstellen en uitdragen van de technische visie en roadmap voor frontend; - het verder ontwikkelen en moderniseren van het frontend platform; - het ontwikkelen van herbruikbare platformcomponenten voor onze websites en digitale klantomgevingen; - het maken en bewaken van technische en architectuurkeuzes; - hands-on ontwikkelen met Angular en TypeScript; - het inhoudelijk richting geven aan developers en ontwikkelteams die gebruikmaken van het platform; - het bewaken van standaarden, kwaliteit, onderhoudbaarheid en samenhang; - het vertalen van behoeften vanuit verschillende teams naar toekomstbestendige technische oplossingen; - samenwerken met onder andere solution teams, architectuur, security en infrastructuur. Het gaat daarmee om meer dan software ontwikkelen. Jij helpt de technische koers van het frontendlandschap te bepalen en zorgt ervoor dat die koers ook daadwerkelijk landt binnen de organisatie. Wat deze rol interessant maakt? Je krijgt de kans om op meerdere niveaus impact te maken. De ene keer duik je zelf de techniek in. De andere keer bespreek je een architectuurkeuze, werk je aan de roadmap of help je een ander team om een oplossing binnen het platform goed neer te zetten. Daarbij kijk je verder dan het individuele vraagstuk. Je vraagt je steeds af: hoe maken we het platform eenvoudiger, consistenter, schaalbaarder en toekomstbestendiger? #LI-DNI Wat vragen we van jou? We zoeken nadrukkelijk een ervaren frontendprofessional die technische diepgang weet te combineren met visie en leiderschap. Je hebt: - ruime ervaring met frontendontwikkeling; - diepgaande ervaring met Angular en TypeScript; - ervaring met NX workspace / monorepo en NodeJS, of vergelijkbare moderne frontendomgevingen; - ervaring met Azure App Service en Azure Pipelines, of vergelijkbare cloud- en CI/CD-omgevingen; - ervaring met het ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen van frontendplatformen; - het vermogen om een technische visie en roadmap op te stellen en uit te dragen; - ervaring met het inhoudelijk richting geven aan developers of andere ontwikkelteams; - voldoende senioriteit om technische keuzes uit te leggen en verschillende stakeholders daarin mee te nemen; - kennis van .NET en API-integraties (pré); - ervaring met Agile, Scrum en/of SAFe; - minimaal hbo-werk- en denkniveau; - een goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels en woonachtig in Nederland. Wie ben jij? Je bent technisch sterk, maar bent niet iemand die het liefst alleen met code bezig is. - Je kijkt verder dan het vraagstuk van vandaag; - Je ziet afhankelijkheden tussen teams en systemen; - Je durft technische keuzes te maken en daarvoor te staan; - Je kunt ontwikkelteams enthousiasmeren en meenemen; - Je schakelt makkelijk tussen developers, architecten en management; - Je bent pragmatisch en weet wanneer een oplossing technisch goed genoeg is; - Je neemt eigenaarschap over de ontwikkeling van het platform. Je combineert daarmee de kwaliteiten van een senior engineer, technisch sparringpartner en kartrekker. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten. Salaris per maand: Op basis van cao schaal 16 HAY is de range € 5.082,02 tot € 6.776,03 op basis van 36 uur. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button! 810c8c7037bb.title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
810c8c7037bb.description: The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us. Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten. HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before. The kind of work you could be on in your first months: Agentic Commerce : making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat. AI Design Studio : letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence. AI-first customer service : replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end. Internal agent swarms : automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours. Whatever you spot next : if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it. We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week. Who you are: You are a builder before anything else . You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age. You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better. You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out. You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks. You will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest. You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it. You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees. You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly. You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud. What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that. What you get: The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else , because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change. A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship. Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you. Ownership from day one : your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs. The best tools, no budget debates : the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as soon as they are worth using. A growth path that follows your output, not your age : if you outgrow your role in six months, your role grows with you. A fast, flat, no-politics team in Rotterdam, with a hands-on culture and a high bar. Flexible set-up : full-time, or part-time alongside your studies. We care about what you deliver. Salary and contract are tailored to your situation and your level, and we pay properly for real talent. How to apply: Skip the cover letter. Show us what you have built. Send us three things: Your best project : a link to something you built: a live product, a repo, a demo video. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you would do differently now. Something you think is broken : one thing about HelloPrint (our website, our ordering flow, anything) that you would rebuild with AI, and how you would do it. A short intro : who you are and what you are obsessed with right now. Five sentences is plenty. What happens next: We read every application ourselves and reply within 5 days

87f15e896dea.description: Bouw mee aan de digitale toekomst van de openbare ruimte Bij Progresity ontwikkelen we software die gemeenten helpt om de openbare ruimte slimmer, veiliger en duurzamer te beheren. Onze applicatie BinnenBeter verbindt inwoners en gemeenten: via de BuitenBeter app kunnen inwoners eenvoudig meldingen doen van problemen in de openbare ruimte, van kapotte straatverlichting tot zwerfafval of een losliggende stoeptegel. Gemeenten ontvangen deze meldingen in BinnenBeter en kunnen ze efficiënt opvolgen, zodat elke melding leidt tot een zichtbare verbetering in de leefomgeving. Zo zorgen we samen voor schonere, veiligere en beter onderhouden steden voor miljoenen inwoners in Nederland. We staan aan de vooravond van een belangrijke volgende stap. Niet alleen ontwikkelen we onze software verder, ook professionaliseren we de manier waarop we software bouwen. We willen groeien naar een moderne engineeringorganisatie waarin eigenaarschap, kwaliteit, automatisering en continu verbeteren centraal staan. Daarom zoeken we een Lead Software Engineer (Java) die niet alleen technisch sterk is, maar ook energie krijgt van het verder brengen van een engineeringteam. Iemand die verder kijkt dan de code van vandaag, een duidelijke technische visie kan ontwikkelen en anderen weet mee te nemen in verandering. Die begrijpt dat goede software niet alleen draait om technologie, maar ook om samenwerking, vakmanschap en het maken van de juiste keuzes. Jouw rol Als Lead Software Engineer (Java) combineer je hands-on software engineering met technisch leiderschap. Je werkt binnen een multidisciplinair productteam aan de verdere ontwikkeling van BinnenBeter en neemt het voortouw in de technische richting en professionalisering van Engineering. Je bent eigenaar van de technische visie en architectuur van het product. Je bepaalt samen met je collega's hoe we onze software toekomstbestendig houden en vertaalt technische ambities naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan nieuwe functionaliteiten: ook onderhoudbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, security, betrouwbaarheid en technische schuld krijgen structureel aandacht. Tegelijkertijd ben je een belangrijke kartrekker in het verbeteren van onze manier van werken. Hoe kunnen we sneller en betrouwbaarder releasen? Hoe maken we geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD vanzelfsprekend? Hoe zorgen we dat engineers verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor hun software, ook nadat deze in productie staat? Je hoeft deze uitdagingen niet alleen op te lossen. Je coacht Software Engineers, stimuleert eigenaarschap en zorgt dat technische kennis en verantwoordelijkheden niet bij één persoon blijven liggen. Je gaat onder andere aan de slag met: Het ontwikkelen, uitdragen en bewaken van de technische visie en softwarearchitectuur van BinnenBeter. Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van robuuste, onderhoudbare en schaalbare software met Java en Spring Boot. Het richting geven aan belangrijke technische keuzes en het ontwikkelen en borgen van engineeringstandaarden en architectuurprincipes. Het vertalen van relevante wet- en regelgeving en beveiligingseisen naar concrete technische richtlijnen. Het verbeteren van onze engineeringpraktijken, waaronder CI/CD, testautomatisering, observability en DevOps. Het inzichtelijk maken en structureel aanpakken van technische schuld, kwetsbaarheden en andere technische risico's. Het ontwikkelen en realiseren van een technische verbeteragenda, samen met het engineeringteam. Het coachen van Software Engineers en stimuleren van zelfstandigheid, kennisdeling en technisch eigenaarschap. Het versterken van de samenwerking tussen Engineering, Product, UX, Quality en Cloud/Platform. Het onderzoeken van nieuwe technologieën en werkwijzen, waaronder AI, die onze software of manier van ontwikkelen daadwerkelijk beter maken. Wat neem je mee? We zoeken een ervaren Software Engineer die inhoudelijk sterk is, maar ook begrijpt dat technisch leiderschap meer vraagt dan het maken van goede technische keuzes. Je kunt complexe vraagstukken analyseren en een duidelijke richting bepalen. Tegelijkertijd weet je anderen daarin mee te nemen, sta je open voor andere perspectieven en haal je voldoening uit het ontwikkelen van collega's. Wat we belangrijk vinden: Ruime ervaring met Java en Spring Boot en een sterke achtergrond in professionele software engineering. Ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, REST API's en het ontwerpen van onderhoudbare en schaalbare applicaties. Je kunt complexe technische vraagstukken doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en onderbouwde technische keuzes maken. Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van technische standaarden, architectuurprincipes en engineeringpraktijken. Je hebt kennis van moderne softwareontwikkeling, waaronder CI/CD, geautomatiseerd testen, security en observability. Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden of coachen van andere Software Engineers en vindt het leuk om collega's technisch verder te helpen. Je communiceert helder, kunt technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen en weet verschillende disciplines met elkaar te verbinden. Je neemt initiatief, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet ideeën om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen. Je bent pragmatisch en kunt een goede balans vinden tussen technische kwaliteit, ontwikkelsnelheid en klantwaarde. Je bent beschikbaar voor 32, 36 of 40 uur per week. Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: Ervaring met Angular en TypeScript. Ervaring met WildFly, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes of vergelijkbare technologieën. Ervaring met het begeleiden van technische veranderingen of het professionaliseren van een engineeringteam. Ervaring met cloud-native architecturen, DevOps en het beheren van software in productie. Je hoeft niet eerder de functietitel Lead Software Engineer te hebben gehad. Misschien ben je nu Senior Software Engineer of Software Architect en merk je dat je steeds vaker technische richting geeft, collega's begeleidt en verbeteringen initieert. Als je klaar bent om daarin een volgende stap te ze

ef988289e3ef.title: Agent Security Engineer
ef988289e3ef.description: Belmont Lavan is hiring an Agent Security Engineer to secure autonomous AI agents before and after they reach production. Agents now call tools, hold credentials and act on live systems, so they need the controls we already expect for people and services: identity, least-privilege access, monitoring and testing. You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence. Requirements 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP) Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust Cloud security on AWS, Azure or GCP, including logging, detection and policy-as-code (e.g. OPA / Cedar) Ability to explain AI risk clearly to engineers, risk teams and executives Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

300641fd1290.title: DevOps Engineer
300641fd1290.description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. DevOps at SkinVision As a DevOps Engineer at SkinVision, you will play a key role in building, scaling, and securing the infrastructure that powers our AI-driven health platform. You’ll design and maintain our cloud-based systems in AWS, implement CI/CD pipelines, enhance observability using Datadog, and drive operational excellence through automation and monitoring. Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of a medical-grade system that serves users globally. You’ll collaborate closely with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure smooth delivery, rapid deployments, and resilient operations — ultimately enabling us to deliver life-saving technology with confidence. Beyond hands-on expertise with AWS and modern DevOps tooling, we’re looking for someone who thinks architecturally. You’ll get to know our current setup, form your own view of how it should evolve, and help define a target vision for our infrastructure, then drive its implementation. Day-to-day operational work is part of the role, but we value someone who thinks before building and takes ownership of where our infrastructure goes next. What you will do Cloud Infrastructure & Automation Design, build, and manage AWS-based infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation. Automate environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments using CI/CD pipelines. Ensure system resilience, security, and performance through automated monitoring and alerting. CI/CD & Deployment Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and safe deployments across environments. Manage deployment workflows using Argo CD and Kubernetes. Collaborate with developers and ML engineers to streamline build, test, and release processes. Integrate automated testing, rollback strategies, and version control into the deployment lifecycle. Observability & Monitoring Build a comprehensive observability stack using Datadog for metrics, logs, traces, and alerts. Define service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and dashboards for system performance. Proactively detect and resolve performance bottlenecks, capacity issues, and reliability risks. Create automated health checks and ensure visibility across production systems. Security & Compliance Implement security best practices for AWS, containers, and CI/CD pipelines. Manage identity, access, and secret handling (IAM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store). Ensure compliance with medical device standards and data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA). Partner with the Information Security Officer to embed security controls across infrastructure and deployments. Reliability & Incident Management Lead incident response and root cause analysis for infrastructure or deployment-related issues. Establish SLAs and operational runbooks for production environments. Continuously improve system reliability through chaos testing, redundancy, and fault tolerance. Mentor engineers on DevOps principles, observability practices, and infrastructure automation. Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture Assess the current infrastructure and deployment setup, and form a well-reasoned view of how it should evolve. Define and maintain a target architecture for our cloud platform, balancing reliability, scalability, security, and cost. Translate the target vision into a practical roadmap and drive its implementation incrementally, alongside day-to-day operations. Document and communicate architectural decisions, aligning with engineering and leadership on technical direction. Essential skills Minimum of 6 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure roles. Strong expertise with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, etc.). Expert in Kubernetes and Argo CD, deploying and managing production-grade custom Helm charts with secure, automated GitOps workflows in EKS Advanced knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar). Proficiency in Datadog for observability, monitoring, and alerting. Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or Go. Experience managing infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible. Familiarity with networking fundamentals, load balancing, and API gateway configuration. Excellent problem-solving and incident management skills. Desirable skills Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, MedTech, or FinTech. Familiarity with multi-environment architecture (staging, pre-prod, production) and blue-green deployments. Exposure to event-driven systems, message queues, and data streaming (Kafka, SNS/SQS)

8a33dd934ce1.title: Senior PHP Backend Developer
8a33dd934ce1.description: About Shiftbase At Shiftbase, we build workforce software that helps people get work done. Thousands of teams across Europe rely on our platform every day to plan work, track time, and manage leave, freeing them from unnecessary admin so they can focus on what matters and what sparked their business. As we continue to grow in customers, usage and product ambition, the demands on our platform grow with us. Our backend needs to scale in quality, reliability and speed of change . That’s why we’re investing heavily in modernising our platform, building a foundation that allows us to move faster, deliver better experiences, and support the next phase of Shiftbase’s growth. About the role: As a Senior Backend Engineer, you are a key driver of both product delivery and platform modernisation. You work on the core of our backend, improving reliability, performance and scalability, with the explicit goal of turning Shiftbase from a platform people enjoy into a platform they love. You help evolve a mature monolithic codebase into a more modular, testable and future-proof architecture. By modernising the foundation of the product, you directly enable better user experiences, faster iteration and higher overall product quality. What you'll do Drive technical excellence Design and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for complex features and system components Make informed architectural decisions that balance pragmatism with long-term vision Set the bar for technical craft through your contributions and code reviews Own complex technical initiatives from design through production, breaking them into testable increments Build for reliability and scale Define comprehensive testing strategies for complex features, championing quality within the team Debug and resolve complex issues across multiple components, improving system observability Apply security best practices throughout the development lifecycle Contribute to monitoring, alerting and system health improvements Enable team growth Mentor engineers with targeted technical guidance and feedback Support onboarding and enable a collaborative, knowledge-sharing environment Help shape delivery practices and improve team velocity through data-informed decisions What we're looking for Core technical expertise You have deep backend engineering experience with complex, high-scale systems. We don't expect expertise in everything listed below. We value engineers who've built depth and breadth through genuine curiosity and a drive to solve real problems. These are examples of competencies that matter in this role: Modern PHP & architectural patterns : Experience with hexagonal architecture, domain-driven design, or similar patterns that emphasize domain modeling over framework magic. You can build maintainable systems without relying on framework shortcuts. SQL & database design : Comfort writing raw SQL (not just ORM abstractions) and working with complex relational schemas particularly around time-sensitive data like scheduling, timesheets and payroll where integrity and performance are critical. Legacy modernisation experience : You've gradually evolved mature systems rather than pursuing big-bang rewrites. You know when to modernize strategically vs. leaving working code untouched, and understand the balance between progress and stability when serving thousands of customers. Monolith to services : Experience breaking down monoliths with good judgment about when distribution solves real problems (deployment bottlenecks, team autonomy) vs. when it adds unnecessary complexity. Testing in legacy contexts : Practical experience with unit and integration testing, particularly incrementally improving coverage in existing systems. This might be your dream job if… ✅ You enjoy modernising a mature platform and turning legacy code into something you’re proud of ✅ You get energy from breaking down a monolith and shaping a more modular, service-oriented architecture ✅ You care about product quality , not just “shipping code”. ✅ You like improving reliability, performance and developer experience as much as adding new features ✅ You enjoy working closely with product and frontend to make better technical and product decisions This probably isn’t your dream job if… ⛔️ You only want to work on greenfield projects and avoid legacy systems altogether ⛔️ You’re uncomfortable refactoring existing code or making incremental improvements ⛔️ You prefer being handed fully-defined solutions rather than helping shape them ⛔️ You’re looking for a role where architecture decisions are already “done” ⛔️ You’d rather optimise locally than care about the end-to-end product experience Note: Candidates outside the Netherlands will not be considered Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

05d16ff3f61a.title: Data Talent
05d16ff3f61a.description: Krijg jij energie van data en wil je bouwen aan iets waar je echt trots op kunt zijn? Bij Prijsvrij Vakanties en D-reizen draait alles om data: van betrouwbare datastromen tot automatiseringen, dashboards en analyses die collega’s helpen betere keuzes te maken. Ons data team groeit, en daarbij geloven we in één ding: de juiste persoon is belangrijker dan de juiste functietitel. Ben jij een echt datatalent? Dan maken we graag een plek voor je. Vertel ons waar jouw krachten liggen, dan kijken we samen hoe jij het beste tot je recht komt in ons team. ✈️ Bij ons data team kun je terecht als: Data Engineer: je bouwt en beheert pipelines, databases en koppelingen, en zorgt dat data klopt en beschikbaar is; AI Engineer: je bouwt toepassingen met LLM’s en AI-agents en zorgt dat AI echt waarde toevoegt in onze processen; Data Scientist: je ontwikkelt voorspellende modellen en zet machine learning en AI in waar het waarde toevoegt; Data Analyst: je vertaalt vragen uit de organisatie naar heldere analyses en bouwt dashboards in Power BI die collega’s dagelijks gebruiken; Business Analyst: je vormt de brug tussen de business en het data team, en zorgt dat de juiste vragen worden beantwoord. Herken je jezelf in een combinatie van deze rollen? Nog beter! Dit krijg jij: De allerbeste deal! De reis van jouw leven met een positie in een informele organisatie, waar harde werkers het verschil maken voor onze klanten. De mogelijkheid om je intern te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij ontvangen je met open armen in een hecht en gezellig team, waar je samen met je collega’s bijdraagt aan onze missie: een zorgeloze reis voor de beste prijs! Een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden; 25 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime) en 8% vakantiegeld; Een goede pensioenregeling via Nationale Nederlanden; Korting op je eigen vakanties én Friends & Family-korting om weg te geven; Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 kilometer enkele reis; Volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden via My Academy; Een moderne werkplek in het bruisende hart van ‘s-Hertogenbosch; Office gym, een handig fietsplan en collectiviteitskorting bij CZ; Gezelligheid gegarandeerd met onze vrijdagmiddagborrels, Bossche bollen als er iets te vieren is én maandelijks een padeltoernooi. Of je al een tijdje werkt en toe bent aan een volgende stap, of net bent afgestudeerd: je bent welkom. Talent zit niet in je leeftijd, maar in wat je kunt en wat je nog wilt leren. Jij (gaat op vakantie en) neemt mee: Een afgeronde hbo of wo-opleiding; Een technische basis, opgedaan tijdens je studie of in een eerdere baan, en de wil om die verder uit te bouwen; Ambitie om het beste uit data te halen, en uit jezelf; Een analytische blik: je ziet patronen in data en weet wat je er wel en niet uit kunt concluderen; Een zelfstandige en gestructureerde houding, waarmee je makkelijk schakelt bij ad-hoc vragen; Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Je woont in de regio Den Bosch en haalt energie uit samenwerken met collega’s op kantoor. Ready for take-off? Klaar om samen met ons data om te zetten in een zorgeloze reis voor de beste prijs? We maken graag kennis met je! Nog vragen? We zijn maar één belletje of WhatsAppje van je verwijderd: 06 45 49 13 03. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

ab49ce71da02.title: Data Analyst
ab49ce71da02.description: Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact! At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in. We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome. What will you do? Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied. Product In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work. Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition; Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working; Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts; Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them; Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development; Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company. Commercial & marketing support Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex. Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities; Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS. This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact. Your team You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data. The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks. What are we looking for? We are looking for someone who: Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst; Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics; Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude; Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it; Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter; Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders; Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues; Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus); We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them. What do we offer? A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment; 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek; 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance; We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp; Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more; A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy; One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in; A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions; A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility. YoungOnes is a place where you learn fast, build fast and see results fast. Ready to take the lead? Then we would love to hear from you. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

867d0ceb27ad.title: QA Engineer
867d0ceb27ad.description: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams. What you'll do Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building; Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why; Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable; Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses; Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority; Advise on releases. 2384055daada.description:
About the Team

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives.

About the Role

As a Test Engineer on the Robotics team, you will help shape the next generation of embodied AI. You’ll design and run rigorous, exploratory and requirements-driven tests—building custom test equipment, analyzing results, and translating findings into actionable insights that drive design breakthroughs and mitigate risks across hardware and software. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence how our AI scales beyond simulation, ensuring that every design, test, and iteration brings us closer to truly adaptive, versatile robotic systems.

In this role, you will:

 - Design and build custom test benches to evaluate system performance under realistic operating conditions; proficient in CAD and familiar with GD&T.

 - Analyze and interpret test data to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes.

 - Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans that validate mechanical performance against product requirements.

 - Execute validation and verification testing, capturing both quantitative and qualitative data with high fidelity.

 - Author clear, actionable test reports that summarize results, highlight risks, and recommend design or process changes.

 - Partner with engineering, product, and leadership teams to inform design iterations and strategic decisions.

 - Design and execute compliance and regulatory testing campaigns, informing in-house vs 3rd party testing strategy

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have strong intuition for mechanical and electromechanical systems and how they fail, degrade, or vary in real-world operation.

 - Enjoy hands-on lab work designing, instrumenting, operating, and debugging test equipment and robotic hardware.

 - Can turn evolving requirements and ambiguous failures into repeatable tests, trustworthy data, and clear engineering decisions.

 - Balance rigorous validation, safety, and traceability with rapid hardware iteration.

 - Communicate clearly across mechanical, electrical, software, controls, and manufacturing teams, and build alignment on risks and corrective actions.

Preferred Qualifications

 - 7+ years of experience in hardware testing or validation, including at least 2 years working with robotics hardware components and systems.

 - Bachelor’s or graduate degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Experience designing test fixtures and stands using CAD, engineering drawings, and GD&T.

 - Hands-on experience integrating sensors, instrumentation, and data acquisition (DAQ) systems, including calibration and measurement traceability.

 - Experience developing automated or hardware-in-the-loop tests using Python, C/C++, or AI coding tools for test execution, data collection, and analysis.

 - Experience designing reliability, accelerated life, environmental, and hardware qualification tests for robotic or electromechanical systems.

 - Experience supporting EVT, DVT, PVT, pilot production, or sustaining hardware validation.

 - Experience using root cause analysis, FMEA, or FEA to guide design improvements.

 - Experience executing product standards compliance certification campaigns.

About the Team

OpenAI, in close collaboration with our capital and delivery partners, is building the infrastructure required to support frontier AI systems. The Data Center Engineering team defines repeatable technical standards and carries them through design, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness. The team works across data center facilities, power generation, compute infrastructure, construction, procurement, and operations to deliver reliable capacity at unprecedented scale and speed.

About the Role

We are seeking a Controls Engineer to design, program, integrate and commission on-site power generation and microgrid control systems serving large AI data center campuses. You will own control architecture and functional requirements across generation packages, balance-of-plant systems, electrical protection, microgrid controls, and data center monitoring. You will work from concept through factory testing, site commissioning, performance validation, and operational improvement.

This role requires hands-on experience with industrial control systems, including PLC and DCS programming, plant-level control sequences, equipment integration, simulation, testing and commissioning. The engineers will work with equipment vendors, system integrators and the broader data center team to make sure the complete power system operates safely and reliably across normal and failure conditions.

Travel: 50%

Key Responsibilities

 - Power Generation and Microgrid Controls
   
   - Design, program and commission plant power controllers (PPCs) and microgrid control systems for gas turbine and reciprocating engine power plants.
   
   - Develop control sequences for grid-connected, islanded and transition modes, including startup, shutdown, synchronization, load sharing, import/export control, load shedding, black start, restoration and resynchronization.
   
   - Coordinate active power, reactive power, voltage and frequency controls across generators, energy storage, MV UPS and other distributed energy resources.
   
   - Define how the plant responds to generator trips, loss of utility power, large load changes, equipment failures and loss of communication.
   
   - Work with OEMs to define the boundaries between turbine or engine controls, generator controls, the PPC, protection systems and data center controls.

 - Electrical systems and utility interconnection
   
   - Review utility and transmission-provider interconnection requirements and translate them into plant control, protection, metering, communications and testing requirements.
   
   - Work with utility and equipment vendors to define controls and interfaces at the point of interconnection, including power limits, voltage and frequency response, reactive, power factor, telemetry and dispatch.
   
   - Review interconnection studies, operating procedures and test requirements, and track the actions needed to demonstrate compliance.
   
   - Work with Engineer-Of-Record (EOR) to review load-flow, short-circuit, stability, step-load and electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies. Use the results to develop control settings, sequences and test cases.

 - Control Architecture:
   
   - Develop and review functional design specifications (FDS), sequences of operation, network architecture diagrams, I/O lists and alarm philosophies.
   
   - Review P&IDs and instrumentation for generation-plant systems, including fuel gas, cooling, lubrication and other balance-of-plant equipment.
   
   - Define equipment interfaces, control modes, permissives, interlocks and failure responses between OEM packages and the plant control system.

 - Real-Time Simulation and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing:
   
   - Develop and execute real-time simulation and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) tests for generation and microgrid control systems using RTDS and RSCAD.
   
   - Work with internal engineering teams and equipment vendors to build and validate representative models of the electrical system, from the generation plant and utility interconnection through the data center distribution system to representative GPU rack loads.
   
   - Develop and execute test cases for normal operation, mode changes, load steps, trips, faults, and system failures.
   
   - Compare simulation and HIL results with equipment data, factory test results and field performance. Document model assumptions and limitations.

 - Testing, commissioning and delivery
   
   - Develop and review FAT, SAT and integrated systems test plans for plant and microgrid controls.
   
   - Participate in factory testing, site testing, energization support, tuning and commissioning of generation and data center power systems.
   
   - Troubleshoot controls and system-integration issues using controller data, alarms, event records, trends and test results.
   
   - Work with OEMs, EPCs, utilities and system integrators to resolve interface gaps and track issues through closure.
   
   - Coordinate the handover of final project deliverables, including software, configurations, backups, test records, operating instructions and training, to the data center operations team.

Qualifications

 - 8+ years of hands-on experience designing, programming, integrating and commissioning industrial controls for power generation, industrial plants, utilities, or mission-critical infrastructure.

 - Strong hands-on experience with PLC, DCS, SCADA, historian, industrial-networking, and control-system integration.

 - Experience with plant power control, generator controls, synchronization, load sharing, islanding and load-shedding schemes.

 - Experience integrating controls with power generation equipment, protective relays, SCADA/EPMS and other plant systems.

 - Experience developing functional specifications, sequences, I/O, alarms, graphics, and factory or site test procedures.

 - Ability to troubleshoot across software, instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, communications, and operating-process bo

75bc8e1cca8e.title: Software Engineer, GPU Infrastructure
75bc8e1cca8e.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


WHY THIS TEAM?

Internal Infrastructure builds the infrastructure and tools used to train, evaluate, and serve Cohere's foundation models. You will work with AI researchers and ML engineers on stability, scalability, and observability. The work accelerates the models behind Cohere's platform, North.

You will run the shared Kubernetes fleets those workloads land on: multi-cloud GPU and TPU clusters, node health, performance, and the partnership with cloud providers and hardware vendors. The role includes a compensated 24x7 on-call rotation.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Deploy and operate GPU Kubernetes clusters across clouds, and bring up new hardware generations and providers.

 - Work with cloud providers and hardware partners on reliability, performance, and cost, including RDMA and high-speed interconnects.

 - Automate node, GPU, and fabric fault detection and remediation so most faults are fixed without a human.

 - Improve fleet utilization, track cost, and cut the time it takes to get a faulty node back into service.

 - Troubleshoot production failures and performance problems, and leave the system easier to operate than you found it.

We hire at more than one level. We set level based on the scope you've owned and how independently you drive work.



YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Run GPU Kubernetes clusters with thousands of GPUs for ML or HPC workloads.

 - Debugged Linux, networking, and performance problems. Familiarity with RDMA, NCCL, or accelerator health is a plus.

 - Written software in Python or Go. You would rather extend a solid open-source project than rebuild it.

 - Worked with researchers, ML engineers, or another team whose goals were not identical to yours.

 - Found a bottleneck, proposed a fix, and driven it in a fast-moving environment.

If this does not line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

d390b4184b12.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - ML (London)
d390b4184b12.description:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn, Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re looking for Forward Deployed ML Engineers who want to work at the intersection of deep technical work and direct customer impact. As an ML FDE, you’ll partner with leading AI companies and foundation model labs to help them achieve state-of-the-art performance on their most demanding workloads: LLM serving, model training (SFT, RLHF), audio pipelines, scientific computing, and more. You’ll help teams reach outcomes most engineers can’t on their own.

The FDE team today includes world-class software engineers, computational scientists, ML engineers, and former founders. We’re looking for people with strong engineering fundamentals, deep curiosity across the AI stack, and energy for working directly with customers on hard problems.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Work hands-on with companies like Suno, Cognition, and Meta to architect and optimize production AI workloads on Modal

 - Contribute to open-source projects (members of the team are active contributors to SGLang) and publish technical content that demonstrates Modal’s capabilities across the AI stack

 - Collaborate with Modal’s product and sales teams, contributing to the platform as both an engineer and a product stakeholder

 - Build trusted relationships with technical leaders (CTOs, VPs of Engineering, ML leads) at companies doing frontier AI work

 - Conduct technical demos, experiments, and proofs of concept that make Modal’s performance advantages tangible




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 2+ years of professional ML engineering experience, ideally with hands-on work in inference optimization, model training, GPU programming, or ML infrastructure

 - You’re familiar with the serving (e.g., vLLM, SGLang) and training (e.g., slime, verl, TRL) toolchains and can go deep on at least one (you don’t need all of them)

 - You’re a strong communicator who can go deep on technical architecture with an engineering team and clearly articulate tradeoffs to technical leadership

 - You have a genuine interest in working directly with customers: you find it energizing to understand someone else’s problem and help them solve it

 - You’re willing to work in person in London




NICE-TO-HAVE:

 - Side projects, open-source contributions, or published work you’re proud of in ML or systems performance

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Sell directly to founders, CTOs, and heads of ML who define the ideal customer and hold the budget from day one.

REQUIREMENTS:

2582e3616111.title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
2582e3616111.description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

What You'll Do
Lead foundational measurement and insights work for generative music experiences, developing the frameworks that help Spotify understand how creators, listeners, and rights holders engage with generative AI music. Design and run large-scale analyses and evaluations of generative music systems, from prompt interpretation to model output quality, using Spotify's unique behavioral datasets, annotations, and experimentation platforms. Partner with Engineers and AI Researchers to integrate evaluation signals into model development loops, debugging workflows, and product iteration, making sure scientific rigor informs technical direction. Identify the behavioral and market dynamics that shape sustainable consumer demand and creator participation, and translate them into clear strategic recommendations. Build practical, scalable metrics and decision systems that define what "good" looks like for AI music: credibility, user delight, safety, creator alignment, and ecosystem trust. Bring together model, user behavior, and ecosystem signals into clear narratives that shape product strategy, cross-functional alignment, and long-term priorities across Spotify. Create the datasets, dashboards, and long-term measurement systems that give Spotify a lasting, comprehensive understanding of product health and impact. Work closely with Product, Design, Research, Legal, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Policy, and Licensing teams, bringing statistical rigor and principled measurement to help build artist-first systems that scale responsibly.
Who You Are 
You have a track record of using insights to shape strategy for major company initiatives involving many different partners. You have significant hands-on experience in advanced analytics or data science, ideally in a domain involving LLM evaluation, user-generated content, or complex user behavior. You communicate clearly, form well-founded, evidence-backed points of view, and can bring together messy, multimodal signals (quantitative, qualitative, and model telemetry) into clear narratives for senior executives, researchers, engineers, and the music industry. You're proficient in advanced analytics with Python and SQL, have analyzed large datasets, and use AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Copilot) to increase your productivity and impact. You have experience developing metrics frameworks for complex products that help teams measure impact and reason clearly about priorities. You have experience with machine learning frameworks, designing and assessing multimodal or embedding-based models, and validating them against LLM judges or human ground truth, with an understanding of how to evaluate models beyond offline accuracy. You have a solid grounding in experimental design and causal inference, such as A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and power analysis. You thrive when tackling loosely defined problems in ambiguous, zero-to-one spaces.
Where You'll Be 
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home This team operates within the US Eastern timezone for collaboration
The United States base range for this position is $144,714–$206,735 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.


Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

You like staying ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development. 91009a5ab604.title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Finance
91009a5ab604.description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to lead the data architecture behind our most business-critical financial work: billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting. You'll design the data solutions that finance, payments and audit teams depend on, set the standards for how analytics work ships, and mentor others on the team.

This is a shape-the-team role. You'll have real influence over how we work, what we build and the pace we move at.

We expect you to use AI fluently where it adds leverage in modeling, code review and debugging, and to apply clear judgment on where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and development of high-impact data models in dbt.

  • Architect data solutions across business-critical financial workflows, including billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting.

  • Mentor analytics engineers and review code to uphold standards across the team.

  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the data stack.

  • Translate business problems into clean, efficient data solutions in close partnership with stakeholders.

  • Set team-wide standards for documentation, CI/CD, observability and testing.

  • Set the team's norms for where AI belongs in our workflow, from model development to code review, and where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering or a similar role, with a track record of designing data models that hold up to cross-functional use.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with dbt, SQL and Python on a modern data platform (Databricks or equivalent).

  • Strong grasp of pipeline orchestration, testing frameworks and the practices that keep them healthy at scale.

  • Comfortable setting technical direction, mentoring engineers and working closely with finance, payments and audit stakeholders. You can explain a trade-off clearly and influence the decision that follows.

  • You use AI hands-on in your day-to-day technical work and can show specific examples of how it has changed the way you build, review or debug data models.

  • You catch AI's errors before anything ships, including hallucinations, overconfident answers and plausible-but-wrong code, and you have a clear sense of where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

440ff4377f83.title: Staff Engineer - Search
440ff4377f83.description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

As a Staff Engineer on the Search team, you'll take on one of our most important platform challenges: making every employee able to find what they need, and get a trustworthy answer, across Staffbase and the tools around it. Today search spans people, posts, pages, files and connected integrations, and it increasingly feeds AI-generated answers. You'll define how retrieval, ranking and grounded answers work at that scale.

Your north star is a search platform that finds the right thing, fast, for the right person. It must respect permissions on every query, work in every language our customers use, and give answers that cite their sources. You'll build the core, set the quality bar, and decide where we use proven techniques and where we experiment, all on a mature, multi-tenant platform.

This is a role for someone who wants to drive, not just deliver. You'll shape the direction of an open-ended problem, and you'll measure your work with real relevance data, not gut feeling.

Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Java, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, MongoDB, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Docker and Playwright, plus LLM and embedding services for retrieval, reranking and summarisation.

The Team

The Search team sits at the heart of how employees find information at Staffbase. We own the full path from query to result: indexing and embeddings, hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval, ranking and reranking, typeahead, and the AI summaries that answer questions with citations. Search is also a core source of knowledge for Navigator, our AI assistant, and the main way it grounds its answers in company content.

That means two big things. First, we make results relevant: understanding the query, retrieving the right candidates, ranking them well, and doing it in the user's language. Second, we make search safe and fast: every result respects the user's access rights, every tenant stays isolated, and the fast path stays fast. We don't ship relevance changes on a hunch. We run offline evaluations, golden query sets and online signals, and we change one thing at a time.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and similar-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the "You build it, you run it" approach and take pride in it

What you'll be doing

  • Define and drive the search and retrieval strategy: hybrid (BM25 + vector) retrieval, reranking, query understanding and rewriting, chunking and embedding choices
  • Build and evolve the core ingestion and query pipeline, from sync and indexing to ranked results and AI summaries with citations
  • Own search quality: build evaluation tooling and golden sets (including unanswerable and permission-varying queries), define relevance metrics, and turn them into decisions
