6f22d3e0c709.title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Marketing Website
6f22d3e0c709.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. The Role As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io : the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it. Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly. The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO. What You'll Do Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly. Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review. Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely. Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can. Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch. Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break. Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience. Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it. We’d love to hear from you if you have At least five (5+) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms. Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory. Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library. You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production. Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass. You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers. A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints. Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job. We’d be particularly excited if Prior experience working on a large SaaS marketing website, at real traffic and with real stakes attached. Astro, or another islands or static-site framework. Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform. Experience with AWS Lambda. Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system. Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents. A strong design sensibility: an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them. Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience. Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance. Location Our preference is for this role to be based hybrid out of our London, UK office. We can also accommodate remote workers elsewhere in Europe subject to compliance and right to work checks. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . Why We Need a Platform Security Engineer Now Omnea takes security seriously. In an era where exploits and supply chain attacks are being discovered and conducted faster than ever before, it’s vital that we stay on the cutting edge of keeping our systems and our customers’ data safe. Hardening our systems is only part of the solution. As we scale out to more industries with their diverse security requirements, we want another individual who can help us attain and maintain higher levels of compliance certification. For calibration, candidates typically bring 5+ years of platform engineering experience in high-growth, cloud-native SaaS environments, but we care more about impact than years. We’re looking for that “T”-shaped skillset where the candidate’s depth is in Cloud Security. Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have a product engineering background but caught the bug for security and cares deeply about enabling people to work fast, safely. Finally, we’re looking for someone who sees security as an enabler and force-multiplier and answers questions with a “Yes, here’s how we do it securely” attitude as opposed to the flat “No” security teams are too often renowned for. You’ll have a massive hand in making sure we’re up to those standards. Collaborate with our DevX streams. Omnea ships fast, and we want to ship even faster. Let’s do it, and do it in a way that can be scaled out across the entire codebase and easily implemented by the rest of the engineering staff. What Can You Expect? A strong team. You design reliable infrastructure and write clean production code (TypeScript or similar). You've built and maintained CI/CD pipelines, IaC, and security gates at scale. Cloud-native. Deep knowledge of AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge, IAM, networking), or equivalent cloud-native experience. You understand serverless and its trade-offs. Security as an enabler. You think about engineers and business as your customers. You automate toil, improve feedback loops, and care deeply about making other people productive. Commercially minded. You understand that infrastructure & security exist to serve the product and the business. You make trade-offs with that in mind. Bias for action. You iterate quickly, ship pragmatically, and automate everything. Culture carrier. You coach teammates, share knowledge freely, and keep calm when things break. 17b96ad4bd2b.description: Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far. Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role AI is changing what it means to deploy enterprise software. Configuring a customer's procurement workflows used to mean weeks of manual setup, integration by integration, edge case by edge case. Increasingly, that first-draft build work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI agents can generate workflow configurations, draft integration mappings, and produce the initial pass on a customer's setup. The job shifts with it. Instead of building every workflow yourself, you specify exactly what needs to exist, direct AI to build it, and apply the judgment AI can't: is this the right configuration for this customer's approval policy, will Legal and Finance actually sign off on it, does it hold up once real spend starts flowing through it. In practice, that might mean catching that the approval chain AI just drafted works perfectly for HQ, but misses a regional delegation-of-authority rule that would fail an audit in the customer's APAC entity. As Omnea's AI Solutions Lead, you own deployment of the Omnea platform end to end - typically running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently - for some of Europe's most recognisable companies. You advise customers on the best-fit configuration, direct AI-assisted build work to get there fast, and validate every output against what the customer actually needs. You'll also deal with the politics that come with every enterprise rollout: the Legal team wanting one more sign-off, the Finance stakeholder who doesn't trust the new approval flow, the exec sponsor who's gone quiet. You become the internal voice of the customer, and you're judged on outcomes you can point to: time to launch, post-go-live CSAT, and whether that customer becomes a case study or reference. This is an early hire on Omnea's customer team, working directly with our sales, customer, product, and engineering leadership. The future shape of the role is yours to define! What You'll Do Discover and design Run discovery with customer stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, and IT, and translate their process into an Omnea configuration Design the target workflow: approval chains, routing logic, integrations, and the edge cases that make procurement hard On a deployment with a dozen-plus integrations, you own the sequencing - what has to land first, what blocks what - and the harder calls underneath it: which system is the source of truth for a given entity, and how records reconcile when two systems key that entity differently Define success criteria and a realistic path to go-live with the customer's project sponsor Build with AI, not instead of it You're not just directing AI to draft your own deliverables faster - you're configuring the specialized agents Omnea's customers rely on every day: an intake agent that knows how to ask a procurement analyst the right follow-up question, a risk agent that flags what actually matters to this customer's Legal team The real leverage comes from chaining agents together - an intake agent that hands clean, structured requests to a risk agent, which in turn routes into approvals with the right context already attached. You design how those agents work as a system, not just individually Writing a spec for one agent is a skill. Writing one that holds up across a chain of agents - where one agent's output becomes another's input - is the actual bar here Validate every AI-generated output against the customer's actual process, policy, and edge cases before anything ships Handle what AI can't: judgment calls on ambiguous requirements, custom logic, and anything that needs a human read on internal politics Deploy and prove value Present configured workflows to stakeholders, from procurement analysts to CFOs, working through the pushback and internal politics that come with any enterprise rollout, and win their buy-in Run multi-day onsite workshops with customers, coordinating dozens of stakeholders across multiple workstreams at once - a different muscle than a single stakeholder meeting Project-manage the deployment: timelines, blockers, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to launch, acting as an extension of the customer's team Track adoption after go-live and keep the configuration working as the customer's process evolves Work with Product and Engineering during the design phase, not just after something breaks in the field - you're often the earliest signal on whether a new module will hold up for an enterprise customer, and that shapes what gets built next What's Different About This Role You'll spend more time specifying and validating than building from scratch. AI produces the first draft; you make sure it's right

About Clear Street:

Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.

We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.

For more information, visit https://clearstreet.io.

 

The Team:


The Regulatory Reporting Engineering team at Clear Street is a small team with a great deal of responsibility. We work closely with stakeholders to ensure that we meet all our financial and regulatory obligations in a timely fashion. Our goal is to make the lives of our stakeholders easier by leveraging innovative technology to create automated solutions for their workflows. As Clear Street grows into more product lines and geographical regions, every member of the team will have an opportunity to have an immense impact on the firm as a whole.  Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where you can make a significant contribution, collaborate with talented professionals, and work with cutting-edge technology to drive operational excellence.

 

The Role:

As a Lead Software Engineer on the Regulatory Reporting Engineering team, you will play an integral role in automating our Compliance & Finance regulatory processes. You'll build on your analytical skills to create solutions that process large amounts of data from our data warehouse to generate clean, correct reporting, including building out reconciliations.

You will partner with key stakeholders across the Compliance, Finance, and Treasury teams  to understand regulatory/financial obligations and business requirements, and translate them into clean designs and scalable solutions. As the tech lead in the team, you will provide technical guidance, prioritizing work, perform hands-on design and development and code review,  as well as evolve our technical standards and best practices.

 

Tech Stack: Python, SQL, Snowflake, Retool, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo, Metaplane, REST APIs

Required Qualifications: 

  • You have at least three (3) years of software design and development experience including CI/CD, source code control, testing, and quality management.
  • You are highly proficient in Python,  SQL, database design, and have experience working with data warehouses like Snowflake to generate complex solutions at scale.
  • You are a self-starter with a sense of urgency and an eagerness to learn and explore new technologies as appropriate to solve business problems.
  • You are a strong communicator who can interact in a clear and concise manner with non-technical business stakeholders, product managers as well engineers.
  • You can troubleshoot and logically assess problems and determine solutions.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • You have experience working in the post-trade automation space designing and architecting systems that deliver solutions to complex data problems.
  • You have experience generating complex financial industry regulatory reports like EMIR, MFID,  SFTR, CPR, K Factor etc.

 

We Offer:

At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, pension, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical and dental insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we are requiring employees to be in the office a minimum of three days per week.

Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse — in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

d34a92f35217.title: Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning
d34a92f35217.description:
At Locus Robotics, we build AI-powered systems and intelligent robots that keep global supply chains running. Our platform combines advanced AI, real-time decision-making, and autonomous robotics to help leading companies improve efficiency, scale operations, and adapt to constant change.

Locus Robotics is a place to do meaningful work with real-world impact, where your ideas move quickly from concept to deployment. We invest in our people, encourage continuous learning, and give you the opportunity to grow your career while building technology that is used every day at global scale.

As an Applied AI Scientist, Simulation & Reinforcement Learning, you'll own the simulator behind SDL, our programme building a world-first, reinforcement-learning-driven orchestration framework for people and robots. That framework needs a simulator that is trustworthy enough to develop, tune and validate it before it touches a live warehouse.

You will take over day-to-day ownership of our discrete-event simulation (built on SimPy), make it measurably closer to reality, and use it as the training and evaluation ground for learning-based policies. Simulation comes first; reinforcement learning grows to be the larger part of the role as the simulator matures. You'll compare your simulations against live operational data from some of the world's largest fulfilment sites, and your work will decide what is validated and shipped to fleets of robots in customer sites worldwide.

This is not a notebook role. The simulator you own is the foundation that decides what ships to customer sites worldwide. You will work in a small, collaborative team where research meets production, as part of Applied Data Science (ADS), reporting to Oscar Mendez.

  • Location: This is a remote position based in the United Kingdom. Candidates must reside in the UK.
    Right to Work: Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK. Locus Robotics is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.

Responsibilities

Own the simulator

  • Own and develop our SimPy-based discrete-event simulator, including its logic, design choices and the fragile areas that need care.
  • Pay down technical debt: improve test coverage, code quality, reproducibility and developer tooling.
  • Build the experiment infrastructure around the simulator: orchestration, study management, reporting and automated runs across benchmark sites.
  • Generate and maintain site data (e.g. distance files, configs) needed to simulate customer warehouses.
  • Support scenario testing and sensitivity analysis for our order-engine and orchestration teams.

Tune and close the sim2real gap

  • Define, measure and reduce the sim-to-real gap against real site data.
  • Run parameter optimisation and tuning studies (e.g. Optuna), and diagnose anomalies and non-determinism.
  • Model warehouse processes such as congestion, picker behaviour and queueing at the right level of fidelity.
  • Communicate results and confidence clearly to engineering, product and operations stakeholders.
  • Use Optimization, RL & DL to tune the simulator

Grow into reinforcement learning

  • Turn the simulator into a proper RL environment (Gymnasium/Gym-style interfaces) with fast, repeatable, scalable training runs.
  • Design, train and evaluate RL policies, starting with guidance generation, and benchmark them against current heuristic algorithms.
  • Guard against overfitting to simulator artefacts, and design experiments that show what transfers to the real world.
  • Prototype, evaluate and productionise learning-based components alongside the wider ML, MLOps and OE teams.
  • Stay current with RL, multi-agent systems and simulation research, and assess what is applicable to Locus.
  • Contribute to internal technical papers, patents and, where appropriate, publications.

Qualifications

  • A PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Robotics, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field, or MSc and 5+ years of industry experience applying AI/ML or simulation to real-world problems.
  • Hands-on experience building, extending or validating simulators, ideally discrete-event simulation (SimPy or similar).
  • Practical experience with reinforcement learning and training simulation-based agents, including simulation for RL and Gym-style environments.
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, maintainable and reproducible code.
  • Rigorous experimental and statistical thinking: benchmarking, tuning, ablations, uncertainty.
  • Experience in robotics, logistics, warehouse or other operations-heavy domains.
  • Publications in major AI, ML, robotics or vision venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV).
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage diverse audiences effectively and explain uncertain results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences in a multidisciplinary environment.

The expected base salary range for this role is GBP 70,000 - 120,000  based on external market data, plus bonus and equity. Actual offers will depend on factors such as the candidate's experience, education, training, key or critical skills, geographic location, and current market and business conditions.

Additional Information 

Locus Robotics is an equal opportunity employer.

b1db74634989.title: Senior Product Manager - Data Lake (f/m/d)
b1db74634989.description:
Notre Team Data lake recherche un·e Senior Product Manager (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille ou Paris

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : au travers du sport rendre le bien être accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, elle guide chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client.

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons notre futur.e Senior Product Manager pour rejoindre les équipes Data Factory.

Cette plateforme technologique, globale à tout le groupe de manière internationale, soutient le développement de l’usage de la Data et de l’IA chez Decathlon, du calcul du chiffre d’affaires à l’aide de conception de produits innovants.

Nous sommes garants des outils, de la scalabilité, de la mise en place et du respect des bonnes pratiques de développement. Nous accompagnons au quotidien l’ensemble des acteurs métiers tels que Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists.

La Data Factory est conçue comme une Modern Data Stack, avec un lakehouse comme centre de gravité.

Elle est ensuite divisée en plusieurs équipes, chacune étant pilotée par un leader technique, avec comme ambition de travailler avec un.e Product Manager attitré.e.

Notre équipe Data Lake est donc la brique fondamentale de cette mission.

Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !

L'équipe est composée actuellement de :

  • 1 Product Manager
  • 1 Data Architect
  • 1 Data Engineer
  • 1 Software Engineer
  • 2 Ops Engineer

Exemples de challenges actuels :

  • Améliorer notre offre de support pour faciliter le parcours utilisateur (documentation, gestion des incidents, ...)
  • Discussion avec les équipes Data/IA des pays et domaines sur leurs challenges du moment (données sensibles, données privées, ...) pour définir les priorités de nos équipes
  • Comment faciliter la gouvernance des données ? Par exemple intégrer des règles automatiques de validation des données, data contractualization, ...
  • Rationalisation de notre offre et décommissionnement du legacy

 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Notre ambition groupe, celle d’améliorer l’expérience digitale de nos clients, nous amène à une nouvelle approche orientée clients, une approche produit.

Le/La Product Manager de l'équipe Data Lake:

  • Acquiert une compréhension de son périmètre, de l'état de l’art sur le marché, du fonctionnement technique des outils associés.
  • Représente nos utilisateurs métiers, comprend leurs challenges et les retranscrit aux équipes techniques.
  • Accompagne la mise en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités ou produits sur tout le cycle de vie (démo, formation, communication, documentation, …).


Tu seras garant·e de l'évolution et de la robustesse de ce produit critique pour l'ensemble des équipes Decathlon.

Tes missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants :

  • Vision & Delivery : Tu pilotes le cycle complet du produit, de la Discovery à la coordination du Delivery en lien étroit avec le Leader. Tu traduis les enjeux business et techniques en une roadmap claire, priorisée et axée sur la valeur.

  • Projets Stratégiques : Tu lead l'End-of-Life (EOL) de notre Legacy, orchestres la migration vers la nouvelle infrastructure et designs les nouveaux espaces et fonctionnalités sur Unity Catalog.

  • Gouvernance & Excellence Opérationnelle : Tu assures la gouvernance fine du metastore, la gestion des droits d'accès et intègres au cœur de ta roadmap les enjeux de sécurité, de performance, de maintenance et de FinOps (optimisation des coûts cloud).

  • Leadership Fonctionnel & Synergies : Tu assures le management fonctionnel de l'équipe technique au quotidien et tu pourras être amené·e à animer un groupe transverse de PM sur des sujets communs afin de garantir l'alignement de notre vision produit globale.

  • Mesure de l'impact : Tu définis et suis les indicateurs clés de réussite focalisés sur la fiabilité, la robustesse de la plateforme et la mesure précise de l'usage de tes produits. Tu co-animes le budget du produit avec le leader.

47b9ff7d0d50.title: Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d)
47b9ff7d0d50.description:
Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend  - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d)      


L’équipe Login est le pilier de l’écosystème Decathlon. Composée de profils passionnés et multiculturels, notre équipe d'une dizaine de personnes construit une solution d’authentification sécurisée et haute performance pour plus de 80 pays. Notre ambition ? Offrir une expérience membre fluide via un point d’entrée unique et hautement sécurisé. Notre défi actuel est de taille : mener une migration d'architecture d'envergure internationale depuis notre système Spring Security 5 vers Spring Security 7. Rejoins une équipe de passionné·es au cœur des enjeux globaux de Decathlon !

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

La mission principale est d’accompagner la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités et l’amélioration de l’application, le tout tournant autour d’une organisation s’appuyant sur un écosystème agile afin de délivrer rapidement et fréquemment le plus de valeur possible à nos produits.

Contexte DevSecOps : you build it, you run it, you enjoy it !

  • Security by Design

Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC : Contribuer à l'implémentation de ces protocoles pour garantir des accès sécurisés à nos services.

Sécurisation du Code : Appliquer les principes de sécurité dès la conception (OWASP, protection contre les injections, gestion sécurisée du cycle de vie des sessions).

Veille Sécurité : Identifier et corriger proactivement les failles potentielles au sein de l'écosystème Java/Spring.

Administration Cloudflare : Gérer, configurer et optimiser notre infrastructure Cloudflare (WAF, protection DDoS, DNS, CDN, Gestion des Bots). 

Audit et Monitoring : Mettre en place la surveillance des menaces, analyser les logs de sécurité et réagir aux incidents (SOC/SIEM).

  • Développement & Delivery

Production : Assurer le delivery sur les briques core du CIAM (moteurs d'authentification, gestion des jetons, intégrations protocolaires).

Patterns Avancés : Implémenter des solutions résilientes basées sur Kafka (Patterns CDC & Outbox) pour garantir la cohérence des données sans compromettre la performance.

Qualité Intégrée : Garantir la stabilité via des tests automatisés rigoureux (Playwright, Gatling) dès la phase de développement.

  •  Pilotage par la Donnée : Tracking & A/B Testing

Expérimentation : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'A/B testing via Statsig pour valider les évolutions du tunnel d'authentification de manière granulaire.

Tracking Comportemental : Intégrer et maintenir un tracking précis via Amplitude pour analyser les parcours utilisateurs et identifier les points de friction.

Performance Produit : Collaborer avec les équipes Produit pour traduire les besoins business en implémentations techniques mesurables et scalables.

  • Architecture, Scale & Observabilité

Conception Système : Modéliser les flux complexes via le C4 Model pour assurer une vision claire des interactions entre services.

Infrastructure & Ops : Déployer et opérer tes services sur Kubernetes (Helm), avec une maîtrise totale de l'observabilité via Datadog.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • +7 ans en Java dans des environnements distribués à fort trafic.
  • Compétence sécurité : 
    • Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC
    • Expérience sur Keycloak ou équivalent
    • Sécurisation du Code (OWASP, injections, sessions sécurisées)
  • Spring & Spring Security : Connaissance des mécanismes internes (Filters, Authentication Providers, etc.).
  • Event-Driven Architecture : Expérience sur Kafka, CDC et utilisation du pattern Outbox.
  • Data & Growth : Expérience sur des outils de tracking (Amplitude) et de Feature Flagging / A/B testing (Statsig).
  • Cloud & Tools : Kubernetes, Helm, Datadog.
  • Testing : Playwright (E2E) et Gatling/Blazemeter (Load testing).
  • Langue : Anglais technique (documentation impérative).

 

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

Organisation de travail hybride ;

Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

 

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire

648ddacdabb9.title: Staff Product Engineer - AI Native
648ddacdabb9.description: Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? Vision: As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026. Our Impact: From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. Our Recognition: DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. The Role: Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite. We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. Missions Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after. Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration. Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change. Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine". Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention. Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive. Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification. Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing. Requirements Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English. Experience & Seniority: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead AI-Native Practice: Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain Verification & Quality: Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced? Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role): Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who

8fb864b055da.title: Applied AI Engineer
8fb864b055da.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in France. As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems. You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance. Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions. You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results. You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes. Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions. As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy. Accountabilities In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include: Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops. Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability. Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes. Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices. Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment. Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows. Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention. Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities. Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively. Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes. Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems. Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows. Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function. Requirements The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected: Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment. Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments. Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability. Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops. Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems. Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering. Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs. Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges. Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment. High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations. Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English. Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Benefits Competitive Compensation: Annual salary ranging from €100,000 to €150,000. Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely within Europe or the United Kingdom. Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions. Technical Autonomy: Shape engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and the foundations of the organization's agentic AI infrastructure. Cutting-Edge Technology: Work extensively with advanced LLMs, autonomous agents, multi-agent architectures, and AI-powered software development workflows. Meaningful Impact: Build production systems that address real operation

1d0edfaf906a.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
1d0edfaf906a.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in France. As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems. You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures. Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges. Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents. You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks. Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment. Accountabilities In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include: Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities. Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems. Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes. Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking. Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements. Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment. Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback. Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments. Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements. Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected: Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. b441f28bf895.description:
Garda Capital Partners (Garda) is a multi-billion dollar alternative investment firm with over 22 years of experience deploying relative value strategies across fixed income markets for institutional investors. We hire, grow, and mentor great talent and remain steadfast in our commitment to building a culture that helps them succeed. Garda is more than a workplace. We are built on trust, integrity, and a shared vision for how we work together, the enduring relationships we build, and the consistency of our results. Garda's primary offices are located in Wayzata, New York City, West Palm Beach, Geneva, Zug, Copenhagen, Singapore, and Scottsdale. 

Garda is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to own Platform Engineering & Automation. This hands-on role builds and operates shared deployment capabilities for infrastructure and selected applications, while providing advanced infrastructure engineering and production support.

The engineer develops reusable deployment pipelines, infrastructure templates, and self-service workflows that help teams provision environments and release changes consistently — working with architecture, application owners, and regional teams to improve platform reliability and resolve complex infrastructure problems.

Position Responsibilities

Escalation & Infrastructure Support

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents and recurring operational problems
  • Troubleshoot across Windows/Linux systems, identity, networking, cloud, virtualization, storage, and backup
  • Lead root-cause analysis and convert recurring incidents into engineering work or documented standards
  • Participate in major changes, recovery events, and follow-the-sun handoffs

Platform Engineering & Deployment Automation

  • Build automation using PowerShell, Python, and APIs with production-quality testing and error handling
  • Own reusable infrastructure-as-code and configuration templates (Terraform, Ansible)
  • Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and applications, including validation, environment promotion, health checks, and rollback
  • Apply Git, peer review, automated tests, change controls, and secure secrets handling

Observability, Reliability & Standards

  • Improve monitoring, logging, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and automated health checks
  • Tune operational signals to reduce noise and improve detection/recovery
  • Maintain reusable provisioning workflows and self-service capabilities
  • Own platform reliability and lifecycle improvements with service owners

Technical Leadership

  • Mentor engineers and workplace technology staff in troubleshooting and automation practices
  • Review infrastructure code and pipeline designs with architecture, Security, and application owners
  • Maintain runbooks, diagrams, and onboarding guidance
  • Maintain a prioritized platform backlog with the architect and regional leads

Qualifications & Desired Skills

  • 4–6 years of hands-on infrastructure operations experience across several domains
  • Degree in IT, computer science, computer engineering, or a related field
  • Advanced PowerShell or Python automation experience, including API integration
  • Practical experience with infrastructure as code or configuration management
  • Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines (Git, testing, secure deployment, rollback)
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and incident-response skills
  • Working knowledge of monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability concepts
  • Ability to document work, mentor others, and collaborate across a distributed team

Preference for experience with:

  • AWS, container platforms, modern cloud operating patterns (Azure a plus)
  • Experience delivering reusable provisioning workflows for infrastructure and business applications
  • Familiarity with ITSM, change, incident, and problem-management practices
  • Experience in financial services or another performance-sensitive environment
  • Track record of solving complex infrastructure problems and building shared capabilities other teams can use independently
  • Strong track record of maintaining high standards for reliability, documentation, and maintainability
  • Experience remaining effective under pressure, with a history of mentoring and knowledge-sharing within teams

9e5271139296.description: We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer in our Amsterdam office to build Alwin , our Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance, and the systems around it. Alwin agents run multi-step audit procedures over client evidence and return finished workpapers with every number traced back to source. Humans plan, review and sign off. This is a hands-on role: most of your time will be spent writing code, building the hardest parts of the runtime, prototyping new capabilities and getting them into production. You lead by example: engineers follow your direction because they see it work in your code. Your impact will also come through the engineers and teams you work with. Your mission is to build the best agentic runtime for audit: one that completes audit tasks faster, more accurately, more reliably and at lower cost, while scaling to meet the needs of our largest customers. You will identify the problems that most constrain that mission, align teams around a technical direction and drive solutions through to measurable results, while building the foundations other engineers use and raising the quality of Alwin’s agents in production. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. 178ec5acd402.title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
178ec5acd402.description: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. 9263917314f0.description: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Als netwerk-expert binnen onze afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling gericht op netwerken en systemen die verschillende simulatoren en operationele systemen veilig en efficiënt met elkaar verbinden. Je werkt aan vraagstukken met betrekking tot netwerkarchitecturen, (simulatie)protocollen zoals DIS en HLA, netwerkbeveiliging en schaalbaarheid van complexe simulatieomgevingen. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het mogelijk maken van interoperabiliteit tussen simulatoren, operationele systemen en autonome platforms, en bent betrokken bij de (door)ontwikkeling van zowel bestaande als nieuwe simulatienetwerken. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met onder andere softwareontwikkelaars, domeinexperts en toekomstige eindgebruikers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor nationale en internationale stakeholders. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland. Wat breng je mee? Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten! Daarnaast: Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar; Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging; Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen; Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context; Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen; Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties; Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s; Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken. 4051e9fb810b.title: Senior Engineer I, Total Product Support
4051e9fb810b.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

 

Job’s mission

As a Senior Engineer, Total Product Support at ASM, you will take ownership of highly visible technical projects and drive them from planning through execution and delivery. Acting as the central point connecting engineering teams, operations, and customers, you will ensure that technical solutions are developed, tested, implemented, and supported successfully.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong engineering foundation who enjoys bringing people together, solving problems, and turning technical requirements into clear actions. You do not need to be the subject matter expert in every technical area, but you should be comfortable working with engineers, understanding complex technical concepts, asking the right questions, and keeping projects moving forward.

What you will be working on

  • Lead and coordinate technical projects from initial planning through execution, customer delivery, and program close-out.
  • Develop execution plans, define priorities, coordinate resources, and ensure key project milestones and deliverables are achieved.
  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering teams, technical specialists, operations, management, and customers.
  • Drive the build and qualification phase of technical solutions, including coordinating in-house testing, additional test equipment, technical evaluations, and readiness for customer implementation.
  • Work closely with engineers to understand technical challenges, determine where additional expertise or consultation is required, and drive issues toward resolution.
  • Coordinate directly with customers to understand requirements, provide transparent project updates, and support successful technical implementation.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks and roadblocks early, and communicate openly when plans, deliverables, or timelines are at risk.
  • Analyze project and test outcomes, coordinate follow-up activities, and ensure programs are properly completed and transitioned into customer support.
  • Steer operational activities across multiple stakeholders while maintaining accountability for overall project execution.
  • Provide clear and concise reporting on high-visibility projects to stakeholders and management.

 

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • A solid engineering foundation and the ability to understand and communicate technical concepts across different engineering disciplines.
  • Strong project coordination skills with the ability to plan, organize, and drive activities from start to finish.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the confidence to work with engineers, managers, and customers.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a proactive and hands-on approach to solving problems.
  • Ability to identify risks, communicate challenges transparently, and escalate issues when necessary rather than waiting for problems to resolve themselves.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, processes, and technical environments.
  • High energy, adaptability, and a strong “can-do” mentality.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

 

What sets you apart

  • Experience working in semiconductor equipment, high-tech manufacturing, mechanical/electrical systems, or another complex engineering environment (not required).
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and translating between technical specialists, operations, management, and customers.
  • Relevant professional, internship, research, or project experience demonstrating the ability to coordinate technical work and drive execution is an advantage.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions, raise concerns, and create alignment across different stakeholders.
  • A structured approach to project execution combined with the flexibility to adapt when technical priorities change.
  • Comfortable taking accountability for highly visible projects where clear and timely communication is essential.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally, typically 1–2 times per year, depending on project and customer needs.

 

 

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

e44a01d91916.title: Software Lead Engineer | NTS Eindhoven
e44a01d91916.description: At NTS, we make it possible together. Technology inspires and drives us; it is our passion. Every day we work on unique solutions to complex challenges. Whether it's ultra-complex or ultra-precise solutions, we are proud of what we do and what we deliver. Want to set the technical direction of complex software projects and guide engineering teams towards reliable, high-quality solutions? Are you passionate about software development and high-tech product development, and do you enjoy combining technical expertise with technical leadership? Then get started as Software Lead Engineer at NTS Eindhoven and let's make it possible together. Job Description As Software Lead Engineer/ Technical Lead at NTS Eindhoven, you set the technical direction for our software projects and coordinate the technical work of the engineers assigned to them. Working in collaborative teams of fewer than ten colleagues, you translate project objectives and complex requirements into software architecture, design decisions and executable technical plans. This is a technical leadership role without line-management responsibility. You lead through technical direction, coordination and coaching, while the Group Lead or Competence Manager remains responsible for people management. Our teams develop qualification tools, semiconductor equipment, defence and healthcare systems, and other advanced technology solutions. You collaborate closely with software, mechanical, electrical and mechatronics engineers to deliver integrated system solutions that meet high quality standards. We value clear and transparent communication. You proactively identify technical risks and roadblocks, support the team in resolving challenges and ensure that solutions are delivered in line with project objectives. Furthermore, your key responsibilities are: Lead the technical side of software projects, including architecture, design and technical decision-making; Coordinate the technical work of engineers allocated to your projects and ensure alignment with project plans; Provide accurate technical estimates and planning input to project managers; Safeguard software quality by promoting best practices, code reviews and effective test strategies; Identify technical risks and roadblocks early and define and implement mitigation actions; Coach and support colleagues technically, encourage knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement; Stay close to the code and contribute hands-on whenever required. Job Requirements To be successful in this role, you bring a strong combination of technical expertise, leadership capabilities and interpersonal skills. You recognise yourself in the following profile: Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field; Minimum 8 years of experience in developing technical software using C#, .NET/.NET Framework or C++ (knowledge of C is a plus); Proven experience in setting technical direction, coordinating engineering activities and guiding other software engineers, with or without formal line-management responsibility; Experience in UI development, for example WPF, and a strong understanding of OOP principles and UML design; Experience working in an Agile development environment and with Azure DevOps or similar platforms; Experience in a high-tech mechatronic environment is a strong advantage; Knowledge of one or more of the following areas is a plus: databases, DevOps, test strategy, electronics or mechatronics, and computer vision; Excellent communication and social skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics in an understandable way; Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus; A proactive team player with a strong willingness to learn, develop and collaborate in the fast-evolving high-tech industry. Your terms of employment At NTS, we combine our passion for technology with innovative solutions to complex challenges. You get the freedom and confidence to fully use and develop your talents in a dynamic and energetic environment. We invest both in technology and in you as a future colleague! With this challenge, we offer the following terms of employment: Competitive salary; A position at NTS Eindhoven, with a working week of at least 32 hours; Personal growth and development opportunities, for example through training and/or education; 27 vacation days and an additional 13 ADV days; Excellent pension plan with PME; Travel expense allowance paid monthly, with a maximum of 50 km per single journey and an allowance of €0.21 per km; About NTS We deliver unique solutions to complex challenges and drive technological advancement for our customers. By combining development, manufacturing and assembly, we play an integral role in bringing the supply chain together. We combine the best skills and brightest ideas into a working system for the world's most advanced Semiconductor, Opto-Mechatronics and Analytical solutions. For this reason, we have grown into a Tier-1 supplier to OEMs and an international player operating from various (production) sites in Europe, Asia and the US. Although we offer our teams around the world a great place to work, we do not forget to remain firmly rooted locally. Ultimately, the core of NTS is our people. Their excellent manufacturing skills, customer-focused mindset and clear technical solutions have made NTS what it is today. Together, we create a culture that everyone can be proud of because we make it possible together. That's why we take every opportunity to celebrate our people, our craftsmanship and our successes.
