fefdd118cc36.description:
Harbor is looking for a Senior Intapp Implementation Engineer to lead the design, configuration and delivery of Intapp solutions for legal-sector clients. You will work with client stakeholders across IT, Risk and Compliance, Finance and legal teams to turn business needs into secure, practical solutions across the matter lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone with substantial experience implementing and enhancing Intapp products in a law-firm environment. You will take ownership of complex workstreams, guide technical decisions and support other members of the delivery team.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead end-to-end Intapp implementation work, from discovery and requirements through solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
  • Design and enhance workflows, forms, rules and application configurations for client and matter intake, conflicts, risk and compliance, time recording or related processes.
  • Advise clients on solution options, product capabilities, design trade-offs and implementation approach.
  • Configure and support relevant Intapp products, such as Intapp Intake, Conflicts, Open, Time, Walls, Flow and Integrate.
  • Plan and oversee integrations with legal finance, document management and other business systems, including integration testing and defect resolution.
  • Lead workshops with business and technical stakeholders; document requirements, process flows, functional designs and technical specifications.
  • Plan and coordinate system testing, user acceptance testing, data validation, training, deployment and business readiness.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues and work with client teams and Intapp support to resolve product or implementation problems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, controls, data quality and user experience.
  • Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and contribute to delivery standards, documentation and estimates.
  • Support upgrades, migration planning and cloud readiness where required.

What we’re looking for:

  • At least five years of hands-on experience implementing, configuring or significantly enhancing Intapp products.
  • Experience delivering Intapp solutions in a law firm or comparable professional-services environment.
  • Proven participation in multiple implementation or major enhancement projects, with responsibility for solution design and delivery.
  • Strong working knowledge of one or more Intapp products, such as Intake, Conflicts, Open, Time, Walls, Flow or Integrate. Depth in a core product is essential; experience across several products is an advantage.
  • Experience designing workflows and translating Risk, Compliance, Finance or legal business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience with integrations between Intapp and other enterprise or legal-sector systems.
  • Confidence leading workshops, managing stakeholders and explaining technical choices clearly.
  • Experience planning or carrying out testing, deployments, upgrades and post-go-live support.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation and analytical skills.

Desirable experience:

  • Intapp cloud migration or cloud readiness work.
  • Legal finance or document management platforms such as Aderant or iManage.
  • SQL, APIs, reporting tools or integration platforms.
  • Conflicts management, ethical walls, information barriers, client due diligence or AML workflows.
  • Agile delivery, project governance or mentoring other engineers.

How success will be measured:

You will deliver reliable Intapp solutions that meet agreed business and control requirements, communicate risks and decisions clearly, and leave clients with supportable configurations and useful documentation.

About Us:

Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. Anchored in a rich heritage of deep knowledge, steadfast relationships, and mutual respect, our unwavering dedication lies in shaping the future of the legal industry and fostering enduring partnerships within our community and ecosystem.

Harbor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, civil union status, national origin, ancestry, age, parental status, disabled status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification, in accordance with applicable law.

a60cab535883.description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. How we work We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work. We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart. We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move. Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest. A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer. The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5 , that looks like this. What you'll be doing Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion. Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced. Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve. Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting. Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you. Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve. c0d55237f62a.title: Senior Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence
c0d55237f62a.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years. Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true. That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design. Partner Excellence Highlights You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls. Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it? A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training? Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring? A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning. Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science. The Opportunity As a Senior Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence at Relay, you'll: Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix. Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like. Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision. Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools. Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop. Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network. We're looking for candidates who… Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model. Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise. Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for. Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong. Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes. Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast. Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

bc016fb1a0a5.title: Senior Decision Scientist, Marketplace
bc016fb1a0a5.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years. Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens. Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design. Marketplace Highlights You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them. Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible? Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own? Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming? A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning. Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science. The Opportunity As a Senior Decision Scientist, Marketplace at Relay, you'll: Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix. Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay. Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision. Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools. Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop. Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed. We're looking for candidates who… Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself. Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for. Can trace why drivers or couriers stop booking or cancel, and can read the experiments behind a pricing or incentive change, including when a clean test isn't possible. Have been through real change, such as a pivot, fast growth or a new market, and rebuilt something because of it. Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and happy to build their own analysis apps, monitors and alerts. Would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast. Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. 49e3b3ebc54b.title: Quality Engineer firmware IoT
49e3b3ebc54b.description:
Notre domaine Sport Products recherche un·e Quality Engineer firmware IoT en CDI basé·e à Lille.

L'équipe "Augmented Products" est au cœur de l'innovation chez Decathlon. Notre mission ? Concevoir une stack technique complète, de l'objet connecté au Cloud, pour offrir une expérience sportive augmentée à nos utilisateurs mondiaux. Composée d'experts passionnés, notre équipe relève des défis technologiques majeurs liés à la scalabilité et à la fiabilité des données. En nous rejoignant, vous aurez un impact direct sur la manière dont des millions de sportifs interagissent avec leurs produits.

 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Tu conçois et déploies les stratégies de test automatisé et manuel pour valider la qualité et la fiabilité des firmwares IoT pour différentes catégories de produits et diverses architectures matérielles.

Tu crées, exécutes et maintiens le référentiel des tests firmware (BLE, WiFi, LTE, CAN, OTA) sur bancs de test et environnements réels.

Tu identifies, qualifies et suis la résolution des anomalies en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement firmware et produit.

Tu garantis la conformité de la télémétrie, des services GATT et des protocoles de communication avec les spécifications établies.

Tu participes à l'amélioration continue des processus QA et promeus la culture de la qualité au sein de l'équipe pluridisciplinaire.

Tu participes à la définition et la promotion d’une approche Shift-Left en intégrant les exigences de testabilité dès la phase de conception et de cadrage des fonctionnalités avec les équipes Produit et Firmware.

Tu conçois, construis et fais évoluer les outils, frameworks et bancs d'essai d'automatisation des tests pour réduire le besoins d’action manuelles, l'instabilité et la dépendance au matériel physique.

 

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

 

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITÉ

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es. Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

c5ab6cd731a7.title: Data & AI Manager Pricing (f/m/d)
c5ab6cd731a7.description:
Notre équipe data Customer Relationship recherche un·e Data manager basé·e à Paris. 

Notre vision de la Pricing Excellence repose sur une approche globale de Revenue Growth Management (RGM) visant à établir le juste prix pour le consommateur et ainsi maximiser la valeur client et la rentabilité de l'entreprise. Notre objectif est de délivrer une tarification data-driven qui équilibre le coût total, la perception client et la viabilité financière de l'entreprise.

Pour cela, nous exploitons les outils digitaux, la Data et l'Intelligence Artificielle afin de maximiser les revenus et d'assurer une efficacité opérationnelle orientée vers le client. L'équipe est structurée autour d'un Centre d'Excellence Pricing et d'une équipe Data & AI, qui développent de concert des solutions novatrices et industrielles pour optimiser proactivement la tarification et l'expérience client.

 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION ET IMPACT STRATÉGIQUE

En tant que Data & AI Manager, tu rejoins l'équipe de direction Digital Customer Relationship au sein de laquelle tu seras garant de la définition des priorités DATA (gouvernance, Business Intelligence, modèle de données, référentiels, IA) pour l'activité Pricing. Tu définiras et porteras la vision stratégique Data & AI qui permet d’accompagner la transformation du Pricing et du RGM à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

Membre clé du leadership, tu pilotes une organisation d'une dizaine d'experts Data (Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers) et tu garantis l’alignement parfait entre l'innovation technologique, l'excellence opérationnelle et les ambitions économiques globales du groupe. 

 

RESPONSABILITÉS CLÉS

  • Vision stratégique & feuille de route Data: définir la trajectoire Data & AI pluriannuelle (gouvernance, IA générative & prédictive, architecture, BI, référentiels) alignée sur les enjeux stratégiques du Pricing et du RGM. Arbitrer et prioriser les investissements technologiques à haut ROI en étroite collaboration avec les Product Managers et les représentants métier.
  • Leadership, culture & développement des talents: inspirer, structurer et faire évoluer une équipe à fort niveau d'expertise. Instaurer un environnement d'excellence, attirer les meilleurs talents, développer le leadership des collaborateurs et garantir un modèle d'organisation agile, bienveillant et performant. 
  • Gouvernance, ROI & création de valeur Business: incarner la culture de la valeur auprès des directions métiers (Revenue Management, Directeurs Commerciaux, Finance). Définir la grille d'évaluation de la création de valeur apportée par les solutions IA et assurer une gouvernance rigoureuse des actifs Data.
  • Excellence opérationnelle: garantir l'excellence technique et le niveau d'exigence industriel (robustesse, sécurité, éthique de l'IA, monitoring, haute disponibilité). Insuffler la culture MLOps/DataOps pour accélérer le passage de l'expérimentation à la production à grande échelle.
  • Influence transversale: garantir un alignement fluide avec les Engineering Managers et les Product Managers, dans et en dehors du domaine digital. Inculquer une véritable culture de la Data au sein des équipes produits.
  • Gestion budgétaire & pilotage économique: définir, piloter et gérer le budget global de l'équipe et des infrastructures Data/IA associées. Assurer la planification financière annuelle et pluriannuelle (horizon 3 ans), en optimisant les coûts liés aux RUN (infrastructures cloud, coûts de calcul et licences) tout en maximisant la valeur produite.

 

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Expérience: expérience confirmée dans la Data & l'IA, dont au moins 4 à 5 ans sur des fonctions de management d'équipes pluridisciplinaires ou au sein d'une leadership team.
  • Compétences stratégiques: capacité démontrée à traduire des enjeux business complexes (Pricing, Retail, RGM) en stratégies Data & AI applicables et rentables.
  • Leadership: posture de leader inspirant, capacité à négocier et à influencer, excellence managériale.
  • Savoir-faire technique: solide culture de l'industrialisation IA (DataOps/MLOps), de la gouvernance des données et de l'architecture moderne des plateformes Data.

698ed54eee22.title: Senior Clinical Research Associate
698ed54eee22.description:
At Precision for Medicine, we are always looking to connect with exceptional talents, and we are currently seeking Senior Clinical Research Associates in Poland, Hungary, United Kingdom, France and Germany to support a dedicated FSP partnership, working closely with a strategic sponsor in a highly collaborative and quality-focused environment. 

This evergreen posting is part of our ongoing talent pipeline strategy and enables interested candidates to be considered for future opportunities aligned with upcoming project requirements. While there may not be an immediate opening, candidates whose experience matches our anticipated needs will be considered for future opportunities as they arise.

This position can be offered fully home-based within France. 

About you:

  • You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned.
  • You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game.
  • You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties.
  • You have an impeccable eye for detail.
  • You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them.
  • You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work.
  • You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

You will monitor and own the progress of clinical studies at investigative sites and ensure that clinical studies are conducted, recorded, and reported per protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP, and all applicable regulations and standards. You will coordinate all necessary activities required to set up and monitor a study (i.e., identify investigators; helping prepare regulatory submissions, conducting pre-study and initiation visits, etc.).

Senior CRAs handle appropriately sized clinical trials, and support clinical study teams with trials that are larger in scope. You will also have the opportunity to train and mentor junior staff members. You will interact directly with clients, initiate payments, and participate in proposal activities, including development and client presentations.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • 4-year college degree or equivalent experience
  • Holder of CRA certificate

Other Required:

  • Minimum 5 years of CRA/SCRA experience within a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device environment
  • Experience monitoring clinical trials across a variety of therapeutic areas.
  • Availability for domestic travel including overnight stays, which may constitute up to approximately 50-60% travel commitment (international travel may be required for some senior level positions)
  • Fluency in English and the local language is required
  • Additional language(s) will be considered an asset

Preferred:

  • Graduate or postgraduate degree with a concentration in a scientific or healthcare discipline
  • Study start up activities experience
  • For Senior CRAs, understanding of financial management

Why Precision for Medicine?

At Precision for Medicine, we combine the agility and collaboration of a specialized CRO with the scientific expertise needed to support innovative clinical development programmes. Our employees are empowered to make an impact, build meaningful client relationships, and grow their careers in an environment that values quality, accountability, and professional development.

Please note: This is an evergreen opportunity intended to build our network of experienced clinical research professionals for future project requirements. Hiring decisions and timelines will be dependent upon business needs and upcoming study opportunities.

b176e4cdbbe8.description: About Isembard Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics. The role This role sits where MasonOS meets the shop floor. Every new factory in our network adds training, adoption and support work. You will embed with factories and network sites, own their success with MasonOS end to end, ship production code, apply AI to their workflows and build the tools that make each new site easier than the last. You are measured on the support burden falling, not on tickets closed. Put agentic workflows into operational use: reporting, supplier follow-ups and order status. Ship fixes and small features into MasonOS through the same review as every other engineer. Turn patterns from the field into clear, written requirements for the roadmap. What you bring The ability to ship production code with minimal supervision. Full-stack fluency across backend, frontend and integrations. Hands-on experience applying LLMs to real workflows. Clear communication with operators and technical leaders, and the ability to build trust on site. The judgement to decide what matters without waiting for a ticket queue. Useful, not essential: forward-deployed or deployment engineering experience, exposure to manufacturing, CNC, aerospace or defence, or MES or ERP systems. 61e7d36b7664.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The community you will join:

Airbnb is looking for a Marketing & CRM intern to join the Experiences team in Paris for a 6-month internship. 

You will work directly with the person in charge of Demand for Paris Experiences, alongside Marketing, Growth and Product Management partners.

Experiences let guests step into the real life of a destination: cook with a local chef, explore a hidden neighborhood with a historian, discover Paris through the eyes of the people who live there. Paris is one of our most iconic and competitive markets, and our job on the Demand side is to make sure the right guests find the right Experience at the right moment, whether they are visiting Paris or live nearby.

We are looking for a curious, organized and data-friendly student who loves the craft of CRM and Operational Marketing: a sharp brief, a well-built email, a smart audience, and an analysis that tells us what to do next. You are comfortable juggling several campaigns at once, working with different teams, and turning numbers into clear recommendations.

 

The difference you will make:

You will support the Paris Experiences Demand lead on the day-to-day CRM and marketing activity that drives bookings. You will see a campaign from the first brief to the final analysis, and you will own your own projects along the way. During your internship, you will:

Run email campaigns end to end

  • Write briefs for email campaigns (audience, objective, key messages, timing) and coordinate with copy, design and CRM partners
  • Execute campaigns through our internal tools and planning process, including setup, QA and send follow-up
  • Analyze results after each send (opens, clicks, bookings, incrementality) and share clear learnings and next steps

Support listing promotion and audience targeting

  • Analyze cohorts of guests (new vs. returning, local vs. traveler, International vs Domestic) to understand behavior over time
  • Build simple, readable dashboards and recurring reports to select and prioritize listings based on quality, availability, performance and fit with the campaign
  • Work with Market and Supply teams to make sure what we promote is bookable and best-in-class
  • Turn insights into concrete recommendations for audiences, timing and messaging

Follow local activations

  • Provide operational support and follow-up on field campaigns such as flyering, partnerships, events or more: briefing, logistics, timing, partners and results tracking
  • Help measure what works locally and recommend future iterations

 

The intern experience:

As an intern, you will be part of a team where you contribute to real projects with real business impact. Your manager, your team and our wider employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during your internship. We provide the support, mentorship and hands-on experience you need to learn quickly and make an impact. 

You’ll get a front-row seat on how a global marketplace builds demand for a destination, with real ownership from day one: your campaigns go live and your analyses shape decisions. You’ll do it alongside a team that cares about craft, curiosity and human connection. You can expect to:

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Market Management and Acquisition partners to deliver projects
  • Present your analyses and recommendations to stakeholders
  • Seek and give feedback throughout the internship
  • Take part in the Experiences and broader Airbnb community

 

Your expertise:

  • Current student or recent graduate (degree completed within the last 12 months) from a leading business school, engineering school or equivalent program in France, looking for a 6-month internship starting in January 2027
  • Fluent in French and English, with excellent written communication: you can write a clear brief and a clear recap. You also have an eye for great copy and for what makes a message feel human
  • A strong interest in marketing, CRM or growth, and in travel, hospitality or community-driven products
  • Curious about data and performance metrics, with an interest in using insights and quantitative analysis to evaluate campaigns, track performance, and inform decision-making. Experience with Claude or other AI tools to work faster and smarter is a must-have. 
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage several campaigns and deadlines in parallel, and to follow up until everything is done
  • A collaborative mindset and the confidence to work with people across teams, from Marketing to Product to Operations
  • Must have work authorization for France. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position

 

Your location:

Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in Paris, France to be able to conduct their work. Interns can expect to spend half of their time at the office and half working remotely with exact dates as agreed upon by the hiring manager. Additional in-person attendance for team meetings or offsites

100e18124a7b.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Data Infrastructure
100e18124a7b.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions. Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why. What we're looking for You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi). You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing. Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies Information extraction or truth discovery at scale Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats Example projects Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months. Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes. Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest. Exa is an equal opportunity employer. bc8db6513564.title: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
bc8db6513564.description:
4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.


For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.

You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.

What You’ll Bring

You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:

  • Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.
  • Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.
  • Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian.
  • Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.
  • Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.

We specialize in the international trade of raw materials/ingredients (starches, sugars and plant proteins) for the food, animal feed and paper industries and operate in more than 100 countries. The company culture is relaxed when possible and businesslike when needed. In an open office environment, we aim for short and direct communication between all departments. We are looking for new talents with a no-nonsense mentality who want to actively contribute to the further growth of the company, with own initiative encouraged. The role As a Junior Business Data Analyst, you are the link between business and IT. You bring together processes and data to support decision-making. You help the organization to use data structurally, reliably and effectively. You look beyond data alone: you make processes clear, see opportunities for digitization and automation and use data to help departments. You become part of the IT & Data team and work with all departments, including Finance, Trade and Logistics. You translate data into concrete insights and actively contribute to the further professionalization of data-driven work within Royal Ingredients. What will you do? Data and insights Analyze operational, commercial and financial data from various sources Contribute to data governance, data quality and standardization of definitions and KPIs Think along about further development of the data and analytics platform Contribute to the development of AI tools to make data more accessible Processes and digitization Proactively gather questions and needs from departments, identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities and translate these into concrete recommendations Map and analyze business processes and contribute to process architecture Think about digitization and automation of processes What do you bring? Je bouwt niet alleen aan techniek, maar denkt ook mee over hoe we AI slim, veilig en schaalbaar toepassen in een product dat er echt toe doet. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van AI-functionaliteiten binnen AivyCare. Het ontwikkelen van backend services, API-koppelingen en intelligente workflows. Het verbeteren van kwaliteit, testbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid. Het meedenken over architectuurkeuzes, technische richting en ontwikkelstandaarden. Goed kunt samenwerken met product, architectuur en andere disciplines. Bij PharmaPartners krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuw AI-gedreven product voor de eerstelijnszorg. De kans om vanaf een vroeg stadium mee te bouwen aan AivyCare: een nieuw platform in de eerstelijnszorg. Op dinsdag- en donderdagmiddag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s te gaan bootcampen. Een hechte, open werksfeer: ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. 7598f79951f2.description: Amsterdam (hybrid) | Part-time (freelance) 8 hours a week | €2,000 to €2,500 per month Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys. Foleon is based in Amsterdam and New York and serves more than 1,200 global B2B brands. We value people who are bold, ambitious, collaborative, and customer-centric. Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus. Your Mission As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR. Your Job Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early. Lead compliance for our AI proposition: classify our AI use cases, map our obligations as a provider or deployer under the EU AI Act, and set up the documentation, transparency and governance it requires. Make sure our platform, and the content our customers publish with it, meets the European Accessibility Act and related standards. Build privacy into the product by advising on GDPR questions tied to new features and data. Advise on cybersecurity law, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and incident reporting duties, working closely with our security team. Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team. Your Competencies & Skills Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you. A practical communicator who explains complex regulation to product teams in plain language, with answers instead of memos full of caveats. Proactive and curious: you spot gaps before they become problems and want to understand how the product actually works. Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up. Your Qualifications A Master’s in Law (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience, ideally a mix of law firm and in-house at a tech or SaaS company. Hands-on experience as product counsel for software, ideally including AI products. Deep working knowledge of the EU AI Act and how it applies to AI propositions in practice. Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act). A solid grounding in commercial and corporate law, with working knowledge of employment law. GDPR and privacy expertise is a plus, ideally at DPO level or with a certification such as CIPP/E. Experience working with scale-ups on a retainer or fractional basis is a plus. Fluent English. Dutch is a plus. For you, this is a chance to understand if Interrail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring. In the meantime… If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a feel for our culture, values, and place worldwide? Got questions? 63e6a8c347fd.title: Data Center Architect
63e6a8c347fd.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. 15e04a78a27e.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Applied AI Engineering team helps developers and enterprises deploy generative AI safely and effectively. We serve as trusted technical advisors, helping customers and partners move from early experimentation to production-scale AI systems.

As a Partner Applied AI Engineer focused on Google Cloud, you will help customers build with OpenAI in the cloud environment they already use. You will work with Google Cloud and its partner ecosystem to turn early implementations into repeatable approaches that field teams can deliver independently.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced technical leader to serve as a primary technical counterpart to Google Cloud Customer Engineers, AI specialists, and partner technical teams.

You will shape joint technical strategy, define engagement models, and build systems that scale beyond individual deals. Working across pre- and post-sales, you will guide enterprise customers from discovery through production while enabling Google Cloud and its partners to lead subsequent deployments.

This role combines hands-on engineering, technical judgment, and ecosystem leadership. You will bring deep familiarity with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI), particularly Model Garden and its Python SDK tooling, and help customers choose supported OpenAI integration paths based on workload requirements, model capabilities, security controls, and operational needs.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

Strategic Google Cloud engagement and influence

 - Build trusted relationships with Google Cloud field leadership, Customer Engineers, AI specialists, and partner teams across regions.

 - Influence joint account strategy and identify new opportunities where OpenAI can improve customer outcomes within Google Cloud environments.

 - Define engagement models and prioritization frameworks that concentrate technical effort on high-impact opportunities and reusable solutions.

 - Help teams distinguish model access through Model Garden, purchasing through Google Cloud Marketplace, and direct OpenAI offerings.

Complex deal leadership and execution

 - Lead technical strategy for complex enterprise engagements, from use-case discovery and architecture design to prototyping, evaluation, and production deployment.

 - Resolve integration and operational blockers with OpenAI and Google Cloud counterparts, giving account teams clear decisions and next steps.

 - Validate model and feature availability, regional requirements, access controls, data handling, quotas, and support boundaries for each workload.

 - Prioritize opportunities and allocate technical resources according to customer impact and the potential to scale through the ecosystem.

Solution architecture and hands-on building

 - Design and build OpenAI-powered applications that integrate with Google Cloud services, including Cloud Run or Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery where appropriate.

 - Develop reference implementations for supported Model Garden access to OpenAI through the Responses API, alongside direct OpenAI integration patterns where those better meet customer requirements.

 - Use the Vertex AI SDK for Python / Agent Platform SDK to discover deployable Model Garden models, inspect deployment configurations, and deploy supported open models to endpoints. Validate project, region, machine and accelerator choices, credentials, permissions, and test inference; distinguish this workflow from managed model API access.

 - Maintain supported SDK dependencies and adapt examples as Google updates its SDKs. Use Google Gen AI SDK for Google generative-AI capabilities migrated out of legacy Vertex AI modules, and the documented OpenAI API or SDK for OpenAI integration paths.

 - Build retrieval-augmented generation and tool-using workflows, connecting approved enterprise data and services with clear authorization boundaries.

 - Establish evaluation, observability, CI/CD, and operational practices that address output quality, safety, reliability, latency, and cost.

 - Make identity, networking, secrets management, and data governance explicit in architectures rather than assuming controls transfer between services or providers.

Ecosystem enablement and scale

 - Create workshops, demos, playbooks, and reference architectures that Google Cloud teams and systems integrators can use independently.

 - Teach partner engineers how to evaluate model choices in Model Garden and select deployment approaches based on customer needs.

 - Pair with field teams on early deployments, then transfer delivery ownership as patterns mature.

 - Scale through global and regional systems integrators and independent software vendors, maintaining reusable assets as integrations evolve.

Cross-functional leadership and feedback

 - Work with Alliances, Product, Engineering, GTM, and Enablement to align technical priorities and execution.

 - Turn recurring customer and partner issues into evidence-backed product feedback and specific requests.

 - Maintain clear guidance on validated capabilities, preview limitations, and unresolved gaps, and follow decisions back to the field.
   
   


YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have substantial technical consulting or equivalent experience, including relationships with senior technical and business leaders in complex organizations.

 - Have hands-on experience with Model Garden and the Vertex AI SDK for Python / Agent Platform SDK, including programmatic model discovery, deployment configuration, endpoint deployment, and inference testing. Understand how this tooling differs from Google Gen AI SDK and OpenAI API/SDK integration paths.

 - Can build production applications using Python or another relevant language, APIs, containers, and cloud services.

 - Have practical experience with LLM evaluation, retrieval, tool use, and secure enterprise integration.

 - Balance hands-on delivery with strategic influence, know when to go deep

Strategic partner engagement and influence

Validate each route against the customer’s governance and deployment requirements. Distinguish Databricks-billed usage from direct OpenAI billing and confirm commercial eligibility and attribution before making commitments.

Complex deal leadership and execution

 - Lead technical discovery, architecture, prototyping, evaluation, and production readiness. Agree with both account teams on what the customer will deploy, how success will be verified, and who owns the next step.

 - Validate model and feature availability, identity and network boundaries, data handling and residency, capacity, metering, and support ownership. Work with Alliances, Sales, and Billing Ops on technical readiness without taking ownership of pricing, terms, offer acceptance, or billing approvals.

Solution architecture and hands-on building

Use the appropriate integration path for the workload and validate permissions and data movement before deployment.

 - Put evaluation, observability, and deployment practices in place to measure quality, safety, reliability, latency, cost, and real workload usage.

Ecosystem enablement and scale

 - Create demos, workshops, reference architectures, and playbooks that partner engineers, field teams, and systems integrators can use independently. Pair on early deployments, then hand off proven patterns with clear prerequisites and support paths.

Cross-functional leadership and feedback

 - Work with Alliances, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Enablement to resolve blockers. Turn patterns across accounts into specific product feedback backed by evidence, and keep field guidance current on what is supported, what is limited, and what is not yet available.




YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have substantial experience leading technical engagements with enterprise engineering and business leaders across pre- and post-sales.

 - Have hands-on depth in at least one of OCI, Snowflake, or Databricks and can build credible architectures across the others. You understand enterprise data governance and know how to integrate OpenAI products into production systems.

 - Can build in Python or a comparable language and have practical experience with APIs, retrieval, tool use, LLM evaluation, and secure cloud deployments.

 - Can explain how a workload is purchased, accessed, served, metered, and supported without conflating those decisions. You build trust across sales and engineering, and measure success through customer adoption and partner self-sufficiency.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

About the team In this role, you’d be joining the Code Forge team in Developer Productivity. Our team is responsible for the systems that store Stripe’s code and its history, and serve it to every engineer, AI agent, and CI job. Our team helps Stripe increase the GDP of the internet by helping Stripe engineers ship faster and more safely. Stripe has a massive monorepo, and it keeps growing. AI is changing how software is built, and the demand on our systems grows with it. Our goal is source control that scales to meet any demand and serves each of its users in the way that best fits their work: engineers who write and review code, AI agents that work in parallel, and CI jobs that build and test every change. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing, building, and operating distributed systems, databases, or storage infrastructure in production Experience building critical, latency-sensitive systems that require strong consistency, durability, high availability, and disaster recovery Experience leading large, complex projects with multiple engineers across teams and organizations, explaining technical tradeoffs, building alignment with partners and leaders, and mentoring engineers in an environment where technologies and priorities change quickly Experience using AI coding agents in your daily work to write, test, and understand software Preferred qualifications Experience building developer tools that help engineers move faster, scaling large monorepos, or working with source control systems such as Sapling/Mononoke, Jujutsu (JJ), Mercurial, or Git Experience using user feedback and data to understand user needs and guide engineering decisions Experience building storage engines or databases, including on-disk formats, indexing, compression, and replication Experience with consensus, replication protocols, or strongly consistent distributed databases Experience with algorithms and data structures for large graphs or content-addressed data Proficiency with profiling, tracing, and debugging tools (for example, perf or eBPF) to find performance problems in distributed systems Proficiency in Go for high-performance distributed services

ab97bfe227ff.description:
About the Team

We are building general-purpose robotics. In the short term, we are focused on robots to support skilled workers to build our future infrastructure. In the long term, we imagine everyone having a personal robot doing anything they need. Progress is rapid, and based on a foundation of co-design between robotics hardware and ML research.

About the Role

As a Firmware Engineer, you will define and drive the architecture of embedded systems for next-generation hardware products. You will own foundational firmware decisions across real-time execution, device bring-up, hardware interfaces, fault handling, safety mechanisms, and production readiness.

We’re looking for someone with deep experience building safety-critical or high-consequence systems, where failures can have meaningful consequences. You should be comfortable reasoning about risk, designing for diagnosability and graceful degradation, and creating engineering practices that raise the reliability bar for the entire team.

You should also be unusually good at moving fast. Sometimes the right answer is a carefully reviewed architecture that will endure for years; sometimes it is getting a rough-but-useful prototype working by the end of the afternoon so the team can learn something concrete tomorrow. We value engineers who know the difference, make that call well, and can operate credibly in both modes.

You will be both a technical leader and a hands-on builder: setting direction, reviewing critical designs, unblocking the hardest problems, and writing production firmware when it matters most.

Our embedded stack uses a lot of Rust. Extensive experience in the language is a big help!

In this role, you will:

 - Rapidly bring up new hardware and set execution pace for the team.

 - Lead firmware architecture for embedded systems spanning boot, RTOS/runtime behavior, peripheral control, power management, communications, and field diagnostics.

 - Define engineering standards for reliability, fault tolerance, observability, and maintainability across the firmware stack.

 - Design and review safety-critical mechanisms, including fault detection, recovery paths, watchdog strategies, redundancy where appropriate, and safe-state behavior.

 - Build quick, scrappy prototypes when speed of learning matters, then harden the right ideas into production-quality systems.

 - Partner closely with engineers in hardware, software, and AI research from early prototype through production.

 - Build rigorous bring-up, validation, and release processes for embedded platforms.

 - Establish testing strategies across unit, hardware-in-the-loop, integration, stress, and failure-injection testing.

 - Drive root-cause analysis for subtle hardware, firmware, and system interactions.

 - Make clear tradeoffs across performance, memory, power, schedule, and safety.

 - Mentor firmware engineers and help shape a culture of urgency, technical rigor, practical judgment, and high-quality execution.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have extensive experience developing firmware in an iterative environment.

 - Get a thrill from bringing up new hardware and taking end-to-end ownership over ensuring it works.

 - Have led architecture and delivery for complex embedded products that shipped to real users or operated in demanding production environments.

 - Are deeply fluent in low-level languages (we use Rust!) and comfortable working close to hardware under real-time constraints.

 - Understand embedded systems from first principles, including interrupts, scheduling, memory layout, buses, DMA, timing behavior, and failure modes.

 - Have strong instincts for defensive design, fault containment, validation depth, and post-deployment diagnosability.

 - Know when to build the durable system and when to produce the fastest credible artifact that unlocks the next decision.

 - Communicate clearly across disciplines and can turn ambiguity into sound technical direction.

 - Care about building systems that are not only fast and capable, but also trustworthy.

 - Make heavy use of Codex, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted coding systems to accelerate implementation, prototyping, debugging, and iteration.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with Rust in embedded environments.

 - Experience with Embassy or other async embedded Rust frameworks.

 - Familiarity with mixed-language firmware architectures, including introducing Rust incrementally into existing C/C++ systems.

 - Experience with ARM Cortex-M or Cortex-R platforms, RTOSes, and low-power embedded designs.

 - Experience building firmware for sensor-rich, latency-sensitive, or tightly integrated electromechanical products.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

d9b851d80d1e.description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Security team ensures that while AI moves at breakneck speed, everyone driving the racecar is wearing a seatbelt. We secure LangChain's core platform and protect AI agents from emerging threats. We work across the stack so developers can confidently ship from prototype to production without compromising on safety or privacy. You'll be a hands-on security engineer working with product teams to secure agentic workloads across our SDKs, LangSmith and LangGraph services, and customer integrations. 




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - You'll ship secure designs and code, improve authentication and tenant isolation, and help teams address vulnerabilities and infrastructure risks. 

 - You’ll work on security problems that don’t have an established playbook. The scope depends on what you bring. You might: 
   
   - Own a high-risk surface like authentication or tenant isolation and fix it end to end.
   
   - Set direction for a larger security initiative across our SDKs, LangSmith, and LangGraph.
   
   - Define how we design and secure agentic products across the company.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years in security engineering with strong software skills (Python or Go; TypeScript a plus).

 - Depth in cloud/Kubernetes security (e.g., GCP/AWS IAM, workload identity, admission controls, network policies).

 - Hands‑on AppSec: code review, threat modeling, secure design, secrets & key management, authn/z patterns, multi‑tenant isolation.

 - Experience building detection & response and running incident management.

 - Familiarity with supply‑chain security (SBOM, sigstore/cosign, SLSA‑style controls) and dependency risk management.

 - Clear, pragmatic communication with engineers and customers.


NICE TO HAVE'S

 - Security for SaaS + self‑hosted offerings, including air‑gapped deployments.

 - Exposure to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 programs and evidence automation.

 - Experience with Go services and Infra as Code (Terraform/Helm), plus policy‑as‑code (OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno).

 - Knowledge of privacy patterns (data minimization, retention, masking, workspace scoping)..
   
    




COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. 

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.




BENEFITS

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

a44d3a83cfe0.title: (Senior ) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d)
a44d3a83cfe0.description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. As our (Senior) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d) , you build and run the verification process that proves our safety controller and the safety software on our robots do what the safety requirements say, release after release. You own the evidence that our certification body reviews. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it. You will join the Safety & Compliance team in Munich, which is developing a new safety controller in-house while keeping the safety-software system on our robots today certified and moving forward. Verification has not had a dedicated owner so far, so you create the structure, the catalog and the process rather than only executing an existing one.
