6e4f0f2b90bd.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

 

At Wolt, as a part of Doordash, we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery platform to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and courier partners. 

What makes our team unique:

  • Our global Security team aspires to be the world’s most admired security team, with members across EU, UK and North America (operating as Wolt, Deliveroo and Doordash).
  • We’re shaping our next generation infrastructure that is hardened from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity - no legacy tech or off-the-shelf product solutions. There is a lot to do around this new development as well as our “classic” platforms of the three companies.
  • The greater team is not just information security - we’re more holistic, and also physical security and safety are a part of our global operations.

 

This position is open in our Wolt hubs in Berlin, Germany, or Helsinki, Finland, and will be a part of the Global Security Engineering team.

 

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

 

  • Build and maintain core security products, including but not limited to Remote Access Management, Secrets Management, Tokenization, Encryption and Knowledge Graphs, Access Control at global scale.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, Security teams and Vendor Partners to build “paved paths” that provide actionable feedback to embed secure design practices into the product and infrastructure development process.

  • Lead the technical direction and roadmap for your assigned area of ownership.

  • Build and maintain high Operational Excellence (OE) to ensure we operate T0 services with excellence, rigor and durable standards to ensure minimal to no downtime.

  • Participate in on-call rotation and promptly respond to on-call events with urgency and rigor.

  • Manage the lifecycle of security product feature requests and improvements full life-cycle from triage, validation, design, testing, and implementation.

  • Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity.

  • Mentor and coach earlier career engineers, setting and enforcing high standards for Operational Excellence and Software Engineering.

 

Over time, your role can evolve depending on your interests and skills. Our company is  a large place and there’s a lot to do!

 

As the Security team sometimes needs to address high-priority security issues as well as ensure the availability of the components we have built, this position includes an on-call duty. On-call compensation and terms will be agreed separately in accordance with the local employment law.

 

Our humble expectations* 

  • Able to demonstrate a track record of driving improvements to a company’s infrastructure security posture.

  • Breadth of technical experience across various infrastructure and security areas running in large production environments.

  • Highly skilled in distributed systems and platforms development using program languages such as Java/Scala/Kotlin, Golang, or Python.

  • Strong experience with infrastructure as a code tooling like Terraform.

  • Expertise with cloud infrastructure and management in AWS.

  • Experience solving complex, systemic issues that require creative thinking and solutions.

  • Exceptional analytical and investigative abilities with hands-on experience leading root cause analysis.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to review design documents with respect to cloud infrastructure, security and engineering personnel.

  • Must be comfortable regularly exercising discretion and independent judgment in performing job duties, including evaluating options, making informed decisions, and determining appropriate courses of action within the scope of assigned responsibilities with minimal oversight.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

dc17a0b59c2b.title: Senior Space Systems Engineer, Mission Optimization
dc17a0b59c2b.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The Mission Optimization team is responsible for continuously improving the operations and productivity of the world’s largest Earth observation satellite constellation. We identify, triage, and resolve the bottlenecks that limit what our fleets can deliver – from contact scheduling and downlink latency, to collection capacity, to concepts of operation for our future missions.

As a Senior Space Systems Engineer on this team you will own the definition of novel concepts of operations. You will take problems that begin as a customer commitment, a contractual obligation, or an unexploited spacecraft capability, and turn them into an operational concept that engineering teams can build and operators can run.

You will operate with substantial latitude, working closely with spacecraft and systems engineering groups to understand what current and future fleets are capable of, with the software and operations teams who build and run the systems you're changing, and with Product and customer-facing teams to stay anchored to commitments and SLA risk. Being effective across those boundaries is a core part of this job.

  This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Define and own concepts of operations for new missions, new spacecraft capabilities, and new customer products, from early design through nominal operations
  • Lead optimization initiatives that span multiple organizations – setting the technical direction, building agreement, and holding the outcome against fleet SLAs and KPIs
  • Serve as a primary technical interface for the team with stakeholders across engineering, operations, and product
  • Translate contractual and customer obligations into operational concepts and capacity commitments the fleet can actually meet
  • Model and analyze fleet performance with operational data to identify where capacity, latency, or agility are being left on the table
  • Design, develop, and maintain the software solutions that implement these concepts
  • Act as a recognized subject-matter expert across Planet and provide technical mentorship within the team

What You Bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in spacecraft operations, mission systems engineering, or a closely related field
  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • Ownership of concepts of operations for complex operational systems, from definition to implementation
  • Working proficiency in Python or a comparable language, ability to model systems, analyze operational data, and contribute production code
  • Quantitative approach, including statistical analysis and reasoning over large operational datasets
  • A track record of leading technical initiatives across organizational boundaries
  • Ability to communicate and negotiate technical positions with senior stakeholders
  • Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience operating or designing operations for a large-scale satellite constellation
  • Background in optimization, scheduling, or operations research
  • Experience taking a new mission from design through commissioning and nominal operations
  • Familiarity with commercial Earth Observation, tasking, or fulfillment systems
  • Experience in a customer- or partner-facing technical role
  • Familiarity with orbital mechanics, link budgets, and spacecraft resource modeling
  • Experience with DevOps tooling and practices (Git, GitLab, Docker, CI/CD, Linux, Sentry, Datadog)

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Export Control Requirements:

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export lic

5ab69ee3b9fe.title: Data analyst - AML
5ab69ee3b9fe.description:
About the team:

At SumUp, keeping our platform safe and compliant is critical to the trust of the millions of small businesses we serve around the world.

You’ll join our Global AML team at an exciting point in its growth. We’re expanding into new markets, evolving our AML capabilities, introducing AI-enabled controls, and navigating increasingly complex regulatory expectations.

As an AML Data Analyst, you’ll play a key role in turning AML data into actionable insights. Working closely with our global AML Operations and AML Governance teams, as well as colleagues across Engineering and Data, you’ll help us understand how our controls are performing, identify risks and gaps early, and make better decisions as our business scales.

This is a role where your analysis will go beyond reporting. The insights you generate will directly support how we monitor, improve, and strengthen our global AML framework.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Build and maintain AML dashboards, operational reports, and data packs used by AML Operations, AML Governance, and senior leadership
  • Design measurement frameworks that track AML operational KPIs, including case volumes, productivity, SLA adherence, and screening hit rates
  • Support AML teams by providing data extracts, analysis, trend identification, and root-cause analysis on AML control outputs and data quality issues
  • Run data validation and quality checks to keep AML data accurate and consistent across systems and regions
  • Support Transaction Monitoring and Sanctions/PEP screening through data analysis, requirements definition, and testing
  • Partner with Engineering and AML Operations to define data requirements and support automation projects
  • Build self-service analytics resources so AML Operations teams can explore data and find insights independently

 

You’ll be great for this role if you have:

  • Experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role within financial services, fintech, compliance, AML, or another regulated environment.
  • Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries and building reliable datasets for reporting and analysis.
  • Practical experience with Python for data analysis and automation.
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify patterns, trends, root causes, and actionable insights from complex data.
  • The ability to translate technical analysis into clear recommendations and stories for non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Experience working with data quality, validation, multiple data sources, and competing stakeholder priorities.
  • A proactive, curious mindset and interest in AML, financial crime, fintech, and emerging technologies such as AI, with the ability to take ownership in a fast-changing environment.

 

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp’s future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

 

About us:

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

87ca24c05683.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
87ca24c05683.description:
Kurz und knapp

Du hast dein Studium frisch in der Tasche, sprühst vor Tatendrang und willst nicht an der Seitenlinie stehen, sondern direkt das Steuer übernehmen?

Bei uns steigst du nicht einfach nur ein – du übernimmst ab Tag 1 echte Führungsverantwortung. Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) bist du das pulsierende Herz unseres vollautomatisierten Fulfillment Centers (FC) in Oberhausen. Zusammen mit Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation revolutionieren wir den Markt und bauen das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamführung: Du bist Coach, Vorbild und Sparringspartner. Mit echter Empathie führst, inspirierst und entwickelst du dein Team aus 5 Teamleitenden und über 200 Lagermitarbeitenden.
  • Schichtleitung: Bei dir laufen die Fäden zusammen. Du priorisierst im laufenden Betrieb, löst Engpässe direkt vor Ort und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich vom Band rollt.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es nicht. Du blickst über den Tellerrand, zerlegst komplexe Logistikprozesse datenbasiert in ihre Einzelteile und hebst unsere Abläufe mit deinen eigenen Projekten aufs nächste Level.
  • Abwechslung: Langeweile? Fehlanzeige. Du liebst die Dynamik aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (3-4 Tage pro Woche) und konzeptioneller Deep Dive Arbeit im FC Office (1-2 Tage pro Woche).
  • Stakeholdermanagement: Wenn der Betrieb kocht, läufst du zur Hochform auf. Du behältst selbst bei ungeplanten Spitzen einen kühlen Kopf, triffst souverän Entscheidungen und gibst deinem Team jederzeit Rückhalt.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistik, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich.
  • Erste praktische Einblicke in die Lager-, Logistik- oder Produktionswelt (z. B. durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten) und absolute Machermentalität.
  • Ein großes Herz für Menschen: Du bist nahbar, kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch und hast Spaß daran, andere über sich hinauswachsen zu lassen.
  • Echte Stressresistenz sowie die nötige Flexibilität für unser rotierendes 3-Schicht-System (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr, 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr & 21:30 – 6:00 Uhr, auch samstags).
  • Einen scharfen, analytischen Verstand, gepaart mit dem unbedingten Willen, Dinge anzupacken und ins Ziel zu bringen.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung. Dazu bieten wir ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

a722fc08d426.title: Engineering Manager, ChatBots and AI
a722fc08d426.description:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company. 

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. 

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Workato is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the ChatBots and AI team within our Platform organization. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity: you turn unclear requirements into clear execution plans, make confident decisions with incomplete information, and keep both the team and leadership aligned. The team is fully remote and international - you'll build the processes and culture that make it work at pace.

About the Team

The ChatBots and AI team's mission is to deliver AI agents to end users. We own the runtime and integration layer - conversation storage, API design, streaming, and integrations with external interfaces like Slack and other applications. The team is made up of Senior and Staff engineers working in Ruby/Rails and Go on a modern stack: PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, and AWS. You'll collaborate with dedicated QA, SRE, and UX/UI teams, as well as engineering teams across the broader organization. Workato has a strong cross-functional culture - your team won't work in isolation.

What You'll Do

  • Identify blockers early, resolve them decisively, and escalate when escalation is the right call

  • Balance feature work against internal investments - AI-SDLC, CI/CD, platform upgrades, and technical debt

Team

  • Design team processes that fit a distributed, asynchronous environment - and evolve them as the team and company change

  • Apply AI tooling to how the team works, not just what it builds

Technical Ownership

  • Participate in architecture and design decisions as a technical peer to your engineers

  • Make trade-off calls on scope, approach, and sequencing - and be accountable for them

Communication

In this role, you will combine simulation, lab validation, and engineering feedback to improve product performance from prototype to deployment. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify electromagnetic issues early, validate concepts in the lab, and translate findings into practical design improvements. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join QuantumDiamonds? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Develop and run electromagnetic simulations for magnetic and RF systems in industrial machines Analyze and optimize components and system behavior, including coils, shielding, antennas, cabling, and subsystem interactions Investigate electromagnetic effects on machines and assemblies during integration, testing, and operation Identify and mitigate EMI/EMC, coupling, and interference issues across electrical and mechanical interfaces Translate findings into concrete design improvements and provide feedback to electrical, mechanical, and system engineering Support product development from design through integration, validation, and certification readiness What is expected of you Strong background in electrical engineering, physics, or a related field Several years of hands-on experience in electromagnetic simulation and development in an industrial environment on system level Good understanding of electromagnetic theory and simulation methods such as FEM, FDTD Power user of simulation tools like Ansys HFSS, Maxwell, Icepak or similar Practical experience with measurement, testing, and validation of electromagnetic behavior on real systems Familiarity with EMI/EMC requirements Experience with development processes related to CE, SEMI, UL or IEC 61010 compliance is a strong plus Ability to derive pragmatic engineering solutions and work effectively across disciplines Our benefits Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active. Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired. Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. About us QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act. e5e4ef818a53.description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually. Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second , we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time. Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake , providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange. Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference . We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem. The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines , and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second . Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For Quantitative Academic Foundation: You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. You are available to contribute up to 20 hours per week during the semester. ML Model Prototyping: You will support the research and evaluation of deep learning and machine learning models that predict user behavior across our 770 million user base. We are looking for solid Python skills and hands-on familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and gradient boosting libraries (LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost) to prototype new algorithms. Plus: ML Infrastructure Exposure: Any prior exposure to the systems that run our real-time scale—AWS, workflow orchestration (Airflow), containerization (Docker), or basic model deployment workflows—will accelerate your impact. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. f0cd2b8576b6.title: Software Development Engineer in Test II, NavNative
f0cd2b8576b6.description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What We Do The Navigation Native team builds the high-performance C++ engine that serves as the "brain" of our Navigation SDKs. This library runs directly on end-user systems (on-board), powering everything from mobile apps to in-vehicle infotainment systems for partners like BMW, Porsche, and Zeekr. We solve the fundamental challenges of movement: transforming noisy GPS/IMU data into precise map-matching, managing complex road-network graphs, supporting routes and alternatives, tracking progress along a route, and providing "Electronic Horizon" capabilities for ADAS. Our work happens at the edge, supporting location frequencies up to 10Hz and ensuring a seamless experience even in tunnels or dense urban canyons. As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. What You'll Do We are looking for smart, fast-learning engineers who care as much about proving that navigation works as about making it work. As an SDE(T), you will: Build and maintain the unit, integration, and functional test architecture for a C++17 library, and the CMake and CI pipelines that run it. Turn real-world location recordings into regression tests, and define the quality metrics for map-matching, routing, and route-following. Keep the quality signal fast and trustworthy: eliminate flaky tests, run sanitizer and performance builds, and track coverage. Build AI-driven test tooling: agent-based test generation, automated dogfooding and triage, and AI-assisted PR review. Partner with feature engineers on testability and review designs for how they will be verified. Thoughtfully leverage AI tools in your workflow and set the standard for how the team uses them. What We Believe Are Important Traits for This Role 5+ years of experience in C++17: comfortable writing test code and tooling, reading production code, and debugging with sanitizers and profilers. Python or similar for harnesses and analysis. Proven experience building test infrastructure for a large native codebase: test frameworks, CMake, and CI systems. A data-driven mindset: you define metrics, build the tooling to measure them, and use them to argue for or against a change. Experience diagnosing hard-to-reproduce failures: flakiness, platform-specific behavior, memory and threading bugs. Strong English skills, with the ability to explain test results, risk, and trade-offs to peers and stakeholders. Would be a Plus Familiarity with navigation concepts (map matching, dead reckoning, route progress, or Electronic Horizon). Experience with replay- or simulation-based testing using real sensor and GPS data. Hands-on experience building AI- or agent-based developer tooling for testing, code review, or triage. Experience with coverage tooling, performance benchmarking, or testing SDKs through generated bindings. Employment Requirements Employment Type: Full-time Weekly Hours: 40 h per week Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany) What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How We Support You Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable. Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits. Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family. Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth. Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents. Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies. Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO. Map end-to-end journeys, prototype interactions, and craft production-ready UI that holds up in high-pressure environments. Go where the work happens. Join on-site visits and user sessions, watch real workflows, and capture the constraints that never show up in specs. Obsess over users, drive adoption. Design for diverse user groups with varying levels of tech comfort, and understand how your work drives adoption. Turn insight into direction. Synthesize research into clear problem statements, hypotheses, and UX principles the team can rally around. Balance speed and quality. Use AI-assisted workflows and tools to accelerate exploration and prototyping without compromising craft or usability. Be a partner to Product and Engineering. You operate well in ambiguity: you ask the right questions, make pragmatic trade-offs, and keep quality high. You bring the human side: empathy, direct communication, and high accountability . You are fluent in English 🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people. We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany. You become a co-creator of our success with stock options. You get generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible, plus free language courses. You decide when you work best, that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up. ✨ Ready to talk? 002cf856f642.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a Senior AI Deployment Strategist, you will bridge the gap between vision and execution, ensuring our customers not only see the potential of AI but realize its value in their operations. This role is a unique blend of strategic advisory and hands-on deployment leadership, spanning both presales and postsales phases. You will act as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, architecting AI solutions that drive transformation and delivering measurable business outcomes. You will be embedded in our most strategic accounts, diagnosing business challenges, designing AI-powered solutions, and leading their deployment from concept to full-scale adoption. This role demands a rare combination of executive presence, technical credibility, and commercial acumen, with a focus on both winning and delivering high-impact AI initiatives. What You Will Do Strategic Advisory & C-Suite Partnership • Serve as the lead strategic advisor for a portfolio of high-value enterprise clients, building trusted relationships with executive leadership (CEO, CTO, CIO). • Lead C-suite workshops to diagnose business drivers and co-create multi-year AI transformation roadmaps aligned with corporate strategy. • Develop and present compelling business cases and proposals, articulating the ROI of AI adoption and the value of Mistral’s platform. Presales: Shaping the Vision • Partner with sales and product teams to identify and qualify opportunities, positioning Mistral’s solutions as the catalyst for enterprise transformation. • Design tailored AI strategies and proof-of-concepts that address critical business challenges and demonstrate tangible value. • Act as a subject matter expert in client engagements, ensuring our solutions are understood, trusted, and adopted. Postsales: Driving Deployment & Adoption • Own the end-to-end success of AI deployments, from strategic planning to operational integration, ensuring solutions are embedded into the customer’s core workflows. • Lead cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, and product managers to execute deployment roadmaps and deliver measurable results. • Navigate organizational complexity and drive change management to ensure seamless adoption and long-term success. Commercial Growth & Thought Leadership • Identify and cultivate expansion opportunities within accounts, connecting Mistral’s capabilities to new business challenges and driving commercial growth. • Mentor junior strategists and contribute to the development of best practices, methodologies, and playbooks for customer engagement. • Represent Mistral AI as a thought leader through speaking engagements, executive briefings, and industry contributions. What We're Looking For • You have 8+ years of experience in technical management consulting, enterprise technology, or a customer-facing strategic role, with a focus on AI/ML, data architecture, or digital transformation. • You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.) • You possess a deep, practical expertise in AI/ML concepts, enterprise data architecture, and modern software development with hands-on development of AI solutions —enough to credibly engage with technical teams and executives alike. • You have a proven track record of engaging and influencing C-suite executives, with the ability to navigate complex conversations and align AI strategies with business objectives. • You excel at structuring ambiguous problems into actionable programs and thrive in fast-paced, high-stakes environments. • You are equally comfortable in presales and postsales : shaping deals, designing solutions, and ensuring their successful deployment. • You have experience managing high-value accounts, understanding deal mechanics, and building compelling cases for investment. • You are a c ollaborative leader who can motivate cross-functional teams and drive results through influence, not authority. We are looking for adaptable, low-ego team players who are passionate about turning AI vision into reality and delivering transformative impact for our customers. 7a318cfb8284.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a talented German speaking Senior Sales Engineer to join our Enterprise sales team. As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you will work closely with our sales team to understand our Enterprise customers’ complex business needs and showcase how Fivetran’s data replication solutions can help them achieve their desired business outcomes. You will be responsible for providing technical expertise, identifying technical requirements, and ensuring a successful proof-of value throughout the sales cycle.

This is a full-time remote position based in Germany, with preference for Munich.

Technologies You’ll Use

AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, New Relic, Linux, Windows, Python, Java

What You’ll Do

  • Work with Enterprise customers to understand their business, their use cases, and their data replication requirements
  • Develop and deliver technical presentations to Enterprise audiences
  • Ensure the technical win by running an organized proof-of-value process
  • Work closely with multiple cross-fuctional organizations driving change and improvements to Fivetran as a whole.
  • Work closely with multiple Sales representatives, while maintaining a high level of customer focus and technical excellence
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends in our industry
  • Assist team members in advanced technical or business roadblocks

0df855f9fd8f.description:
Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012.
We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers.
Learn more about us at www.testlio.com.

About This Opportunity

We're looking for people in Italy, Belgium, and Germany to help us test how local payment methods work when paying for advertising on Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager.

Requirements:

  • Location & Payment Method:
    • Italy: Satispay account.
    • Belgium: Wero activated with a Belgian bank account.
    • Germany: Wero activated with a German bank account.
  • Have access to Meta Ads Manager, or be willing to create an account.
  • Have an iOS/Android device or a computer with an updated browser, plus a smartphone with the required payment app.
  • Comfortable following instructions and submitting feedback in English.
  • Available to start ASAP and complete testing by November 16, 2026.
  • Duration: Approximately 1.5 hours.
  • Compensation: Paid hourly testing assignment.

Don't have Satispay or Wero yet? You can still apply if you're willing and eligible to set it up before testing.

What You'll Do:

  • Follow step-by-step instructions from our testing team.
  • Add a local payment method to Meta Ads Manager.
  • Complete a small advertising payment of approximately €5.
  • Check whether the payment goes through successfully.
  • Report any errors or unexpected behavior, including screenshots when needed.

Why do we need local testers?
Online payment methods can work differently depending on the country, bank, and device. That's why companies need local people to help check that payments are processed correctly.
Your role is to follow simple instructions, complete a small authorized transaction, and tell us whether everything worked as expected.
No previous software testing experience is required!

Privacy & Security

We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously.
You'll receive instructions for the assigned testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive banking information in your reports.

If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps.

8c1d382e33d7.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Operations Tech Team
8c1d382e33d7.description: Staff Backend Engineer - Operations Tech Team Hybrid in London, UK We’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join the Operations Tech team. You’ll influence the technical direction of iwoca’s in-house CRM and build parts of it yourself – the system that hundreds of staff across sales, account management, credit, and collections use to give our customers five-star service. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Operations Tech team builds the tools iwoca’s UK operations teams use every day: the CRM, and the systems behind phone calls, emails, notifications, and task management. Those tools are a competitive advantage – they help colleagues manage risk and enable the outstanding customer service that sets iwoca apart. The team works closely with the Operations Strategy team, which sets operational priorities and scopes much of the tooling. Many of its users work in the same building, and you’ll see how your changes affect the people you work with. We’re growing the team to ten engineers (including this role), two of them tech leads, and two product owners. Most of its time goes on quarterly roadmap projects, alongside a support rota, and regular small feature improvements. The role As a staff backend engineer, you’ll take whole projects end to end: work out what operations teams need, design it, build it, and look after it in production. You’ll decide with the tech leads where the CRM’s service boundaries sit and how to model each domain’s data. You’ll judge your work by what it changes for those teams and their customers. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no line management, but you’ll mentor the engineers around you. You’ll often pair with a more junior engineer, share what you know, and set the standards the team works to through design discussions and code review. You’ll learn how iwoca lends, from credit decisions to collections and financial crime. The team is adding AI to the CRM’s workflows, and you’ll have a say in where it helps. Live project examples: Migrating the monolith. Moving CRM functionality out of iwoca’s Django monolith into separate services, such as customer contact and phone calls, that deploy and scale on their own. Building customer-facing AI agents to take the load off our teams as we grow, and the infrastructure to make them reliable and trustworthy Improving our onboarding journey to so that there’s less manual work getting a customer their funds, for example using LLMs to speed up compliance checks Credit card operations. Building the CRM services that let operations teams support customers on iwoca’s business credit card. iwocaChat. Extending the Claude-powered assistant that answers operations staff questions about a customer, using data held across several systems. The requirements Essential: System design. You’ve designed large production systems and the domain models at their core, and changed their architecture while people relied on them. Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You’ve written and run backend services in it. Technical leadership. You’ve led technical decisions across a team as an individual contributor, and helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions. Operational problems. You’ve worked with non-technical colleagues to understand a problem they had, and built the system that solved it. AI leverage. You’ve built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience. Bonus: Python stack. You’ve worked with Python, Django, Celery, and PostgreSQL. Full-stack. You’ve contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript. Monolith migration. You’ve moved functionality out of a large monolith into separate services, while both stayed in production. Asynchronous systems. You’ve built services that communicate through message queues such as RabbitMQ. Contact systems. You’ve worked on telephony, email, or messaging systems, such as Twilio. Models in production systems. 1383d23bf3f1.description:
Location: London, Warwick, Manchester, Derby

At BakerHicks, ​​​​​​​our Electrical Services team works with clients across multiple sectors, delivering large and complex projects which require highly resilient power supplies. Specialising in heavily-regulated industries where quality and safety are key, we’re experienced in all aspects of the project lifecycle from definition and feasibility to detailed design and site monitoring. 

We are actively recruiting across this capability to support a growing portfolio of live projects and welcome applications from Senior and Principal-level contractors to join the team to support the workload.

Our Electrical Services teams work across a range of UK projects, delivering complex solutions within Nuclear, Defence and other regulated sectors, alongside wider infrastructure and energy environments. 

Roles are available across multiple locations.

 

What you will be doing

  • Deliver engineering design and consultancy services for BakerHicks under the direction of the line manager or project lead.
  • Produce design outputs (drawings, specifications, reports), undertake site surveys, support construction stages, liaise with clients and design/construction teams, manage projects, oversee costing, and ensure progress against the project brief.
  • Check calculations and detailed drawings to ensure designs meet quality standards, compliance requirements, and client expectations.
  • Work collaboratively with multi‑disciplinary teams to deliver safe, efficient, and buildable solutions.
  • Maintain an understanding of CDM requirements.


Projects range from early design through to delivery and operational support, providing exposure to technically challenging and safety‑critical environments.

 

What you’ll bring

 

  • Confidence in producing high-quality designs, with the technical capability to carry out independent checks and ensure accuracy.
  • A strong awareness of commercial considerations, with the ability to identify and flag potential risks or concerns where appropriate.
  • A solid understanding of project delivery and people management principles, enabling effective anticipation of challenges and proactive escalation of risks or recommendations.

 

 

What We’re Looking For

Qualifications & Eligibility

  • Ideally Chartered Engineer status, or working towards (CEng CIBSE or CEng IET)
  • Eligible to obtain SC clearance at minimum 

Technical Experience

  • Considerable design, technical detailing and specification writing experience.  
  • Possess a working knowledge of BIM Level 2 Delivery. 
  • Possess a working knowledge of Navisworks, AutoCAD, NBS and Amtech/Trimble, or ideally exposure to Electrical OM
  • Experience working in integrated, multi‑discipline design teams
  • Familiarity with technical assurance and quality processes

 

Security & Project Requirements

Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels. The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements. In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.

Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: (National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK) 

 

About BakerHicks 

We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see: About | BakerHicks. 

BakerHicks. A Morgan Sindall Group company.  

  

Benefits 

Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.

f07167bd46ad.description:
Help Shape the Future of the UK's Energy Infrastructure

BakerHicks has established itself as a trusted engineering partner within the UK's Transmission & Distribution sector, delivering major infrastructure projects for some of the country's leading utility clients. With continued growth and a strong pipeline of secured work, we are seeking an experienced Principal/Lead Primary Design Engineer - HV Substations to join our expanding Power team.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical energy infrastructure projects, leading technical excellence across complex HV substation designs up to 400kV.

 

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the HV Substation Team Leader, you will lead a team of Primary Design Engineers and CAD Technicians, ensuring the consistent delivery of high-quality engineering solutions and technical documentation.

You will provide technical leadership across HV substation projects, support the development of junior engineers, and act as a key point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders. 

You will also support business development activities by contributing technical input to tender submissions and helping secure future project opportunities.

 

Why This Role:

  • Work on some of the UK's most significant Transmission & Distribution projects.
  • Be part of a business that is helping deliver the infrastructure required for the UK's energy transition.
  • Lead and mentor a growing team of engineers and technicians.
  • Work closely with major utility clients including National Grid, SSEN, Scottish Power, UKPN, ENWL and others.
  • Enjoy genuine opportunities for career progression, technical leadership and professional development.
  • Collaborate within a multidisciplinary engineering environment where innovation and new ideas are actively encouraged.
  • See projects progress through the full lifecycle, from concept and design through to construction and energisation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the delivery of primary engineering design for HV substation projects up to 400kV.
  • Manage and mentor a team of engineers and CAD technicians.
  • Ensure the quality, accuracy and consistency of project deliverables.
  • Support and develop junior engineers through coaching and technical guidance.
  • Provide technical oversight and approval of engineering work.
  • Take ownership of HV Plant CDAE responsibilities on National Grid projects where applicable.

 

Design & Engineering

Prepare, review and approve:

  • Primary layouts and elevations.
  • Single Line Diagrams (SLDs).
  • Transformer sizing and specifications.
  • GIS and AIS switchgear designs.
  • Shunt reactors, NERs and reactive/capacitive compensation schemes.
  • Switchroom layouts.
  • CT sizing calculations.
  • Busbar design and short-circuit force calculations.
  • Busbar and connector specifications.
  • LVAC systems for substations.
  • Earthing studies and earth return current calculations.
  • Insulation coordination studies.
  • Mechanical interlocking schemes.
  • Equipment technical specifications.
  • Type registration documentation.
  • Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities.

 

Project Delivery

  • Manage programme, budget and quality requirements for engineering deliverables.
  • Prepare, review and approve feasibility studies, outline designs, detailed designs and technical reports.
  • Review and approve construction drawings and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate internal teams and external suppliers.
  • Support bid and tender submissions.
  • Maintain updates to the Business Development Tracker.
  • Participate in client meetings, design reviews and technical workshops.

 

About You:

You will be an experienced HV Substation Engineer with a strong technical background and a passion for delivering high-quality engineering solutions.

 

You will have:

  • Significant experience delivering primary design and engineering for HV substation projects up to 400kV.
  • Strong knowledge of UK Transmission and Distribution standards and specifications.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience leading engineering teams and reviewing technical deliverables.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting and developing others.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving.

 

Essential Requirements

  • BEng or BSc in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Extensive experience in HV substation primary design and engineering.
  • Experience producing designs, calculations, reports and drawings associated with substation projects up to 400kV.
  • Strong understanding of IEC standards and industry best practice.
  • Experience working to National Grid and DNO specifications.
  • Experience managing engineering teams and coordinating project delivery.
  • Experience working alongside CAD technicians using AutoCAD, Revit or similar software.

 

Desirable Requirements

  • MEng or MSc in Electrical Engineering.
  • National Grid HV Plant CDAE accreditation.
  • Chartered Engineer (CEng) status or actively working towards chartership.
  • Experience supporting bids, tenders and work-winning activities.

a4010bdc70f3.title: Staff Product Security Engineer
a4010bdc70f3.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We're seeking a Staff Product Security engineer to develop novel security tooling, discover vulnerabilities, and ultimately secure our suite of advanced technologies including artificial intelligence systems, command and control platforms, aerospace vehicles, and long range sensors.

The ideal candidate has a background in electrical or software engineering, with a focus on platform security, or has pivoted to a product or application security role. They will be able to conduct complex security architecture reviews, research and mitigate exploits against hardware and software, and work with other engineering teams to build resiliency into our products.

Responsibilities:

  • Owns the development and maturation of security features for Anduril’s products
  • Authors and maintains security documentation including System Security Plans, Threat Analysis and Risk Assessments, and compliance evidence
  • Collaborates and builds solutions with engineering teams to meet and exceed industry-standard security goals
  • Collaborates with manufacturing and operations teams to develop secure handling and operational processes
  • Engages with teams to remediate uncovered weakness in designs, implementations, integrations, and processes
  • Integrates and matures Product Securitys suite of tooling thought Anduril’s products.
  • Conducts security assessments including architecture review, source code analysis, configuration auditing, and adversarial testing

Requirements:

  • Proficient with one or more programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Golang, Rust, Python)
  • Experience assessing security of firmware, applications, network, IoT, or embedded systems
  • Experience developing features for and improving security of firmware, applications, network, or embedded systems
  • Experience building, testing, and delivering production-ready systems, especially for embedded and/or Linux systems
  • Experience with structured threat modelling and risk assessment methodologies
  • Experience in building and security autonomous systems and their unique threat model
  • Experience in any previous military or defence domain; land, air, sea desirable but not mandatory
  • Familiarity with anti-tamper and reverse engineering hardware and software mechanisms
  • Strong and professional communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a UK Security Clearance to a minimum of SC level
  • Must be a UK citizen

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excels at the above listed Requirements
  • Experience with UK Ministry of Defence Cyber Security Model, including
    • UK Government Security Classifications
    • DefStans (05-138 at a minimum)
    • Cyber Secure by Design (including JSP 440’s Cyber Secure by Design guidance and/or JSPs 453 and 604)
    • Defence Information Protection Notices (DIPNs)
    • Industry Security Notices (ISNs)
  • Familiarity with aviation cyber security standards such as DO-326A/ED-202A
  • Experience with SORA or CAA Type Certification cyber requirements
  • Experience engaging with certification bodies like the CAA or MAA/DE&S
  • Familiarity with RF Emanation Protection (including TEMPEST)
  • Experience of Network Security Devices (including Inter-Domain Gateways and Cross Domain Solutions)
  • Familiarity with security architectures of embedded, aerospace, or cyber-physical systems
  • Experience with programmable logic devices and their development tools
  • Regularly builds, tests, and delivers production-ready systems, especially for embedded and/or Linux systems
  • Ideally a sole UK National (i.e. hold no other citizenships)


Anduril is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you are someone passionate to work on problems that matter, we’d love to hear from you!

657ddabf2f6e.title: Senior Modelling and Simulation Engineer
657ddabf2f6e.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

At Anduril Australia we are developing un-crewed maritime and air domain systems that leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require Senior Modelling and Simulation Engineers with deep experience with platform simulation. The Senior Modelling and Simulation Engineer strives to leverage their experience to support the rapid design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous vehicles through the entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the design, development, integration and support of next-generation modeling and simulation architecture that enables the continuous delivery of capability orders of magnitude faster than the competition
  • Act as the subject matter expert for design and implementation of engineering level simulation of Anduril platforms, including physical interaction with the environment, as well as platform, system, subsystem, component and device level models.
  • Simulate solutions for Guidance, Navigation and Control algorithm and Vehicle Management System component implementations.
  • Collaborate with vendors and/or customers to integrate external models within the Anduril engineering simulation architecture.
  • Create models and test and simulation fixtures that operate with both software- and hardware-in-the-loop
  • Contribute to the design and development of other software systems and sub-systems
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of robotic software, including full lifecycle testing
  • Support vehicle manufacturing and deployment
  • Work as a member of a multi-disciplinary software team, including as a mentor for Software Engineers from differing backgrounds

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience
  • Extensive experience with platform physics based modelling and simulation.
  • Experience writing C, C++ or Python
  • Systems and/or application programming skills including algorithms, data structures, concurrency and optimization
  • Capacity to work holistically on software enabled capabilities up and down the software stack and through lifecycle through design, implementation, operation and sustainment
  • Capacity to act as the technical owner for a software service, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution
  • Capacity learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in a senior role for the simulation and delivery of a robotic system, particularly in the air, maritime or space domains
  • Experience with flight dynamics and platform physics and control
  • Experience with MATLAB and Simulink
  • Familiarity with communications busses and protocols such as CAN, CANFD, ARINC-825, ARINC-429, MIL-STD-1553, UART/RS232/RS422/RS485, SPI, QSPI, I2C, Ethernet, etc
  • Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Familiarity with System Engineering concepts
  • Desire to learn and grow in to other roles that require experience as a Senior Software Engineer, such as Principal Software Engineer and/or Engineering Manager
  • Desire to grow in to a Tech-Lead-Manager role, with responsibility for line management of engineers, in addition to delivery

9cef16b95eb8.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

(Internal Job Title: Senior Value Engineer)

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the FSI sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English and French communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains and FSI trends. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.
  • Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics,  comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor
