c753b84230f2.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de l'IA et de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. 

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. 

En tant que stagiaire Software Engineer, tu seras ammener à: 

  • Participer activement à la conception et à l'implémentation de solutions techniques robustes et scalables.
  • Architecture logicielle : Contribuer à la réflexion sur l'architecture de nos applications, en veillant à la performance et à la maintenabilité du code
  • Déploiement et opérations (DevOps) :  automatisation des tests et des déploiements cloud avec des pipelines CI/CD et une infrastructure en tant que code (ex : Terraform), packaging d'applications dans des conteneurs (ex : Docker), implémentation d'outils d'observabilité des données (ex : DBT)
  • Déploiement de ton logiciel sur le cloud : GCP, AWS ou Azure 
  • Déploiement d’une ou plusieurs expertises techniques suivantes : développement logiciel, ingénierie analytique, ingénierie ML, architecture cloud ou ingénierie de sécurité et de fiabilité des sites
  • Veille technologique : Explorer de nouvelles technologies et outils pour optimiser nos méthodes de travail.

Profil recherché

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en sotware engineering, génie logiciel, informatique, ou développement web et tu recherches ton stage de fin d’études à partir de Janvier 2027
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Maîtrise d'un ou plusieurs langages de programmation comme Python, Java, JavaScript (Node.js), Go ou Scala.
    • Connaissance des principes de la programmation orientée objet et/ou de la programmation fonctionnelle.
    • Expérience avec des bases de données SQL ou NoSQL.
    • Une familiarité avec le Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) et les conteneurs (Docker, Kubernetes) est un atout.
    • Connaissance des outils de versioning, en particulier Git.
  • Qualités personnelles :
    • Curiosité et proactivité : Tu as envie d'apprendre et de proposer de nouvelles idées.
    • Rigueur et souci du détail : Tu es soucieux(se) de produire un code propre et de qualité.
    • Esprit d'équipe : Tu es capable de travailler en collaboration et d'échanger avec des profils variés (Data Scientists, Consultants, etc.)
    • Français courant pour travailler en équipe et anglais professionnel obligatoire pour nos clients internationaux 

Le processus de recrutement : pour rejoindre Artefact, nous te proposons un processus de recrutement en quatre étapes durant lequel tu auras l’occasion de parler de ton expérience et d'en apprendre davantage sur Artefact et le poste d'ingénieur logiciel.

  • Entretien RH

9bc421983311.description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention. Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability.

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France, and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries.

 

 

This position is based in Rennes, France.

Chance to apply closes: 6th of November 2026.

 

The Solutions Engineer at IDnow is the client's trusted advisor through pre-sales and integration. You design the solution the client will rely on, you give them confidence that it will work in their environment, and you become the person they turn to for technical and solution decisions. Your focus is the technical side of the journey up to the point where the client is live on our products, and you make that path smooth. 

This is a hands-on, deeply technical role, and a commercial one. Solutions Engineers carry a quota and are measured on two things: the deals they help win, and whether the client goes live successfully. You work hand in hand with Sales to convince the client that our solution is the right one and to move them toward signature, and then you make sure they can use it well in production. You earn that through technical depth, but you are client-facing, credible and persuasive in a sales motion. You do this across our whole client base.

We hire this role at more than one level. The core of the job is the same; the scope you own and the complexity you handle grow with your experience. This role carries real ownership across the client journey, and a say in how the work evolves.

 

Key Responsibilities

Discover and Design

  • Lead technical discovery, qualifying conversion rates, false acceptance and rejection trade-offs, fraud exposure and integration constraints before proposing a solution,
  • Design end-to-end solution architectures that orchestrate document verification, digital identity, fraud signals, biometric authentication, eID and EU Digital Identity Wallet flows, and e-signature,
  • Link every technical choice to the client’s business objectives and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), so proposals speak to outcomes rather than features,
  • Define defensible architecture decisions covering fallback logic, data residency, scalability and performance,
  • Support Sales with proposals, Requests for Proposal (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), advising on which capabilities to combine and why.

Prove, Integrate and Go Live

  • Lead proof-of-concept and pilot engagements, configuring Application Programming Interface (API) integrations, building Postman collections and managing sandbox environments,
  • Validate behaviour under realistic conditions and document what the client needs to go live,
  • Guide client developers through API and mobile Software Development Kit (SDK) integration, including webhooks, authentication and testing,
  • Troubleshoot integration issues by reading logs and diagnosing failures at the API and SDK level, rather than only forwarding them,
  • Maintain a living integration map of the client’s architecture, data flows and dependencies,
  • Own the account from signature to go-live, running the go-live plan and handing a documented account to Customer Success and Support at the end of hypercare.

Advise and Enable

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with business and technical stakeholders, from first conversation to go-live,
  • Represent the client’s technical reality internally, feeding integration blockers, product gaps and pilot learnings back to Product and Sales teams,
  • Work with the internal escalation team on deeper platform issues, arriving with clear technical context,
  • Stand alongside Sales in client meetings, addressing objections on integration effort, feasibility and alternatives,
  • Improve demo environments, architecture templates and integration guides, and mentor team members as the practice grows.

8e15c70579f3.title: Data & People analytics Intern - January 2027
8e15c70579f3.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our People team at Mirakl, a global team of around 30 people covering the full employee lifecycle across all of our offices worldwide. Together, you'll be contributing to building an exceptional employee experience and shaping the future of how Mirakl grows, learns, and develops its talent.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Coordinate learning events — Organise Manager Days, hackathons, bootcamps, lunch & learns and show-and-tell sessions, owning logistics, invitations, materials and post-event follow-up from start to finish.
  • Track participation and feedback — Manage attendance, collect feedback and synthesise key learnings and improvement opportunities to continuously raise the bar on our learning programmes.
  • Curate learning content — Audit and structure existing AI, enablement and learning resources into clear, audience-specific learning paths that make it easy for every Miraklian to grow.
  • Create practical resources — Develop guides, FAQs, checklists and quick-reference materials that support learning adoption and make knowledge accessible across the organisation.
  • Support AI fluency initiatives — Gather and document AI use cases, design surveys and knowledge checks, and organise assessment data to help the People team make informed decisions.
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's level degree in HR, from a business school or university
  • Experience in HR or learning is a plus, but not a prerequisite. Hybrid profiles combining analytical skills and project management are welcome.
  • Comfortable organising events and facilitating sessions, in connection with the projects mentioned.
  • Availability for a 6-month internship starting in January 2027 is required.

64c85d4fea7b.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
64c85d4fea7b.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. Your team You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about. Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses. Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access. The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly. Your mission As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale. What you will do Publisher integrations Build and improve publisher integrations end-to-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers. Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory. Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend. Deals & catalog Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API. Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe. Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it. Supply tooling & publisher platform Build real-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend. Build publisher-facing features: reporting, insights, and self-serve catalog tools. What we're looking for 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production. Strong programming skills (Go, Python and/or Rust), with real engineering discipline: testing, code review, CI/CD, maintainable design. Hands-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in your day-to-day engineering workflow. Experience integrating with external partners' systems and APIs, and owning those integrations when they break. Comfortable owning services from code to production: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and the observability to know your systems are healthy. Product sense: you like talking to the people who use what you build, and you turn ambiguous business needs into concrete deliverables. Excellent communication in English, with internal teams and with partners' technical contacts. Pragmatism over purity: a bias toward shipping value. Nice to have Experience in AdTech or programmatic: OpenRTB, SSPs, PMP / PG deals, VAST. Knowledge of the CTV ecosystem (publishers, apps, FAST channels). Experience with identity solutions (UID2 or similar). Experience building partner-facing or B2B dashboards and reporting. Our Values At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. What We Offer The base pay range for this role in Paris is €90,000 – €125,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. The base pay range for this role in New York is $140,000 – $200,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up: Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! Health ins

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide. We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios. We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them. If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you. What You'll Build As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle. You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate. Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting. Build Products End-to-End Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production. Create Intuitive User Experiences Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently. Create Powerful Automations Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements. Develop AI-Powered Features Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently. Connect the Ecosystem Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem. Solve Real Operational Problems Build solutions for: Real-time reservation and availability synchronization Dynamic pricing intelligence Smart lock access and key management Automated guest communication across channels Guest check-in and upsell journeys Operational forecasting Cleaning and maintenance automation Owner reporting and financial workflows AI-powered monitoring and alerts Measure and Improve Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes. Build for Scale Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform. Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren engineers binnen projecten en helpt hen zich inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen. Je signaleert kansen binnen projecten, denkt mee over aanvullende dienstverlening en levert waar nodig een bijdrage aan offertes en klantgesprekken. Je volgt ontwikkelingen en innovaties binnen het vakgebied en deelt jouw kennis actief met collega’s. Het team Je komt te werken in een hecht team van jong tot oud. Met jouw ervaring help je niet alleen projecten verder, maar draag je ook bij aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team Dit ben jij Je bent een ervaren engineer die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische en oplossingsgerichte instelling. Kun je technische vraagstukken vanuit een integraal perspectief bekijken en begrijp je de afhankelijkheden tussen verschillende disciplines. Ben je gewend om met opdrachtgevers, ontwerpteams en externe partijen te overleggen en kun je jouw technische keuzes overtuigend onderbouwen. Neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit, voortgang en het resultaat van jouw werkzaamheden. Vind je het leuk om jouw kennis te delen en minder ervaren collega’s inhoudelijk te begeleiden. Ben je analytisch, kwaliteitsgericht, resultaatgericht en werk je graag samen. Heb je een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Een goede beheersing van het Engels is eveneens belangrijk. Dit bieden wij Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.192 en € 5.891 (op basis van 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en expertise. Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. Over Deerns Deerns is als onafhanke

81573c6a3791.title: Staff Engineer - Fintech
81573c6a3791.description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You will own the agents, skills and standards that let a tribe of product builders move quickly on payments without the architecture fragmenting. Hotels take payments across regions and through providers that each behave differently, and Payment Interfaces exists to give customers one coherent payment experience on top of several PSPs. Embedded payments at this depth is rare among European SaaS companies, so the problems here are ones few engineers get to work on.

You will be a Staff Engineer in the Payment Interfaces team, part of the Fintech tribe. You will report to the Director of Product and Engineering, sit in the tribe’s leadership group, and work alongside product builders, other staff engineers and product managers. No one reports to you, so your influence comes from the architecture, tools and standards that other people choose to work in.

The team integrates several PSPs depending on region and conditions. When integrations drift apart, builders slow down and quality suffers. This role exists to keep them coherent by encoding what good looks like into tools and agents, so every builder meets the standard by default.

What you would do 

  • Own the tribe’s engineering agents, skills and context, and encode architectural standards, review logic and quality gates into them so the standard is met by default.
  • Build an AI first responder for customer tickets about payment issues, with clear rules for when it answers and when it hands over to a person.
  • Stay hands-on for the hardest technical problems: migrations, system-wide refactors and long-lived architecture decisions across PSP integrations.
  • Keep Payment Interfaces integrations coherent as PSPs and regional requirements change, collaborating with builders who own their own work.
  • Coach builders and fix off-standard outcomes at the cause, so the lesson sticks.

AI Fluency Level 4: in this role, that means you build the AI systems the tribe works in, not only use them. You design the agents, skills and evaluations that builders rely on every day, make the engineering decisions about how they behave, and set the rules for when an AI answer can stand and when a person must step in.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to “AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates” on Confluence.

What you would bring 

  • Hands-on experience integrating with payment service providers or payment processors.
  • Deep engineering craft and architectural judgment, including a sense of what is worth codifying and what is a one-off.
  • AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you have built agents, skills, evaluations or tooling that other engineers use, and you can explain where human oversight stays non-negotiable.
  • A systems mindset that turns hard-won knowledge into reusable architecture and tooling rather than documentation.
  • Comfort with influence as your main way of getting things done, working with builders, product managers, principals and senior leaders without anyone reporting to you.

Nice to have 

  • Experience in hospitality, travel or another operationally complex B2B SaaS environment.
  • Experience publishing or speaking externally about your work.
  • A track record of coaching other engineers and multiplying their effectiveness.

1b4b9531c46b.title: Backend Developer (Python, Java)
1b4b9531c46b.description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we've been building that knowledge for over 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we're also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax advisors don't just get an answer, but an answer they're willing to attach their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it daily, generating over 100 million euros in ARR across Europe. We're looking for a Medior Backend Developer to help build that. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD Lawyers and tax advisors ask a question in GenIA-L and get a reliable answer. That answer is what they see. What you build is everything needed to make it happen: the backend. These are the systems and connections that keep our AI product fast, secure and reliable. You join the AI team and work with our AI engineers every day. They make the product smart; you make sure that intelligence actually reaches the user. After six months, you know the code well and have shipped several new features. After that, you choose the direction you want to grow in: more towards AI, for example by improving the quality of our AI answers, or more towards DevOps, for example by improving how we automatically test and release software. You build and maintain the backend of our main AI product, together with our AI engineers. You build APIs and services: the connections that let the different parts of the platform talk to each other. You keep an eye on code quality and make sure we follow good practices and standards. You monitor and maintain our live applications and fix problems when something goes wrong. You bring your own ideas on how to improve the product and the way we work. You are proactive, enthusiastic, and take initiative. You communicate clearly and confidently, conveying information in a concise and engaging manner. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You pick up your work independently. You don’t need much guidance, but you know when to involve a colleague. You have opinions and you are not afraid to share them. And you enjoy working with AI specialists on a product that is still very much in development. At least 3 years of experience building Python applications that run in production and are actually used by customers. Experience with FastAPI and Pydantic. Experience with LangChain or LangGraph is a plus. You have built production-grade APIs that work reliably for real users. You work independently within a team and don’t need hand-holding. Knowledge of Postgres, GraphQL or MongoDB is a plus. Some DevOps knowledge is nice to have, for example working with GitHub Actions and Helm. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR You join the AI team with one other backend engineer, three AI engineers and a Product Owner. You also work closely with the search team, the frontend team and our backend and AI leads. You report to our Lead Backend Engineer. You get a lot of freedom and room for your own opinions and ideas, in a fun team with a good work-life balance. And you can grow into a Senior or Lead Backend Engineer role. A monthly base salary up to €5500 and a standard 36-hour working week. An end-of-year bonus of 4% of your gross annual salary and a variable profit share of up to 6% of your gross annual salary. 23 holidays and a 12% personal benefits budget, of which 8% is holiday allowance and 4% you can spend freely, for example on extra days off. A good pension plan through PGB, including additional partner insurance. A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometre or a public transport allowance, plus an attractive bike scheme. For employees who travel less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement. Hybrid working: two days a week at our office in The Hague, on Tuesday and Thursday. Room to grow. In your field, in your role, in the organisation. WANT TO KNOW MORE? We'd love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within a few business days. Have a few questions first? Message or call Nadine at 0628556265. A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process. 132f85d4d063.title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
132f85d4d063.description: De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen. Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector. De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht. Dit ga je doen: Samenwerken met toezichthouders om risico’s voor consumenten tijdig te signaleren. Ontwikkelen van dataproducten die inzichten vertalen naar gerichte acties. Implementeren van betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen voor effectiever toezicht. Visualiseren van resultaten in dashboards die toezichthouders ondersteunen. Kansen signaleren om processen slimmer in te richten en repetitief werk te automatiseren. Experimenteren met nieuwe technieken zoals AI om toezicht slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken. Team Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR. Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. Ook kijkt het team naar risico’s van nieuwe technologie in de financiële sector. Zo spelen we een belangrijke rol in het tijdig herkennen van risico’s. De deadline voor deze vacature is 25 november 2026. Dit vragen we: ⭐ Een afgeronde WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Business Analytics, Wiskunde, Econometrie, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare (bèta) studie met een sterke analytische of statistische component. ⭐ Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring en kennis van het data/science werkveld en de daarbij behorende tools en technieken. Hierbij is ervaring met Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Python, Azure Data Bricks een vereiste. ⭐Kennis van softwareontwikkeling, versiebeheer, codereview en unit testing is vereist. ⭐ Analytisch sterk: het vermogen om complexe datasets te analyseren, patronen te herkennen en inzichten te genereren. Je neemt informatie niet zonder meer aan, toetst aannames en identificeert risico’s, afwijkingen en mogelijke blinde vlekken. ⭐ Proactieve houding: je werkt graag samen en draagt bij aan het gezamenlijke succes, tegelijkertijd kan je zelfstandig knopen doorhakken en analyses omzetten in concrete en bruikbare uitkomsten. ⭐ Communicatieve vaardigheden: je kunt complexe technische informatie helder en beknopt overbrengen aan niet of minder-technische collega’s. Ervaring met datavisualisatie om gegevens begrijpelijk en toegankelijk te presenteren voor verschillende belanghebbenden. Please note: excellent proficiency in Dutch, both verbal and written, is required for this position. Wat wij bieden: 📄 Je start met een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband 💰 Afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring word je ingeschaald in schaal F (junior, met een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €52.500 en €87.000) of schaal G (medior, met een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €62.000 en €103.500). Bedragen zijn op basis van een 36-urige werkweek, inclusief 13e maand en vakantiegeld ⏰ 36-urige werkweek, werkdagen in overleg (bijv. 4x9) 🌴 199,5 vakantie-uren per jaar (bovenop je standaard roostervrije dag) 💻 Een laptop en een smartphone 📚 Uitgebreide trainings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden 🚆 Volledige vergoeding van OV-reiskosten (2e klas) 🏡 Thuiswerkvergoeding voor thuiswerkdagen 💪 Bijdrage aan een sportschoolabonnement 🚲 Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een fiets- en deviceregeling en vergoeding voor je thuiswerkplek Meer informatie? 02e98ebb48bd.title: Senior Fullstack Developer .NET
02e98ebb48bd.description: Bij OrtaX, onderdeel van Centric, werk je aan software die gemeenten ondersteunt bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. Onze ambitie gaat verder dan het onderhouden van bestaande software. We ontwikkelen OrtaX continu door en investeren daarbij in nieuwe technologie, data, automatisering en een toekomstbestendige architectuur. Als Senior Fullstack Developer speel je daarin een belangrijke rol. Je beweegt je vanzelfsprekend tussen frontend en backend, bouwt zelf mee aan nieuwe functionaliteit en helpt tegelijkertijd onze applicatie stap voor stap te moderniseren. Daarbij kijken we nadrukkelijk naar jou om technische richting en structuur te helpen aanbrengen . Niet door keuzes alleen te maken, maar juist door technische vraagstukken scherp te krijgen, verschillende perspectieven bij elkaar te brengen en samen met het team tot goede, gedragen oplossingen te komen. 1. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Fullstack Developer werk je samen met developers, analisten en andere specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van OrtaX. Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor je eigen code, maar kijkt ook naar de samenhang en kwaliteit van de oplossing als geheel. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: ontwikkelen van nieuwe backendfunctionaliteit in C#/.NET ; ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van frontendfunctionaliteit met één van de grote frontend frameworks ontwerpen en verbeteren van API's, integraties en dataoplossingen; maken van technische ontwerpen die frontend, backend en data met elkaar verbinden; schrijven en stimuleren van onderhoudbare, testbare en kwalitatief goede code; bijdragen aan CI/CD, automated testing en DevOps ; analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en deze vertalen naar pragmatische oplossingen; aanbrengen van technische structuur en bewaken van samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie; richting geven aan architectuur- en ontwerpkeuzes en inzichtelijk maken van de consequenties van verschillende opties; begeleiden van technische discussies en ervoor zorgen dat kennis en ideeën van andere teamleden worden meegenomen; ondersteunen van collega-developers bij complexe technische vraagstukken; herkennen en bespreekbaar maken van technische schuld, risico's en mogelijkheden voor verbetering; stap voor stap moderniseren van bestaande onderdelen van OrtaX. Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen . Als senior developer help je het team om die afweging bewust te maken. Soms betekent dat investeren in een structurele technische verbetering, soms juist kiezen voor een pragmatische oplossing die past bij de situatie. 2. De technische uitdaging OrtaX heeft een bestaand softwarelandschap én een duidelijke moderniseringsopgave. Daardoor werk je niet alleen aan de vraag: “Hoe bouwen we deze feature?” maar juist ook aan vragen als: “Hoe past deze oplossing in de rest van onze architectuur?” “Welke keuze helpt ons niet alleen vandaag, maar ook over een paar jaar?” “Hoe voorkomen we dat verschillende onderdelen van de applicatie ieder hun eigen richting opgaan?” En misschien nog belangrijker: “Hoe komen we als team tot een technische keuze waar verschillende inzichten goed in zijn meegenomen?” Als Senior Fullstack Developer neem je hierin het voortouw. Je kunt een technisch vraagstuk structureren, alternatieven onderzoeken en een richting voorstellen. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat de beste technische oplossing zelden door één persoon wordt bedacht. Je zoekt actief de discussie met andere developers, luistert naar argumenten en gebruikt de expertise binnen het team om de uiteindelijke oplossing beter te maken. Bij OrtaX gebruiken we AI als een belangrijk hulpmiddel bij het ontwikkelproces. Daarbij geloven wij ook dat de developer verantwoordelijk is dat we goede code en een duidelijke architectuur opleveren. Ook op lange termijn willen we beschikken over een goed onderhoudbaar product. Daarbij is AI inmiddels een essentieel hulpmiddel, maar niet zonder input van de developer. Technisch leiderschap betekent bij ons dus niet bepalen wat anderen moeten bouwen, maar richting geven, structuur aanbrengen en het team helpen betere technische keuzes te maken. 3. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken een ervaren developer die zich daadwerkelijk thuis voelt aan beide kanten van de stack . Voor deze seniorrol zoeken we dus niet naar een backenddeveloper die af en toe frontendwerk doet, of andersom. Je hoeft niet overal dezelfde diepgang te hebben, maar je bent in staat om zelfstandig aan zowel frontend als backend te werken en kunt technische vraagstukken over de volledige keten overzien. Je: hebt een hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau op het gebied van Software Engineering, Informatica, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting; hebt ruime professionele ervaring met C# en .NET ; hebt ruime ervaring met moderne frontendontwikkeling en kunt zelfstandig werken met één van de grote frontend frameworks hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van API's en integraties; hebt gedegen kennis van databases en begrijpt hoe keuzes in de datalaag doorwerken naar backend en frontend; kunt technische oplossingen ontwerpen over meerdere lagen van een applicatie; hebt een goed begrip van softwarearchitectuur en kunt architectuurprincipes toepassen zonder de pragmatiek uit het oog te verliezen; hebt oog voor aspecten als onderhoudbaarheid, testbaarheid, performance, security en technische schuld; bent gewend te werken met CI/CD, automated testing en een Agile/Scrum-werkwijze; kunt complexe technische vraagstukken structureren en terugbrengen tot heldere keuzes; durft besluiten te nemen wanneer dat nodig is en kunt duidelijk uitleggen waarom een bepaalde richting wordt gekozen; staat tegelijkertijd open voor andere inzichten en bent bereid je eigen oplossing ter discussie te stellen; helpt minder ervaren developers groeien door kennis te delen, feedback te geven en samen naar oplo

Als Fullstack Developer speel je daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt aan zowel de frontend als backend van OrtaX, bouwt nieuwe functionaliteit en helpt tegelijkertijd de bestaande applicatie stap voor stap te moderniseren. 1. Wat ga je doen? Als Fullstack Developer werk je samen met developers, analisten en andere specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van OrtaX.Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteit in C#/.NET ; ontwikkelen van moderne gebruikersinterfaces en webfunctionaliteit; werken aan frontendfunctionaliteit met met één van de grote frontend frameworks; ontwerpen en verbeteren van API's en integraties; werken met databases en data-intensieve functionaliteit; schrijven van onderhoudbare, testbare en kwalitatief goede code; bijdragen aan CI/CD, automated testing en DevOps ; oplossen van technische vraagstukken die frontend, backend en data met elkaar verbinden; meedenken over architectuur en technische keuzes; stap voor stap moderniseren van bestaande onderdelen van OrtaX. Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen . 2. De technische uitdaging OrtaX heeft een bestaand softwarelandschap én een duidelijke moderniseringsopgave. Binnen het ontwikkelproces worden onder andere Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, pipelines, testing, SonarQube en Oracle gebruikt. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen bezig bent met: “Hoe bouw ik deze feature?” maar ook met vragen als: “Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat wat we vandaag bouwen ook past bij waar we technisch naartoe willen?” Voor een developer die graag verder kijkt dan alleen zijn of haar eigen user story is hier dus veel te doen. Bij OrtaX gebruiken we AI als een belangrijk hulpmiddel bij het ontwikkelproces. Daarbij geloven wij ook dat de developer verantwoordelijk is dat we goede code en een duidelijke architectuur opleveren. Ook op lange termijn willen we beschikken over een goed onderhoudbaar product. Daarbij is AI inmiddels een essentieel hulpmiddel, maar niet zonder input van de developer. 3. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken vooral een developer die nieuwsgierig is en zich prettig voelt aan meerdere kanten van de applicatie. Je: hebt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Software Engineering, Informatica, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting; hebt ervaring met C# en .NET ; hebt ervaring met, of interesse in, moderne frontendontwikkeling; hebt bij voorkeur gewerkt met één van de grote frontend frameworks; begrijpt principes rondom API's, databases en softwarearchitectuur; schrijft graag code die niet alleen werkt, maar ook begrijpelijk en onderhoudbaar is; bent gewend om samen te werken in een Agile/Scrum-omgeving; denkt analytisch en vindt het leuk om complexe problemen terug te brengen tot een pragmatische oplossing; durft bestaande oplossingen ter discussie te stellen, maar begrijpt ook dat software stap voor stap moet kunnen veranderen; communiceert makkelijk met developers, analisten en andere collega's. 3393af2f79fa.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Buyer
3393af2f79fa.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalogue consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

The CVP team owns the core platform and services that govern how content is geofenced, balanced, and surfaced across Vinted's growing international network of markets. We build robust systems and tooling that manage cross-border visibility, enabling smooth and gradual market connections (e.g., FR-DE, BE-FR-ES) while optimising key liquidity metrics like Sell-Through Rate (STR%) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) by balancing the content in multiple channels.

Our team works closely with Content Visibility Management, Search, and Recommender relevance teams to accelerate product development. Currently, we are driving the automation of content visibility experimentation & analysis. Rather than having different content channels independently re-implement visibility controls, we are building a unified platform to provide autonomy to Decision Scientists. In addition, we are highly contributing in growing new large markets such as the USA and Australia.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive technical execution: Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems to ensure efficient content visibility and search mechanisms.
  • Guide technical decisions: Contribute to and challenge the technical direction of our backend services, leading system design reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code.
  • Scale features globally: Implement and shape A/B tested features that positively impact our 80+ million users. Code changes are rolled out instantly to production.
  • Own your services: Monitor and improve backend service performance and stability. The team owns and monitors service-layer measurements (SLIs, SLOs, etc.) and has an on-call rotation which you will participate in.
  • Lead team-level initiatives: Lead and drive technical initiatives within the team, while collaborating on domain-wide integrations with other engineering teams (such as Search and Recommender relevance teams).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with engineering and product managers, analysts, and other stakeholders, facilitating clear communication within the team and across domains.
  • Contribute to product direction: Provide technical feasibility assessments, identify technical risks, and provide effort estimations to help shape our team's product roadmap.
  • Foster engineering excellence: Mentor, guide, and share knowledge with other engineers in the team to support their technical growth and promote collaborative best practices

About you 

  • You have extensive experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, distributed, and highly available systems.
  • You are highly proficient in backend development. We primarily use Go, Kotlin, Ruby, Python — while prior experience in these specific languages is beneficial, a strong foundation in modern backend engineering and a willingness to learn is what matters most.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka, Apache Flink, or others for real-time data processing and message queueing.
  • A track record working with search engines, information retrieval and ranking optimisations technologies (e.g., Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a high advantage. If not, we expect you to have a strong willingness and motivation to learn.

c3d9f4834111.title: Applied Scientist, Product Policy Research & Measurement
c3d9f4834111.description:
About the Team

The Product Policy team develops and implements policies that shape how OpenAI’s technology is built and used. We work with teams across the company to turn complex questions about AI’s benefits and risks into practical guidance for responsible research, product development, and deployment.



About the Role

We are hiring a senior applied scientist to study how AI affects people and society using OpenAI production data, experiments, and social science methods. This role sits at the intersection of applied social science, AI, and product policy. The scientist will own research from an ambiguous question through study design, data collection and analysis, methodological validation, and recommendations. Their work will inform product and policy decisions and, where appropriate, contribute to external publications. We are looking for a hands-on empirical social scientist with exceptional methodological judgment.



In this role, you will:

 - Develop and execute a research agenda on AI’s social impact, including effects on well-being, learning, social connection, trust, and human decision-making, in partnership with product and policy teams.

 - Own empirical studies end to end: define the question and estimand, choose the design, build the dataset, conduct the analysis, and explain what the evidence supports.

 - Analyze large-scale production and behavioral data, linking them to experiments, surveys, or external outcomes when appropriate to measure real-world effects.

 - Design randomized experiments and credible observational studies; test identification assumptions, quantify uncertainty, and distinguish association from causal effects.

 - Develop and validate measures of social outcomes, including human and LLM-assisted annotations; assess measurement error, subgroup performance, and drift.

 - Translate findings into concrete product and policy recommendations, with clear limits on causal interpretation, generalizability, and decision confidence.

 - Partner with Product Policy, Research, Product, Data Science, Engineering, UXR, Legal, and domain experts; contribute rigorous work to external publications when appropriate.



You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A PhD or equivalent research experience in sociology, political science, psychology, communication, computational social science, or a related empirical field, with demonstrated independent research ownership.

 - Deep expertise in research design, causal inference, experimentation, statistical analysis, and measurement, demonstrated through work you can personally explain and defend.

 - Strong SQL and Python or R skills, with experience independently constructing and analyzing complex behavioral datasets and producing reproducible research.

 - A record of research that informs consequential decisions about technology and people, with the judgment to identify both useful findings and unresolved uncertainty.

 - Clear writing for technical and policy audiences, and experience producing rigorous research papers or equivalent public technical work.

 - The ability to move quickly, collaborate across functions, and maintain scientific independence when findings are sensitive or inconvenient.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. 9a15704b3523.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic exists to ensure the world safely navigates the transition through transformative AI. That work is funded by commercial revenue — and every dollar of it runs through Billing Platform. We build and operate the infrastructure that turns product usage into revenue across everything Anthropic ships: Claude.ai, the Developer Platform, Claude Code, and all that comes next. The faster we can price it, charge for it, and account for it correctly, the faster Anthropic can fund the mission. Pricing Foundations is the team within Billing that turns a signed enterprise agreement into something every system can act on. 0572730c9daa.title: Software Engineer, Data
0572730c9daa.description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship.

About the Role

As a member of the Data team, you will help build the services, infrastructure, and data platforms that power our business. Our team is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and distributing large volumes of data reliably and efficiently, enabling teams across the business to make data-driven decisions and build innovative products.  

This role sits at the intersection of backend software engineering and data engineering, with an emphasis on data engineering. You will build and maintain data pipelines, develop backend services for data ingestion and access, and contribute to the data infrastructure that enables reliable, cost-effective, and high-performance data processing. 

You'll work closely with software engineers, DevOps engineers, product managers, data consumers, and more experienced colleagues, who will provide guidance, code reviews, and support as you grow. While the role involves technical collaboration across the organization, it is primarily focused on engineering rather than stakeholder management. 

We are a trading company, so business requirements change quickly, and priorities can shift. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, takes ownership of their work, is eager to learn, and makes pragmatic engineering decisions in a dynamic environment. 

Responsibilities 

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and ingestion workflows for structured and unstructured data from a variety of internal and external sources, including fetching data from external providers.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and APIs (e.g., FastAPI) that support data ingestion, processing, and distribution, including asynchronous ingestion at scale.

888bc62d1367.title: Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy
888bc62d1367.description:
Who/What is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will sit at the center of this mission. You won't just deliver static slides; you will bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives, guiding clients from a focused short-term engagement with Mittelstand manufacturers to multi-phase AI transformations with enterprises. In this role, you will take ownership of cross-functional workstreams, drive data-driven decision-making, and actively shape the digital future of our clients.

 

What you will do:

  • Client advisory & strategy: Work closely with (international) clients to understand their business needs and translate them into data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making and business transformation.
  • Data & analysis: Collect, synthesise and iterate data to create actionable insights. You work with a modern, AI-native toolstack - from LLM-powered environments (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and agentic workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Lovable) to coding assistants and automation platforms - and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with SQL or Python remains a plus, but the ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery is what we value most.
  • Project delivery: Take ownership of project workstreams and ensure high-quality, timely delivery in alignment with overall project goals. Work collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams across consulting, data, and tech functions.
  • Data & AI solutions: Support the development of data strategies, AI use cases, and business intelligence solutions, contributing to governance frameworks and implementation roadmaps where relevant.
  • Knowledge sharing & collaboration: Contribute to a strong team culture by sharing knowledge, staying up to date with digital and AI trends, and supporting continuous team development.
  • Business development & thought leadership: Actively contribute to Artefact’s growth in Germany - supporting client proposals, shaping new service offerings, and creating intellectual capital such as frameworks, point-of-views, and benchmarks that strengthen our market position.

 

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. 

  • Experience: You have at least 2–3 years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or in-house corporate strategy roles, with a proven track record of participating in data/AI strategy, cloud transformation, or applied AI/Machine Learning projects.
  • Education: A completed university degree (Bachelor’s or Master's) in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.
  • Data & AI Fluency: You possess a strong affinity for data management and modern AI technologies. You are familiar with concepts like Generative AI, LLMs, or predictive analytics and are eager to bridge the gap between business needs and AI deployment. Ideally, you have hands-on experience in AI use case conceptualization or data platform tracking.
  • Business & analytical mindset: You combine strong analytical skills with a business-oriented perspective. You enjoy identifying business problems and translating them into practical AI and data-driven solutions.
  • Technical skills: You are confident working with PowerPoint and Google Slides to produce polished client-ready output. More importantly, you know how to leverage AI tools - from LLM environments to agentic workflows - to run analysis, generate insights, and accelerate delivery. Experience with SQL, BI tools, or programming languages is not a requirement, but comfort with structured data and a hands-on attitude toward new tools is expected.
  • Communication & collaboration: You communicate complex technical topics clearly in both German and English. You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating across different levels and functions (e.g., translating requirements between business stakeholders and data scientists).
  • Personal attributes: You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a strong client focus and stakeholder understanding. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving complex problems.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German and English are required - you will participate in client workshops, present to senior stakeholders, and write deliverables in both languages. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

 

Why ARTEFACT?

2a9da794f880.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Site Reliability Engineer

As a part of Sony Computer Entertainment, the Gaming, Developer & Future Technology Group (GDFT) is leading the cloud gaming revolution, putting console-quality video games on any device, from TVs to consoles to mobile devices and beyond.

Our Site Reliability Engineering team plays a significant role in delivering on the promise of a great cloud gaming experience to our customers. We do this by influencing design and operational decisions towards the overall stability of the gaming service. Our SREs focus on three main things: overall ownership of production, production code quality, and deployments. The successful candidate will be self-directed and able to participate in the way we make decisions at different levels.

We expect our SREs to have opinions on the state of our service and provide critical feedback during different phases of the operational lifecycle. We are engaged throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring the operational readiness and stability.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead team technical discussions, especially around ongoing improvements in Reliability and Scalability
  • Be involved in creating High Level Designs (HLDs) for new products and platforms
  • Mentor junior SRE staff and enable them for success
  • Lead incident response and post-mortem activities within your assigned service team
  • Work with other Engineers in a cross-functional team to prioritise reliability improvements to address technical debt and toil
  • Contribute to code to improve reliability
  • Implement automation to reduce ongoing toil

What we're looking for:

  • Minimum of 5+ years working experience in Software Development and/or Linux Systems Administration role.
  • Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Available to be scheduled in on-call rotation.

Skills & Knowledge:

  • Proficient as a Linux Production Systems Engineer, with experience managing large scale Web Services infrastructure.
  • Development experience in one or more of the following programming languages:
  • Python (preferred)
  • Bash, Go, Java, C++, or Rust
  • In addition, experience with at least 3 of the following topics:
  • Distributed data storage at scale (Hadoop, Ceph)
  • NoSQL at scale (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra)
  • Data Aggregation technologies. (ElasticSearch, Kafka)
  • Scaling and running traditional RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL) with High Availability
  • Monitoring & Alerting (Prometheus, Grafana), and Incident Management toolsets
  • Kubernetes and/or AWS (deployment and management)
  • Software Distribution (Package management and distribution at scale)
  • Configuration Management (ansible, saltstack, puppet, chef)
  • S/W Performance analysis and load testing (QA or SDET experience: a plus)

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.

We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond. 

Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.

e24946b5d247.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. YOUR IMPACT As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, analysis, validation and realisation of Proxima’s Alpha stellarator fusion machine. Your innovative and detailed engineering work will deliver robust mechanical, structural, and thermal performance of critical systems, tooling and manufacturing processes. You will also work with external collaborators and suppliers to develop the designs, equipment, systems and materials that will enable Proxima’s mission to deliver clean, sustainable fusion energy. WHAT YOU WILL DO Develop innovative solutions and detailed mechanical designs for significant systems within the Alpha stellarator, ensuring integration with the broader physics, mechanical and structural systems. Carry out thermal and structural analysis and assessment of mechanical designs, providing design input and implementing recommended design improvements. Conduct technology trade-offs, materials selections and feasibility studies to facilitate the successful identification of the Alpha net energy stellarator. Design, deliver, and support the prototyping and verification of the components, materials, assemblies and manufacturing processes selected for Alpha. Work with external suppliers and collaborators to assist and guide the development and manufacture of the components and systems that will come together to demonstrate the net energy Alpha stellarator. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR High performers with excellent communication and problem-solving skills who love challenges and are not afraid to experiment, take risks, and learn from mistakes. Experience in designing and analysing mechanical components and assemblies, with proficiency in CAD (experience with 3DExperience/CATIA v6 and ANSYS is highly beneficial, but not essential). Experience in designing and delivering the conceptual and detailed design of mechanical, structural, thermal or electro-mechanical equipment, particularly for use in research, development, prototyping and manufacturing. Knowledge and experience of designing and selecting materials for some or all of the following engineering applications: high temperature, cryogenic, electromagnetic, vacuum. Demonstrated ability to work with and manage external suppliers, with multidisciplinary technical teams in fast-paced, dynamic settings. Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not essential. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-45 min) Portfolio Presentation & Review (45-60 min) Technical Panel Interviews (2x60 min) CEO call (30 min) Successful applicants will be assigned to one of the Engineering teams within Proxima, depending on their specific skills, location, and the needs of the organisation. 60f3303d2b67.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
60f3303d2b67.description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. How we work We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work. We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart. We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move. A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. This is a senior role with real influence. You’ll own the enterprise backup and recovery platform across all regions. You’ll set the standards for how data is protected, retained and restored, and you’ll show, with evidence, that recovery targets are met. Lead the engineering, administration and continuous improvement of an enterprise Rubrik environment. Design and enforce global protection policies, including SLA tiers, retention, archiving, replication, immutability, encryption and access controls. Turn requirements into protection. Convert business, regulatory, contractual and risk needs into clear protection tiers, RPO and RTO targets, and practical operating procedures. Keep coverage complete. Bring new workloads into the service and keep protection accurate across on-premises, cloud, virtualised, database and application environments. Keep operations healthy. This work will also involve extensive consultation and collaboration with external experts. It is expected that additional opportunities will arise to lead bench-to-bedside early phase clinical development programs.

The Executive Director, Clinical Research, will work in a matrix organization across Regulatory, Biostatistics, Clinical Operations, Preclinical, Commercial & QA teams to ensure fully harmonized and integrated development strategies. They will be a key Alnylam Development spokesperson at external meetings, including regulatory interactions and scientific meetings.

This position is hybrid, requiring weekly onsite presence and will be primarily located at our Cambridge, MA headquarters or Maidenhead, UK location. Relocation may be possible for the selected candidate.

  • Be the strategic leader providing a strong, clear voice for the clinical programs
  • Develop creative but realistic approaches to drug development and lead clinical efforts to secure global regulatory approvals

  • Provide strategic consultation and guidance to Research on all decisions that have significant clinical components and implications. 
  • Collaborate closely with Preclinical, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs and Commercial to ensure tight strategic integration of product development plans
  • Be accountable via Clinical Research and Operations for all relevant timelines and deliverables
  • Drive/supervise all major written deliverables (regulatory submissions, original articles, abstracts), and presentation materials
  • Be responsible (as appropriate in line with SOPs) for final review and sign off with respect to all controlled documents including protocols, IBs, informed consent forms
  • Influence internal and external audiences in a high impact, highly visible fashion

Qualifications
