0dd4036475aa.title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
0dd4036475aa.description: About machineMD At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere. We’re building neurodiagnostics for the next generation with our neos™ device and oculometrics software. As our Software Test Engineer, you’ll have room to make a visible difference in how we test. Find a gap, develop an approach, and put it to work, whether that means automating a manual check, building better test data, or connecting tests across the system. You’ll develop our test automation with support from developers, requirements engineers, and testers. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test. The Role You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. Your main contribution will be developing automated tests, test data, and scripts that make complex scenarios repeatable and problems easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers. Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice. Automation Across the System – develop automated tests for complex, distributed systems across different frameworks and technologies, covering multiple components, interfaces, and end-to-end scenarios beyond UI testing. Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others. Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time. Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment. What We Look For Experience Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend. Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task. Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code. Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus. Qualifications Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage. Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field. Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration. How You Work Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. you choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop. Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found. Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn, lend a hand. Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives. Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases. Working at machineMD Based in Bern, Switzerland, with roughly 80% of your working time on-site (approximately four days a week at full-time employment) and Monday as our shared anchor day. Collaborative, in-person working, with flexibility to do your best work. Our Four Pillars of Integrity guide how we work together: Radical Responsibility: Own our choices. Feeling Our Feelings: Name and honour our emotions. Candor: Speak and listen with honesty. Clear Agreements: Make and keep clear commitments. Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics in a dynamic startup, let’s talk! How to Apply Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why. 69d89a34eaae.title: Stage Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
69d89a34eaae.description: Wil jij ervaren hoe het is om AI niet alleen technisch te begrijpen, maar ook écht werkend te maken binnen een organisatie? Heb jij interesse in AI, data, technologie én consultancy? Dan is deze stage binnen ons Data & AI-team misschien wel jouw volgende stap! Vanaf februari 2027 zoeken wij een stagiair(e) Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Data Science die gedurende 3 tot 12 maanden meewerkt aan interne AI-initiatieven binnen IG&H. Met deze stage krijg je de kans om jouw technische vaardigheden te combineren met consultancyvaardigheden: van het bouwen of onderzoeken van AI-oplossingen tot het ophalen van behoeften bij stakeholders en het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen onze organisatie. Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze leerzame stage ga je aan de slag met interne AI-oplossingen en innovatieprojecten. Afhankelijk van de behoefte vanuit de business werk je zelfstandig aan projecten binnen het team. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld bijdragen aan: het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van AI-tools die interne processen efficiënter maken; het in kaart brengen van processen binnen interne teams en onderzoeken waar AI kan helpen/ondersteunen; het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen IG&H, bijvoorbeeld door mee te denken over trainingen, communicatie of praktische toepassingen van tools zoals Copilot; het doen van onderzoek naar nieuwe AI-producten, toepassingen of proposities; het vertalen van technische mogelijkheden naar concrete businesswaarde; samenwerken met andere collega’s binnen Data & AI. Over het team Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Ons Data & AI-team bestaat uit ruim 40 data-experts, waaronder Data Scientists, Data Engineers en Consultants. Samen realiseren zij innovatieve data-, analytics- en AI-oplossingen voor klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health. Het team groeit snel en heeft de ambitie om verder uit te bouwen tot een van de meest toonaangevende Data & AI-praktijken van Nederland. Die groei komt voort uit ons succes: klanten kiezen steeds vaker voor IG&H vanwege onze combinatie van strategisch inzicht, technische expertise en pragmatische executie. We werken aan projecten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en nieuwe businessmodellen. Voor professionals die impact willen maken is dit een omgeving waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Hier bouw je niet alleen mee aan de toekomst van onze klanten, maar ook aan de verdere groei van het Data & AI-team zelf. Wat wij verwachten van jou: We zoeken een leergierig en analytisch sterk persoon die energie krijgt van AI, data science en consultancy. Je vindt het leuk om technologie te begrijpen, maar minstens zo belangrijk: je wilt ontdekken hoe je technologie toepasbaar maakt voor mensen en organisaties. Je brengt mee: Je volgt bij voorkeur een masteropleiding in de richting van Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Econometrie, Natuurkunde, Wiskunde, Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische/kwantitatieve studie; Je hebt ervaring met Python; Je vindt het leuk om met stakeholders in gesprek te gaan en behoeften goed uit te vragen; Je kunt technische onderwerpen helder uitleggen aan mensen met verschillende achtergronden; Je bent sociaal, nieuwsgierig en proactief; Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels; Je bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Ervaring met SQL, API’s, Azure of AI-tools zoals Copilot is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Belangrijker vinden we dat je nieuwsgierig bent, snel leert en zin hebt om jezelf inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen. Wat wij jou bieden: Bij IG&H krijg je de kans om in korte tijd veel te leren binnen een ambitieus en betrokken Data & AI-team. Je werkt aan een eigen project, krijgt goede begeleiding en maakt kennis met de praktijk van consultancy en technologie. Verder bieden wij jou: Een stage binnen een Great Place to Work met een prettige sfeer en enthousiaste collega’s; De kans om mee te werken aan concrete AI-initiatieven binnen IG&H; Je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s binnen het Data & AI-team; Begeleiding door een buddy en mentor vanuit de organisatie; Veel ruimte om jouw technische én consultancyvaardigheden te ontwikkelen; Een inspirerend kantoor in Utrecht; De mogelijkheid om na enige tijd in overleg deels thuis te werken; Teamactiviteiten, borrels en een open, ondernemende werksfeer; Een contract van 3 tot 12 maanden en een vergoeding tussen de € 700 en € 900,- bruto per maand. Waarom IG&H? Met meer dan 650 getalenteerde collega’s hebben we een unieke cultuur gecreëerd die zowel high caring als high daring is. We dagen elkaar uit om grenzen te verleggen, maar doen dat altijd vanuit vertrouwen, samenwerking en plezier. Als deze stage bij je past, dan is IG&H een mooie plek om je verder te ontwikkelen. Je krijgt de kans om veel te leren in korte tijd, je eigen ideeën in te brengen en te ontdekken hoe het is om te werken binnen een consultancy- en technologieorganisatie waar AI volop in beweging is. Je werkt direct mee aan onderwerpen die relevant zijn voor de toekomst van IG&H en onze klanten. Ben jij enthousiast geworden over deze stage binnen ons Data & AI-team? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met ons recruitmentteam via We willen dat onze medewerkers een afspiegeling zijn van de diversiteit in de samenleving. We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is trots een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in overweging genomen voor een stage of dienstverband, ongeacht nationaliteit, ras, religie, geslacht, genderidentiteit of -expressie, seksuele geaardheid, genetica, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit, maar het belangrijkste is dat we trots zijn op onze collectieve prestaties en een Great Place to Work. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld

3114343f3ea7.title: Android Developer
3114343f3ea7.description: At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with your future colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare. We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer at Luscii, you will build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible. Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role. The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform. Your role As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps. What you will be doing: Develop and optimise Android applications in Kotlin, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience. Shape mobile architecture and technical solutions, applying sound software design principles and patterns. Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical approaches early. Develop features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. Investigate and resolve production issues, using debugging and performance analysis to keep our apps reliable. Review code, share technical guidelines and collaborate with development, QA and support colleagues. Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and recommend improvements where they add value. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Most important benefits Salary : € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii). Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least five years of experience in Android or mobile development and extensive experience with Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow. You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment. You have experience with clean architecture, software design patterns and approaches such as MVVM or MVI, and you understand how to apply them in maintainable mobile applications. You have experience with Jetpack Compose, mobile unit and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and Android design guidelines. You understand mobile performance and reliability, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation, as well as working with web services, cloud platforms and APIs. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Knowledge of SQL Server relational database design and optimization. Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions). 9b8cac2d4383.title: Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployments (Non-Profits)
9b8cac2d4383.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
9b8cac2d4383.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Beneficial Deployments Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most. About the Role We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping nonprofits and foundations get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for a portfolio of partners, working alongside our Account Executives from first conversation through deployment. You'll help partners find where Claude makes a real difference to their mission and their operations, design solutions that fit their budgets, data and teams, and turn early pilots into lasting adoption. What works for one partner becomes something the whole sector can use. Responsibilities Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of nonprofit partners from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success. Partner with Account Executives on account plans, discovery and technical evaluation. Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API and Claude Code across program delivery, fundraising, operations and data analysis. Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement. Run workshops and trainings that build AI fluency across partner teams. Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next. Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed. Travel to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building. You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering or technical consulting. A track record of getting lean, skeptical or slow-moving teams to adopt technology and keep using it, including working through how they buy and govern it. Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you have built and evaluated working prototypes or agents, and can guide a partner's own engineers on architecture and evals. You don't need to write production code. Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to program leads, operations staff and executives. Patience with long buying cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit. A track record of agency and autonomy: you spot what needs doing before anyone asks, agree that it matters, drive it to a finished result and know when to pull others in. Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission. Bonus if you've worked in a sales team, or with or at nonprofits, foundations or other mission-driven organizations. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $240,000 — $315,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. 11ec1d3bea69.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
11ec1d3bea69.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. About the role As Platform Docs Lead at Anthropic, you will be the single-threaded owner of developer documentation for the Claude Platform. You'll own the information architecture, the content, and the overall experience of platform.claude.com/docs — from a developer's first quickstart to the reference page they keep open in a pinned tab. This role sits on the DevX team and is closer to DevRel than to traditional technical writing. The job is taste, judgment, and end-to-end developer empathy in addition to strong writing skills: you'll be expected to build with the Claude API yourself, understand the product firsthand, and turn that understanding into documentation developers genuinely love. You'll also own documentation written for AI agents and contribute to the skill that teaches Claude how to help developers use the Claude API. a3e42e5145da.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data. When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human . This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design. The work combines research and production engineering: The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers . The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints. Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work. Key responsibilities Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals Deploy, tune and operate these classifiers in the critical path of internal agents, RL training, and evaluations, and own their accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and failure behaviour Build the datasets, labelling pipelines, and evaluations that allow us to measure and improve our classifiers and harm taxonomies Partner with red teaming colleagues to stress-test our classifiers, and harden them against what they find Work with the teams whose agents, environments, and evaluations we run on, so that false positives get fixed quickly without weakening protection Contribute to the team's The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. a9d218e7d8be.title: Member of Technical Staff (Index Engineer, Search Crawler)
a9d218e7d8be.description:
AI answers are only as trustworthy as the information behind them. Perplexity grounds its answers in fresh, real-world sources, and the index is what makes that possible. We're looking for an engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of Perplexity's Search Crawler. You'll build systems that ingest, process, and organize large volumes of crawled content into efficient, queryable structures, working primarily on offline and nearline pipelines that keep data fresh, complete, and accessible to downstream retrieval. Throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical across datasets that change continuously.



Responsibilities 

 - Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines at the core of Perplexity's search infrastructure.

 - Develop and optimize indexing strategies that balance performance, freshness, and resource efficiency.

 - Work on storage formats, compaction, and update mechanisms that keep data accessible and current.

 - Keep pipelines reliable and predictable under high-throughput conditions. 

 - Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interface contracts that stay flexible as the system evolves.

 - Define and implement observability across offline and near line pipelines, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals.

 - Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations as business needs change.

 - Partner with retrieval, ranking, and ML teams to make sure indexing outputs meet their requirements.

 - Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals.
   
   

Qualifications

 - 5+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems.

 - Strong programming experience in Go, C++, or Rust.

 - Experience with high-throughput data processing systems and very large datasets.

 - Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines.

 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability.

 - Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents.

 - A systems-thinking mindset and the ability to reason about end-to-end data flows.

98784e6efb30.title: Senior Strategic Presales and Solutions Consultant (AI)
98784e6efb30.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

As a Senior Strategic Presales and Solutions Consultant (internal title: Senior Applied Value Engineer )you push the envelope in solving mission-critical problems for our customers. You will work with our most strategic customers, understand their strategy and key challenges, and build Celonis solutions using cutting-edge AI technologies from market leaders such as Microsoft and OpenAI. With Celonis’ market-leading Process Intelligence (PI) Platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ businesses and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization to increase Celonis' footprint at those customers.

The Role:

As Senior Applied Value Engineer, you are a strategic pioneer leading the charge in solving complex, business-critical problems for our customers. Working with our most strategic global accounts, you will diagnose their strategy and key operational challenges to discover and build tailored, domain-specific use cases. You will architect and prototype state-of-the-art AI and technical solutions on the Celonis platform, demonstrate their business impact to C-suite Executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption, and value realization. 

Native-level German proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

The role is based in Munich.

The work you’ll do:

  • Discovery & Advanced AI Solutioning: Act as the foremost Celonis product and domain positioning expert. Seamlessly translate deep domain expertise and complex customer requirements into flawless enterprise architecture. You will lead technical discovery to architect, prototype, and build bespoke, state-of-the-art AI solutions targeting nuanced operational pain points.
  • AI Solution Development: Lead the end-to-end execution of high-stakes Proof-of-Value (PoV) projects. Architect and deliver highly secure, scalable LLM/agent systems with advanced RAG, tools, and strict guardrails; integrating flawlessly with rigid enterprise data, identity, and compliance frameworks.
  • Value Selling & Realization: Act as a trusted advisor, maintaining active involvement with strategic accounts to ensure programmatic value realization until agreed-upon value, massive adoption thresholds, and operational transformations are achieved.
  • Domain & Industry Specialization: Leverage deep domain expertise combined with cross-system, AI-driven solutioning to architect industry-specific E2E solutions. You will codify this work into reusable methodology and globally scalable assets to accelerate time-to-value and mentor junior peers.

The qualifications you need:

  • Executive-Facing Presales & Value Engineering (5+ years): Demonstrated experience independently owning the technical close and driving compelling AI transformation narratives. Requires a proven background in accountable PoV execution, complex ROI/TCO modeling, and showcasing the "Art of the Possible" by pitching visionary solutions to hidden problems—with a clear track record of driving projects all the way through to achieved value.
  • Domain & Industry Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of core operational workflows and industry landscapes (e.g., supply chain, finance). You can speak the language of C-suite executives and seamlessly connect complex, systemic bottlenecks to strategic AI solutions.
  • Software/Data Engineering: Python proficiency, modular API design, creating reusable libraries, advanced SQL, and scalable data integration using ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Hugging Face).
  • Strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders (including executives), whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos. 
  • Degree: Masters Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • Native-level or near-native German language skills, with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.
  • The role is based in Munich.

44855a48db61.title: Senior Backend Engineer / DevOps
44855a48db61.description:
wongdoody creates human experiences at 25 studios across 4 continents. We believe the future can be molded. And by shaping human experiences through creativity and tech, we work to build a future we believe in.

For us, this starts with our own culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment where every human can bring their whole self to work. Our clients are brands we believe in, from global big players to local heroes to startups we love. With each of our partners, we embark on a journey of co-creation, pushing the boundaries of what's possible and exploring the space where creativity and tech meet.

Our team of fun, welcoming, values-driven, and collaborative problem solvers has one focus at the heart of everything we do: human experience. Human experiences are the touchpoints where brands connect with customers. And we transform businesses by creating engaging, inspiring moments using strategy, creativity, data and technology - all backed by the global technological power of Infosys.

Experience, Tech & AI

We are a cross-unit and cross-location AI, tech and experience team. With more than 50 developers, AI engineers, technical artists and consultants working directly with other WongDoody teams, we are team players and specialists - both in frontend and backend, as well as in creative production pipelines. As part of Infosys, we belong to a leading global technology company with access to solutions and extensive know-how in the fields of commerce, marketing automation and AI.

Our local benefits

  • Flexible working hours and 100% overtime compensation
  • Work where it works for you. At home or in the office, or any mix you like
  • Working for strong brands and clients we believe in
  • 30 days vacation per year
  • Company Benefits
  • Urban Sports Club
  • Nice people in welcoming teams

What you can expect

  • Develop and maintain web applications and APIs (REST, GraphQL) in line with architectural, security, and code quality guidelines, using PHP, Python, and Node.js
  • Create technical concepts and proofs of concept (PoCs) as a basis for project estimates, and maintain technical project documentation
  • Implement serverless and server-based cloud hosting environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) using and improving our automated toolset
  • Build and orchestrate automated CI/CD pipelines based on GitLab, GitHub, Terraform, and Docker
  • Ensure the scalability, observability, security, and cost efficiency of the technical architecture
  • Maintain delivered solutions by monitoring their availability and providing necessary security and performance updates
  • Provide technical guidance and educate team members and colleagues on development and operations topics
  • Use AI assistants such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Review Bot, and a set of internal AI tools
  • Ensure high software quality for yourself and the team by actively participating in peer code reviews
  • Design, improve, and automate infrastructure for development teams

What we'd love to see

  • 5+ years of practical experience in commercial projects
  • A college or university degree in an IT-related field, or comparable education
  • Very strong technical knowledge of PHP and Python; Node.js is a plus
  • Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and databases, both relational and document-based
  • Experience with Bash scripting is a plus
  • Good experience with Docker and a solid understanding of cloud-based infrastructures such as AWS and GCP
  • Expertise in DevOps tools and technologies, as well as designing and improving CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with Linux-based systems such as Debian, including secure provisioning and maintenance
  • Experience with automation tools for testing and infrastructure provisioning
  • Familiarity with agile project management processes such as Scrum or Kanban
  • Strong English skills are required
  • Good German skills are also a plus

We care about your personality and professional skills. We don't care about your gender, age, nationality or appearance and are open to working with everyone.

Please note: This is a job ad by wongdoody GmbH based in Germany. Through our website or other sources, you may find job ads published by one of our wongdoody sister companies around the globe with whom we act jointly under the band “wongdoody”. For each job offer, only the entity is responsible, which has published the ad. Contact persons, required information and applicable terms may differ. You can inform yourself how wongdoody GmbH is processing your personal data provided in the application process

f6d3974633ce.title: QA Engineer - Payments
f6d3974633ce.description:
SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes
  • Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.
  • Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff
  • Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they're fixed
  • Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence

5ce58b8204ec.title: Strategic Finance Intern
5ce58b8204ec.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life's best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT Building a fusion power plant is one of the most capital-intensive projects in Europe, and every major decision at Proxima rests on our financial models. Our Strategic Finance team owns the long-term investment model, the multi-year business plan, and the financial modelling behind our fundraising, government funding, and corporate development deals. As our Strategic Finance Intern, you will be a second pair of eyes on these models, making sure they are accurate, consistent, and speak from one source of truth. You will work directly with the Strategic Finance lead and partner with the wider finance team and department heads. WHAT YOU WILL DO Review and reconcile our models: Work through our long-term investment model and multi-year business plan, check formula integrity and cross-sheet consistency, and reconcile both against our budget. Find and resolve discrepancies: Keep a clear log of every mismatch you find, trace it to its cause, and work with the relevant teams to resolve it. Document how the models fit together: Write clear handover documentation on how our models connect and where each input comes from, so the next person can pick them up quickly. Build tools the team will use: Create dashboards and automations on top of the reconciled models to enable the business operations team and the rest of the business to quickly find answers to their finance questions. WHO YOU ARE Modelling experience: Hands-on financial modelling experience, ideally from investment banking, private equity, venture capital, transaction services, or a finance role at a startup. Excel and spreadsheet fluency: You can trace logic through models someone else built, spot errors quickly, and suggest improvements. Experience with Excel macros or Google Apps Script is a plus. Independent problem-solving: You structure a messy question, reason from the data in front of you, and work through blockers without needing step-by-step guidance. Confidence to flag problems: You tell a team lead when their numbers don't tie, clearly and constructively, and own your mistakes when you make them. AI-native: You use AI tools such as Claude to work faster and build better tools, not as a replacement for doing the thinking. Startup mindset: Curious, proactive, and detail-oriented. You welcome feedback, enjoy working with others to help the team succeed, and are excited by fusion energy. Availability: You can start immediately and commit to 2-3 months on-site in Munich. Fluent English is required; German is a plus. Don't tick all the boxes? We would still like to hear from you! INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30 min) Technical Interview, including a short modelling case (60 min) Second Technical Interview (45 min) *This role sits at "L1" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information. At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don't look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. 2c854c2aea42.title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), AI Engineering: AI Catalog
2c854c2aea42.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.

In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

What you'll do

  • Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the GitLab monolith (Ruby) and, where needed, the AI Gateway (Python). Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.
  • Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.
  • Design, implement and review GraphQL and REST APIs and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients.
  • Improve and extend automated testing (RSpec and other frameworks) to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.
  • Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.
  • Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.
  • Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, including background jobs, APIs and data models.
  • Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends is a plus.
  • Skill in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.
  • Real enthusiasm for AI and hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations is a plus.
  • Proven SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and data modeling.
  • Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.
  • Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.

About the team

The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. b76dacf60827.title: Research Engineer, AI Monitoring
b76dacf60827.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.

When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human. This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.

The work combines research and production engineering:

  • The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers.

  • The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints.

Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals

  • Deploy, tune and operate these classifiers in the critical path of internal agents, RL training, and evaluations, and own their accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and failure behaviour

  • Build the datasets, labelling pipelines, and evaluations that allow us to measure and improve our classifiers and harm taxonomies

  • Partner with red teaming colleagues to stress-test our classifiers, and harden them against what they find

  • Work with the teams whose agents, environments, and evaluations we run on, so that false positives get fixed quickly without weakening protection

  • Contribute to the team's direction, including what to build, what to partner on, and where to invest

Minimum qualifications

  • Ability to organise and prioritise several parallel streams of work, and to communicate clearly with the teams that work affects

  • Ability to critically review code and experiment results, including work produced by AI agents

  • Sincere interest in developing safe and beneficial AI systems

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading ambiguous technical projects and setting direction for other engineers or researchers

  • Experience evaluating large language models, developing classifiers, or operating high-scale production systems where requirements change quickly

  • Experience building detection systems where true positives are rare and false positives are costly, such as abuse, fraud, spam, or intrusion detection

  • Experience running low-latency, high-availability services that other systems depend on, including being on call for them

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, or working with probes and other methods that read model internals

  • Experience with LLM inference or serving infrastructure, or with integrating new components into training infrastructure

  • Background in security, such as sandboxing or detection and response

  • Familiarity with research on AI control, scalable oversight, agent safety, or reinforcement learning

In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market. Machine learning: forecasting and predictive models that feed planning decisions, from development to monitoring in production. 387f8ccb7ab5.title: Network Production Engineer
387f8ccb7ab5.description: About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI. We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible. Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. The Production Engineering Team Examples of key problems the team is working on Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal. Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up. Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it. Role Scope Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers. Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours. Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs. Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in. Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic. What We're Looking For The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it. You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone. You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet. You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero. Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling. Salary & Benefits Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity). Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms. Health, dental, and vision insurance. Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms. We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. 1c8c41d9b3c2.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
1c8c41d9b3c2.description: About Cinder Cinder is the mission-critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important digital platforms true to what they stand for. The internet has always been abused by bad actors, and AI is making it exponentially worse, driving fraud, abuse, and manipulation at a scale and speed no human team can fight alone. Cinder gives platforms one command center to fight back: to write and enforce policy, deploy AI agents against abuse in real time, investigate threats, file NCMEC reports, and prove their safety programs are working. Our customers are some of the largest internet platforms in the world. The decisions made in our software directly determine what stays up, what comes down, and how users are treated. We're a small, fast-moving team backed by Accel and Y Combinator. We care about being intentional, direct, and deeply focused on solving real customer problems. Why this role Once a deal closes, you're the technical owner on the ground. You're the escalation point for the customer, working closely with their CSM and Agent Product Manager (agent PM), and the first line of engineering defense when something isn't working the way they expect. For some customers, "close" means embedded. You're effectively part of their engineering team, in their Slack, on their calls, building alongside them. The platforms you'd be embedded with have hundreds of millions of users between them. When you fix something, it's not hypothetical. It's live, that day. What you'd actually work on Shape and prove the solution. Work directly with customers to understand their problems, identify the right use cases, and build proofs of concept that demonstrate value and de-risk the path to production. Own deployments end to end. Take the technical work from scoping and system design through implementation, rollout, and adoption — partnering with the CSM while owning the engineering plan. Build the last mile. Connect Cinder to each customer’s stack through APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, custom workflows, and production-quality code where configuration isn’t enough. Enable customer teams. Run technical workshops, document what you build, and give customers the knowledge and tools to operate successfully without us in the room. Turn fieldwork into product leverage. Solve issues in the systems you ship, identify patterns across customers, and turn those lessons into reusable tools and improvements to the core product. Own on-call for customers when system downtime means moderation stops. What we're looking for 4-8 years as a software engineer, solutions engineer, or in a similar role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Solid Python fundamentals. You can read, debug, and extend backend code without hand-holding. Comfortability with SQL, Typescript, React, and GraphQL. Real experience owning implementation, not just scoping it. You've configured or customized a product for a specific customer and shipped something that changed what that customer could actually do. You are exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and repeatedly take initiative — you thrive when dropped into unfamiliar situations, learning quickly, and finding ways to deliver value. No degree requirement. We care about what you can build, not where you learned to build it. Bootcamp grads are welcome. Nice to have Understanding of trust & safety or safety operations, either firsthand (you've worked in it) or through a specialized background — a T&S-focused master's, for example — that gives you real fluency, not just familiarity. Consulting experience where you turned a client's ambiguous ask into a working solution. Familiarity with React Query or Strawberry specifically. Experience being embedded with a customer or client team, rather than working at arm's length through tickets. Location & Benefits Our team is based in London and we believe that in-person collaboration is important. We offer medical and dental insurance benefits through Allianz Global. We hold at least two all-company events per year. We offer paid lunch when our team is in-person. Technical judgement: Challenge designs and guide trade-offs without owning every implementation detail. Execution: Create clarity and drive complex work to completion. Systems thinking: Understand how platform components and teams fit together. Operational mindset: Care about reliability, maintainability, and production quality. Builder mindset: Much here is not built yet, and you enjoy creating the process, not just running it. Qualities we look for: Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same. Why should you join us? What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive. 5a2816d79507.title: Legal Counsel - Commercial and AI
5a2816d79507.description: About H: Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement , both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move. H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents , fully managed agents that take actions on computers. What you own Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA . What you'd be doing Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers. Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument. Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. What we ship includes open-weight models: Holo3-35B-A3B is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. Customers can see on our Trust Center that we hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, and which subprocessors we use. When needed, questions outside contracts: employment, corporate or competition law. Who you'd work with Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, is hiring for this role. You'd join our Legal team and work closely with engineers and business teams. What we think it takes Likely a good fit if you Hold a master's in law and are admitted to the bar. Have a minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant legal experience. Know data protection law well (GDPR and the rules around it), along with IP, contract law and liability, and regulatory compliance. Have worked somewhere that was growing fast. Can explain a legal position plainly to an engineer. Work well on your own and adapt when plans change. An international outlook matters here too. Stronger still if you built that experience negotiating contracts at a tech or AI company. You do not need to have worked at an AI company before. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway. How we hire Three conversations. First a 30 minute call with our Talent team, then 30 minutes with Julie, and last a conversation with a member of our leadership team. Practicalities It's a hybrid job: you'd be in Paris with the team for three days in an average week. We offer a competitive package. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Au sein de cette organisation, l'équipe Digital Payment, est en charge de proposer la meilleure expérience de paiement pour nos marchands comme pour nos clients d'un point de vue performance, stabilité, cout, profitabilité et UX. Pour cela, elle a la charge de plusieurs produits digitaux utilisés sur la majorité des expériences digitale de Decathlon et contribuant fortement au chiffre d'affaire de l'entreprise :

  • OnePay : l'orchestrateur de paiement (le core), qui permet à nos marchands une standardisation et une flexibilité d'accès aux moyens de paiement (plugins) en choisissant le plus pertinent par rapport au contexte grace à un moteur d'éligibilité, au panier ou au client. Onepay propose notamment un widget de paiement directement intégrés par les différents front-office web.
  • OneWallet : le portefeuille numérique, qui sauvegarde de manière sécurisée les tokens des différents moyens de paiement et permet ainsi une expérience d'achat sans couture pour nos clients.
  • Payment Preview : module d’éligibilité permettant d’exposer les moyens de paiement possibles au plus tôt de l’expérience d’achat.
  • Third Party Checkout : un module permettant d'utilisant les partenaires de paiement pour faciliter le checkout pour les clients guest.
  • Payment Manager : une API d'orchestration du core qui permet de gérer des flows complexes de paiement composés ou de remboursement.

Les indicateurs principaux de l'équipe sont autour de la conversion à l'étape de paiement et le taux d'acceptance, c'est à dire la performance de nos partenaires.

En dehors des sujets autour de l'expérience et de la performance de paiement, l'équipe travaille actuellement sur la mise à disposition de moyens de paiement innovants (en étant pionnier sur le marché) et sur comment utiliser l'IA pour accélérer l'intégration de partenaires de paiement locaux.

Tu rejoindras une équipe à taille humaine, composée d'ingénieurs passionnés. Nous sommes fans de développement logiciel, d'Infrastructure as Code, de culture DevOps/SRE, d'automatisation, de veille technologique... et bien sûr, de sport !

About Decathlon

Decathlon aims to become the best sports digital platform and open ecosystem in the world. We want to enable customers to experience Decathlon through many local sport-centric experiences by connecting many third-party actors and services, in a secure and performant way.

Our digital teams bring together more than 5000 collaborators are united to build and scale digital products with the aim to always deliver the best value to our users. With a presence in more than 70 countries, Decathlon is committed to innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction.

Job Description

Decathlon is seeking a talented and experienced Data Scientist to join our Demand and Assortment Planning team within the Supply Chain department. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in developing AI models into production and providing insights/recommendations to optimise demand forecasting and assortment planning processes. We welcome candidates with expertise in time series forecasting and a passion for leveraging data to drive business decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Analyse and study historical sales data and market trends to forecast demand for Decathlon products.
  • Develop and implement advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms for demand forecasting and assortment planning, including foundation models. 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Supply Chain Business, Engineering, and Product Development to align Data and AI efforts with business objectives.
  • Evaluate and improve existing forecasting models and methodologies to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders through clear and concise data visualisations and presentations.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in data science and supply chain management.

Hard Skills

  • Proficiency in statistical analysis, forecasting, machine learning techniques, time series, time series foundation models and time series analysis (stationarity, decomposition, drift, anomaly detection).
  • Experience with programming languages such as Python, Spark, TensorFlow, Pytorch for data analysis and modelling.
  • Strong knowledge of data manipulation and visualisation tools such as pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, or ggplot2.
  • Familiarity with database systems and querying languages (e.g., SQL, PySpark) for data extraction and manipulation.
  • Experience with demand forecasting and inventory optimisation software/tools is a plus.
  • Experience with Generative AI is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach to learning and professional development.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with changing priorities.
  • Initiative and proactivity

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data science, statistical modelling, or related fields.
  • Proficiency in Python for data analysis and modelling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Data Science.
  • Experience in demand forecasting, inventory optimisation, or supply chain analytics.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.
  • Previous experience in the retail or e-commerce industry is a plus.
  • Experience in implementing Generative AI to enhance forecasting, alongside optimising business or organisational processes for product delivery.

Technical Environment

  • Execution Engine: Databricks, AWS EKS, Sagemaker
  • Payload: Python, Spark, Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow / Pytorch, Pyspark 
  • CICD: Github Actions
  • Serving: Docker, Protobuf, gRPC
  • Model registry, Model Tracking: MLFlow
  • Orchestration:  Airflow
  • Documentation / code: Git, Confluence
  • Data Visualisation: Tableau
  • Agentic & Gen Ai : Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
