Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building systems that ingest, process, and organise massive volumes of data into efficient, queryable structures. You will work primarily on offline and nearline pipelines, ensuring that data is fresh, complete, and efficiently accessible by downstream retrieval systems. You will operate in an environment where throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical; designing systems capable of handling tens of gigabytes per second across continuously evolving datasets.

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

  • Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines that sit at the core of our search infrastructure
  • Develop and optimise indexing strategies balancing performance, freshness, and resource efficiency
  • Work on storage formats, compaction strategies, and update mechanisms to keep data accessible and current
  • Ensure reliability and predictability of pipelines under high-throughput conditions
  • Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interaction contracts, while remaining flexible as the system evolves
  • Define and implement observability primitives, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals across offline and nearline pipelines
  • Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations when business needs require it
  • Collaborate with runtime and ML teams to ensure indexing outputs meet retrieval and ranking requirements
  • Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and data processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals

You may be a good fit if you:

  • 8+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems
  • Strong Go experience (C++/Rust is a plus)
  • Experience with large-scale data processing systems (10+ GiB/sec throughput, petabyte-scale datasets, etc.)
  • Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability
  • Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents
  • Systems-thinking mindset and ability to reason about end-to-end data flows

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

  • Content systems including, scraping, proxying, or anti-bot infrastructure
  • Ad tech, social networks, or other large-scale content platforms
  • DBMS internals (open source or SaaS) and cloud infrastructure

10668c419762.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
10668c419762.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory, you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals, quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, inference engines, serving architecture, and benchmarking to improve latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while preserving quality and reliability.

You will work with kernel and platform engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and resolve performance and quality regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through reproducible benchmarks and safe production rollouts under real-world workloads.

Your responsibilities

  • Own optimization projects for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.
  • Compare inference engines and recommend serving configurations suited to individual workloads.
  • Diagnose model-quality and performance regressions during production rollouts.
  • Improve LLM and VLM endpoint latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.
  • Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, and NVIDIA Dynamo.
  • Develop production model-compression workflows covering quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.
  • Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving. For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.
  • Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.
  • Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.
  • Build reproducible benchmark harnesses measuring TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token. Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.
  • Collaborate with GPU kernel and platform engineers to trace bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.
  • Produce design documents, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Must-haves

  • Strong engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer inference.
  • Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack, such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or an equivalent internal system.
  • A strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks involving KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.
  • Ability to quantify trade-offs among latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost.
  • Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or SmoothQuant.
  • Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or related inference acceleration methods.
  • Experience supporting agentic workloads involving tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.
  • Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization.
  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or KServe.

36548129a773.title: Senior Backend Developer
36548129a773.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load. You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache. You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies. You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end. You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong. You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises. You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over. English is your working language. German is a plus. What makes you stand out You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax. You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model. You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama. You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it. The team We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action. We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you. The facts Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith Pensum: 100% Start: As soon as possible La

8a869c660b6e.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
8a869c660b6e.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own our customer deployments end to end. Our system runs on-prem at industrial facilities, critical infrastructure, and military sites, integrated with the cameras, networks, and robots already in place. You survey the site, plan the deployment, install and integrate the system, tune it to the site's conditions, and hand it over to operators who will rely on it daily. You are also the technical face of Laelaps on site. You work with security operators to understand how they actually work and where the bottlenecks are, align with their leadership on what success looks like, and translate what you learn into configuration, code, and product priorities. Early deployments you run alongside the founders; over time you own sites and accounts independently. Expect roughly half your time at customer sites in Switzerland and Europe, and the rest in Zurich, turning field lessons into tooling and automation that make each deployment faster than the last. This is an engineering role with a customer in the room, not a support or services role. What You'll Work On Deployments end-to-end: site surveys, network and hardware planning, installation, camera and VMS integration, commissioning, validation, and handover. On-prem infrastructure: install and manage our stack on edge hardware (NVIDIA DGX Spark, Jetson Thor class devices) inside customer networks, often air-gapped or heavily restricted. Integrations: connect existing cameras, sensors, VMS platforms, and robots into one coordinated system, and write the glue code where no integration exists yet. System tuning: calibrate detection and tracking to each site's terrain, lighting, and threat profile until the system performs in the field as it does in the demo. Pilots to production: make POCs succeed technically, because pilots that work become contracts. Customer understanding: sit with operators, interview stakeholders from the control room to the leadership floor, and map the real problems and bottlenecks behind the stated requirements. Customer trust: train operators, respond fast when something breaks, and be the engineer customers ask for by name. The deployment playbook: turn every hard-won lesson into runbooks, tooling, and automation that compound. Product feedback: bring real field signal back to the core engineering team and shape the roadmap with it. Who We're Looking For We are looking for an engineer who runs toward the messy parts, with the EQ to match the IQ. You are as comfortable in a server room or on a windswept perimeter as you are in a terminal, and just as comfortable in a conversation. You can spend a shift with a security operator and earn enough trust that they tell you what actually goes wrong at 3 a.m., then brief a head of security or a site director in their language, not yours. You listen more than you pitch, you read the room, and you switch registers between the guard house and the boardroom without breaking stride. You debug across the whole stack without ceremony: is it the hardware, the network, the driver, the model, or the config? Above all, you take personal ownership of the outcome: the deployment works because you made it work, and the customer trusts us because you earned it. Your Background 3+ years of relevant software, robotics, embedded systems, or systems integration experience. A Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong Python and hands-on C++ experience. You can read, debug, and extend production code in both. Experience deploying and operating software on-prem or at the edge (Docker required; GPU inference experience a strong plus). 5871d17c4a66.title: Research Engineer, Foundation Model (Multimodal Fusion & Distillation)
5871d17c4a66.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame. This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain. What You'll Work On Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in. Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else. Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures. Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate. Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship. Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs. Who We're Looking For A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know when an open model is good enough and when to build, you measure on the slice that matters before claiming a number, and you care whether the model works on a real site, not only on a benchmark. Your Background 4+ years training and fine-tuning large vision or multimodal models, or a PhD plus industry experience. Strong PyTorch, comfortable with multi-GPU and multi-node training. Hands-on fine-tuning of vision-language models (instruction tuning, parameter-efficient methods, full fine-tunes). Experience with knowledge distillation or model compression for deployment. Work with video or non-RGB sensors: thermal, infrared, lidar or radar. Evaluation discipline and solid software engineering hygiene. Nice to Have Point-cloud or 3D foundation models. Self-supervised and latent-prediction methods (JEPA-style). Edge deployment with TensorRT or similar. Robotics or field data collection. Publications at top ML, vision or robotics venues. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten. Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk. De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen. HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. Wat ga je doen? Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan. Concreet ga je onder andere: Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers. Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten. Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen. AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers. Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen. De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden. Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent. Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen. Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven. Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie. Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie. Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen. “We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.” – Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead Wie ben je? Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar. Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren . Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen. Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd. Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen. Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties . Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring. Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen. Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen. Ervaring met tools zoals Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT en Power BI is een pre. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar AI en enthousiast wordt van de vraag: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen AI daadwerkelijk goed gaan gebruiken? Wat bieden wij jou? Een afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op de organisatie. Intensieve begeleiding door de AI Transformation Lead. Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap. De kans om ervaring op te doen met AI-adoptie en organisatieverandering . Praktijkervaring met het ontwikkelen en geven van AI-trainingen, demo’s en workshops. De mogelijkheid om met echte adoptiedata te werken en te onderzoeken welke interventies daadwerkelijk effect hebben. Een actieve rol binnen het AI Champions-programma. Werken aan actuele AI-vraagstukken binnen een internationale organisatie. Een hybride werkomgeving vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere. Een informele en betrokken werksfeer waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand (obv 32 uur). Aan het einde van je stage heb je niet alleen een sterke afstudeers

f5a2bd571fd7.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
f5a2bd571fd7.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for Senior Fullstack Engineers to work on creating UX solutions for external and internal customers. Thousands of AI engineers across healthcare, robotics, media, and retail as well as your own collegues interact with Nebius through what you build.

Your responsibilities:
  • Working with multiple internal customers, while keeping UX consistent across all the different services
  • Working with APIs in multiple data centers, with changing regional model, while thinking about client latencies
  • Creating completely new UX solutions, not directly related to infrastructure services, such as customer communication services, Cloud shell, IaaC code generation and anything else that will improve customer experience
  • Creating complex user flow scenarios for different customer tiers in close collaboration with other teams
  • Building a design system that stays coherent as the product surface doubles. And making instruments to facilitate quick delivery across development, design and documentation teams
We expect you to have:
  • 5+ years of experience in software development.
  • Strong proficiency in modern web development
  • Strong proficiency in Node.JS
  • Understanding of modern databases (PostgreSQL or other relational databases)
  • Experience designing and working with APIs (RESTful and other RPC)
It would be nice if you have:
  • Experience with React, tanstack-query
  • Experience with NestJS or similar Node.js frameworks.
  • Exposure to DevOps concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux).
  • Experience with Go development
  • Experience with modern message queues/brokers systems
  • Experience working with distributed systems or complex workflows.
We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. 

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

6c99c763738a.title: Data Analyst (EN)
6c99c763738a.description: Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact! At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in. We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome. What will you do? Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied. Product In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work. Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition; Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working; Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts; Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them; Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development; Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company. Commercial & marketing support Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex. Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities; Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS. This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact. Your team You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data. The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks. What are we looking for? We are looking for someone who: Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst; Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics; Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude; Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it; Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter; Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders; Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues; Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus); We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them. What do we offer? A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment; 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek; 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance; We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp; Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more; A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy; One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in; A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions; A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility. YoungOnes is a place where you learn fast, build fast and see results fast. Ready to take the lead? Then we would love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

dea02a4a6759.title: Senior Controls Engineer
dea02a4a6759.description: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen. Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Wat bieden wij jou? We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley. Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel) Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen. Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem. Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000 Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA) Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal) In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken? Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst. We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken. 👉 Is deze functie perfect voor jou? a085cb8ff5ae.title: Embedded & Firmware QA Engineer
a085cb8ff5ae.description: 🌊 Who are we? We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging. Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we're proud of. We're committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. The Role You'll own the quality of the firmware and embedded systems across our physical product portfolio. That means making sure every firmware release is tested, reliable, and ready for the field, and that defects are caught before they reach a client. This is a senior, hands-on role. You understand electronics and embedded systems well enough to reproduce and diagnose issues yourself, read a schematic, and build your own test kits and jigs. You don't wait for an engineer to set things up for you. You run your area independently. Over the past year, we've built a validation framework that changed how we release firmware. We now ship on evidence instead of gut feel: structured test cycles across our product generations, tracked defects across release candidates, formal release reviews, and controlled rollouts to the fleet. Your first job is to own that framework and keep it strong. Your bigger job is to take it further. Today, testing mostly happens once a release is nearly done. We want to catch risk earlier, inside the firmware stage-gate process, through integration testing, corner cases, and tests at the edges of the operating envelope. You'll move firmware QA from reacting to preventing. What You'll Do Embedded & Firmware Testing Own test strategy and execution for firmware and embedded systems across our physical products. Reproduce field and development issues independently, using your electrical and embedded understanding. Develop diagnostic and validation methods for firmware features, aligned with our stage-gate process. Define and run regression testing ahead of every firmware release. Test at the system-integration and interface level, including the edges of the operating envelope where real risk sits. b7d8767d701b.location: Seattle, San Francisco, New York, Chicago, Atlanta, Remote in the US, Canada
b7d8767d701b.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Stripe Marketing organization is undergoing a fundamental transformation in how it works. We're building a team of Forward Deployed AI Accelerators (FDAs) embedded directly with marketing cohorts to make AI the default mode for all work — not an occasional tool, but the foundation of how every marketer at Stripe executes. Today, marketers are already achieving remarkable results — building their own data dashboards, creating agents that compress multi-day processes, and authoring tools that accelerate workflows. The FDA team exists to take what's working and systematically scale it across the entire marketing organization. What you'll do As a Forward Deployed AI Accelerator, you'll be embedded with a cohort of 25–45 marketers organized by functional team, shared workflow, or location. You'll build alongside them, and you'll help them fundamentally change how they operate. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you've permanently transformed and the extent to which those in your cohort start any task with an AI tool. Responsibilities Identify and document the highest-leverage workflow transformations within your cohort's day-to-day work by deeply understanding their processes and outputs Build custom tools, agents, automations, and skills tailored to each marketer's specific responsibilities Coach and partner with each marketer through a progressive journey — from awareness, to first win, to regular AI integration, to full workflow transformation, to self-sufficiency Teach marketers to build and iterate on their own tools over time, creating independence Recognize patterns across your cohort and systematically scale what works — a tool built for one marketer will be reusable for their peers Document every tool, playbook, and transformation pattern you build so the entire FDA team uses each other's work Share wins visibly within your cohort and with leadership to build momentum, inspire, and celebrate success Track individual and cohort progress rigorously against a defined maturity model, moving every marketer toward self-sustaining, AI-first work Prepare marketers for an agentic future — not just prompt writing, but designing, building, and overseeing autonomous, multi-agent workflows Who you are We're looking for people who have already lived the transformation they'll be driving for others. You've used AI to fundamentally change how work gets done, not as a novelty, but as your default operating mode. You are a deep AI practitioner. You build agents, automations, and tools fluently. You don't just know what AI can do in theory. You've built things that changed how real teams operate, and the people you built for actually use what you shipped. You build in real time alongside the people you support. You spot transformation opportunities and execute on them. You look at a team's workflows and see where AI changes the economics: where existing work can be done in a fraction of the time, or where entirely new programs become viable that weren't worth doing before. Then you build the thing, not just the slide. You understand marketing work. You either have direct experience in marketing or quickly learn the workflows, deliverables, tools, and pressures of your assigned cohort. You know that understanding someone's work is a prerequisite to transforming it. You are a pattern recognizer. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it applies to others. You think in systems, not one-off solutions. You are a strong communicator. You explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, adapt your style to different people, and make progress visible to leadership and stakeholders. You are high-caliber, persistent, and versatile. Your skills and experience are valuable across the company. You're the kind of person who succeeds in many roles at Stripe. You bias toward action and speed. You'd rather show someone a working proof-of-concept on their own deliverable today than present a polished deck about what's theoretically possible next quarter. You are comfortable with ambiguity and evolution. This is a new team building a new operating model. The playbook will be rewritten as we learn. You thrive in that environment. Minimum requirements 3+ years of professional experience in a role requiring diagnostic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration Demonstrated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered agents, tools, automations, or workflows that real people use in their actual work, whether that made existing processes meaningfully more efficient or made previously unviable work possible for the first time Proficiency with AI development tools and platforms (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, custom agent frameworks, API integrations, workflow automation tools) Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and adapt your style to different learners Comfort working across multiple workstreams and relationships simultaneously (you'll be supporting 25–45 marketers at varying stages of their AI journey) Track record of coaching, teaching, or enabling others, with evidence that people you've helped actually changed how they work Preferred qualifications Experience in a formal AI transformation role where the job was substantially about identifying opportunities for workflow transformation and executing on them with hand

This role is responsible for leading strategic conversations and developing plans that will transform the payments and financial infrastructure for leading enterprises. We're building an AI-first team. Using AI to work efficiently, and to deliver faster and better outcomes for our users, will be a key part of this role. What you’ll do Responsibilities Plan and execute integration engineering end-to-end, from high-level architecture down to code implementation. Think on your feet and communicate technical concepts, explaining how Stripe works from both a product feature and API architecture perspective. 8b8b7a9a7da5.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, TX San Francisco, CA Available Term Winter (January - April 2027) About the role Cloudflare’s mission is to help build a better Internet—and our Communications team is responsible for telling that story to the world and to our own employees. Across Public Relations, Social, Internal, Visual, and Executive Communications, we support major company announcements, Innovation Weeks, internal employee platforms and news, our public social channels and executive communications. Cloudflare moves fast, and so does our work. We're looking for a builder who is just as curious about how organizations communicate as about the technology behind it. You might be studying information science, data science, HCI, digital media, journalism, cognitive science, business or information systems, or communications with a strong technical streak, or coming from a coding bootcamp or self-taught path. You'll work at the intersection of AI, automation, and employee and corporate communications, identifying opportunities to eliminate manual work, connect disconnected systems, and build tools that make our team smarter and more effective. By the end of the internship, you’ve built new tools or processes for how we can better communicate or collaborate. Responsibilities Automate the everyday: Build workflows that can save the team time—like creating a dynamic, shared visual calendar that pulls milestones automatically from multiple team trackers, auto-populating our weekly internal newsletter with top press coverage, or keeping our internal wiki (Company Hub) continuously updated with the latest stats or coverage highlights. Own a flagship AI project: Sit down with teammates across PR, Social, Design, and Internal Comms to uncover an opportunity to use AI to reimagine a time-consuming or fragmented process. Own the process from discovery through prototyping, testing, and deployment. Improve AI knowledge and retrieval: Partner with Communications and the Agentic Solutions Team to improve how internal AI tools access, organize, and retrieve information and share with employees. Help identify gaps in existing knowledge sources, improve content quality and structure, and test the accuracy and usefulness of AI-generated responses. Share what you build: Teach the team how to use the tools you build and share and learn from other interns and teams across the company. Present flagship AI project during company-wide intern presentations. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience: Technical foundation: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a field such as information science, data science, human-computer interaction, digital media, business or information systems, journalism, communications, or a related technical field. AI enthusiast: Experience building with AI tools, including LLMs, AI agents, or AI-assisted development tools. 5bcc95275dfc.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Presence is OpenAI’s team building AI agents that organizations can trust to handle real conversations and get things done. Our mission is to turn advances in frontier models into dependable systems that can resolve customer issues, support employees, and improve through experience in production.

Imagine calling about an unexpected charge. An agent needs to understand your situation, verify your identity, find the relevant account information, apply the right policy, and resolve the issue or bring in a person. It needs to do all of this naturally, accurately, and quickly, even when the conversation takes an unexpected turn. Presence brings together the models, execution systems, integrations, and controls that make experiences like this possible across voice, chat and email.

One of our most exciting challenges is what happens after an agent goes live. We're building a system for understanding where agents fail and making them better: investigate a production conversation, reproduce the problem in an evaluation, use Codex to develop a fix, test it against the current agent, and measure the result after deployment. Our ambition is to make more of this improvement process agentic over time, while giving people control over what changes reach users.

Read the launch announcement https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence/.

 


WHAT WE WORK ON

 - Realtime voice: Natural conversations with fast responses, interruptions, and reliable audio, even under heavy traffic.

 - Agent systems: Orchestration, reasoning, tool execution, integrations with company systems, and enforcing permissions and policies.

 - Agent quality: Production debugging, simulations, evaluation infrastructure, regression testing, and measuring whether changes improve real outcomes.

 - Product and developer experience: Making it easier for teams to build, test, deploy, and operate sophisticated agents using Codex and OpenAI's capabilities.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

You'll work at the intersection of frontier research, product engineering, and production systems, with a direct feedback loop from people using what you build. We collaborate closely with Research, Forward Deployed Engineers, and customers to understand where models and systems break down and turn those lessons into improvements that can benefit many deployments.

The impact is already tangible. At launch, Presence was resolving 75% of issues coming into OpenAI's English phone support without a human, and its Codex-assisted improvement process helped cut transfers to people by 15 percentage points over ten days. Introducing OpenAI Presence https://openai.com/index/introducing-openai-presence/

We're looking for people excited by ambitious engineering problems, building products people depend on, and helping define how AI agents are developed and improved in the real world.

 


YOUR BACKGROUND MIGHT LOOK SOMETHING LIKE:

 - 9+ years of professional engineering experience, excluding internships, in backend, platform, or product engineering roles.

 - A track record of hands-on technical leadership, including setting architecture, breaking complex problems into clear implementation plans, and guiding engineers through delivery.

 - Deep backend engineering and systems design skills, with proficiency in at least one backend programming language and experience designing services, data models, and interfaces that remain reliable as usage grows.

 - End-to-end ownership of complex systems or product capabilities, from ambiguous requirements and technical design through implementation, launch, and production iteration.

 - Strong production engineering judgment: you can diagnose difficult failures, reason about performance and scalability, and improve reliability through testing, observability, and operational discipline.

 - Strong product judgment that connects technical decisions to user needs, with the ability to balance delivery speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.

 - The ability to move between backend infrastructure and product experiences, contribute across the stack when needed, and quickly learn unfamiliar systems, tools, and domains.

 - Clear technical communication and effective collaboration across disciplines, including explaining trade-offs, creating alignment, and driving complex work forward while remaining hands-on.

 - Experience with AI agents, enterprise workflows, integrations, or agent development and evaluation is a plus, but not required.

About the Team

Dots for Companies helps organizations put AI to work. Our scope includes increasing adoption and retention in Business and Enterprise plans, exploring shared AI teammates with their own responsibilities, and building the tools people need to manage their work. We build on the broader Dots platform while developing experiences specific to companies.

About the Role

We are looking for Senior and Staff Full Stack Software Engineers to build Dots product experiences from the interface through the services that power them. You will help define how people delegate tasks to enterprise agents, follow their progress, and collaborate with them over time. This role combines hands-on product development with the systems work needed to make persistent, asynchronous agent experiences reliable.

In this role, you will:

 - Build full stack experiences that help teams discover, adopt, and continue using Dots at work.

 - Experience shipping user facing software across frontend and application backend systems, with clear ownership of the resulting user experience.

 - The ability to make progress when requirements are incomplete, seek the right input, and adjust as you learn.

 - Interest in AI tools that help people do work, with a willingness to experiment with unfamiliar product patterns.

784a7eff497e.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Content Intelligence
784a7eff497e.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Verbatim squad sits within the Enrichment & Content Intelligence product area and is focused on helping Spotify better understand audio, text, and visual content through machine learning. The team develops technologies that power experiences across Spotify including content skipping, transcription, moderation, and visual understanding. Working at the intersection of large-scale machine learning and product innovation, the squad partners closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to build intelligent systems that improve how users experience content across the platform.

What You'll Do
Lead end-to-end machine learning initiatives from ideation and prototyping through experimentation, deployment, and large-scale productionization. Design, develop, and deploy machine learning systems that operate across hundreds of millions of content signals using both real-time and batch processing architectures. Advance Spotify’s capabilities in natural language understanding, multimodal AI, and content intelligence. Build and evaluate LLM-powered solutions using modern prompting techniques, retrieval systems, and advanced model orchestration approaches. Define rigorous evaluation methodologies including golden datasets, precision and recall frameworks, offline benchmarking, and online experimentation. Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and Data Scientists to influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions. Mentor engineers across the organization and help elevate machine learning engineering standards and best practices. Contribute to the adoption of AI-assisted development workflows and tooling that improve team productivity and engineering effectiveness.
Who You Are
You have solid experience developing and deploying machine learning systems in production environments. You have successfully delivered large-scale machine learning architectures operating on substantial datasets and high-throughput production systems. You have deep experience with machine learning, deep learning, and modern AI technologies. You have hands-on experience working with large language models and understand how to evaluate, adapt, and deploy them effectively for real-world product challenges. You have experience building evaluation frameworks and can quantify model performance through robust experimentation and measurement techniques. You know how to navigate ambiguity and make thoughtful technical trade-offs that balance product impact, scalability, and engineering quality. You have experience influencing technical direction across cross-functional teams and can communicate complex machine learning concepts to diverse audiences. You care about developing others and enjoy mentoring engineers through technical guidance and collaboration. You have experience working with NLP, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, or multimodal machine learning systems. You are curious about emerging AI technologies and excited about integrating tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI-assisted development capabilities into engineering workflows.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London or Stockholm. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

ee1b70c37845.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
ee1b70c37845.description: Technical Solutions Engineer Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Stripe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team is the glue that supports our developer-users and champions developer experience as being central to the overall experience of our users. TSE interacts directly with developer-users more than any other team at Stripe, so your role will have a significant impact on what Stripe is known for and values most. When we do our job well, developers all over the world are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on Stripe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex financial systems. What you’ll do TSEs understand the fundamentals of programming incredibly well and eagerly jump in and familiarize themselves with others’ code. You will do a wide variety of things, including explaining technical concepts about Stripe’s products, build and debug integrations with developers, and produce/improve guides that help our users solve particular problems to be successful with Stripe. You will interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of mediums, enabling them to be successful when using Stripe. Early on, current team members will devote a large amount of time to teaching you and helping you get to a level of comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. Later, we’d love for you to take on this role with others on the team and Stripes broadly, as teaching is a great way to learn and to reinforce what you know. If you’re someone who enjoys working with all kinds of code, is a fast researcher, a strong writer, and enthusiastic about helping others build mission-critical products with Stripe, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities Communicate with a number of external developers and aid them in building their applications against Stripe’s infrastructure in a number of programming languages (including Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, NodeJS, .NET, ReactJS, React Native, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, and Java for Android). Unblock external developers with their thorniest integration challenges through a variety of support channels including email, ticketing software, internal issue trackers, community platforms (like StackOverflow), and real-time chat software (like Slack and Discord) Develop and maintain internal and external documentation, examples, integration demos, and code-snippets that demonstrate usage patterns of the Stripe infrastructure. Identify points of friction developers encounter and collaborate with engineering teams to make Stripe products better. Participate in a number of extended engineering teams’ regular planning sessions, design reviews, and development meetings. Develop and maintain a suite of internal support tooling for TSE and Stripe Support more broadly e.g. a retrieval augmented generation LLM-based Copilot tool or the Invoice Explainer Admin tool. Act as a developer advocate and educational resource internal to the organization by regularly assembling training for non-developers internal to the organization and responding in real-time to product integration questions. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements At least 4 years of full-stack software development experience, with a proven track record of building web or mobile applications that deliver high-quality user experiences Direct experience explaining technical concepts, and would be comfortable explaining how Stripe works to both technical and non-technical audiences Understands how to write good, clean code in multiple programming languages, as well as how to read code that might not be quite as well written Ability to help users during working hours in the region you are in. This may occasionally include providing weekend coverage for monitoring/supporting critical infrastructure, which TSEs are uniquely equipped to assist with given the team’s knowledge around Stripe’s products and active integrations. The team is largely remote, and we are very supportive of working arrangements that allow for family care and other needs to be met. Preferred qualifications Enjoys writing in a clear and quick manner General software engineering skills are important to us, as we understand that new languages and frameworks can be learned if you understand the concepts Experience teaching or coaching developers Comfort working with a great deal of autonomy and limited supervision Degree in Computer Science, Software/Computer Engineering, or a related analytical field of study

4d84b2e4211f.description:
About the Team

The Agent Identity team builds the foundational identity infrastructure that enables AI agents to securely act on behalf of users and organizations. We develop the systems that allow agents to establish their identity, demonstrate whose authority they are operating under, and securely access resources across applications and environments.

Our team owns agent identity and delegation, authentication and authorization, credential lifecycle management, revocation, and integrations with external platforms. We also build Sign in with ChatGPT, enabling OpenAI to serve as an identity provider across a growing ecosystem of applications.

As AI agents become increasingly autonomous, our work is foundational to how users, organizations, and developers establish trust in agentic systems.

About the Role

We are looking for experienced software engineers to design and build the identity infrastructure powering the next generation of AI agents across OpenAI’s products, including ChatGPT and Codex.

You will tackle complex, largely unsolved engineering challenges at the intersection of identity, security, distributed systems, and agent infrastructure. You’ll help define how agents authenticate across environments, how users securely delegate authority to agents, and how agents interact with external applications and services.

This is an opportunity to shape foundational technical primitives at OpenAI while helping influence how the broader industry approaches identity in an increasingly agent-driven world.

In this role, you will:

 - Design and build foundational agent identity primitives, including agent authentication, delegated authorization, and credential lifecycle management.

 - Develop secure mechanisms that enable agents to act on behalf of users and organizations across internal and external systems.

 - Architect authentication and authorization flows for connectors, third-party applications, and cloud-based agent execution environments.

 - Build and evolve Sign in with ChatGPT, enabling secure identity federation and interoperability across the broader application ecosystem.

 - Design highly scalable, reliable, and secure distributed systems that support credential issuance, rotation, revocation, and access enforcement.

 - Partner closely with engineering, product, security, and external platform teams to solve emerging identity challenges and help shape industry standards.

 - Drive technical direction and own complex initiatives from initial architecture through production deployment.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or business-critical backend infrastructure.

 - Have deep technical experience in identity and access management, workload identity, identity providers, authentication, authorization, or credential lifecycle management.

 - Alternatively, have experience building cloud-based AI agents, agent execution environments, browser-based automation, or connector infrastructure, with firsthand exposure to identity and authentication challenges.

 - Have familiarity with identity and authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or related emerging standards.

 - Bring a security-first mindset and proactively consider trust boundaries, failure modes, and potential abuse when designing systems.

 - Thrive in ambiguous problem spaces where established technical patterns may not yet exist, and enjoy defining solutions from first principles.

 - Have a track record of driving complex technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions, and collaborating effectively across engineering teams.

 - Are excited about defining how identity, trust, and delegated authority will work in a world where AI agents increasingly act on our behalf.

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Our team members are subject matter experts in both cybersecurity and US Government policy. We’re excited about generating creative solutions to ambiguous security requirements. We achieve this with a strong IT technical foundation to scale and automate security management technical administration of our USG facilities, close consultation with stakeholders, and direct ownership of the Authorization to Operate (ATO) process.

At Spotify, our Subscriptions mission helps make the subscription experience seamless and reliable for millions of listeners around the world. We're building the technology that supports subscribers throughout their journey, from their first purchase to renewals, plan changes, and beyond.
We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join Rover, the team responsible for Spotify's core subscription system. Our services manage the lifecycle of every Spotify subscription, including activation, renewals, plan changes, grace periods, and cancellations.
You'll help build and improve the backend services and data systems that millions of subscribers depend on. Whether you're growing your engineering experience or looking for a new technical challenge, you'll have opportunities to learn, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact on Spotify's subscription experience.

What You'll Do
Design, build, and improve backend services that power Spotify's core subscription system. Develop and deliver solutions that support subscription journeys, from activation and renewals to plan changes and cancellations. Work with complex, large-scale systems to improve reliability, performance, and scalability. Collaborate with engineers and teams across Spotify to solve technical challenges and deliver meaningful improvements for subscribers. Contribute to technical discussions, share ideas, and help shape engineering decisions. Work with large-scale data systems and pipelines, building your knowledge while contributing to their ongoing development. Share feedback, learn from your colleagues, and contribute to a supportive and collaborative engineering culture.
Who You Are
You have experience developing backend services using Python or Java and working with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform or similar technologies. You're familiar with database technologies such as PostgreSQL and interested in building reliable, scalable systems. You have an understanding of data systems or pipelines, or an interest in developing your skills in this area. You enjoy solving complex technical problems and finding practical ways to improve existing systems. You communicate clearly and feel comfortable sharing technical ideas, contributing to discussions, and explaining your work to different audiences. You take ownership of your work, seek feedback, and enjoy collaborating with others to achieve shared goals. You bring curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn as technologies and challenges evolve. You may have worked with subscriptions, billing, payments, e-commerce, or financial systems, or you're interested in learning more about these areas.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London or Stockholm We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
