4d9a68e88705.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Science Leader, B2B Marketing & Demand Generation, you will partner with our B2B Marketing organization and help accelerate how businesses discover, adopt, and grow with AI.

You will be a strategic partner to our B2B Marketing leadership team, bringing a deep understanding of the B2B landscape and a point of view on how to grow a business. You will help shape our marketing strategy, identify our biggest growth opportunities, and build the data, measurement, and intelligence capabilities needed to turn those opportunities into impact.

The opportunity spans the full customer journey, from building awareness and engaging buying groups to generating demand, partnering with Sales, and helping customers adopt and expand their use of OpenAI. You will build and lead a team of data scientists and work closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance.

We’re looking for people who bring strong B2B marketing expertise, a track record of influencing growth strategy through Data Science, and experience building and developing high-performing teams.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Be a strategic partner to B2B Marketing leadership. Bring insights, recommendations, and a clear point of view to the most important business decisions. Help leaders understand where we are winning, where we have opportunities, and where to focus next.

 - Shape our growth strategy. Identify the audiences, accounts, industries, and customer journeys where we can have the greatest impact. Connect market opportunity and customer signals to marketing and go-to-market priorities.

 - Build a full-funnel view of the business. Connect awareness, engagement, demand, pipeline, conversion, adoption, and expansion. Make it easier for teams to understand how customers move through the journey and where we can improve their experience.

 - Measure what matters. Build a thoughtful approach to measuring brand and demand generation, combining experiments, causal inference, marketing mix modeling, and other methods. Help leaders understand both near-term outcomes and longer-term effects, with clarity on uncertainty and tradeoffs.

 - Develop buying-group and account intelligence. Bring together customer and account signals to understand who is engaging, where buying groups are developing momentum, and how Marketing and Sales can better reach and serve them.

 - Improve the path from self-serve to enterprise adoption. Partner across Marketing, Sales, and Product to understand when businesses are ready for a deeper relationship and how to support the transition to broader deployment and sustained usage.

 - Build AI-native intelligence capabilities. Partner with Engineering and product teams to turn insights into scalable tools, recommendations, and workflows that help marketers and go-to-market teams make better decisions.

 - Build and develop a high-performing team. Recruit and grow exceptional talent, set a high bar for analytical rigor and business impact, and create an environment where people can do their best work.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have experience leading Data Science, Analytics, or a related team in a B2B business, with a track record of influencing growth strategy and business decisions.

 - Have a strong understanding of B2B marketing and go-to-market, including demand generation, account-based marketing, enterprise sales cycles, and complex buying groups.

 - Have experience measuring marketing effectiveness using experimentation, causal inference, and other approaches, and the judgment to choose the right method for the question.

 - Have experience connecting marketing, sales, product, and customer data to understand the full customer journey.

 - Have a track record of building strong partnerships with senior leaders, challenging assumptions constructively, and turning complex analysis into clear recommendations.

 - Have experience hiring and developing high-performing teams, including leaders and senior individual contributors.

 - Are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, moving between strategy and execution, and building capabilities where the path is not yet defined.

We’d be especially excited if you bring:

 - Experience building predictive models, account intelligence, or recommendation systems that have been adopted by business teams.

 - Experience with product-led growth or self-serve-to-sales motions alongside enterprise go-to-market.

 - Curiosity about AI and a desire to use it to rethink how marketing and go-to-market teams operate.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

a5bba29422a4.title: Software Engineer, Collections Infra
a5bba29422a4.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale.

This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume.

 - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping.

 - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on.

 - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load.

 - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles.

 - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter.

 - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck.

 - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. 5f8ec888666e.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI Consumer Devices is building the next generation of products that bring powerful AI into people’s everyday lives. Guided by OpenAI’s mission to ensure AGI benefits all of humanity, our team combines world-class researchers, engineers, designers, and operators who care deeply about creating useful, intuitive, and responsible technology. You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside exceptional people on ambitious, zero-to-one challenges at the intersection of hardware, software, and AI. This is a chance to help define an entirely new category of products—and shape how people experience AI in the future.

The Operating Systems team is critical in this mission, turning sophisticated hardware and AI capabilities into a reliable, trusted platform. Security is central to that work: we define trust boundaries, integrate hardware-backed protections, isolate sensitive context, and establish the guardrails that let AI applications and agents act safely, privately, and under user control.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Security Architect to define the security architecture for OpenAI’s next-generation operating system. You’ll work alongside hardware security architects and partner with operating system, silicon, firmware, privacy, and product teams to protect users, their devices, and their data.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can connect operating system internals, hardware-backed security, and real-world product constraints. Your work will shape the platform’s trust model, protect sensitive information, and set the technical foundations for AI that is safe, private, and under user control.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Define the operating system’s security architecture, trust boundaries, privilege model, and protections for sensitive user data.

 - Partner with hardware security architects to integrate roots of trust, secure elements, trusted execution environments, and processor security capabilities into the operating system.

 - Design foundational platform defenses, including secure boot, code signing, attestation, secure updates, key protection, and device recovery.

 - Establish isolation and access controls across the kernel, applications, system services, and AI workloads.

 - Define guardrails for how AI applications and agents access information, use sensors and tools, retain context, and act on a user’s behalf.

 - Lead threat modeling and architecture reviews across the platform, translating emerging threats into practical, enforceable requirements.

 - Prototype solutions, review security-critical systems code, and guide engineering teams through complex technical and product tradeoffs.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Deep experience designing or securing operating systems, kernels, embedded platforms, hypervisors, or other privileged systems software.

 - Complex understanding of operating system internals, including memory protection, process isolation, executable loading, device drivers, and privilege boundaries.

 - Experience building security architectures that span hardware, firmware, operating systems, applications, and cloud services.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Bring practical expertise in secure boot, code signing, device identity, attestation, trusted execution, and hardware-backed key protection.

 - Can write or review systems code in C, C++, Rust, or comparable languages, with a strong grasp of secure development and exploit mitigation.

 - Build rigorous threat models, influence cross-functional engineering teams, and communicate security tradeoffs clearly.

 - Care deeply about user privacy, personal agency, and building systems that earn trust through their design.


HELPFUL EXPERIENCE:

 - Shipping security technologies for consumer operating systems, mobile platforms, or connected devices.

 - Kernel hardening, memory-safety mitigations, virtualization-based security, or secure enclave integration.

 - Security architecture for AI agents, sensitive-context isolation, permissioned tool use, or prompt-injection resistance.

 - Device provisioning, manufacturing security, secure recovery, or lifecycle security for hardware products.

2c566ba53ec5.description:
About the Team

OpenAI and its capital and technology partners are building a global network of data centers for demanding AI workloads. The Infrastructure Quality team sets and verifies quality, reliability, and performance requirements for equipment across that network.

We work with manufacturing partners, general contractors, engineers, and operations staff from supplier qualification through commissioning. Together, we verify that equipment arrives ready for installation, startup, and long-term service.

About the Role

As a Manufacturing Quality Engineer for Data Center Modular Builds, you will own supplier manufacturing and integration quality for modular systems, including hot aisle containment (HAC), modular cooling units (MCUs), and electrical skids. Working with mechanical and electrical integrators and their suppliers, you will lead supplier qualification, support product and process development, and translate engineering requirements into manufacturing controls, inspections, and acceptance criteria.

You will partner with cross-functional teams to monitor production and integration quality, conduct audits, and resolve risks to integrated products acceptance and delivery. You will also serve as the primary quality contact for site escalations involving manufacturing or integration defects in modular systems and(OFCI) components. Through structured root-cause investigations, corrective action, and closed-loop learning (CLL), you will drive resolution and feed field lessons back into supplier processes to prevent recurrence and improve future builds.

Key responsibilities

Modular Systems Quality and Supplier Development

 - Lead supplier qualification and support product and process development for mechanical and electrical integrators.

 - Oversee manufacturing and integration quality for modular builds, including HACs, MCUs, and electrical skids.

 - Work with integrators and suppliers to translate engineering requirements and critical-to-quality (CTQ) characteristics into practical manufacturing controls, inspection points, and acceptance criteria.

 - Develop and drive supplier improvement plans (SIPs) using the Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) approach to strengthen manufacturing and integration processes.

 - Use production data, audit findings, test results, and supplier scorecards to identify systemic or recurring issues, prioritize improvements, and measure sustained results.

Site Escalations and Corrective Action

 - Serve as the primary quality point of contact for escalated site issues attributable to manufacturing and integration failures, coordinating containment and resolution with site teams and supplier factories.

 - Lead root-cause and corrective-action (RCCA) investigations using structured methods such as 8D and 5 Whys. Verify root causes, track corrective and preventive actions to closure, and confirm their effectiveness.

 - Apply closed-loop learning (CLL) to incorporate field findings and lessons learned into supplier and integrator manufacturing controls and future builds, preventing recurrence.

Manufacturing and Integration Monitoring

 - Partner with Quality Program and Manufacturing Operations teams to monitor production and integration progress, quality controls, inspection results, and factory test readiness. Identify emerging risks and coordinate timely action with suppliers.

 - Conduct product and process audits during and after manufacturing and integration to verify compliance with engineering requirements, approved procedures, and quality standards. Document findings and track corrective actions to closure.

 - Align production checkpoints, inspections, and factory testing requirements with suppliers, engineering, sourcing, supply chain, commissioning, and quality teams. Coordinate deviation resolution and escalate risks to equipment acceptance or delivery.

Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, or industrial engineering.

 - At least 10 years of data center industry experience spanning quality engineering and manufacturing engineering.

 - Experience working with integrators and suppliers across multiple tiers to manage quality throughout the product lifecycle, from OFCI component manufacturing through integration and site issue resolution, and drive product and process improvements.

 - Ability to define CTQs and acceptance criteria, develop inspection and test checklists, review test results, and maintain auditable quality records.

 - Experience monitoring supplier production, conducting product and process audits, managing controlled documents and deviations, and using supplier scorecards to drive improvement.

 - Demonstrated experience leading root-cause investigations and corrective actions for manufacturing or field issues using structured methods such as 8D and 5 Whys, and driving continuous improvement through PDCA.

 - Ability to coordinate supplier schedules and plan inspections and tests across multiple equipment programs.

 - Ability to communicate quality requirements, resolve issues, and coordinate decisions across suppliers, engineering, commissioning, sourcing, supply chain, manufacturing, operations, and construction teams.

 - Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40% of the time to supplier manufacturing facilities and data center project sites.

Preferred Skills

 - Technical knowledge of data center infrastructure, including mechanical, electrical, and controls systems.

 - Experience in supplier performance management for mission-critical facilities.

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Quality Manager, or Quality Auditor.

 - Experience in industrial or high-volume manufacturing environments.

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems.



About the Role

You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions.

You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground.

You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it.



This role is based in Tokyo. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.



In this role you will:

 - Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria.

 - Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review.

 - Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates.

 - Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence.

 - Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt.



You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software.

 - Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering.

 - Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security.

 - Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes.

 - Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders.



Additional experience includes:

Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas:

 - Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment.

 - Security community engagement: You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners.

 - Application security: You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities.

 - Automated remediation: CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases.

 - Detection engineering: You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior.

 - Cloud and identity security: You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross-account trust.

 - Security research: You’ve reverse-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research.

 - Agent security: You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. 

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-po

7e0b30c3f6ea.title: Brand Data Infrastructure Lead
7e0b30c3f6ea.description:
About the Team

The Growth team helps people and businesses discover, adopt, and get lasting value from ChatGPT and other OpenAI products. We partner with Brand Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, and Creative to connect marketing investment with customer and business outcomes. Our brand data infrastructure brings together media, audience, creative, and research data so teams can plan, measure, and improve brand investment across markets.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Brand Data Infrastructure Lead to own the data foundations that make brand marketing measurable and scalable. You will define how brand media, campaign, creative, audience, and research data are organized, connected, validated, and made available for decisions. This hands-on role combines brand and media expertise with practical data fluency, turning fragmented platform and partner outputs into dependable datasets and repeatable workflows.

This role sits within Growth Marketing and works closely with Brand Marketing, Media Operations, Growth Platform’s solutions engineering team, Data Engineering, and Data Science. You own Brand’s data roadmap, business definitions, source requirements, data-quality acceptance, and adoption. Engineering partners own production architecture, connector and pipeline implementation, instrumentation, and technical incident resolution. Data Science owns statistical methodology and model development.

Your first priority is to establish consistent campaign and creative taxonomies, dependable media and measurement feeds, clear data-sharing arrangements, and trusted reporting inputs. Build a foundation that supports TV/CTV, online video, social, audio, out-of-home, and other brand channels, with the coverage and history needed for brand tracking, lift studies, incrementally, and marketing mix modeling.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the Brand data infrastructure roadmap. Translate brand strategy, media plans, and measurement needs into prioritized data capabilities, source integrations, quality improvements, and reporting foundations. Balance business value, global coverage, delivery dependencies, cost, and sustained adoption.

 - Define shared data models and taxonomies. Establish consistent campaign, creative, channel, partner, audience, and market definitions, identifiers, reporting grains, and time conventions. Align stakeholders on how datasets connect and how metrics should be interpreted across platforms and markets.

 - Set source and integration requirements. Define the fields, granularity, history, coverage, refresh cadence, and reconciliation needed from platforms, agencies, publishers, and measurement vendors. Partner with engineering on data contracts, integration priorities, acceptance criteria, and ownership throughout the data lifecycle.

 - Enable Brand channels and partner data. Lead data readiness for TV/CTV, video, social, audio, out-of-home, and emerging channels. Ensure new partners and campaigns provide usable delivery, spend, audience, creative, and geographic data, working with Media Operations and channel owners on setup and reporting requirements.

 - Make Brand measurement data ready to use. Coordinate the datasets and metadata required for brand tracking, brand lift, geo experiments, incrementality studies, and marketing mix modeling. Work with Data Science on study requirements and comparability, and connect media and research outputs with relevant product and business outcomes.

 - Own vendor data access and governance readiness. Lead the marketing side of partner evaluation, onboarding, and service reviews. Define required data, delivery terms, permitted uses, and responsibilities with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Procurement, then make those requirements usable for engineering, vendors, and marketing teams.

 - Establish data quality and dependable operations. Set expectations for completeness, freshness, consistency, and reconciliation. Use source reports and delivered datasets to identify missing feeds, taxonomy gaps, duplication, and reporting discrepancies; assess business impact, coordinate resolution, and validate recovery with the accountable technical or vendor owner.

 - Build usable data products and handoffs. Partner with data and analytics teams on curated Brand datasets, reporting inputs, documentation, and self-service access. Maintain definitions, lineage, training, and support procedures so Brand leaders, regional teams, and measurement specialists can use the data consistently with less manual reconciliation.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring 8+ years of experience in marketing data, brand or media measurement, marketing technology, analytics operations, or related roles, including hands-on ownership of data capabilities that improved marketing decisions.

 - Have practical experience working with brand media and measurement datasets, including spend and delivery, reach and frequency, creative metadata, brand tracking, surveys, or lift studies. You understand differences in coverage, granularity, definitions, and comparability across sources.

 - Understand data models, identifiers, taxonomy, data contracts, and quality checks, and how they support brand lift, incrementality, and marketing mix modeling. You can interpret source extracts and reporting outputs, investigate discrepancies, and work effectively with measurement specialists.

 - Have helped enable TV/CTV or other Brand channels across platforms or international markets, partnering with agencies, publishers, and measurement vendors on their data delivery and reporting requirements.

 - Translate Brand needs into clear data requirements, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans for engineering and analytics partners. You can validate delivered outputs, explain business impact, and make responsibilities and dependencies explicit. Familiarity with SQL-based analysis is valuable; deep coding expertise is not required.

 - Bring strong vendor managemen

5008bea25ee3.title: Research & Development Site Lead (London)
5008bea25ee3.description:
Perplexity builds frontier intelligence systems for the world's most discerning users. We're rapidly scaling our technical team to meet this ambition, including with Perplexity London, our UK-based research & development hub.

We're seeking an exceptional R&D leader to serve as Site Lead for Perplexity London. As our senior leader in the United Kingdom, you'll shape Perplexity's presence in one of the world's leading AI & technology hubs. You'll exercise functional responsibility over a major technical portfolio, along with organizational responsibility for Perplexity London at large.

Joining Perplexity London as Site Lead represents an opportunity to build and scale a world-class R&D organization in a region known for technical excellence in AI. You'll enjoy autonomy and support from our cofounders (who each possess extensive research backgrounds) to make Perplexity London a leader in the UK AI ecosystem. You'll also help shape the growth of Perplexity Frontier Research https://research.perplexity.ai in London. This comes with the opportunity to define major parts of our technical agenda across multi-agent orchestration, reinforcement learning, continual learning, systems, and frontier evaluations.

Strong research and/or engineering chops are essential, along with the ability to build strong culture, inspire exceptional team members, and collaborate closely with leaders and colleagues around the world.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Head up Perplexity London, taking responsibility for what the site delivers, how it scales and its standing in the UK.

 - Work directly with Perplexity's cofounders & leaders in other offices so London's work connects to company priorities.

 - Shape how the London office runs day to day including its culture and quality bar.

 - Keep a working grasp of the detail weighing in on designs and research plans

 - Be the face of Perplexity in the UK AI community building relationships with universities, labs and at events.

 - Define our R&D agenda in London across numerous areas of AI and other technical disciplines.

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Extensive background in research and engineering, with evidence of real-world impact via shipped systems, published papers, and/or open source.

 - Has built, scaled, and led technical teams accountable for ambitious roadmaps.

 - Well connected in the UK or European AI community across industry labs and universities.

 - Knows at least one of our research areas in depth and can judge the quality of work in the others.

 - Used to collaborating across time zones with teams in the US.

b799c4a4da6e.title: Backend Engineer - Music
b799c4a4da6e.description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The organization is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.
Our team makes music videos easy for fans to discover and meaningful for artists, powered by scalable, intelligent infrastructure that grows with our catalog. We're building personalized music video playlists, sorting videos into meaningful categories, and learning which videos listeners are most likely to love, then helping that content reach the right people.
As a Backend Engineer, you'll help shape how millions of listeners experience music videos on Spotify, working alongside Data Engineers, Backend Engineers, and partners across product and design.

What You'll Do
Build and run production backend systems that improve how listeners discover and enjoy music videos. Design, develop, and evolve scalable backend services and APIs that support high-traffic parts of the Spotify app. Develop and maintain Java services and Scio data pipelines used by millions of listeners every day. Partner with product managers and engineers to solve complex problems and create smooth, enjoyable experiences for listeners. Contribute to system design, code quality, and reliable, well-run systems as part of an autonomous, cross-functional squad. Explore and experiment with AI tools available at Spotify to improve how we build and ship.
Who You Are
You have experience with Java or another JVM language, and familiarity with (or interest in learning) data pipeline tools like Scio, Apache Beam, or similar. You've built and operated distributed, high-volume services in production, ideally on a cloud platform such as Google Cloud Platform. You're comfortable with system design, data structures, and algorithms, and use data to inform how you design systems and make decisions. You work directly with partners to understand their needs and turn them into scalable backend systems, APIs, and pipelines. You enjoy working in teams where experimentation and iteration are part of everyday work. You care about code quality, reliability, and maintainability, and take pride in shipping well-crafted work. You bring a collaborative mindset and are comfortable working across team boundaries. Experience in data engineering or machine learning is a bonus, not a requirement.
Where You'll Be
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. This team operates within the US Eastern timezone for collaboration
The United States base range for this position is $151,942–$189,927 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.
 


Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

ff9a6d9af10e.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

 

 

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.

Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.

Location: We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.

The team you'll join: Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.

What You'll Work On

  • Cloud infrastructure. Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.
  • CI/CD and developer experience. Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.
  • Observability. Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.
  • Security and automation. Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.

You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • Have strong DevOps / SRE background designing and operating cloud infrastructure and production systems
  • Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform
  • Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience
  • Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code
  • Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security
  • Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost
  • Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required

Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.

Our Tech Stack

We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.

You don't need to know all of it. We don't expect proficiency in every part of this stack. Strong infrastructure fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than knowing every tool already.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Get to know Ledgy, the Platform team, and our internal users with an onboarding buddy
  • Explore our infrastructure and delivery workflows, and ship your first improvement
  • Analyze current state of our cloud infrastructure and propose meaningful enhancements

First 3 months:

  • Independently deliver improvements to CI/CD, observability, or infrastructure design
  • Share operational ownership and help reduce recurring friction for engineers
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and document what others need to operate our systems

First 6-12 months:

  • Own DevOps and SRE function and DevOps initiatives from problem definition through rollout and adoption
  • Deliver measurable improvements to developer experience, reliability, or cost
  • Help shape our platform's direction and mentor other engineers

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role

6783a4b6df82.title: Platform QA Chapter Lead (all genders)
6783a4b6df82.description: As Platform QA Chapter Lead on the Platform side at JustPlay, you’ll lead and scale quality assurance for our core app experience - the foundation that powers our games, live operations, and player rewards. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience. You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation. Job Responsibilities Own the full QA lifecycle for JustPlay’s app and platform features - from test planning and execution to reporting and defect management. Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability. Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort. Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle. Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.). Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team - setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks. Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks. Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations. Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences. Job Requirements 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams. Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments. Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines. Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles. Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams. Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset. Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion. Nice to have Experience in backend integration testing and API monitoring. Experience with contract testing frameworks such as Pact. Job Benefits Work-Life Balance and Flexibility : Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers Mental Health Support : Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work Training & Development : A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply Germany-Based Benefits : 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution State-of-the-Art Equipment : Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed A Relocation Package : Includes visa support for those who need it Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations Berlin Office Perks : Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment. Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer. About us Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. experience with comparable PLC platforms is also welcome Strong SCADA engineering skills - ideally Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum, but experience with another platform (e.g. WinCC, PCS 7, Ignition, Aveva, Zenon) plus the willingness to grow into WinCC OA is just as welcome Practical experience with loop checks, instrument calibration and signal troubleshooting, and with reading P&IDs, loop diagrams and I/O lists A structured, disciplined approach to documentation and change control, and the confidence to say no to a change that compromises safety or system integrity Good command of English; 5831b46219c1.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
5831b46219c1.description: The Role: We are looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the board management infrastructure for Openchip's next-generation data center accelerator platforms. In this role, you will own the complete board management solution from hardware definition and MCU integration through firmware development, bring-up, validation, and deployment. Your work will enable silicon bring-up, hardware validation, remote access, observability, and platform automation for our validation platforms and production systems. You will work across hardware and software domains, collaborating closely with silicon, hardware, validation, firmware, and system teams to ensure our in-house accelerator silicon can be brought up, debugged, validated, and accessed efficiently. This is a hands-on role combining embedded development, hardware integration, laboratory debugging, and technical leadership. Key Responsibilities: · Define and implement board management architectures for validation platforms, debug boards, and accelerator cards. · Evaluate, select, and integrate MCUs, management controllers, sensors, and supporting hardware components. · Develop firmware and software for power sequencing, telemetry, monitoring, voltage margining, reset control, and platform automation. · Evaluate, customize, and integrate technologies such as OpenBMC and other open-source management frameworks. · Enable remote platform access, recovery, and management capabilities for engineering teams. · Collaborate with hardware teams on schematic reviews, hardware integration, and bring-up requirements. · Create tools, scripts, and automation to improve validation efficiency and engineering productivity. · Support first-silicon bring-up, board debugging, and platform validation activities. · Debug hardware and firmware interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment. · Support manufacturing test, firmware provisioning, and lifecycle management processes. · Drive technical execution across multiple projects while contributing to architecture, risk reduction, and long-term platform strategy. · Generate design documentation, validation procedures, and engineering guidelines. Minimum Qualifications: · Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering , Computer Engineering , Embedded Systems , or a related field. · 5+ years of experience developing embedded firmware and software. · Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ development. · Solid understanding of digital hardware design and board-level electronics. · Experience reading and reviewing schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and hardware interface specifications. · Familiarity with I2C/SMBus, SPI, UART, GPIO, JTAG, and other common embedded interfaces. · Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related laboratory equipment. · Experience with Linux-based development environments. · Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualificacions: · Experience with OpenBMC, embedded Linux, Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or similar platforms. · Experience developing board management controllers, service processors, or platform management solutions. · Experience supporting silicon bring-up, board bring-up, or hardware validation programs. · Familiarity with data center, server, networking, accelerator, or HPC hardware. · Understanding of power sequencing, PMBus, telemetry, monitoring, and voltage margining concepts. · Familiarity with PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and other high-speed platform interfaces. · Experience developing automation tools using Python or similar scripting languages. · Exposure to manufacturing test, production provisioning, and deployment workflows. · Knowledge of secure boot, firmware update mechanisms, and remote-management architectures. Soft skills: · A systems-level mindset spanning both hardware and software. · Strong technical curiosity and a hands-on approach to engineering challenges. · The ability to work effectively across multiple technical disciplines. · Sound engineering judgment and a pragmatic approach to problem solving. · Ownership and accountability for delivering robust platform management solutions that enable successful silicon bring-up and platform validation. What We Offer? · A chance to work at one of the most transformative AI and silicon engineering companies in Europe with cutting-edge technology and industry leaders · We offer a remuneration package that values your experience · We believe in investing in our employees and providing them with opportunities for growth and career development · Join an innovative team and experience company growth · Travel within Europe, with occasional travel to Asia, to work with our teams and partners We are looking for outstanding people willing to join our mission to change the silicon industry and help build a better world. If you identify with Openchip, please contact us. At Openchip, we believe a diverse and inclusive team is the key to groundbreaking ideas. We foster a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential—regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or gender identity. 74951ea0340c.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
74951ea0340c.description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership. We're looking for a motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our Team Greenrock – Demand Division . Our Tech team owns Flix's Revenue Management System (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management. This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience. About the Role Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries. Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout. Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams. Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system. About You Education and Revenue Management expertise (must-have) Advanced degree ( Master's or PhD ) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics , or a related quantitative field Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management. Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus. Engineering and data craft Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets. Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production. Soft skills Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions. Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system. We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! What We Offer Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career Why Join Flix? At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey! dfdf33aad9d7.title: Insights & Data Analyst / BI Developer (m/w/d)
dfdf33aad9d7.description: Little Dot Studios Deutschland ist eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Social-Media-Agentur, ein Multi-Plattform-Produktionsunternehmen und digitales Mediennetzwerk – und zählt zu den weltweit führenden YouTube-Spezialisten für Marken aus Entertainment, Sport und Industrie (u. a. ARD, YouTube Health, MAN Trucks & Bus oder Creators wie Matthias Malmedie). Vom Standort München aus sind wir Teil eines globalen Teams von über 500 Digital-Expert*innen in UK, US, Deutschland und APAC. Gemeinsam betreuen wir mehr als 1.000 digitale Kanäle, betreiben über 250 eigene Social-Media- und sechs FAST-Channels und generieren weltweit über 11 Milliarden organische Views pro Monat . Damit diese Inhalte ihre Ziele erreichen, brauchen wir genau dich in unserem Team Data & Insights ! Für unsere Team am Standort München oder remote deutschlandweit suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Insights & Data Analyst / BI Developer (m/w/d) in Teilzeit (25 Std./Woche) – zunächst befristet auf 1 Jahr (mit Perspektive auf Verlängerung). Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Daten, Analysen und das Erlernen neuer Fähigkeiten. Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Aufgaben Datenanalyse & Performance-Optimierung: Du analysierst und verarbeitest große Datenmengen rund um Social Media, SEO, Paid Search und digitales Marketing, behältst alle relevanten KPIs im Blick und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Datenmodellierung & Automatisierung: Du baust saubere Datenmodelle in Google BigQuery , verarbeitest Daten mit SQL und Python , bindest Datenquellen über APIs an und entwickelst automatisierte Reportings sowie interaktive Dashboards in Looker . Schnittstelle zu Kreativ- & Mediateams: Du übersetzt komplexe Zahlen in verständliche Storys, präsentierst deine Erkenntnisse souverän und unterstützt unsere Projekt-, Kreativ- und Mediateams dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Vielfältige Kundenprojekte: Du treibst eigene Daten- und Insights-Projekte für ein breites Portfolio an Kunden voran – sowohl eigenverantwortlich als auch im engen Austausch mit unseren Entwicklern und Fachabteilungen. Qualifikation Erfahrung: Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data/Marketing Analytics, BI, Digital Marketing oder einem verwandten Umfeld (z. B. Traffic Management). Tech- & Daten-Skills: Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Datenverarbeitung mit SQL und Python sowie Erfahrung mit Google BigQuery . Social- & Reporting-Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit YouTube Analytics , der Meta Business Suite und gängigen BI-/Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio ). Development-Grundlagen: Erste Erfahrungen oder ein gutes Grundverständnis im Bereich Software Engineering / API-Anbindung. Storytelling mit Daten: Du kannst komplexe technische Analysen so aufbereiten und erklären, dass auch nicht-technische Teams sie sofort verstehen und nutzen können. Mindset: Du arbeitest akribisch, gut organisiert und proaktiv, denkst gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hast ein echtes Gespür für Social Media und internationale Trends. Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch. Nice-to-have (kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus): Erfahrung mit spezialisierten Python-Libraries (z. B. Mito oder Zeitreihenanalysen mit ARIMA ). Kenntnisse in Social-Intelligence-Tools wie Tubular oder Locowise . Benefits Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, mit deinen Analysen aktiv an unserem Wachstum mitzuwirken, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere strategischen Entscheidungen maßgeblich zu prägen. Liefere datenbasierte Impulse: Als wertvolles Mitglied unseres Teams hilfst du uns, Zielgruppen und Markttrends tiefgehend zu verstehen und unser Unternehmen gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. (Angepasst von „Trends deiner Generation“) Sorge für deine Zukunft vor: Mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) unterstützen wir dich dabei, schon heute langfristig und sicher für morgen zu planen. (Neu ergänzt) Bleib fit und gesund: Mit dem EGYM Wellpass unterstützen wir dich dabei, körperlich und mental in Bestform zu bleiben. Profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitsbedingungen: Wir legen großen Wert auf eine gute Balance – du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, mobil im Homeoffice zu arbeiten. Arbeite in einem inspirierenden Umfeld: Unser Team vereint entspannte Atmosphäre mit ehrgeizigen Zielen – hier gehen Spaß an der Arbeit und Erfolg Hand in Hand. Erkunde vielfältige Inhalte: Mit einer breiten Palette an Themen, von Sport über True Crime bis hin zu Nachhaltigkeit, bieten wir ein spannendes Umfeld, das weit über trockene Zahlen hinausgeht. Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Teamarbeit steht bei uns im Mittelpunkt – wir kommen regelmäßig zusammen, nicht nur in Meetings, sondern auch bei Team-Events, um den Zusammenhalt zu stärken. Genieße die Atmosphäre im Büro: Unser Büro in der Macherei bietet nicht nur hervorragenden Kaffee, sondern auch die Gelegenheit, nach der Arbeit bei einem gemeinsamen Getränk zu entspannen. Bitte bewirb dich ausschließlich auf Englisch (mit deinem englischen CV und gerne auch einem Anschreiben auf Englisch). Deine Bewerbung geht bei Anna ein, die dir auch vorab gerne deine Fragen beantwortet. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

4d1832f41f99.description: Titanom ist ein KI- und Softwareunternehmen mit Fokus auf digitale Produkte in Bildung, öffentlichem Sektor und angrenzenden Bereichen. Unsere Mission ist es Lösungen zu entwickeln, die nicht nur technisch funktionieren, sondern im Alltag bestehen – langfristig, sicher und nutzerorientiert. Deine Rolle als Software Engineer: Mit Code innovative Lösungen gestalten In unserem agilen Team entwickelst du moderne Webanwendungen und KI-Features. Du baust skalierbare Architekturen, integrierst Machine-Learning-APIs und schaffst intuitive User Experiences. Wir arbeiten hauptsächlich mit TypeScript, Next.js und React bzw. mit Python und FastAPI – aber neue Ideen und ein cooler TechStack sind immer willkommen. Dein Impact bei Titanom: Entwicklung & Optimierung moderner & nutzerzentrierter Web-Apps (Frontend & Backend) mit Technologien wie z. B. Next.js, TypeScript und Python Integration von KI-Technologien zur Verbesserung der User Experience in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Teams, um innovative Lösungen für reale Probleme zu entwickeln Optimierung von Webanwendungen für Skalierbarkeit, Geschwindigkeit und Performance und sichern der Codequalität durch Tests, Debugging, Optimierung Erstellung von Libraries & Packages , die echten Mehrwert schaffen Erforschung & Umsetzung innovativer Use-Cases mit modernsten KI-Technologien von Large Language Models bis zu Vision Transformers Teilnahme an Code-Reviews und aktive Mitgestaltung der Entwicklungsprozesse Kreative Problemlösung – auch für Machine-Learning-Aufgaben Lernen & Wachsen : Teilnahme an wöchentlichen Workshops zu Software Engineering & Machine Learning Requirements Wir suchen Entwickler:innen mit Ownership-Mindset & Umsetzungsstärke: Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Mathematik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Praxiserfahrung in der Web- oder Softwareentwicklung mit Interesse an Fullstack-Entwicklung Freude daran, Features von der Idee bis zum sauberen Production-Release zu bringen Erfahrung mit CI/CD und automatisierten Tests Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (min. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (min. B2) Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Hands-on-Mentalität Interesse an KI-Themen wie LLM-APIs, RAG, Vector Search und Motivation, sich in Vision-Modelle einzuarbeiten Deine Vergütung Für diese Position bieten wir ein Fixgehalt im Bereich von 50.000 bis 60.000 EUR pro Jahr , abhängig von deinen individuellen Stärken und Erfahrungen. Uns ist wichtig, dass du von Anfang an weißt, woran du bist – deshalb kommunizieren wir die Gehaltsrange offen und transparent. Im persönlichen Gespräch finden wir gemeinsam heraus, welche Einstufung am besten zu dir passt. Denn wir glauben daran, dass Transparenz und Wertschätzung mehr sind als Worte. Benefits Flexibilität und Zeit für dich: Flexible Arbeitszeiten (keine Kernarbeitszeit), 30 Tage Urlaub und eine transparente Überstundenvergütung. Lernen als Teil deines Arbeitsalltags: Alle zwei Wochen erwarten dich Workshops zu verschiedenen aktuellen Top-Themen - damit du Neues lernst und dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst. Raum für deine Entwicklung: Übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte deinen Karriereweg in einem wachsenden Unternehmen aktiv mit. Gute Ausstattung und Extras: Arbeite mit einem MacBook und profitiere von steuerfreien Zusatzleistungen wie 50-Euro-Gutscheinen oder einer Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft. Ein Kühlschrank voll mit deinen Lieblingsgetränken: Wir bieten eine umfangreiche Getränke-Flat! Ein Büro mit vielen Möglichkeiten: Unser gut erreichbares Büro bietet Gym, Sauna, Ruheraum und Dachterrasse - dazu Nintendo, Tischtennis, Kicker. Gemeinsam etwas bewegen: Arbeite in einem ambitionierten Team, das eine gemeinsame Vision verfolgt. Erfolge zusammen feiern: Freu dich auf gemeinsame Events - vom Ski- und Wellnesswochenende über den Oktoberfestbesuch bis zu weiteren Firmenfeiern. FAQ – Häufige Fragen zur Stelle bei Titanom Welche Technologien kommen in dieser Position zum Einsatz? Du arbeitest mit einem modernen Tech-Stack, der unter anderem Next.js, TypeScript, Python und React umfasst. Außerdem setzen wir auf innovative KI-Technologien wie Large Language Models und Vision Transformers. Brauche ich Vorerfahrung mit KI-Technologie Nein, Software-Entwicklung-Erfahrung reicht. Wir bieten umfassende Einarbeitung und 10% Education Time für kontinuierliche Weiterbildung. Welche Qualifikationen sind erforderlich? Ein Studium in einem passenden Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik) ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Quereinsteiger:innen , die sauberen Code zu schätzen wissen und praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mitbringen, sind bei uns ebenfalls herzlich willkommen. Welche Soft Skills sind wichtig? Wir suchen jemanden mit Motivation und Drive, Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung, einem hohen Qualitätsbewusstsein, einer Hands-On-Mentalität und der Fähigkeit, kreativ Probleme zu lösen – auch im Bereich Machine Learning. Zudem solltest du Lust auf deine persönliche Entwicklung haben und Lernbereit sein! Gibt es Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung? Ja, absolut! 06ddcc808489.title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
06ddcc808489.description:
Job description

Team & Reporting Line: Program Management Team | Reports to Lead Project & Procurement Manager

Our Mission 

At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth – where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions.

From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world.

Your Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-driven team player to join our Product and Quality Assurance (PQA) team, with a strong focus on Flight Software Product Assurance.

In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of both flight and ground software across our growing satellite constellation. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality, and operations, helping to shape how we build and deliver software in a fast-moving, mission-critical space environment.

The PQA team defines and maintains the company’s quality and Product Assurance standards. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring our software meets the highest levels of robustness, compliance, and reliability, supporting mission success in both orbit and ground operations.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complex, technical environments, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable balancing structured quality processes with the pace of a rapidly scaling space organisation. You will be trusted to take end-to-end ownership, bring clarity to ambiguity, and help embed strong engineering discipline across the software lifecycle.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust Software Product Assurance (PA) programme, reporting directly to the Product Assurance Manager.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of Software Product Assurance across both flight and ground software for our satellite constellation.

  • Ensure rigorous application of software configuration management and release processes, maintaining strong version control, traceability, and engineering discipline.

  • Enforce compliance with safety-critical and mission-critical software standards, with a strong focus on risk reduction and failure prevention.

  • Define and oversee software testing, verification, and validation strategies across all development and delivery phases.

  • Investigate, manage, and resolve software anomalies throughout development, testing, integration, and operational phases.

  • Support Spacecraft Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) activities, ensuring software readiness and compliance at every stage.

  • Coordinate and lead software deliveries from suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal standards, schedules, and quality expectations.

  • Participate in subcontractor reviews and key technical meetings, working closely with procurement engineers and Product Assurance stakeholders.

  • Balance the demands of rapid development cycles with the need to maintain strong Product Assurance and software quality standards in a fast-paced space environment.

Job requirements

About you 

Required: 

  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

  • Proven experience in Flight Software Product Assurance within the space industry.

  • Strong understanding of software testing, verification, and validation in safety-critical environments.

  • Experience with embedded flight software for satellites, spacecraft platforms, or payload systems (experience with FDIR highly desirable).

  • Strong proficiency in software configuration management tools and processes.

  • Familiarity with ECSS standards, particularly ECSS-Q-ST-80C (Software Product Assurance) and ECSS-E-ST-40C (Software Engineering).

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with experience in risk management and anomaly investigation.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines, with a proactive approach to risk identification and escalation.

  • Strong team mindset, with a desire to help build and shape a growing organisation.

  • Comfortable working independently, taking ownership and delivering in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Nice to Have: 

  • Experience with automation, scripting, or AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. prompt-based workflows).

  • Exposure

137ad48762ce.description: TYTAN Technologies The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build. You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change. Your roadmap to make an impact The closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. Inject IMU, GNSS, camera and other sensor data at the interface the hardware expects, close the loop on actuator commands, and keep latency, jitter and time synchronisation within budget, so a flight on the rig behaves like a flight in the air. Fault injection: Sensor failures, GNSS denial and spoofing, link loss, bus errors and power faults, reproducible on demand. System rigs: Rigs for the current and next generation mission computer and for full system configurations with ground station, radio link and interceptors. Provisioned as code, with automated deployment of builds, remote power control, health monitoring and self-recovery. HIL in CI: Merge-gating regression suites, nightly and long-running mission suites, rig scheduling across pipelines, flaky test detection, and structured results traceable to requirements. Test framework: Fixtures for devices, instruments and simulators, so that a domain engineer writes a HIL test as easily as a unit test, and the same scenario runs in SIL and HIL. HIL as a product: Your users are our autonomy, perception and systems engineers. Availability and time to result are your metrics, also in restricted and air-gapped lab networks. 4+ years building HIL or hardware test systems for embedded or autonomous systems, including at least one closed-loop rig you designed and built yourself, not only operated or wrote test cases for Real-time simulation coupled to hardware: plant and sensor models running in real time against real hardware, on commercial HIL platforms or custom Linux-based rigs Expert Python, plus C or C++ for real-time components Strong Linux and CI: self-hosted runners with hardware in the loop, containerised test environments, device management, remote power and console control Debugging across the hardware and software boundary: embedded interfaces such as CAN, UART, SPI and Ethernet, and timing problems you have measured, not guessed Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience Nice to haves Flight or vehicle dynamics models, and PX4 or ArduPilot SITL/HITL HIL platforms such as dSPACE, NI PXI/VeriStand or Speedgoat Sensor stimulation at the hardware interface: IMU, GNSS, camera and video injection Time synchronisation (e.g. PTP), real-time Linux and jitter measurement Test frameworks at scale (pytest or Robot Framework) and instrument control via SCPI or VISA FMI/FMU or Gazebo-based simulation MAVLink and flight controller interfaces GNSS simulators (e.g. Spirent, Safran Skydel) and RF environment simulation Camera and image generation pipelines for perception testing Requirements-based testing in DO-178C or ISO 26262 contexts Rust for performance-critical test components Firmware for test fixtures on microcontrollers End-of-line test stations Why TYTAN? f54929b60105.description: ABOUT BEAMERY With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations.
