Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. What's the opportunity? 

We’re looking for Staff Product Engineers to join the AI Group to build Fin's AI-powered products. Product Engineers working in ML work closely with both our ML Scientists and product teams. They must deeply understand our product, our customers, our ML tech stack and our broader product stack. 

Our group is responsible for defining new ML features, researching appropriate algorithms and technologies, and rapidly getting first prototypes in our customers’ hands.

  • Partner with product teams outside of our group, to shape the best AI-powered product experience for our customers..

  • Play an active role in the hiring, mentoring, and career development of other engineers.
  • Raise the bar for technical standards, performance, reliability, and operational excellence within the group and across Fin.

Profile we’re looking for 

These are meant to be indicative, not hard requirements.

  • 10+ years of experience shipping high-quality products.
  • No ML experience required. We believe you can be highly effective immediately by bringing excellent software engineering skills, and learn ML as you work on the team.
  • You can demonstrate significant impact in the work that you have done.
  • You take pride in having strong technical fundamentals; you love learning and are willing to work hard to invest in your development.
  • Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Javascript etc.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here!
  • Strong willingness to fight for good outcomes
  • Bias towards progress over perfection

Team description

SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads.

What you'll do

  • Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework
  • Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components
  • Contribute to build system integration across the platform
  • Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing
  • Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting
  • Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services
  • Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO
  • Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage

76c41acaa339.title: Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
76c41acaa339.description: Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock. As Applied AI Engineer (all genders), you work like a forward deployed engineer, embedded with our internal teams. AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team. The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem. Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here. As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process. What to expect Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost. Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up. Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building. Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback. 202c6de3fa1e.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
202c6de3fa1e.description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: Team's mission Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do. Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Our users do this work all day, so a clumsy interface is how a task turns back into a ticket for us. Our clients are already asking what AI can do for their operations teams. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it. Upfront is part of the Clients Tribe at Upvest. Together with the Public API and Tooling Apps teams we enable Upvest’s business to scale efficiently, accelerate our client’s time-to-market and embed intelligence and automation into client processes. Your mission You’ll focus on building what actually creates value for our clients. While our OKRs set the destination, we expect you to help map the route. We prioritize impact and shipping speed over a perfectly groomed backlog. Because you're on a client-facing team, the quality of your output directly impacts client trust – especially since we are handling their customers' money. In our domain, the bar is high: anything touching client funds must be correct and auditable, or it's an incident. We will give you the client context, access, and autonomy to figure out what needs building, rather than just handing you a rigid spec. We also expect you to challenge our internal processes if they are slowing down your efficiency or shipping speed. What you’ll do: Take operational problems from concept to production, working across our React/TypeScript frontend and Go backend services. Own modern interface security. Upfront is where external users act on real end-user data, so you will tackle per-client isolated environments, least-privilege access, and Auth0 integrations in a regulated space. Expand the operational surface across Upvest's internal domains and develop a deep understanding of how our core systems piece together. Help define how software delivery works in an AI-enabled company by pushing AI tooling to its limits to maximize quality and speed while staying compliant. Build agentic operations as we move toward exposing Upfront over MCP. Every action requires a strict audit trail, so you will solve real design problems around what an agent can do autonomously versus what requires human intervention. Work in weekly cycles with bi-weekly retrospectives to prioritize high-quality, high-frequency shipping. What you bring: A strong product engineering mindset where you care about the "why" just as much as the "how" and proactively bring ideas to the table. Solid backend experience in Go, Java, or Kotlin (we build in Go but will give you time to ramp up). Practical experience building modern client-facing interfaces using React and TypeScript. Experience building products that require per-customer configuration without devolving into a custom fork per client. Deep knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices. A strong focus on quality, extensibility, and automated testing. True end-to-end ownership across containers, CI/CD pipelines, and relational data modeling. A working understanding of event-driven architectures. A pragmatic approach to engineering and the ability to make smart tradeoffs under constraints. Real-world experience using AI tools to drive software engineering workflows, not only writing code snippets . The ability to navigate undefined problems and align other teams without needing formal authority. It’s great if you have: Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general. Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users. Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation. Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing). How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Wellbeing: Re

af29e5cb21b4.description: Walaris designs and develops AI-driven, software-defined, and hardware-enabled autonomous systems for defense and security applications. Our cutting-edge technology is utilized by customers across the defense, national security, government, marine, and critical infrastructure protection markets worldwide. Software engineers at Walaris are at the core of our company, tackling complex and mission-critical technical challenges with the latest technologies. They integrate real-time machine learning and image processing systems and are constantly designing innovative software solutions to provide best in class capabilities. Working in cross-functional, international teams, our engineers consistently strive to exceed customer expectations. For our office in Nuremberg, we are looking for a C2 Software Engineer (m/f/d) starting in April 2027. Responsibilities Develop command-and-control (C2) systems to meet operational and technical requirements derived from strategic company objectives Integrate Walaris software and technology into military and security systems to add autonomous capabilities and boost overall system performance Develop software solutions that improve system reliability, deployment velocity, and developer experience Own and deliver complex features end-to-end across the full stack, from web-based frontend interfaces through distributed backend services and technical design through production deployment iteration Ensure compliance with relevant military safety and quality standards Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that requirements from R&D, sales, and product management are fully integrated and effectively addressed throughout the development process Requirements Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, or a comparable qualification Professional experience in the development of complex software systems with strong proficiency in Rust, C++, or Python Experience with distributed systems and system integration Hands-on experience with multithreading and concurrency, asynchronous and distributed systems, containerized architectures (e.g., Docker-based environments), messaging systems (e.g., ZeroMQ, DDS, NATS, or similar), and performance optimization and system tuning Expertise in software development on Linux platforms Solid understanding of networking protocols and communication Preferred Qualifications Experience with high-availability and fault-tolerant systems Understanding of real-time and deterministic system requirements Experience with sensor integration and We offer creative freedom, competitive compensation, and a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions truly matter. 912101c6fb0d.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
912101c6fb0d.description:
Kurz und knapp

Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?

Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in Falkensee bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.
  • Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.
  • Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit.
  • Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.
  • Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität:  Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung. Dazu bieten wir ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

b8bb2bf60379.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. YOUR IMPACT You will deliver the helium refrigerator and cryogenic distribution for Proxima's Alpha coil test facility, taking these systems from requirements and process design through procurement, installation and commissioning. procedures, and support operation on site close to Munich WHO YOU ARE A team player who loves challenges and is not afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes A proven track record of pressure relief devices to recognised standards (e.g. ISO 21013, ISO 4126), and using process or system simulation tools such as EcosimPro or Aspen HYSYS for helium refrigeration plants or similar Experience with pressure equipment design to EN 13445 or AD 2000, and with CAD Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not Role Overview

  • Build and deliver frontend features for the Portal using React and TypeScript.

  • Experience with server-side rendering frameworks such as Next.js.

Even better would be

  • Experience writing developer tools, internal packages, or SDKs.
  • Contributions to open-source projects.
  • Experience in startup or fast-paced environments.
  • Deeper familiarity with real-time or WebSocket architectures.
  • (Not a must) Proficiency in one or more backend languages / frameworks (e.g. Node.js / Express / NestJS / TypeScript, or similar)

What we offer

bbc252da258a.description: We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join the Practice Efficiency team at Doctolib. Your mission will be to define and deliver how AI transforms the daily work of healthcare professionals — through intelligent scheduling, automated document processing, smart task management, and AI-assisted patient communication. As a Principal-level individual contributor, you will own the deepest technical challenges within the Practice Efficiency scope: setting the AI architecture bar, driving rigorous evaluation standards, and directly shaping how AI-powered features reach healthcare professionals and their patients at scale — starting with the Phone Assistant, currently one of Doctolib's most strategic product bets. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Own end-to-end AI architecture decisions for Practice Efficiency — from model selection and agentic system design to production deployment patterns,, and strategic build vs. buy calls Architect and deliver agentic applications at scale, defining how Practice Efficiency AI features are structured, evaluated, and iterated on in production Design robust, scalable AI infrastructure: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimisation, and observability — enabling the team to ship reliably and fast Lead the technical delivery of the Phone Assistant's AI capabilities, balancing ambitious product ambitions with engineering rigour and production reliability Ensure responsible AI delivery in a regulated healthcare context, embedding explainability, GDPR/HDS compliance, and human-in-the-loop design across all Practice Efficiency AI features Partner closely with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into sound technical decisions, acting as a bridge between engineering depth and product delivery Who you are Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply. Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted’s Marketing domain is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from winning the USA market to expanding beyond fashion into a multi-vertical platform.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Marketing Data Science and Analytics team to hands-on build, refine, and scale our core predictive and explanatory models. In this role, you will be the technical engine behind our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM), user value machine learning models, and advanced statistical frameworks. Your focus will be on engineering robust, high-performing models that transform complex data into the precise insights our domain relies on.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Evolve Our Marketing Measurement: Code, calibrate, and scale our Bayesian Media Mix Models (MMM) and ROI frameworks to unlock precise business insights.
  • Build and Deploy Core Models: Build and maintain sophisticated econometric and statistical models (MMM, GMV, engagement) to quantify marketing impact and guide multi-channel growth.
  • Automate Model Validation & Health Monitoring: Design automated frameworks and reliability metrics that continuously monitor model health and ensure long-term accuracy.
  • Build Next-Gen, Automated Capabilities: Drive the ambition toward intelligent data products [such as self-healing MMMs] using modern AI and automation to optimize model runtimes and scale our ecosystem as Vinted grows.
  • Partner with Decision Scientists & Marketing Leadership: Act as the core technical partner, translating complex mechanics into clear concepts and helping the team connect model outputs to robust business decisions.
  • Champion Modelling Excellence: Maintain a high bar for code quality, rigorous validation, and reproducibility to ensure our data science practices remain clean and trusted.

About you 

  • Proven Data Science Experience: Hands-on experience focused on advanced statistical, econometric, or time-series modelling (experience in marketing measurement/MMM is an advantage).
  • Deep Theoretical Knowledge: Strong foundation in advanced statistics, causal inference, and regression. Familiarity with probabilistic programming (e.g., PyMC) is a major plus.
  • Research-to-Application Mindset: Ability to read scientific papers, explore state-of-the-art techniques, and replicate or adapt advanced methodologies to solve complex problems.
  • Production-Grade Engineering: Highly proficient in Python, with a passion for building models as data products. You design your pipelines and code so they are modular, reproducible, and easily used or extended by other scientists.
  • Business-Minded Tech Partner: You care deeply about the why behind your code, naturally connecting technical model outputs to commercial metrics and business outcomes.
  • Educational Background: A Master’s or PhD degree in a highly quantitative discipline (Statistics, Econometrics, Mathematics, Data Science, or similar).
  • Impactful storyteller: A charismatic and confident presenter who navigates any topic’s technicality, actively driving and facilitating strategic business conversations across both technical and leadership audiences.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

91703d7b4210.title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training (f/m/d)
91703d7b4210.description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models. Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work. Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming. Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg. We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes. Requirements At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before. As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor. Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful: Test Driven Development (TDD) Trunk based development Continuous integration Domain Driven Design Nice-to-haves Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase. 938a0747e363.title: Senior/ Lead AI Deployment Engineer - Supply Chain
938a0747e363.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with strong platform expertise and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Senior/ Lead Deployment Engineer, you are the hands-on owner of Celonis delivery for your customers. You run the engagement end to end —understanding the business challenge, designing and building the solution on the platform, driving its adoption, and quantifying the value it delivers.

What sets the role apart is the depth you bring —platform mastery, domain & process insight, and the customer relationships— that turn a working solution into business-critical value. Celonis's AI tooling accelerates the build, so your time goes to the solution design, the customer, and the outcome.

The Work You’ll Do

  • Run discovery workshops with business and IT stakeholders, translating strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases.
  • Build and configure the analytical core on the platform—data models, process analyses, and dashboards —directing Celonis's AI deployment tooling to move fast and validating every output for accuracy and business relevance.
  • Lead value workshops to pinpoint root causes of process inefficiencies and define the KPIs that quantify business impact.
  • Design and deploy the operational solutions —automations, action flows, and AI-powered insights— that put the platform to work in users' day-to-day decisions.
  • Present business cases to senior (VP- and C-level) stakeholders and secure their sign-off on the value realization plan.
  • Drive adoption: Enable key users to run and extend the solution independently, and document design decisions for a clean handover.
  •  Manage delivery against timeline, scope, and customer expectations.
  • Act as a subject-matter expert in pre-sales, helping shape and scope engagements (approach, solution blueprint, and effort estimates).

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era

  • You work with AI agents as your primary tools - You set the direction while AI agents do the heavy lifting of the build—bringing the intent, context, and judgment that make the output right for the customer.
  • You turn ambiguous business needs into precise, executable intent—the specification and context engineering craft that most separates great delivery from average.
  • You work at the frontier, experimenting as the tools evolve, finding what works, and raising the bar for the whole team. 
  • You build to last—AI reaches a first result in minutes, and you make sure what ships is robust, intuitive, and ready to scale. 

The Qualifications You Need

  • Supply Chain Experience: 4+ years in Management, IT or data consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors. For Senior DE: 6+ years with demonstrated project leadership.
  • Systems fluency: Hands-on familiarity with the systems where supply chain runs: SAP (MM/SD/PP, S/4HANA, APO/IBP) or equivalents such as Oracle, Kinaxis, o9, or Blue Yonder. 
  • Data & technical skills: Deep data fluency: proficiency in SQL and Python, strong data-modelling skills, and ease turning large, complex datasets into an analysis-ready foundation. You reason about data structurally, with an instinct for relationships, granularity, and data quality. Prior hands-on experience with Celonis is a plus. 
  • AI fluency: Curiosity and comfort using AI-assisted tools in your work (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.), and the willingness to keep learning as they evolve. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
  • Business and process expertise : Strong understanding / deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise Supply Chain processes and performance metrics. 
  • Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
  • Consulting & communication: Ability to steer customer workshops, present to manage

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Agentic Developer Experience Engineering team led by Benoit Lateltin, AI Transformation Program Lead.

The team currently consists of 3 Software Engineers, 100% dedicated to building the agentic tooling powering all of Mirakl Labs. Together, you'll be designing, shipping and running AI agents and assistants that transform how 330+ engineers, Product Managers, Designers and QAs work every day.

Please note this role requires to be based 4 days at the office, per week.

Your Impact

  • Build agents and assistants as products - across the full software development lifecycle (code review, tech design, maintenance, incident response), from first prototype to tools teams genuinely rely on every day.
  • Define and expand AI delegation safely - set the human control points, guardrails and evaluation frameworks; measure the autonomy rate per task type and extend what agents handle as trust builds over time.
  • Turn team pain points into working software - sit with engineers, PMs, QAs and designers to find the real friction, prototype fast, pilot with volunteer squads, and scale what works.
  • Build the knowledge infrastructure agents consume - along with tooling for usage, cost and impact monitoring, leveraging the Data & Agentic Platform and DevExp foundations rather than rebuilding them from scratch.
  • Make every product measurable - adoption rate, time saved, quality, cost: nothing ships without its metrics.

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, Developer Productivity, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, with experience building reliable, maintainable and production-ready systems
  • Hands-on experience building and operating AI-powered products, using LLMs, RAG and AI Agents
  • Experience applying AI to software development workflows, such as code review, technical design, testing, documentation, maintenance or incident response
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and integrating developer tools, code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, issue trackers or documentation platforms
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving their reliability, quality and level of autonomy, through appropriate evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop mechanisms
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments

1038ae725f0d.title: Senior Optical Design Engineer
1038ae725f0d.description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. Overview We are expanding our optomechanical capabilities, and the success of our projects depends on optical designs that are precise, manufacturable, and verified through rigorous analysis and testing. As a Senior Optical Design Engineer, you will own optical designs from concept through lab validation, turning requirements into lens designs and optical assemblies that perform reliably in the real world. This position is central to our mission of delivering cutting-edge free-space optical systems for space applications, and it will support successful pre-production runs and strong collaboration with our suppliers. This position reports to our Responsible Engineer, Optical Systems, and is based in our Toulouse, France office. Our working language is English. What you will be doing Design and optimize lenses and optical systems, from first-order layout to detailed optimization with ray tracing and physical optics propagation (POP). Carry out tolerance analysis and Monte Carlo simulations to predict manufacturing and assembly yield, and define realistic tolerances with suppliers. Conduct STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analysis with mechanical engineers, verifying performance and margins across operating conditions. Conduct stray light analysis. Produce lens and optomechanical drawings, and work with mechanical engineers to ensure designs are manufacturable and assemblable. Define assembly, alignment, and bonding procedures, and support their implementation in clean room environments. Plan and execute lab assembly and test, covering alignment, characterization, and performance verification of prototypes and flight-representative hardware. Characterize components and assemblies through optical metrology, and identify discrepancies . D rive root-cause investigations and design iterations. Work with suppliers on design for manufacturing, tolerancing, inspection, qualification, and pre-production runs. What you bring to this role A Master’s degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field, with a strong foundation in geometrical and physical optics. 5+ years of experience in optical design, including lens and optical system design , optimization and STOP analysis. Proficiency in Zemax OpticStudio, including sequential ray tracing and optimization. Hands-on lab experience in optical assembly and test, with working knowledge of metrology instruments such as interferometers, wavefront sensors, MTF benches, autocollimators, and centration measurement tools. Experience with spaceborne optics or qualification to space-relevant standards, such as ECSS. Selection of adhesives, coatings and optics materials. Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot problems across simulation and hardware. A proactive mindset and a commitment to high standards of quality and performance. Bonus points Experience with free space optical communication systems . Python and ZOS-API skills for automating analysis or processing data. Experience with ANOVA methodology, including Gauge R&R studies and statistical post-processing in tools such as JMP. Practical knowledge of cleanroom practice, optics cleaning, adhesive bonding . a358a8aeea82.title: Research Data Scientist
a358a8aeea82.description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 Explore your future career 🔭 We are looking for a Research Data Scientist to take ownership of Marketplace Economics and Public Thought Leadership within our specialized Research team, reporting directly to Marc Palyart (Director of ML). Working alongside two Machine Learning Researchers, you will be Malt's go to expert in applied economics and causal inference. You will combine rigorous econometric methods with a pragmatic, product and business oriented mind modeling two-sided marketplace dynamics (liquidity, fee elasticity, supply-demand balance, search frictions) to directly improve product conversion. Some of the questions you might explore : - How is the freelancing market evolving in time ? What drives supply and demand in freelance markets, and how do workers and companies respond to changing economic conditions? - What makes a market place efficient and what are the frictions that prevent beneficial matches ? How to solve these frictions ? - How do prices, platform fees, and supply and demand elasticities shape marketplace dynamics and participants' behavior? Key responsibilities ✨ Marketplace Economics : Investigate the economic mechanisms driving marketplace dynamics, supply-demand imbalances, liquidity, pricing elasticity, and matching efficiency. Applied Causal Inference & Experimentation: Formulate falsifiable economic hypotheses, design quasi-experimental and experimental setups (Diff-in-Diff, Instrumental Variables, Fixed Effects), and isolate true causal mechanisms within complex, multi-sided platform interactions. External Research & Flagship Thought Leadership: Co-author Malt’s research publications as well as macroeconomic barometers in close partnership with Marketing, translating raw platform telemetry into compelling public narratives for industry leaders and tier-1 media. Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, ML, Marketing, and C-Suite stakeholders to identify high-impact research questions, challenge assumptions, and uncover underlying economic mechanisms. Hands-On Data Engineering & Modeling: Write clean SQL on BigQuery and engineer robust, reproducible analytical pipelines in Python, leveraging modern AI-assisted tools to maximize research velocity. About you 🧑‍🚀 Academic Foundation: PhD (or Master's degree with equivalent proven empirical research track record) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Social Sciences, or a related empirical discipline. Strong Quantitative and Research Background Empirical Econometrics & Modeling: Proven expertise in microeconomic modeling, causal inference, and empirical identification strategies (e.g., panel data, Instrumental Variables, Diff-in-Diff, selection models). Applied Research Mindset: You combine scientific rigor with a pragmatic approach to solving real-world economic problems. You know how to adapt your methods and the depth of your analyses to the question at hand. Hands-On Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Statsmodels, SciPy) and high-level SQL on modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google BigQuery, Snowflake). Stakeholder Fluency: Exceptional ability to scope ambiguous problems, communicate complex econometric findings to non-technical leaders, and constructively challenge stakeholder assumptions. Full professional proficiency in English. If you're excited about using unique marketplace data to explore meaningful economic questions, shape real-world decisions, and contribute to a deeper understanding of the future of work, we'd love to hear from you! 12b452216eb4.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do As DFT Engineer, you will define and own the Design-for-Test strategy of our next-generation SoC from the ground up. This is not a role where you inherit an existing flow, scripts, or team — you build it. You will work closely with RTL design, physical implementation, and our test partners to make our chips manufacturable, testable, and ready for volume production. Required Skills and Experience 10+ years in DFT, with at least one full SoC tape-out owned end-to-end — not just one slice of a large team effort. Strong hands-on experience with one major DFT suite: Siemens Tessent, Synopsys TestMAX / DFTMAX / TetraMAX, or Cadence Modus. Scan insertion and test compression (EDT / DFTMAX / Modus-type). MBIST and memory repair integration. JTAG / IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), IEEE 1500 wrappers. ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, path delay), coverage analysis and improvement. DFT verification: gate-level simulation of patterns, timing-aware checks. Test-mode SDC / STA understanding. Scripting: Tcl, Python. Experience in silicon bring-up and ATE debug. Language: English at a proficient level. Responsibilities Define DFT architecture and test strategy — coverage targets, test time, pin budget — in collaboration with Siemens experts and our design team. Implement hands-on: scan insertion, compression, MBIST, JTAG/IJTAG/IEEE 1500 wrappers, ATPG, sign-off. Drive DFT verification: gate-level simulation of test patterns and timing-aware checks. Support physical design and STA for test modes — constraints, scan timing closure. Be the bridge between RTL design, physical implementation, and the ATE / test house for silicon bring-up. Deliver patterns to ATE and debug failing patterns with the test house. Contribute to DFT tool evaluation and set up a reusable, scalable flow. Preferred Qualification Experience at advanced nodes (7nm and below). Experience with large AI/HPC or multi-core SoCs, NoC-based designs. Hierarchical DFT on large designs. Has participated in a DFT tool selection or flow setup from scratch. Logic BIST, in-system test, or functional safety (ISO 26262) exposure. Yield analysis and diagnosis (e.g. Tessent Diagnosis, YieldInsight). Pay and benefits Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions. Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers). Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays. Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1919 

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities:

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

  • Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS
  • Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C/C++/Rust skills
  • Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise

Preferred Qualifications:

You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.

db6f79769ced.description: Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. eebe227c25ee.title: Senior Software Engineer, Customs
eebe227c25ee.description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Customs Matters More Than Ever

International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.

That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.

The opportunity: 

Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.

Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.

Things we ❤️

  • Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way
  • Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows
  • Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform
  • Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases

You will:

  • Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.
  • Work on systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities and the process of moving cargo in and out of countries.
  • Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.
  • Geek out about shipping, customs regulations and logistics. (We do this often.)
  • Figure out the most efficient way for our customers and partners to participate in the process of moving freight across borders.
  • Design and build deep, complex integrations with government agencies and partners.
  • Automate archaic customs filing processes and save the operations team thousands of phone calls per week.
  • Deliver supply chain insights to logistics teams via a world-class analytics experience.
  • Create beautiful and efficient domain models for the incredibly complex world of freight forwarding.

You should have:

  • ≥ 5 years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.
  • A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, designers and engineers alike.
  • A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.
  • A desire to develop your tooling repertoire. We are tech-agnostic regarding candidate background, but our platform is built with Ruby.
  • Non-optional: an aptitude for learning quickly.

How we work:

  • We come to the office at two to three times a week to hang out, have lunch, white board, and collaborate
  • We have the latest and greatest hardware and software for you to work with
  • We’re agile, but not married to a single doctrine like scrum. The teams decide how they work best.
  • Stack: we’re coming from a React/Flow + Ruby on Rails monolith, and moving to React/Typescript, Kotlin Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love GraphQL, GRPC, Postgres, Kafka and Snowflake

What's in it for you?

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis 
  • Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. 
  • A defined pension contribution scheme
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours.

3e7ab2ca7f13.title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
3e7ab2ca7f13.description:
Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable

Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform.

About the Team

The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on.

You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it.

The Challenge

Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering:

  • Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure.
  • Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets.
  • Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones.
  • Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes.
  • Modern storage back-ends: public cloud services and S3-compatible object storage built on Pure FlashBlade//S and NetApp StorageGRID in our own datacenters, plus a long-term archiving tier.
  • Security first: immutability, segregation and hardening in a highly secure environment where recoverability is the ultimate guarantee.

Your Role

As a Platform Engineer, you take full responsibility for the lifecycle of the platform: architecture, deployment, evolution and reliability. You treat the platform as a product: you improve features, drive innovation and keep the user experience of customer teams in mind. You work closely with technology vendors (primarily Commvault) and push their product teams to improve, while applying standardized guardrails, driving automation and following best-in-class practices.

Your focus is on making day-2 operations simple and cost-effective, so there is room to implement new security features, streamline customer onboarding and enable new projects. You also guide customers in their data protection needs, contribute to RFIs/RFPs, and help scope and design new solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the architecture and lifecycle of a multi-tenant data resilience platform, in line with our plan-build-run methodology.
  • Design and ship self-service capabilities that customer teams use independently, end to end.
  • Automate everything repeatable: deployments, tenant onboarding, configuration and platform operations, using Infrastructure as Code.
  • Ensure platform availability, aiming for 100% uptime and maximum customer satisfaction.
  • Evolve a diverse storage back-end across public cloud and on-prem S3-compatible solutions.
  • Enable customers to protect workloads on VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and more.
  • Work with vendor product teams and drive their roadmaps.
  • Provide hands-on advisory and technical support, contribute to RFI/RFP processes, and help design new solutions.

Who Are You?

  • First and foremost, you are a platform engineer at heart, and you like building things other engineers rely on. A passion for data protection, security and resilience is a plus, and you’ll grow it here.
  • You enjoy teamwork, thrive on challenges and like collaborating with both peers and customers.
  • You’re comfortable in highly secure, complex environments.
  • You have a solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures and security concepts.
  • You are proficient in Linux and/or Windows ecosystems.
  • You have experience across private (VMware/OpenStack) and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
  • You’re skilled in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible and/or Chef) and in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).
  • Experience with data management/protection tools is valuable, whether Commvault, Rubrik or similar, but not a must. We’ll teach you the domain; you bring the engineering craft.

More information?

Do not hesitate to call Maggie: 06 23 75 70 86.

Only application submitted through the website will be considered. 

Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. 
 
It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

43adc377f82b.title: Platform Engineer
43adc377f82b.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.
As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do

You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

  • Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.
  • Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.
  • Boost developer productivity by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles.
  • Drive reliability and scalability through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions.
  • Improve platform operations usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively.
  • Collaborate and innovate by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.

What You'll Bring

You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.

  • Cloud-native expertise: At least 5 years of production experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Automation mindset: Experience automating workflows and CI/CD pipelines and working with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Observability experience: Hands-on experience using and maintaining tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry to improve reliability and performance.
  • Strong ownership: You proactively address platform issues and work toward long-term scalability and resilience.
  • Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions.
  • Continuous learning: You keep developing your knowledge of cloud-native tools, technologies, and practices in a fast-moving ecosystem.

How We Work

The Platform Horizontal supports engineering teams across Catawiki by reducing infrastructure complexity and providing reliable, secure, and scalable foundations.

  • We collaborate closely with product teams to understand their challenges and improve their development experience.
  • We favour self-service capabilities, reusable solutions, automation, and measurable, gradual improvements.
  • We share knowledge and treat reliability, security, quality, and developer experience as shared responsibilities.

6937c7ddd41e.title: Frontend Engineer
6937c7ddd41e.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

Join one of Catawiki’s main Development Verticals, Demand, Supply or Fulfilment, and help us improve the experience of buyers, sellers, and internal teams across our platform. Working alongside Backend, Frontend, iOS, and Android Engineers, you’ll build product innovations for Catawiki’s apps and web app.
You’ll collaborate closely with QA, UX Designers, Product Managers, and with the support of a Tech Lead Manager to create beautiful, adaptable web frontends on top of scalable microservices. While your product area may vary, your goal will remain the same: deliver reliable, high-quality experiences that make a meaningful impact for our users.

What You'll Do

Here at Catawiki, you will make an impact by improving and delivering product innovations for the Catawiki platform:

  • Build impactful product experiences by improving and delivering innovations across the Catawiki platform for buyers, sellers, customer service, and internal operations teams.
  • Create adaptable web frontends on top of scalable microservices using our core frontend stack of TypeScript and ReactJS.
  • Deliver responsive, accessible experiences that work well across desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.
  • Optimise product performance by measuring and monitoring systems and using insights to improve the experiences you build.
  • Experiment and learn by partnering with Product Managers and UX Designers on A/B tests, using data analysis to validate ideas and iterate.
  • Collaborate across disciplines with engineers, QA, design, and product colleagues to build scalable and maintainable solutions.

What You’ll Bring

You are a Frontend Engineer with extensive frontend experience in multiple technologies, with an impressive portfolio of past frontend deliveries, and eager to expand your knowledge and impact, ready to take the next step in your career. As a Senior Developer, you are effective in lifting the level of your team, and you love to cooperate with Frontend Engineers of other teams.

  • Extensive frontend experience: Demonstrated experience as a Frontend Engineer, using JavaScript or TypeScript as your main stack, with a strong portfolio of frontend deliveries.
  • Strong web foundations: Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, along with an understanding of HTTP/S, the Critical Rendering Path, CORS, caching, and CDNs.
  • Modern frontend expertise: Familiarity with libraries and frameworks such as ReactJS, NextJS, Redux, CSS Modules, Tailwind, and/or Rails.
  • Product-focused collaboration: Proven experience in product companies, working closely with engineers and Product Managers as part of an autonomous, cross-functional team.
  • Production ownership: Experience designing, implementing, deploying, monitoring, and managing applications with a focus on availability, latency, and consistency - you build it, you run it, you love it.
  • Quality-minded engineering: An understanding of principles such as SOLID and DRY, with consideration for accessibility, security, SEO, performance, testing, observability, internationalisation, and typing when building features.
  • Collaborate and grow with your team: You take initiative, welcome new challenges, help raise the level of your team, share knowledge across teams, and actively expand your skills and impact.
  • Experiment, learn, and iterate: You validate ideas quickly, iterate based on insights, and are willing to discard what does not work - then build validated solutions for long-term scalability
