eb7218757e5e.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, SPACE - Sandbox Platform)
eb7218757e5e.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

SPACE is Perplexity's sandbox platform. It's the isolated execution layer behind Perplexity Computer, the public Sandbox API, and a growing set of agent products. Every time an agent writes code, runs a tool, opens a browser, builds an app, or works on a user's files, it runs inside a SPACE sandbox.

We built our own sandbox platform that lets us build the exact platform our products need: real pause and resume, forking, rolling snapshots, credential isolation, fine-grained network policy, and enterprise-grade encryption. The work spans low-level virtualization and networking, distributed state machines, petabyte storage, and careful API design. Reliability, security, and cold-start latency are all things our customers feel directly.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and build core sandbox infrastructure for running untrusted, agent-generated code safely, quickly, and at scale.

 - Own sandbox isolation and security end to end, working with Security Engineering on defense in depth for compute, networking, storage, and sensitive information.

 - Build stateful systems that manage long-lived execution environments and keep user data durable and correct through failures.

 - Drive performance and efficiency across the stack, from startup latency and resource density to cost.

 - Run sandbox infrastructure as an always-on production service, setting the bar for reliability, observability, capacity planning, and incident response.

 - Define clear platform interfaces and APIs so internal teams and external developers can build on sandboxes with confidence.

 - Provide technical leadership: mentor engineers, write clear design docs, and make long-term architectural decisions that keep the platform simple, secure, and able to evolve.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience designing and running production backend or infrastructure systems

 - Strong distributed systems experience: you've built and operated systems that coordinate state across many nodes, and you're fluent in consistency, consensus or leader election, idempotency, retries, and failure handling at scale.

 - Strong system design skills for stateful systems where correctness under failure matters.

 - Hands-on experience with Linux systems and modern infrastructure (for example AWS, Kubernetes, and container or VM runtimes).

 - Comfortable with security-sensitive systems and making pragmatic trade-offs between isolation, performance, and velocity.

 - Collaborative mindset and eagerness to work on hard problems with other experienced engineers.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, KVM, gVisor, Kata, or other virtualization and sandboxing technology.

 - Experience with snapshotting, copy-on-write filesystems, or block storage.

 - Experience with Linux networking (namespaces, eBPF, egress filtering) or secrets and key management.

 - Experience with custom scheduling, multi-cluster orchestration, or distributed state machines.

 - Experience building developer-facing APIs and SDKs, or code execution and agent infrastructure.

If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed above.

83113e42a06e.title: Design Engineer, Notion.com
83113e42a06e.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Web team builds Notion.com http://Notion.com to inspire current and future customers. We tell the story of what’s possible with Notion, give people ideas for what they might make themselves, and route them to the place of greatest impact: learning more, getting in touch with sales, or making their first workspace.

We’re looking for a frontend engineer with a designer’s eye and a toolmaker’s instincts. Someone who can take an idea from a rough sketch to a working prototype to a beautifully finished experience. You care about the shape of a letterform, the rhythm of a page, and what happens in the few milliseconds after someone clicks. You also care about how it’s built—and whether a simpler way exists.

The tools are changing what’s worth attempting. An idea you might once have set aside can become a working experiment; a tool you wished existed can become part of your practice. Working with agents should give you more room to follow those instincts—to try another direction, throw away an approach that isn’t working, or spend longer on the detail that makes the whole thing click. We’re interested in what you make with that room.

The Web team at Notion is changing around that possibility. We are a small team that’s focused on making unusually good things, with fewer handoffs, simpler systems, and more time spent on work that deserves human attention. You’ll help us get there: making new experiences on notion.com http://notion.com and building tools that take care of the repetitive work. There’s plenty here to question, plenty to make, and room to surprise us.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll be shipping to Notion.com http://Notion.com faster than we do today, working directly with Creative, Marketing, Growth, or Product Marketing, and leaving jigs and agent loops behind you: components, scripts, and workflows that review code, triage alerts, and watch flows like login and pricing.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll be a daily driver of the site, from end to end, with your fingerprints all over the reusable pieces behind it, the monitoring that catches problems early, and the habit of retiring pages, code, and dependencies that stop earning their place.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Taste. You have a deep feel for typography, grids, proportion, and restraint. You can make something feel alive without adding more to it. You can explain why a detail matters—and recognize when it doesn’t.

 - Exceptional technical ability. Semantic HTML, modern CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, React, and the browser’s layout, rendering, and animation systems are materials you know well. You build accessible, responsive, fast experiences, and your work feels as considered in the browser as it does in a mockup.

 - 8–12 years of experience in frontend development or design engineering, and a bachelor’s degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction (HCI), or related field.

 - Ability to treat code as a creative medium. Your process includes quick experiments, discarded approaches, and prototypes other people can actually use. You can move quickly while an idea is uncertain, then slow down for the details that make it worth shipping.

 - You make tools that leave more room for craft. You notice when a task starts repeating and build the jig: a component, script, or agent workflow that makes the next pass easier and more precise. You know what to standardize and what to leave open, so the tool supports your eye without making every result look the same

 - Agents are already part of how you build. You’ve gone beyond autocomplete. You can show us workflows you’ve put together, what they do on their own, how you check their work, and what you’ve learned when they go wrong.

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision ba

AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Tooling and process

85247bea8ee7.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Spain
85247bea8ee7.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
As an FDSE your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.
 
Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

Our Principles
Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better. Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter. Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on-site, to understand and solve their problems. Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves. Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge. Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers.
What We Value
A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools. Experience or interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users. Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision.
What We Require
1+ years of relevant, post-college work experience. Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science. Strong coder with shown proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar. Ability and interest to travel up to 25%, as needed to client sites, but flexible based on personal preferences. Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance. Spanish language fluency.
Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.

This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. 

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP’s headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. 

About You

You're an engineering leader who cares about getting security-critical systems right and who wants to reach customers fast, not sit buried in a backlog. You think in specs and failure modes, you stay close to the code, and you're already using AI tooling to change how your team builds, not just how quickly they move. You'll take over a small, strong team and own how the world's most demanding manufacturers authenticate, provision, and govern access for their people and, increasingly, the AI agents acting on their behalf. 

What skills do I need?

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with direct involvement building and operating security-critical or identity/access systems in production
  • 3+ years of people management experience leading a software team, where you've hired, given constructive feedback, and grown engineers
  • Hands-on depth with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, OIDC, and SCIM in enterprise environments — you understand the specs and their failure modes, not just the libraries
  • Experience building multi-tenant systems where tenant isolation is a hard requirement
  • Working knowledge of IAM, secrets management, and access policy across AWS and Azure, including the tradeoffs when customers span both
  • A track record of shipping clean, tested code and holding a team to the same standard
  • Active use of AI tooling in your own practice, with a point of view on how it changes the way teams build
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent working experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for identity & access — SSO/SAML/OIDC federation, SCIM provisioning, multi-tenant account structures, and the authorization layer across Tulip's multi-cloud infrastructure.
  • Represent Identity & Access in cross-functional architecture reviews and roadmap decisions.
  • Lead and grow a small, high-caliber team — run regular 1:1s, set quality standards, give direct feedback, and develop engineers on security-critical systems.
  • Protect operations where failures carry tangible stakes—from halted production lines to scrapped material and compliance risks. What you ship here has a direct impact on customers. 
  • Drive adoption of AI tooling in how the team builds — code review, test generation, spec drafting, and agent loops — and share what works across engineering.
  • Create and own difficult tradeoffs on IAM and access policy where tenant isolation and enterprise compliance are non-negotiable.
  • Ship work that reaches customers quickly and reliably, with operational excellence as the default.

Key Collaborators

  • Platform Engineering 
  • Product Management
  • Customer Success

Working At Tulip

We’re building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

70448f65947a.title: (Senior) Flight Safety Engineer (f/m/d)
70448f65947a.description:
Mission Brief 

At Isar Aerospace, we are enabling affordable and flexible access to space. As Europe’s leading privately funded launch company, we are developing and operating launch vehicles that provide reliable access to orbit for commercial and institutional customers worldwide. 

To support the continued development and operation of our launch systems, we are looking for a (Senior) Flight Safety Engineer to take ownership of flight safety engineering activities across vehicle development, licensing, and launch operations. In this role, you will drive the flight safety framework for our launch vehicles and act as a key interface between engineering, regulatory authorities, and launch range partners. 

As a (Senior) Flight Safety Engineer in the Mission and Launch operations team, you will work at the intersection of engineering, risk analysis and mission operations. In that frame, you will ensure that our launch systems meet the highest standards of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance throughout the vehicle lifecycle. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission 

  • Own system-level flight safety engineering activities for launch vehicle development and operations.  
  • Define, manage, and verify system requirements related to Range Safety Systems (RTS) and Flight Termination Systems (FTS), ensuring compliance with range and regulatory requirements.  
  • Support mission licensing activities and regulatory approvals, including preparation of safety analyses and compliance documentation.  
  • Coordinate with RAMS department to perform Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Modes and Effects Analyses (FMEA), Failure Modes, Effects and Criticality Analyses (FMECA) to support the safety case.  
  • Coordinate closely with Avionics, GNC, Flight Software, Propulsion, Structures, and Operations teams to ensure safety requirements are properly integrated into system design.  
  • Support the development, maintenance, and validation of debris and fragmentation models to assess flight safety risks and support mission approvals.  
  • Support flight safety analyses including trajectory risk assessments, casualty expectation calculations, and launch commit criteria development.  
  • Contribute to anomaly investigations, root cause analyses, and continuous improvement of flight safety methodologies and processes.  
  • Support the evolution of Isar Aerospace's flight safety standards, tools, and engineering practices. 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Master's degree or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.  
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in launch vehicle flight safety, system safety, reliability engineering, launch vehicle development, missile systems, or a comparable aerospace environment.

383c346336f4.description: About the Role Our flight-control system is already flying Skyron400. Now we want to make it faster, sharper and more capable. As our Senior Flight Control & State Estimation Engineer, you will take technical ownership of the control and estimation capabilities that determine how precisely our interceptor estimates its state, how quickly it reacts and how aggressively it can operate without compromising stability or robustness. From advanced estimation and control algorithms to embedded Rust optimization and flight-test analysis, you will set technical direction, make decisions based on real flight data and drive measurable improvements in aircraft performance. What is your Day to Day Mission: Take technical ownership of flight-control and state-estimation architecture, priorities and validation. Improve state estimation using Kalman filters, IIM, particle filters and model based approaches. Fuse IMU, radar, camera and ToF data into robust vehicle and target-state estimates. Increase the accuracy of velocity and position estimation in GPS-denied environments. Optimize sensor filtering, synchronization, outlier rejection and latency compensation. Own the design, implementation and tuning of flight-control algorithms for maximum agility, precision and stability. Identify real flight dynamics from recorded data and use them to improve models, estimators and controllers. Improve sensor and vehicle models used in simulation, SIL and HIL environments. Profile and optimize flight-critical Rust code for deterministic execution and minimum latency. Plan and lead flight-test analysis, identify performance limits and turn every flight into the next improvement. What You Bring to the Team This is a senior flight-control role. We are looking for deep expertise in flight-control design and tuning, together with a strong understanding of how control, state estimation, sensing and embedded implementation interact as one complete system. At least four years of professional experience developing and tuning flight-control systems, including implementation and testing on real systems. Experience with drones or other UAVs is strongly preferred. Exceptional candidates coming directly from university may be considered only if they can demonstrate at least three years of substantial hands-on flight-control experience through projects, research programs, student teams or comparable work, including implementation and testing on real systems. Deep foundations in control theory, state estimation, sensor fusion and flight dynamics. Hands-on experience with Kalman filters, nonlinear estimation or probabilistic filtering. A proven track record of designing, tuning and validating controllers for highly dynamic systems. Strong implementation skills in Rust, C++ or another systems programming language. A strong understanding of real-time execution, numerical stability, sensor timing and latency. Hands-on experience with simulation, system identification, flight-log analysis and flight testing. The drive to challenge existing performance limits, test ideas quickly and keep iterating until the data proves the improvement. Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. Be at the forefront of next-generation Defence innovation . Work in a fast-paced, agile environment where your ideas make an impact. Collaborate with a team of industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. Opportunities for individual and professional growth in a globally recognized organization. About us: Quantum Systems specializes in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in the defense, security, and public sectors. The Mechanical and Biomedical Engineering department is looking for an engineer with strong practical and analytical skills.   • Presenting results, both internally and to clients

  • An excellent academic record, studying for or having completed a relevant Engineering degree
  • A solid understanding of core engineering fundamentals and physical principles
  • A genuine enthusiasm for tackling real-world problems through engineering
  • A creative and analytical approach to problem-solving and concept generation

In addition, experience in any of the following areas would be advantageous (but not essential):

  • Familiarity with engineering tools such as Python/MATLAB and 3D CAD software

  • Relevant industrial or project experience

It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization. That's why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled. Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you'll feel at home at Supermodular AI. Your role As an AI Client Executive at supermodular.ai , you will own the development of strategic enterprise relationships and turn complex AI transformation opportunities into meaningful, long-term engagements. You will work directly with senior technology and business leaders to understand where AI can create material impact in their organizations. This means going beyond selling predefined services. You will need to understand how an organization operates, identify the problems worth solving, and work with our technical team to turn those problems into engagements we can execute. You will own the commercial relationship from the first conversation through closing and account expansion. 9ab75e720db1.description:
As Microsoft continues to push the boundaries of AI, we are looking for passionate individuals to work with us on some of the most interesting and challenging AI questions of our time. Our vision is bold and broad: to build systems with true artificial intelligence across agents, applications, services, and infrastructure. It is also inclusive: we aim to make AI accessible to consumers, businesses, and developers so that everyone can realize its benefits.

Microsoft AI (MS AI) is seeking an experienced engineer to help build and operate the evaluation platform that supports large-scale model training and development. We’re looking for someone who combines strong systems engineering fundamentals with operational excellence and who can build reliable evaluation infrastructure at scale. This role will work closely with researchers and training teams across our European offices to ensure evaluations are reliable, efficient, and available when teams need them.
We seek a versatile engineer who can build solutions that stand the test of time and who brings positive energy, empathy, and kindness to the team while remaining highly effective in a fast-paced environment.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
This role is based in London, U.K., or Zurich, Switzerland. Candidates are expected to be local to the applicable office and work in the office four days per week.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary engineer for the evaluation platform during European hours, providing dedicated coverage for the evaluation stack supporting large-scale model training.
  • Develop and extend core evaluation platform capabilities, including benchmark configurations, problem sets, graders, and evaluation runners.
  • Improve evaluation throughput and scheduling efficiency.
  • Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and dashboards to proactively detect evaluation degradation.
  • Partner closely with researchers and training teams across European offices to define evaluation requirements, coordinate launches, and unblock experiments.
  • Contribute to technical design and code reviews across the evaluation platform stack, and maintain high-quality operational documentation and on-call runbooks.
  • Embody our culture and values.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field AND 4+ years of technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, Python, C++, Go, or Rust;
  • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field AND 2+ years of technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, Python, C++, Go, or Rust;
  • OR equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated experience operating production distributed systems, including participation in a formal on-call rotation.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, including experience working in a large, shared, typed codebase.
  • Experience debugging distributed system failures across the stack, including scheduling, resource exhaustion, networking, and process-level faults.
  • Willingness and availability to participate in a scheduled on-call rotation covering European business hours.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GPU-based workloads, distributed training, or large-scale inference infrastructure.
  • Experience with distributed compute frameworks and schedulers, such as Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm, or comparable systems.
  • Experience with observability and alerting tooling, such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation, benchmarking, or reinforcement learning training infrastructure.
  • Track record of reducing operational burden through systematic reliability improvements, automation, or tooling.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing requirements and deadlines.

 

The typical base pay range for this role across Switzerland is CHF 183,800.00 - CHF 309,700.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

Find additional benefits and pay information here: https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/switzerland-corporate-pay

https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

3777 - Associate, Data Engineering, UK

Role Summary and Impact

DTA is WPP’s global data products and technology arm. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by building the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.

We work with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through the Open Media Studio, an AI-enabled media and data platform for the next era of advertising.

We’re endlessly curious. Our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

You will work with the Measure data platform – a unified system for data connection, ingestion, transformation, and reporting – built on a robust technology stack including Adverity, GCP, and PowerBI. In this role, you will support client projects that aggregate diverse data sources into a single, unified view, helping to ensure data integrity and consistency to enable comprehensive insights. Under the guidance of senior team members, you will focus on understanding specific client requirements and learning to develop visualisations that deliver on them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Essential

  • Foundational experience or academic project work involving bringing disparate datasets together in data visualisations.
  • Hands-on experience or coursework working with Power BI.
  • A basic understanding of data modelling, data integrity challenges, and general best practices.
  • Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

Desirable

  • Basic exposure to Cloud platforms: GCP (preferred) or others.
  • Experience with using SQL, Python and other languages to query, analyse, or transform data.
  • Basic understanding of digital marketing and/or web analytics data.
  • Exposure to DBT (Data Build Tool).
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Jira or Confluence.
  • Exposure to working in a technical team that uses Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Basic understanding of version control tools like GitHub/GitLab.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. 3165 - Account Director, Data Operations  - GCS

Role Summary and Impact

 

The Data Delivery & Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end coordination, quality assurance, and governance of media data within the Cockpit programme across multiple markets. Acting as the central point of contact between local market teams, global Nestlé stakeholders, and external data partners, this role ensures the timely delivery of accurate, high-quality data that supports MMM modelling and business decision-making. The successful candidate will drive process consistency, manage complex stakeholder relationships, resolve data-related issues, and oversee programme timelines to ensure smooth and efficient execution across all participating markets.

Data Delivery and Project Management

Own and maintain the Cockpit refresh calendar for all participating markets, ensuring alignment with MMM modelling timelines.

  • Coordinate with local market teams, data processing vendors (e.g., Redmill), and global & z-EUR Nestle to ensure timely submission of accurate data to meet cockpit calendar.
  • Manage ad-hoc refresh requests and assess feasibility against resource and process constraints.

Data Quality Assurance

  • Review and validate incoming media plan data for completeness, accuracy, and adherence to agreed formats (e.g., no channels with impressions but zero spend).
  • Perform central QA checks before data is loaded into Cockpit, or oversee local QA when/if decentralised.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies (e.g., spend, impressions, reach) with local teams.

Process Governance & Standardisation

  • Enforce agreed actualisation processes for Cockpit markets
  • Ensure consistent application of data governance rules, including mandatory metrics, cost allocation, and added value treatment.

Stakeholder Management

Act as the central point of contact for the cockpit program between:

  • Local OpenMind (OM) market teams
  • Global Nestlé stakeholders (e.g., Z-EUR, IT)
  • Data processing vendors (e.g., Redmill)
  • Facilitate alignment calls to resolve blockers and ensure all parties are informed of timelines, dependencies, and changes.
  • Communicate clearly on delays, risks, and mitigation plans.

Primary Skills

  • Strong background in media planning, buying, or media operations with a deep understanding of campaign structures, channels, and metrics.
  • Experience managing multi-market data workflows and working with multiple stakeholders across geographies.
  • Proven ability to interpret and troubleshoot media data (spend, impressions, reach, CPM/CPC calculations).
  • Strong project management skills, able to manage multiple deadlines and priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical data issues to non-technical stakeholders.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

cdd24347380e.title: Centre of Excellence Senior Engineer
cdd24347380e.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

At Nscale, our Infrastructure Operations team plays a critical role in maintaining service availability, driving operational excellence, and ensuring our global data centre estate operates safely, reliably, and efficiently.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We are hiring a Centre of Excellence Senior Engineer to help define, standardise, and continuously improve the way Nscale operates its global data centre estate.

This is a senior technical role for someone with deep infrastructure operations experience who enjoys solving complex problems, leading operational improvements, and driving consistency across multiple data centre locations.

You'll work closely with Infrastructure Operations, Engineering, Deployment, and Platform teams to establish best practices, improve operational efficiency, lead major infrastructure initiatives, and help shape the future operating model for one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies in the world.

This role requires occasional travel to Nscale data centres across multiple countries to support deployments, operational improvements, and critical infrastructure initiatives.

What you'll be doing

Infrastructure Operations & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead complex infrastructure projects, including hardware installations, upgrades, and operational improvement initiatives.

  • Drive standardisation across Nscale's global data centre estate by developing repeatable operational processes and best practices.

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and service reliability.

  • Support the development of Nscale's Centre of Excellence as the operational authority for infrastructure operations.

Incident Management & Technical Leadership

  • Take ownership of complex infrastructure incidents from diagnosis through to resolution.

  • Lead major incident response activities and coordinate technical teams during critical events.

  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement long-term corrective actions to improve platform resilience.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to operations teams across multiple locations.

Capacity Planning & Infrastructure Optimisation

  • Partner with cross-functional teams on capacity planning and infrastructure optimisation initiatives.

  • Support operational readiness for new deployments and infrastructure expansion.

  • Help develop scalable operational models that support rapid business growth.

Documentation, Standards & Governance

  • Own the creation and continuous improvement of operational documentation, standards, and runbooks.

  • Define and maintain operational procedures for incident management, planned maintenance, and communications.

  • Ensure consistency of operational execution across all Nscale data centres.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Deployment, Platform Engineering, Network Engineering, and Operations teams.

  • Travel to data centre sites to support deployments, resolve complex technical issues, and improve operational excellence.

  • Build strong relationships across the business to drive alignment and influence operational best practices.

About You

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical infrastructure, data centre, or operations environment.

  • Extensive experience working within large-scale data centre environments.

  • Proven ability to solve complex, systemic infrastructure issues and deliver long-term operational improvements.

  • Strong analytical and structured approach to troubleshooting and problem solving.

  • Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple sites or operational teams.

  • Advanced technical certifications relevant to infrastructure operations.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting hyperscale, HPC, AI, or NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.

  • Hands-on server deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting experience.

  • Strong customer service mindset with experience supporting mission-critical infrastructure.

Leadership & Attributes

  • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Self-starter with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.

  • Passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement.

  • Able to influence without direct authority and build trusted relationships across teams.

We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! 63ecebba06df.title: Lead Platform Engineer
63ecebba06df.description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start. The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself. This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter. Principal Accountabilities Platform Architecture and Engineering Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines.  Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time. Infrastructure as Code and Automation  Deliver and manage all infrastructure through Terraform and secure CI/CD, so that every change is automated, repeatable, version-controlled, tested, and reversible. Drive manual change and configuration drift towards zero.  Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management. Security, Governance, and Compliance  Embed security, governance, and compliance throughout the platform lifecycle, implementing effective policies, access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, and configuration standards.  Collaborate with Allica’s Security, Engineering, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms meet organisational, regulatory, and control requirements, supported by clear documentation and auditable evidence.  Identify and manage architectural risks, security vulnerabilities, control gaps, and technical debt, ensuring remediation actions are prioritised, tracked, and completed. Platform Operations and Service Ownership  Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements. Lead the response to complex incidents, own the root-cause analysis, drive out repeat causes rather than repeat fixes.  Use service data, operational experience, and FinOps practices to continuously improve platform automation, resilience, engineering standards, cost visibility, forecasting, and resource optimisation. Team Leadership  Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers while remaining personally hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and the hardest technical problems.  Set the technical bar and raise it, through coaching, design review and the example of your own work. Personal Attributes & Experience  A strong track record architecting, and running production Azure environments at scale. Fluent in landing zone and subscription design, private networking, containerised compute, API management and resilience patterns across zones and regions. Line Management Experience Extensive hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure at scale, infrastructure as code, containerised runtimes, identity and observability.  Has carried production accountability for systems that matter. Comfortable in handling incidents.  Treats developer experience as a product. Talks to engineering teams, watches how they actually work and designs for adoption rather than mandate.  Treats regulatory and security requirements as engineering constraints to design around, not obstacles to route past. Prior regulated or high-assurance experience helps but is not a prerequisite.  Gets adoption by building things engineers want to use and by making a clear case, not by escalation.  Prefers the boring, well-understood solution unless the problem genuinely demands otherwise. Willing to remove things. Desirable Experience  Architecture or engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform.  Experience working in complex, regulated, or security-sensitive environments. Knowledge of Kubernetes, container platforms, serverless services, and cloud-native application patterns.  Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD technologies.  Familiarity with FinOps, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and cloud-control frameworks.  Relevant Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud

31f72652c724.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role The Material Flow Engineer designs, builds, and optimizes the end-to-end physical movement and presentation of hardware from receiving docks through warehousing, kitting, and lineside delivery, to support high-rate production schedules and rapid manufacturing scale. This role owns the physical-to-digital operating mechanisms that translate factory layouts and inventory data into executable material handling workflows, including Plan for Every Part (PFEP) management, facility layout engineering, and custom material handling hardware design. You will serve as the connective tissue between Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, driving inventory accuracy, eliminating lineside bottlenecks, and deploying low-CAPEX, high-impact floor solutions before scaling to automation. In addition to daily floor execution, you will partner closely with Design Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Facilities to support New Product Introduction (NPI) line readiness, factory expansions, and continuous lean process improvements. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Material Flow Design: Analyze, design, and optimize the receiving, storage, movement, and lineside presentation of all production and non-production materials to eliminate technician search and walk time. Plan for Every Part (PFEP) & Data Ownership: Build, maintain, and own the PFEP database defining part dimensions, packaging specifications, containerization, storage media, replenishment triggers (Kanban/min-max), and delivery frequencies. Factory & Warehouse Layout Engineering: Create conceptual and detailed 2D/3D facility layouts (AutoCAD/CAD) for warehouse racking, supermarket zones, tugger routes, and lineside staging to support scalable production rates. Custom Hardware & Packaging Development: Design, procure, and deploy custom material handling equipment, including kitting carts, lineside racks, dunnage, and returnable packaging, to protect sensitive components and ensure seamless point-of-use presentation. Constraint & Bottleneck Mitigation: Conduct daily Gemba walks, time studies, and root-cause analyses to proactively identify material flow bottlenecks, implement poka-yoke (error-proofing) workflows, and resolve floor constraints before they impact build schedules. Cross-Functional & NPI Alignment: Represent material flow readiness in production, NPI, and operational review meetings. Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Operations Leadership to support new line launches, facility expansions, and engineering changes. Performance & Data-Driven Optimization: Extract and analyze production, inventory, and cycle-time data using SQL and ERP/WMS systems to right-size buffer stock, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and drive down material handling costs. Qualifications & Skills Masters’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related technical/analytical discipline. 2+ years of hands-on engineering experience in a fast-paced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, automotive, or high-volume production environment involving complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies. Strong hands-on knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Just-In-Time (JIT), Kanban, Plan for Every Part (PFEP), and Six Sigma principles applied on an active production floor. Proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or equivalent) for facility layout engineering and custom cart/rack design. Experience querying and analyzing operational and ERP/WMS data using SQL, Python, or advanced Excel to drive material flow and inventory decisions. Demonstrated experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) line launches, greenfield facility buildouts, and production ramps. Strong cross-functional communication skills with a proven ability to influence production teams, engineering peers, and leadership on the shop floor. Adaptable, hands-on problem solver willing to balance analytical modeling with immediate physical execution on the factory floor in a rapidly changing environment. Ability to work 100% onsite and travel up to 20% as needed to supplier sites or sister manufacturing facilities. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Dans le cadre du développement de nos outils de reporting RH et de la transformation digitale de nos processus People, Decathlon Digital recherche son ou sa futur(e) Stagiaire BI Engineer Workday.

👥 À propos de l'équipe et du rôle

Tu intégreras l'équipe People Data de Decathlon Digital pour participer activement à la valorisation de nos données RH mondiales.

Au cœur du déploiement global de Workday RH auprès de nos 100 000 collaborateurs répartis dans plus de 65 pays, tu auras une opportunité concrète de façonner les outils décisionnels qui soutiennent le développement, le bien-être et la gestion des talents à l'échelle du groupe. 🌍

💡 Pourquoi ce projet vaut le détour

Travailler sur Workday RH chez Decathlon dépasse largement la simple production d'états de reporting :

  • Un écosystème SIRH de pointe : centraliser et fiabiliser la donnée humaine d'une communauté internationale massive via des technologies décisionnelles modernes.
  • Un impact métier direct : transformer des volumes complexes de données en indicateurs clés et tableaux de bord interactifs pour éclairer les décisions stratégiques des dirigeants et des équipes RH. 📊

🛠️ Tes missions

  • Conception et développement de reportings : participer à la création de rapports personnalisés (Custom Reports, Matrix Reports) et de tableaux de bord interactifs (Discovery Boards) sur Workday.
  • Analyse du besoin métier : échanger avec les interlocuteurs RH internationaux pour cadrer leurs indicateurs de performance (KPIs) et les traduire en solutions techniques robustes. 🤝
  • Modélisation et logique calculée : configurer les champs calculés (Calculated Fields) garantissant la finesse et la justesse des analyses collaborateur.
  • Gouvernance et catalogue de données : documenter, organiser et optimiser le catalogue de rapports pour fiabiliser le maintien en conditions opérationnelles, éviter les doublons et assurer l'adoption des outils. 📂
  • Sécurité et conformité : veiller au respect rigoureux de la confidentialité (RGPD) et à la gestion des droits d'accès via les groupes de sécurité (ISG/CSG). 🔒

🎯 Ton profil

  • Formation : étudiant(e) en dernière année de cursus Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, master spécialisé en Data, Informatique décisionnelle ou Business Intelligence).
  • Socle technique : solides bases en SQLet intérêt marqué pour les outils de BI/reporting (Workday, Tableau, Power BI, etc.). 💻
  • Qualités personnelles : rigueur méthodologique, capacité d'analyse, autonomie et curiosité technique.
  • Langues : français courant et bon niveau d'anglais requis (contexte de travail international et interlocuteurs anglophones). 💬

❓ FAQ & Recrutement

Comment se déroule le processus de sélection ?

  1. 📄 Étude de ta candidature avec une réponse sous deux semaines.
  2. 📞 Premier échange RH / technique.
  3. 👥 Entretien avec ton futur responsable d'équipe et un référent métier.
Faut-il être un grand sportif pour postuler ?

Non ! Nous cherchons avant tout des passionnés de données, curieux et motivés par notre dynamique d'équipe, que tu pratiques un sport au quotidien ou non. 🏃‍♂️

Offre d'Emploi : Lead AI Governance (Center of Expertise Data & AI Governance - Central)

Notre équipe Data & AI Governance recherche un·e Lead AI Governance (f/m/d) en CDI, basé·e à Lille ou Paris.

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data et l’intelligence artificielle sont au cœur de notre stratégie, guidant chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client et sportive. Notre défi ? Déployer une IA éthique, sûre, performante et auditable à l'échelle mondiale.

Tu seras rattaché au Head of Data & AI Governance et tu rejoindras le Data & AI Governance Center of Expertise (CoE) en tant que référent·e technique et méthodologique (rôle d'expert / Staff track, sans management hiérarchique direct). Ta mission sera de bâtir et porter notre framework de gouvernance de l'IA, de sécuriser notre passage à l'échelle (Agentique, GenAI & ML classique) et de guider l'ensemble des équipes vers une IA de confiance.

TON CONTEXTE DE JEU

  • Une organisation internationale fédérée : ~70 pays et 5 Business Units majeures avec une forte autonomie locale, nécessitant un cadre clair, agile et une visibilité centrale.
  • Un produit interne dédié : La plateforme GovAI, en cours d'industrialisation (registre unique des cas d’usage, évaluation algorithmique et gestion continue des risques).
  • Un collectif pluridisciplinaire soudé : Animation d'un comité opérationnel hebdomadaire réunissant le Legal, la Compliance, les Risques, la Sécurité et les Achats.

 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que lead d'expertise et chef d'orchestre fonctionnel, tu fais le pont entre les exigences réglementaires, la technique et le business. Tu es là pour éclairer les choix stratégiques et fédérer la communauté autour de standards responsables.

Tes missions s'articulent autour de 4 grands axes :

  • Pilotage Stratégique & Framework : Définir notre doctrine d'AI Governance (alignée sur l'AI Act / RGPD) et animer le Comité Opérationnel (Legal, Risques, Sécurité). Tu portes la roadmap globale et pilotes son succès par des KPIs concrets (ROI, délai de qualification).
  • Plateforme "GovAI" & Governance as Code : Travailler avec l'équipe Produit/Build du CoE pour industrialiser notre plateforme interne. L'objectif : implémenter une logique de Governance as Code en automatisant l'intégration des garde-fous (biais, traçabilité, drift) directement dans les pipelines (MLOps/LLMOps) pour réduire le Time to Market.
  • Gestion des Risques & Actifs IA : Standardiser la classification des risques (systèmes critiques vs non-critiques) et piloter l'inventaire unifié des modèles (GenAI & ML). Tu garantis la conformité des données (entraînement/inférence) sur tout le cycle de vie.
  • Acculturation & Réseau (AI Literacy) : Fédérer un réseau mondial (~70 pays, 5 BU) de Data Scientists, PM et leaders Tu agis en partenaire de confiance et Business Enabler pour démocratiser l'IA de confiance sans freiner l'innovation.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expertise Senior en Gouvernance IA & Data : Une solide expérience sur les problématiques d'IA Responsable, de gestion des risques algorithmiques et de réglementation (notamment l'AI Act européen, RGPD, standards ISO/IEC 42001 ou NIST AI RMF).
  • Leadership d'influence & Posture d'expert : Excellente capacité à fédérer des collectifs pluridisciplinaires (tech, business, legal), à vulgariser des concepts complexes et à obtenir l’adhésion sans autorité hiérarchique dans un environnement international et distribué.
  • Culture Technique Data & Machine Learning : Compréhension approfondie du cycle de vie des modèles ML/DL, des architectures Cloud, des spécificités de la GenAI (RAG, fine-tuning, guardrails) et des mécanismes de données associés.
  • Esprit "Business Enabler" : Pragmatisme et sens du résultat ; tu conçois la gouvernance comme un accélérateur d'innovation sécurisé plutôt que comme un centre de contrôle bloquant.

STACK TECHNIQUE & ÉCOSYSTÈME

Dans ton quotidien, tu interagiras avec un écosystème technologique moderne :

  • Gouvernance, Métadonnées & Catalogage : Unity Catalog, Collibra, outils d'inventaire IA / Model Registry
  • Data, AI & MLOps : Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow), Python, dbt, Airflow, frameworks de test & monitoring IA (évaluation LLM, détection de biais/drift)


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Diplôme (Licence, Master ou École d'Ingénieur) en Informatique, Data, Systèmes d'Information ou domaine connexe.
  • 10 ans d'expérience au minimum en Data Governance, Data Stewardship, Data Quality ou gestion de programme data.
  • Expériences probante sdans l'animation de communautés et la conduite du changement.
  • Anglais courant (niveau B2/C1 minimum) dans un environnement international.

84f32be1cec1.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques. Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. Vos missions : Rattaché.e à l'équipe Business développement, vous contribuez à la construction d'une infrastructure de données fiable au service de l'activité opérationnelle. Vous concevez un processus complet qui collecte des données issues de sources externes variées, les fiabilise et les met à disposition dans nos outils SIG. Vos principales missions : Identifier et qualifier les sources de données : recenser de manière exhaustive les sources externes pertinentes (open data, bases institutionnelles, données géographiques…) et évaluer leur format, leur fréquence de mise à jour et leur fiabilité. Croiser les sources entre elles : définir et mettre en œuvre une méthode de rapprochement (record linkage), afin d'identifier de façon fiable les mêmes éléments présents dans plusieurs sources. Consolider les données : nettoyer, harmoniser et compiler les données dans un format cohérent, prêt à être intégré à notre base de données existante. Garantir la cohérence entre sources : mettre en place des contrôles de qualité et des règles de mise à jour, pour éviter qu'une modification dans une source ne crée des incohérences dans l'ensemble de la base. Publier les résultats : intégrer les données consolidées à la base et les rendre exploitables dans les outils SIG de l'entreprise. Automatiser le processus : industrialiser la chaîne de traitement pour permettre des mises à jour régulières et reproductibles, sans intervention manuelle. Documenter la méthode : rédiger une documentation claire de la démarche et des choix retenus, pour assurer la maintenance et la transmission du dispositif. HSE : Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via : Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques Qualité : Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs Requirements Votre profil : Étudiant.e en Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, master en data science, informatique, statistiques), vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois à partir de début 2027, avec un goût prononcé pour la donnée et la construction de systèmes fiables. Compétences techniques attendues : Maîtrise de Python (pandas, éventuellement GeoPandas) et de SQL ; Solides bases en modélisation de données et bases de données relationnelles Familiarité avec la consommation d'API et le scraping de données ouvertes. Connaissance des méthodes de rapprochement de données et des notions de statistiques associées (probabilités, scoring, mesures de similarité) ; Notions de SIG (QGIS, ArcGIS ou équivalent) et de données géospatiales. Un plus : Notions d’ETL et d’orchestration de traitements (Airflow, Jenkins…) Pratique de Git et des bonnes pratiques de développement (tests, code review) ; Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire soigneux.se, attentif.ve à la qualité des données et capable de repérer les incohérences, avec l'envie de progresser en autonomie sur un projet, de l'exploration jusqu'au déploiement. Vous aimez expliquer vos choix de façon claire, et vous êtes curieux(se) de travailler avec des collègues d'autres métiers, qui vous accompagneront dans cette découverte. Lieu du stage : Lyon Encadrement : le.la stagiaire sera encadré.e par deux interlocuteurs complémentaires : Business Development (Lyon) : tuteur et manager du stage, en charge de cadrer le besoin métier et de valider les livrables ; Data Engineer (Paris) : tutrice et référente technique, elle accompagne la conception, les choix d'architecture et les bonnes pratiques de développement. Les échanges au quotidien se font à distance (visioconférence, outils collaboratifs). Déplacements : des déplacements occasionnels entre Lyon et Paris sont à prévoir afin de rencontrer ses encadrants. Benefits Comment faisons-nous la différence ? 0816d4b22b06.title: Senior Platform Engineer
0816d4b22b06.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us! Position overview Orakl runs its data and AI platform on AWS: Dagster pipelines, a versioned PostgreSQL warehouse, ephemeral Fargate and EC2 compute, eight microservices. Unique in-house and hospital-provided biological, clinical and omics data flow through it every day. We continuously train our proprietary AI models on this every day to create new scientific insights that will benefit patients. We are hiring a Platform Engineer across three missions: infrastructure, security and scalability. You will be our first dedicated platform hire, and you will decide what this platform looks like for the next years. This is a high-stakes, high-ownership position. Our stack Cloud: AWS (Paris region), cross-cloud backup to a second European provider Compute: ECS and Fargate, EC2, ephemeral provisioning per job Data: PostgreSQL, S3, versioned transformations Code: Python everywhere, Docker, Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Dagster orchestration, Nextflow What you will be doing 1. Security: Codebase, incident management, AI guardrails, fleet management. These are the main things that you will be focusing during your first months with us: Secure the codebase : workflow permissions, pinned actions, dependency and secret scanning, package security. Run vulnerability watch and build our incident response tooling: establish the blast radius, write the fix, deploy it company-wide, run the postmortem. Define our AI guardrails : we use AI tools heavily and we are embedding them in the product, so we need clear rules on which data those tools may reach and how their output is reviewed before it ships. Develop our fleet management tools to **keep our laptops up-to-date and secure, define and enforce security practices, deploy and maintain management and security tooling to our fleet. 2. Infrastructure management: Compute, data access, observability. Own our AWS compute : VPC and network segmentation, EC2 allocation. Support data storage. As the team and our partner base grow, access to sensitive data has to stay compartmented and auditable. You will be consulted on where data belongs, across RDS, Redshift, PostgreSQL and the rest, and on keeping access to it properly controlled. Build the observability layer : metrics, logs and traces in one place, alerting that fires on real failures. Own secure access to our infrastructure : secure networks, access control and policies, observability. 3. Scalability: Improve the tools we have, choose the ones we will need. Our product is being built and the volume of data coming in keeps growing, which will call for architecture and resources we do not use today. You will be expected to anticipate failures and future needs, and bring your expert knowledge and experience to our systems & designs. Who you are Minimum qualifications 5+ years in platform, infrastructure or site reliability engineering , with security a real part of the job rather than an occasional task. Deep hands-on AWS : IAM and identity management, VPC design, RDS, container orchestration, secrets management, federated authentication for CI. Terraform in production with a real review workflow behind it, and containers you have operated rather than only deployed to. Ownership of CI/CD security , ideally GitHub Actions: supply chain integrity, dependency management, build provenance. Incident response as a practitioner. You have been the person on the hook, not the person who read the report afterwards. Fluent in English . Preferred qualifications Highly sensitive data in a high-stakes regulated sector: health, finance or defence. Working knowledge of French health data regulation (HDS, CNIL, GDPR), or another regulated environment and the appetite to learn this one quickly. Device management at scale (Jamf, Kandji, Fleet or equivalent) and automated joiner, mover and leaver processes. Dagster or a comparable orchestration framework, and PostgreSQL in production. What we offer Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research. Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes. Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission. Interview Process Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience relative to the role. Technical Case: A exercise representative of the real challenges you'll face. Reference Call: A conversation with several people with whom you've worked closely. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions. 👉 More abou
