8389076508a6.description: About us Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Senior Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data. 

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
  • Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
  • Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
  • Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes.
  • Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
  • Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.

About you 

  • Extensive proven working experience as a Decision Scientist, Data Analyst, Data Scientist or a related position.
  • Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
  • Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
  • Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
  • Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
  • Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
  • Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.

Work perks

  • 25 days of paid annual leave

  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events

  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A dog-friendly office

Individual learning budget

dc984f89e227.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer with a strong background in designing, deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise-scale data engineering platforms within secure, on-premises and air-gapped environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience working with Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters , including installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, performance optimisation, and workload management in environments with restricted or no internet connectivity. This role will support our Global Data Centre (GDC) environment, requiring a candidate who understands the operational and technical challenges of delivering robust, scalable, and secure data platforms within isolated infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with infrastructure, platform, DevOps, and data engineering teams to build and maintain reliable data processing capabilities. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, configure, and maintain Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark clusters in on-premises and air-gapped environments. Manage the full lifecycle of Hadoop/Spark platforms, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Develop, implement, and maintain scalable data pipelines for batch and distributed data processing. Optimise Spark workloads and Hadoop cluster performance, including resource allocation, job scheduling, and capacity management. Work with PostgreSQL and other enterprise data systems to support data integration, storage, and processing requirements. Support the deployment and management of containerised applications using Kubernetes and Helm. Implement and manage service-to-service communication and traffic management using Istio Service Mesh. Ensure software dependencies, container images, packages, and platform components can be deployed and maintained without external internet connectivity. Implement secure configuration and operational practices aligned with enterprise security requirements. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cluster, application, and data pipeline issues. Collaborate with infrastructure, security, DevOps, and application teams to ensure platform stability and availability. Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and platform architecture documentation. Support integration with legacy enterprise data systems, including VSAM. Requirements Required Technical Skills & Experience 1. Apache Hadoop & Apache Spark Strong hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and administering Apache Hadoop clusters. Proven experience deploying and managing Apache Spark clusters and workloads. Experience with distributed data processing, batch processing, and large-scale data pipelines. Strong understanding of cluster architecture, resource management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Experience operating big data platforms in on-premises and air-gapped environments. 2. Air-Gapped & On-Premises Infrastructure Practical experience working in isolated, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments. Understanding of offline software installation, dependency management, package repositories, and container image management. Experience managing platform deployments without direct access to public internet repositories. Knowledge of secure infrastructure operations and enterprise deployment standards. 3. Containerisation & Platform Engineering Experience with Kubernetes-based platform deployments. Hands-on experience with Helm charts for application and platform deployments. Working knowledge of Istio Service Mesh, including traffic management, service discovery, and secure service-to-service communication. Understanding of container orchestration and microservices architecture. 4. Data Systems & Engineering Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including database integration and performance considerations. Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines. Understanding of distributed data storage and processing architectures. Knowledge of VSAM and integration with legacy enterprise data environments. Preferred / Desirable Skills Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or government data centre environments. Familiarity with Linux system administration. Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management. Knowledge of data security, access controls, encryption, and secure data handling. Experience with monitoring, logging, and platform observability. Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices in restricted-network environments. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical engineer rather than purely an architectural or theoretical resource. They should be comfortable taking ownership of the deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and ongoing operational management of Hadoop and Spark platforms. Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical experience working within environments where internet connectivity is restricted or unavailable, with an understanding of the additional complexities involved in deploying and maintaining enterprise data platforms in such environments. b7879efa7bc3.title: Software Engineer II: Autonomous Supply Chains
b7879efa7bc3.description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Applied AI Engineer, Autonomous Supply Chains

About Flexport

Look around you. Almost everything in the room crossed an ocean to get there. Moving one container from a factory to a warehouse takes 10 to 15 companies: truckers, customs brokers, port terminals, ocean carriers, insurers, lenders and warehouses, each with its own systems, paperwork and rules. A freight forwarder runs that whole journey, so the brand that makes the goods doesn't have to.

Most forwarders still run it on email, spreadsheets and phone calls. We call it email freight forwarding. Flexport runs it on one platform, where AI agents do the routine work and experts step in where judgment matters. We've moved $175B of goods for more than 13,000 brands across 135 countries. Our agents handle 21 million tasks a year, and up to 80% of customs work is automated.

Global logistics is a $13 trillion industry, and even the largest forwarder earns less than 3% of global logistics outsourcing revenue. People-powered operations don't scale: to grow, you hire. Software broke that ceiling for taxis with Uber, and for payments with Adyen and Stripe. Freight is next.

Amsterdam is one of Flexport's six engineering hubs, alongside San Francisco, Seattle, Chicago, Shanghai and Shenzhen. We own four domains end to end: Customs Technology, Autonomous Supply Chains (Applied AI), Platform and Security. See what we build at amsterdam-engineering.flexport.com.

The team: Autonomous Supply Chains

Logistics is famously hard to automate, because the happy path rarely happens. One customer won't take deliveries on a Tuesday. Another wants invoices only on Fridays, with some lines merged and others renamed. Until recently, people handled all of that by hand. Now operators use Forge, the agentic platform we build, to automate their own work: catching anomalies, routing exceptions, escalating stuck containers and adjusting invoices to each customer. Forge remembers every customer's rules and learns from every workflow run, so it gets smarter every day.

Autonomous Supply Chains is our Applied AI team: small, senior and reporting to the VP of Engineering. Self-driving cars are rated from level 0 to level 5. Most of the freight industry still runs at level 0: people emailing spreadsheets. Our goal is level 5 for freight, with Forge as the best agentic platform there is, handling every complexity, every calamity and every odd preference without skipping a beat.

Stack: TypeScript, Rust, Next.js, Temporal, Postgres and Snowflake, with models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google.

The role

As an Applied AI Engineer II on Autonomous Supply Chains, you'll build the agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport's operations faster and increasingly autonomous. You'll find the most painful problems in our operations, design the solution and ship it to operators moving freight across 135 countries. This isn't a role where you join a team and pick up tickets.

What you'll do

  • Design and ship end-to-end AI agents that handle real logistics work, such as customs compliance, document processing, invoice validation and exception management.
  • Build the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop flows that make an agent trustworthy enough to run 24/7.
  • Stay on top of what's happening in the world of AI, and channel those innovations straight into the product. When Jev came out this fall, we had three use cases live within two weeks.
  • Work directly with operators, domain experts and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped products, and measure whether they worked.
  • Move fast from idea to production, and treat every deployment as a chance to learn.
  • Cross organizational boundaries to understand problems deeply and get things done without waiting for permission.

You should have

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, and you've built seriously with LLMs, whether in production, in side projects or just because you couldn't stop yourself.
  • LLM fluency: agent patterns, tool use, RAG, prompt design and evaluation. You know the difference between what works in production and what looks good in a demo.
  • Full-stack capability in TypeScript and Next.js. You can own a feature end to end.
  • Product instinct: you can tell what's worth building, not just how to build it.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English, including design docs that people actually read.

Nice to have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, such as Temporal.
  • Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications.

How we work

  • We value builders. People who think end to end, do their own discovery and ship independently. Nobody hands you a spec.
  • Your users sit next to you. Operators, customs experts and account teams w

56a009593257.title: Backend Engineer
56a009593257.description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

On our path to becoming the most visited online curated marketplace for special objects, our Engineering team is on a mission to deliver the best experience across our platforms by building best-in-class products for search and discovery, bidding, curation, logistics, payments, and support.

We’re a scale-up tackling customer-facing challenges at high scale, with 75,000 auctions per week and more than 10 million visitors per month. As a Backend Engineer, you’ll support one of our three verticals - Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment - improving and delivering product innovations for our platform.
Working in a small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile team, you will build scalable, maintainable, and resilient microservices and features. That’s why we’re looking for developers who share ideas, explore options, and communicate openly.

What You'll Do

You’ll be part of a team with end-to-end responsibility for its own microservices, collaborating across disciplines to build, operate, and continuously improve our products.

  • Build end-to-end by designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving scalable microservices and features.
  • Own what you deliver, taking responsibility for the quality, resilience, and maintainability of your team’s services throughout their lifecycle.
  • Collaborate across disciplines while closely working with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile engineers to share ideas and deliver product innovations.
  • Improve how we work, identifying opportunities to make our engineering processes more effective and efficient.
  • Strengthen our engineering culture by documenting and advocating for development best practices across the team.
  • Raise product quality by fixing bugs and refactoring the codebase where necessary to keep our products reliable and maintainable.
  • Learn and experiment by testing new technologies and participating in Technical Week - a week dedicated to creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains after every two product sprints.

What You'll Bring

You understand the full lifecycle of web development, identify opportunities, explore solutions, and keep customer needs at the center of your work. Our stack is mainly focused on Ruby; however, prior Ruby experience is not essential if you’re passionate about learning new things.

  • Strong software engineering foundations: 7+ years of software development experience, specifically with object-oriented programming.
  • Relevant product experience: 3+ years of experience working with customer-facing products in industries such as e-commerce, fintech, or SaaS.
  • Backend service expertise: Experience designing, implementing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and consistency.
  • API and data knowledge: A good understanding of API design, SQL, and relational databases.
  • Clear communication: Excellent English communication skills and comfort raising concerns, sharing ideas, and documenting your work.
  • Collaborative mindset: You contribute to the team, take initiative, and step in to help when needed.
  • Solution-oriented thinking: You actively identify opportunities and explore alternative approaches to solving problems.
  • Commitment to growth: You take ownership of developing your skills by learning new technologies and seeking new opportunities.

How We Work

Our engineers work in small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile teams aligned with one of three verticals: Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment.

  • Teams are responsible for their own microservices from design and development through deployment, maintenance, and improvement.
  • Engineers collaborate closely with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile colleagues.
  • We value bold thinking, curiosity, openness, initiative, and a strong customer focus.
  • Technical Week creates dedicated space for experimentati

7dd6c2a19e06.title: Analytics Engineer
7dd6c2a19e06.description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for an Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team. You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics, and we will shape that together. Our current tech includes: Data warehouse: BigQuery Ingestion: Stitch Transformation: dbt Cloud Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight What you’ll do Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion. Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page. Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making. Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business. AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer. Champion Data Culture: Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table. Working with AI AI is part of how we work every day, and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye. You are accountable for the quality of what you ship, however it was written. The Team You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max (Data Insights) as part of our small Data team of three on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business. Who you are You have owned analytics engineering work end to end. You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core). You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec. You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language. You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce. You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled. You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering. How we hire There are four stages: 30-minute call with our recruiter. 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager. 75-minute case study, done in our office with colleagues from across the business. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task. 30-minute conversation with a senior leader. What we have for you Competitive compensation 80,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross Learning and growth €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. Time to recharge 25 vacation days Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview) Work from anywhere As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. A team you’ll actually want to be part of Weekly team lunch every Thursday Regular team moments and outings An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond Set up for success Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance An environment to grow and make impact A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission. About Talk360 Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products. acfdc0119a4e.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
acfdc0119a4e.description: The Challenge Much of what Talk360 users see and touch is built with web technology - onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and calling in the browser - on top of a Ruby on Rails platform. Every change you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of people in more than 190 countries, often on older devices, limited data plans and unreliable networks. For them, a checkout that won’t load isn’t a UX inconvenience. It’s a call home that doesn’t happen. Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and we’re building an AI-first engineering team. We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with frontend as their home base: someone who builds excellent web experiences and is just as willing to go into our Rails backend to make them work end-to-end. What You'll Do Lead on frontend Build and improve our web experiences in React: onboarding, buying credit, Shop360 and account features Help evolve our web dialer and the web side of our embedded calling product, used by partners to bring Talk360 calling into their own platforms Shape frontend architecture and technical direction, working closely with the Tech Lead and the rest of the team Bring our design system to the web with consistent, accessible components across all our apps Own frontend quality: performance on low-end devices and slow networks, releases, monitoring and error tracking Work across the stack Take features end-to-end: build the Rails API and data model your frontend needs, instead of waiting for it Contribute to our Ruby on Rails platform, the backend behind our mobile apps, web apps and partner integrations Strengthen automated testing, CI/CD and tooling so we can ship often and with confidence Raise the level of the team through technical designs, code reviews and sharing what you know Learn from customers, build AI-first Ship features and experiments on the journeys that matter most to our users, from first open to buying credit Use data, error reports and user feedback to find and fix what hurts users most Work with Product and Design before implementation to shape solutions, not just execute them Use AI tooling throughout your workflow to raise quality and speed, and help shape how we work as an AI-first engineering team The Team You'll be working alongside Isah (Frontend), Oleg (Full Stack), Alex (Backend), Yahaya (VoIP and Data Platform), Igor (iOS and Mobile Lead), David (Android), and Tom (Tech Lead). The wider tech team you'll collaborate with includes Michal & Ali (QA). On the product side, you'll work closely with Quintin and Kseniia (Product) and Cameron (Design). Talk360 is a lean company, around 30 people globally, which means you'll interact regularly across functions: ops, support, data, and marketing. That cross-functional visibility is one of the things that makes the work here interesting and your impact visible. Tech Stack Must have React and TypeScript in production Modern HTML and CSS, responsive and mobile-first Web performance: making apps fast on low-end devices and slow networks Solid backend experience with Ruby on Rails: API design and relational databases (we use MySQL) Experience owning production applications end-to-end, from technical design to operations Experience implementing automated tests (unit, component and end-to-end) and working with CI/CD Git Actively using AI throughout your development workflow Nice to have Building or maintaining a design system or component library WebRTC, VoIP or real-time communication Payment and checkout flows Infrastructure experience: AWS (ECS, RDS), Docker, infrastructure as code Observability and analytics tooling (Sentry, Graylog, Mixpanel or similar) Who You Are You're a generalist with a frontend heart: you care about what users see and touch, and you'd rather own a problem end-to-end than stay in one layer of the stack. You naturally take ownership without waiting for permission. You enjoy solving hard technical problems while thinking about the bigger picture. You care deeply about software craftsmanship and user experience. You can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices. You enjoy partnering with product teams and learning directly from customer feedback. You share what you know and help others improve and become stronger. You're pragmatic. You know when perfection matters and when shipping matters more. You're excited about building software that genuinely changes people's lives. You're based in or around Amsterdam and able to come to our office two to three times a week. 0ee91526bf82.title: IT Specialist Frontend Platform
0ee91526bf82.description: Wie ben jij Jij bent een pragmatische IT‑specialist met een sterke operationele basis. Je houdt van techniek, maar krijgt vooral energie van het stabiel en voorspelbaar laten functioneren van platformen. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek, operatie, regie en samenwerking. Je behoudt overzicht in complexe ketens en weet prioriteiten te stellen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: HBO werk‑ en denkniveau richting IT; ervaring als IT Specialist, Application Engineer of Platform Engineer; ervaring met services en (SaaS) oplossingen op Microsoft Azure; praktische kennis van Kubernetes / containers / application gateways (bij voorkeur AKS); ervaring met informatie analyse, operations, beheerprocessen en incidentafhandeling; kennis van monitoring tooling (pré: Dynatrace); ervaring met CI/CD en OTAP‑omgevingen; kennis van networking, routing, firewalls en DNS, App en Lowcode oplossingen; affiniteit met security, identity en toegangsbeheer (AD / Entra ID); ervaring met samenwerken en regie op leveranciers of MSP‑partijen; je communiceert helder, werkt gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen Bij Univé werken we iedere dag aan zekerheid voor onze leden. Dat doen we niet alleen met verzekeringen, maar ook met betrouwbare digitale dienstverlening. Binnen IT Kern bouwen en beheren we het fundament waarop onze dienstverlening draait. Betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, continuïteit en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Het team Frontend Platform speelt hierin een cruciale rol. Wij zorgen ervoor dat onze websites, klantomgevingen en digitale contactkanalen stabiel, veilig en toekomstbestendig functioneren. Denk hierbij aan frontendplatformen, CRM‑omgevingen, monitoring, identity & access management, cloudplatformen en integraties met andere ketens. Vanwege verdere professionalisering van ons platform zoeken wij een IT Specialist Frontend Platform. Een pragmatische IT‑specialist die techniek begrijpt én overzicht houdt in de keten. De komende jaren staan onder andere een managed service partner transitie, implementatie van ons ledencontact platform, verdere standaardisatie, lifecyclemanagement, security‑verbeteringen en professionalisering van beheerprocessen centraal. Deze thema’s sluiten aan op de bredere IT Kern doelstellingen rondom stabiliteit, schaalbaarheid, monitoring, governance en professionalisering van IT‑processen. Als IT Specialist Frontend Platform zorg jij ervoor dat onze platformen stabiel, voorspelbaar en veilig functioneren. Jij bent de verbindende factor tussen techniek, operations, leveranciers en interne teams. Je bent niet alleen technisch sterk, maar begrijpt ook hoe processen, beheer, changes en samenwerking in de praktijk werken. Je overziet de gehele keten en weet verstoringen structureel op te lossen. In deze rol ligt de nadruk nadrukkelijk op continuïteit, regie, beheer en samenwerking binnen de keten. Daarbij werk je zowel hands‑on als coördinerend. Wat bieden wij Een inhoudelijk sterke rol binnen een cruciaal platform voor Univé. veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen Frontend Platform. Een afwisselende rol waarin techniek, beheer en samenwerking samenkomen. De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern. Hybride werken vanuit Zwolle en thuis. Overige Arbeidsvoorwaarden jaarsalaris is minimaal € 57.487 en maximaal € 81.163 op basis van een 38-urige werkweek (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning); 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld; variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris; 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38‑urige werkweek; goede pensioen- en studiekostenregeling; thuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoeding; korting op schade‑ en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé. Wie wij zijn Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. Drie focusgebieden De IT-organisatie is vanaf 1 januari 2025 ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. 55b06f7a5c47.title: Staff Software Engineer, Batch Compute
55b06f7a5c47.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Batch Compute Experience team owns the platform that Stripe engineers use to build, run, debug and optimize Apache Spark jobs. Those jobs handle large-scale data processing for analytics, machine learning, finance and core product data pipelines. Hundreds of engineers and thousands of production jobs driving critical business processes, such as payouts and reconciliations, run on this platform. Today, diagnosing and tuning a job means reasoning by hand across scattered telemetry, configuration, query plans and application code. Our goal is to make Spark at Stripe fast to iterate, reliable by default, and self-optimizing, so engineers can focus on business logic instead of Spark internals. We're doing this through three connected efforts: Modernization : keeping Stripe's Spark runtime and dependency stack current, including Spark 3.5 → Spark 4, Scala 2.13 and Apache Iceberg. We're building automated upgrade and validation tools so that upgrading the whole fleet becomes routine and low-risk instead of a multi-year manual effort Agentic Spark and optimization : building trustworthy, AI-powered workflows that diagnose failed or underperforming jobs, recommend fixes based on evidence, and carry them safely into configuration changes, code PRs or escalations. We also want to optimize configuration, query plans and code across the whole fleet Operational excellence : making the platform reliable, observable and compliant, and defining user-experience metrics that show whether we're succeeding Over the longer term, we want to turn the platform into a Spark control plane that keeps learning. It should detect problems before users notice them, validate fixes safely and apply them through policy-controlled automation. What you’ll do As a Staff Engineer on Batch Compute Experience, you'll set the technical direction for one of Stripe's most widely used data platforms. You'll lead multi-quarter efforts across teams, make high-stakes architectural decisions affecting thousands of production workloads, and raise the engineering bar for the team and its partners. Responsibilities Lead Spark modernization across the fleet. Own the technical strategy for moving thousands of production jobs to newer Spark and Iceberg runtimes. This includes target selection, qualification, deciding the rollout unit (cluster, application or hybrid), and rollback planning, while coordinating dependencies with partner infrastructure teams Make upgrades continuous and safe. Design and evolve automated upgrade and validation systems: shadow execution against production data, output-correctness comparison, sandboxed execution, and staged promotion. The goal is to make each new runtime upgrade cheaper than the last Architect agentic Spark workflows. Build LLM-powered systems that diagnose failures, out-of-memory errors (OOMs), data skew and performance regressions. They should produce evidence-backed recommendations that are backtested and gated in CI, and you'll define the safety, provenance and human-approval requirements for every automated action Build safe configuration and remediation paths. Design authorized, validated, reversible no-code configuration changes, along with pipelines that detect anti-patterns across the fleet and open code-fix PRs or tickets Drive efficiency at scale. Identify, prove out and roll out the highest-value configuration and query-plan optimizations, such as shuffle and adaptive query execution (AQE) tuning, executor sizing, join strategy and partitioning. Turn the measured gains into real infrastructure savings without hurting correctness or reliability Improve the developer experience. Shorten the inner dev loop, improve PySpark support and observability (including Python memory diagnostics), and unify how jobs are packaged and launched across schedulers such as Airflow and Flyte Set the technical bar. Lead critical design reviews, define reliability standards (SLOs, observability, testing) for the services we own, mentor senior engineers, and steer the team away from structural and operational debt Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements This is a Staff Engineer role - that typically means you have 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent building data infrastructure or distributed systems A track record of leading complex, multi-quarter infrastructure projects from start to finish, especially migrations or upgrades that touch many consuming teams Experience defining SLOs and running reliable platforms with on-call responsibilities Experience designing safe rollouts for large fleets: staged rollout, reducing blast radius, validating correctness, and planning rollbacks Strong product and developer-experience instincts: you build abstractions that are ergonomic, well documented and easy to adopt Preferred qualifications Deep, hands-on expertise with Apache Spark internals, such as the execution model, memory management, shuffle, AQE, the Catalyst optimizer and query plans, and performance tuning at production scale Experience with open table formats (Apache Iceberg in particular) and the wider data lake ecosystem, such as Trino, Parquet and object storage Proficiency in Scala or Java, plus working fluency in Python Expe

You proactively identify repetitive workflows that AI can improve, validate results against technical evidence, and share effective approaches with the team. ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn, Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We're looking for engineers with deep AI/ML and low-level systems experience who want to build the best technical support experience in the world. This isn't a traditional support role — it's an engineering role where you happen to be closest to our customers.

You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between working directly with customers and shipping fixes, features, and automation that improve Modal for everyone. When you help a customer debug a training run, you'll also fix the underlying issue in the platform. When you notice ten customers hitting the same friction point, you'll build the tooling or automation that eliminates it entirely.

This role is for people who solve problems, not people who answer tickets. The problems you encounter are deeply technical and arise from running some of the most demanding AI workloads in the world. You'll be a member of our engineering team, contributing production code alongside the engineers building the core platform. The difference is that your roadmap is shaped by what you learn at the frontier of customer experience. You will:

 - Ship code that matters. Fix bugs, build features, and create automation that improves the experience for every Modal user — not just the one who reported the issue.

 - Work directly with customers. Help developers and ML engineers debug, optimize, and architect their workloads across Slack, email, and calls.

 - Build scalable systems. Design tooling, dashboards, and automated workflows that make support efficient at scale — delighting customers at the most important moments.

 - Close the feedback loop. Translate patterns you see in the field into concrete improvements — docs fixes, API changes, or new feature proposals.

 - Contribute to open source and technical content. Write examples, build demos, and publish content that helps the broader community succeed on Modal.




REQUIREMENTS:

 - Accomplished in key areas. You bring depth in either low-level infrastructure or ML/AI, and you're not lost in the other.

 - Low-level infrastructure experience. Operating systems, file systems, networking, performance profiling, cluster management and distributed systems.

 - AI/ML engineering experience. Training models, optimizing inference, working with GPUs, or building ML infrastructure.

 - Automation mindset. Your instinct when you see a manual process is to eliminate it and you have the engineering background to make that happen.

 - Clear communicator. Can explain a systems issue to a customer, write a crisp bug report, and draft documentation, all while collaborating internally to ship improvements.

1e902084b549.title: Backend Engineer - Platform Security
1e902084b549.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
We are looking for a Backend Engineer II to join our Security Compliance Engineering team. You’ll help turn complex security, risk, and compliance requirements into scalable software solutions that make it easier for teams across Spotify to build and operate securely. You’ll work with engineers and partners across security to strengthen our technical Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) capabilities.

What You'll Do
Design and build backend products, services, and infrastructure that strengthen Spotify’s technical security Governance, Risk, and Compliance strategy. Build scalable infrastructure and tooling that help apply regulatory requirements and security framework controls across Spotify’s distributed environment. Develop reliable services that automate security and compliance processes, reducing manual work and helping engineering teams understand and meet requirements. Work with security, engineering, and other partners to translate security and compliance requirements into practical technical solutions. Contribute to consistent engineering practices that address security, risk, and compliance requirements while supporting teams at scale. Own the quality of your work from design and development through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
Who You Are
You have experience developing backend software using an object-oriented programming language such as Java and are comfortable working with data. You have experience building distributed, high-volume services and deploying and operating them in production. You understand system design, data structures, and algorithms and can apply these concepts to practical engineering problems. You care about software quality and build reliable, maintainable solutions. You have experience implementing security controls or safeguards in software systems and familiarity with cybersecurity or security GRC frameworks. You enjoy collaborating with others to understand technical requirements, explore trade-offs, and iterate on solutions. You’re interested in information security governance, risk, and compliance and are motivated to deepen your knowledge in this space. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners and can explain complex topics to different audiences.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London or Stockholm We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

cc1c9fc87b58.title: Strategic Account Director, Developer Platform
cc1c9fc87b58.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: London, UK About the Team Developer GTM is changing how Cloudflare wins and grows the next generation of builders, at a time when AI and agents are reshaping the application stack. We turn developer activity into lasting commercial outcomes. That means shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, giving the field repeatable motions, and feeding real-world signals back into Product. We work closely with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing. About the Role Frontier labs hire former CTOs as senior Members of Technical Staff: high-impact individual contributors tasked with solving the hardest problems without the overhead of team management. This role applies that model to go-to-market. We are seeking former sales leaders and founders to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform growth inside a select portfolio of the most important technology companies in the world. As a Strategic Account Director, you will own the long-term Developer Platform strategy and consumption growth for one to three of Cloudflare's top 10 accounts including frontier AI labs and the most innovative software companies. Over time, the largest of these accounts will move to a dedicated 1:1 model. You'll partner with the account team to guide strategic decisions, lead engagement with key executives, and bring developer fluency married to deep business acumen. You'll collaborate as a peer with Cloudflare's sales leadership and work closely with Solutions Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineers, and Product. You are fluent in both developer workloads and commercial mechanics. You can set a multi-year account strategy in the morning and work through a live deal in the afternoon. What You Will Do Architect the account strategy. Build and execute a multi-year Developer Platform plan for each account: defining priority workloads, how adoption grows, competitive position, and the commercial path to get there. Accelerate the customer journey (drive activation → expansion → commercial structure): Use usage telemetry to find next-best actions, expansion paths, and risks. Remove technical, commercial, and organizational blockers so real workloads land and scale. Structure strategic deals. Work with the account executive, Deal Desk, Pricing, Finance, and Legal to design commit structures and consumption-based agreements that match how the customer actually builds. Compete credibly against hyperscalers and other platforms. Lead executive engagement. Build trusted relationships with CTOs and heads of infrastructure, AI, and engineering, as well as the commercial decision makers. Run impactful executive business reviews and leverage Cloudflare leadership at the right moments. Mobilize Cloudflare. Align the account team, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Product, and Support on the account's priorities, establishing clear owners and driving flawless follow-through. Run GTM motions in step with the workloads where we've proven fit. Close the loop with Product. Turn what you see in the account into clear, quantified recommendations on positioning, packaging, limits, and roadmap. Elevate the field: Turn your account experience into workload blueprints, deal patterns, and playbooks. Coach sales leaders and account teams in a train-the-trainer model to scale your impact globally.. Who You Are 12+ years in technology sales, including senior sales leadership (Director, VP, or CRO) or strategic named-account roles at developer-platform or consumption-based companies, such as AWS, GCP, Vercel, MongoDB, Databricks, Snowflake, or an AI lab. A track record of growing consumption and revenue in large, complex, highly technical accounts over consecutive years. Executive presence and credibility with C-level and VP audiences at the fastest-moving technology companies. The ability to turn technical workloads into compelling commercial outcomes, and to navigate complex deal approvals with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Security. Deep experience with usage-based pricing and commit structures. Analytical rigor: you can read product usage telemetry and size opportunities at the level of Sheets or SQL. A clear persuasive writer and presenter, equally effective with developer ICs and executive sponsors. A builder's mindset: you lead through influence and get cross-functional work done without relying on hierarchy. Bonus Points Experience selling to, or working inside, frontier AI labs or AI-native com

eef6e8409c51.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Agents
eef6e8409c51.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

An AI agent is only as useful as what it knows about your company. For many of the world's leading companies, that knowledge lives in Notion. The AI Knowledge & Capabilities team makes sure every agent working in Notion – built by Notion, by customers, or by other AI companies – finds the right answer, quickly and at a cost that makes sense.

We own the systems that make this work: search, knowledge, and memory. We also own the agent harness – the tools, context, and model choices that turn a model into a working agent. We decide what to build using evals, customer feedback, and product judgment. Our work reaches users directly, and other AI teams at Notion build on it.

We recently shipped Memories, so Notion AI, Custom Agents, and agents connected through MCP can learn and remember across platforms. We also shipped Auto, a model router that delivers frontier quality at 90% lower cost. Next, we're bringing memory, search, and the harness together into one system. Nobody has figured out how to package that yet – we want any company to get a great knowledge system for its agents with a click or a few questions.

You will be a technical leader for the team. You'll set direction across search, knowledge, and the harness, starting hands-on with making agents better and cheaper, and help define how Notion measures AI quality.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set technical direction for search, knowledge, and the agent harness – make the architecture calls, run design reviews, and decide what the team builds next.

 - Make Notion's agents better, faster, and cheaper – starting with the harness: which tools an agent can call, what context it gets, and which model handles each request.

 - Lead how we measure agent quality – evolve the metrics and evals that reflect real usage, and use them to choose what ships.

 - Turn company data into answers agents can use – build agentic search and memory that give every agent the context it needs, at the right latency and cost.

 - Work closely with research – partner with Notion's model research team on evals, model choice, and models trained for agentic work, and get what works into production. You'll also work with search platform and AI product teams on work that spans teams.

 - Grow the team – mentor engineers, review designs, and develop the next tech leads.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production applied AI: You've shipped and iterated on production LLM or agent systems used by real users. You owned how their quality was measured, and you changed course based on what you found.

 - Quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs: You've traded quality against latency and cost in a production system, measured the result, and can explain what you gave up and why.

 - Technical leadership: You've owned the technical direction of a complex system, often across teams, and kept it sound as it grew. You don't wait for a roadmap – you find the problems worth solving, make the case for them, and go deep on the hardest ones yourself.

 - Product sense: You've shipped quality improvements users noticed, and you've shaped new products from scratch – from the data model to what users see. You can explain why they mattered.

 - Shipping something new: You've taken an idea from nothing to a product people use. You try new models and tools early, form your own views, and turn them into product decisions.

 - Making other engineers better: You mentor engineers at every level, guide their designs, and share what you know so it scales past you. Multiple engineers have grown by working with you.

 - Clear communication: You write clearly about tradeoffs, disagree directly, and change your mind when the evidence says to.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've improved LLM cost and quality directly – e.g. model routing, eval-driven harness or prompt tuning, or token efficiency in long-running agents.

 - You've founded a company or been an early engineer at a startup, and built systems that hold up at large scale.

 - Experience working closely with research or model training teams.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $299,000 - $352,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e82

386f9a658683.title: Senior Product Engineer (Full Stack)
386f9a658683.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the role Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move. As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better. Tech stack Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. You don't need to know all of it on day one. We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to pick up whatever part of the stack the problem needs. What you will do Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends. Build backend services for pricing, inventory, orders and the integrations that connect suppliers, customers and logistics partners. Build our AI agents and the tools and APIs they use, and make their actions safe through idempotency, validation, audit trails and human review where it matters. Design and build the interfaces where our commercial teams work with agents: reviewing proposals, correcting mistakes and approving decisions quickly. Turn messy external data such as supplier price lists, datasheets and stock feeds into trustworthy data the rest of the business relies on. Measure whether what you shipped works, including evaluating and monitoring LLM-driven workflows in production. Lead technical decisions, write down the trade-offs, and mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and direct feedback. Help us hire by running interviews and defining what good engineering looks like at Andercore. In your first six months, you might Build a pricing engine that scales with our growing assortment and number of markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds. Automate procurement: turn supplier price lists, quotes and order confirmations into structured data, and let AI agents handle the manual steps between our buyers and suppliers. What you bring At least 5 years of experience building and running software in production, with real users and real consequences when it fails. Strong backend skills at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems, with a focus on data correctness and failure modes. Solid command of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with AWS. Your depth is on the backend, but full-stack delivery is expected: you build frontends in TypeScript and React. You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you can ship a good interface for the problem you own. Product sense: you ask why before how, you talk to users, and you can turn a vague problem into a clear plan. Experience in a fast-growing company, where priorities shift and you keep shipping while the business changes around you. A track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones. Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks is a strong plus. Curiosity and good engineering judgment about them is a must. You raise the level of the people around you, and you push back when something doesn't make sense. Experience in trading, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech or other domains where data errors cost money is a bonus.

A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact. Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development. Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance. Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool. 628cf0f10506.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - German Speaking
628cf0f10506.description: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a versatile and highly skilled German-speaking Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team. You will be involved in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support, while also contributing to product development and innovation. At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success. What You’ll Do Customer-Facing Engineering – Work closely with customers from onboarding to ongoing usage, helping them integrate and optimize our AI solutions. Technical Development – Build new features, MVPs, and scalable solutions that directly impact customer outcomes. Full-Stack Development – Utilize React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python to develop robust applications and tools. AI/ML Applications – Design, implement, and iterate on AI/ML solutions, including LLM prompting, tuning of voices, and transcribers to optimize use cases. fa6b1d67272d.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
fa6b1d67272d.description:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Fullstack Engineer to join a newly formed team at Staffbase that builds custom solutions — extending the functionality and capabilities of our award-winning employee communications platform to meet real customer needs. You’ll own solutions from beginning to end: shaping use cases together with stakeholders, building them across the stack, and validating them with the people who use them. You’ll also help bring structure to a growing team of mid-level engineers and mentor them along the way. We’re looking for empathetic, motivated team players who are driven by ownership and growth. Let’s talk!

As part of our tech stack, we use: React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Kotlin, Go, Java, MongoDB, REST APIs & SDKs, Docker, Terraform, Selenium and Cypress, to name a few.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and like-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We believe that team events during working hours play a vital role in building an exceptionally effective team, and we encourage them
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the “You build it, you run it” approach and take pride in it

The team

You’ll join a newly formed team dedicated to building custom solutions that extend the Staffbase platform for our enterprise customers. We turn specific customer needs into reliable, scalable extensions — widgets, plugins, and integrations — that make our product work exactly the way each customer needs it to.

Because the team is new, there’s real room to shape how we work: to set engineering standards, bring structure to our processes, and grow together. That’s where you come in.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Own the development of custom solutions end-to-end — from technical design through implementation, testing, and release
  • Partner with stakeholders (customers, consultants, and internal teams) to define and detail use cases before development, then validate solutions and gather feedback afterward
  • Build across the stack: customer-facing UI in React and TypeScript, backend services, and integrations with Staffbase and third-party APIs
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and help bring structure, engineering standards, and good practices to a newly formed team
  • Work in a cross-functional, agile setup and produce high-quality, well-tested code
  • Give and receive v

12e628eae54f.description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? You’ll join Statista’s newly formed Data Platform team. We’re building a central platform that brings together data—from market statistics to consumer surveys—under consistent standards for quality, documentation, and access. This gives product teams and AI agents a trusted foundation to build new applications and features without duplicating data or setting up separate pipelines. Your role Design, implement, and maintain backend services in Python that power our data access and distribution layer Build and operate automated build, test, and deployment pipelines following CI/CD and GitOps practices, running on AWS and Kubernetes Design and maintain data models and schemas (Avro, SQL) for our data pipelines and services, and publish them to downstream consumers via our Kafka-based distribution platform and schema registry Build access-layer data models in our analytics environment (e.g., Snowflake) so applications can work with the data directly, including via API Act as the coordination interface between the Data and Tech divisions, aligning priorities, schemas, and timelines across upstream and downstream teams Your profile 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role. Strong SQL skills and solid experience in data modeling (e.g., dimensional modeling, star schemas). Hands-on experience with event streaming and message distribution, ideally Kafka, including schema management with the Kafka schema registry (Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema). Experience designing data contracts and schemas between upstream producers and downstream consumers. Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and modern data stack tools (e.g., dbt, CI/CD). Openness to AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code or similar). Comfort working at the boundary of streaming/operational data and analytical data models, and building access layers that serve applications via API. Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused and structured working style. Interest in data governance, standards, and scalable data architecture. Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus), with both technical and business stakeholders, combined with a solid understanding of business requirements and contexts. What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from: Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year Hybrid work and flex-time International team and social events Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities Career & training opportunities Attractive locations and modern offices Mental health support with OpenUp Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.
