0915eb43608e.title: Data Director, EU
0915eb43608e.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

 

📍 London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | 💰 £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & benefits | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available

 

About our Data Discipline 

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

 

Our EU team ⭐

Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo. 

 

Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.

 

You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.

 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.

Shaping product and commercial strategy:

  • You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.
  • You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.

Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:

  • You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.
  • Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.

Changing how decisions get made:

  • You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.
  • You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.

Building and leading a high-performing team:

  • You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.
  • You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Da

1ef7ee3c83fa.title: Marketing Automation Engineer
1ef7ee3c83fa.description:
Growth at United Media

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

fb79a155bcf5.title: Senior Sales Engineer - UK
fb79a155bcf5.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers. This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success. This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team. In this role, you will: Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations. Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry. Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc. Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use. Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers. Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs. Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles. Work in multiple levels of the technology stack. Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails. Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline. 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity. Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management. Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations. Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems. Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems. Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages. An ideal candidate also has: MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline. Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language. Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs. Understanding

In this role, you will take ownership of Azure infrastructure and platform services, drive automation and continuous improvement, and contribute to the design and delivery of secure, reliable, and supportable cloud solutions. You will play a key role in improving operational efficiency, service reliability, and cloud cost optimization. You will work closely with other Cloud Engineers, Product, Engineering, Application Support, and IT teams and report directly to the Cloud Operations Manager. 🌍 ABOUT A2MAC1 A2MAC1 is the leading provider of automotive benchmarking and data analytics worldwide. Our solutions help OEMs and suppliers understand their competitive landscape, accelerate development, and make better strategic decisions based on reliable, structured, and actionable insights. Through our digital platforms, data services, consulting expertise, and AI-driven solutions, A2MAC1 supports the world’s top automotive players. With 700+ employees across Europe, Asia, and North America, A2MAC1 continues its strong growth, driven by innovation and customer success. 🎯 WHAT YOU’LL DO Operate, maintain, and continuously improve Azure infrastructure and platform services, ensuring reliability, availability, security, and performance. Plan and execute maintenance, upgrades, and migrations through established change management processes. Take ownership of cloud services throughout their lifecycle, lead incident investigations and resolution, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive actions to reduce recurring issues. Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules, Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, and automated operational processes using PowerShell and/or Bash. Design, maintain, and improve monitoring and observability solutions, while ensuring effective backup, restoration, high-availability, and disaster recovery arrangements. Implement Azure security, governance, and policy standards, monitor resource utilization, budgets, and cost alerts, and identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising service quality. Collaborate with cross-functional teams on cloud solution design, platform standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. Maintain operational documentation, share technical knowledge, and promote self-service capabilities. Requirements 👤 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Must-have At least 5 years of hands-on experience operating production Azure environments. Ability to work independently and take ownership of Azure services from design through operations. Strong Azure administration skills across networking, identity (Microsoft Entra ID), compute, application services, containers, and storage. Strong understanding of operating Azure PaaS services, including databases, storage, and messaging platforms. Hands-on Terraform experience, including modular design and state management. Experience with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, Git workflows, approvals, and deployment controls. Practical knowledge of Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, KQL, and Application Insights. PowerShell and/or Bash scripting skills. Proven incident management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and change management capabilities. Understanding of security, resilience, performance, and cost trade-offs in Azure. Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take ownership of services, incidents, and outcomes. A proactive and methodical approach, with the ability to remain calm during incidents, collaborate across teams and time zones, share knowledge, and continuously develop technical expertise. 53e4e6fcc95c.title: Manager, Data Centers
53e4e6fcc95c.description:
Modalités de travail:  
Chez GoDaddy, l’organisation du travail varie selon les équipes : certaines travaillent au bureau, d’autres en mode hybride, et d’autres entièrement à distance. 
 
Sur Site: Ce poste s’exerce à temps plein sur site. Vous devez donc résider à une distance permettant de vous rendre régulièrement dans les locaux auxquels vous êtes rattaché(e). Vous travaillerez sur ce site dès votre premier jour 
 
Rejoignez notre équipe : 
Chez GoDaddy, notre infrastructure est au service de millions de clients à travers le monde. Nous recherchons un(e) Data Center Manager expérimenté(e) pour piloter les opérations, les équipes, la performance financière et la qualité des services de notre centre de données de Strasbourg. 

 En tant que membre de l’équipe de management du site, vous déclinerez la stratégie de l’entreprise en actions concrètes à travers la planification des effectifs, le développement des talents, la gestion financière, la gouvernance opérationnelle et l’amélioration continue. Vous collaborerez avec les clients, les fournisseurs et les différentes équipes internes afin de garantir des opérations sûres, fiables et évolutives dans un environnement fonctionnant 24 h/24 et 7 j/7. 

Votre expérience doit inclure …. 

  • Expérience confirmée en management et leadership, notamment dans l’encadrement de managers, le développement d’équipes responsabilisées et la conduite du changement organisationnel. 
  • Expérience dans le pilotage d’opérations au service de clients Enterprise et de services critiques pour l’activité. 
  • Expérience en gouvernance opérationnelle, gestion des risques, continuité d’activité, gestion budgétaire, prévisions et reporting auprès de la direction. 
  • Expertise technique dans au moins deux des domaines suivants : administration système (Linux et/ou Windows), réseaux, architecture des centres de données, programmation/scripting ou automatisation. 
  • Expérience dans la mise en place de programmes de formation, de développement des compétences et de planification de la relève. 

  
Idéalement, vous disposez également de… 

  • Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans les opérations de centres de données, d’infrastructures ou d’environnements critiques, avec des responsabilités croissantes en management d’équipes. 
  • Bonne connaissance des environnements Linux et Windows.

53a3ddf3ecf7.title: Product Engineer (TypeScript)
53a3ddf3ecf7.description: Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better. Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care. Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time. Want to shape the future of healthcare? Join us ! Discover our company culture and values Here is a product teaser Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest Articles on our A round ( techfundingnews , Maddyness , les echos , our blog ) Vocca in a few words Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed. $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform More than 1,000 medical staff use our product all day The problem Every medical centre has its own rules. Who can book what, with which practitioner, at what time, what to do with an urgent case at 6 pm. Today these rules live in prompts and in the heads of our ops team. Each new clinic takes hours of manual work, and the ops team is the bottleneck of our growth. We are building the platform that removes that bottleneck. A scenario engine where the behaviour of the agent is structured configuration, not free text. A self-serve onboarding where a clinic connects its software and sets itself up. A dashboard where the medical staff stop executing and start supervising: the agent handles the volume, humans check what matters. This is the difference between selling a service and selling a product. The long term vision is simple: a clinic signs, connects its software and is live within days, without a single developer involved. You would be building that. What you will own The scenario engine and its configuration model. One product that handles the rules of thousands of medical centres without becoming a swamp. The self-serve onboarding, from the backend to the dashboard. Internal tooling already took a clinic deployment from days to under an hour. The next step is zero developer ticket on a standard onboarding. The dashboard our clinics use all day. Fast, reliable and clean enough that a medical secretary prefers it to the phone. We take frontend quality seriously and follow a design system written in code. Your features, end to end. From the spec with the ops team to production, and the fix when something breaks, with the reason it does not happen again. How we build Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate. Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours. AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks. Close to the field. Every change lands in front of more than 1,000 medical staff. a175423659e8.title: Senior SecOps Engineer
a175423659e8.description: About Equativ & Security team Equativ is an independent ad tech company. Our programmatic advertising platform runs at high scale, with production running entirely on Google Cloud Platform. Equativ is building its ISMS toward ISO 27001 certification, targeted by the end of 2027. The role You run day-to-day security operations for a full-cloud company as a senior engineer in the SecOps team, reporting to the SecOps Manager. You bring technical proposals to the SecOps Manager; the IT & Security lead approves the SecOps roadmap. You back up the SecOps Manager on technical topics and during incidents. You are also the link between SecOps and the other teams, mainly R&D, Platform Engineering and IT. You keep them in sync on security priorities, changes and incidents. You train them on secure practices and on the security tooling they use, so they can own security in their own areas. Most of your time goes into building and running things yourself. You write the Terraform, the detections and the automation. Responsibilities GCP guardrails and posture as code: definition, organization policies, IAM and service-account hygiene, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, KMS and Secret Manager; run our CSPM (Wiz); take controls from monitoring to enforcement with a rollback plan; deliver controls in Terraform and CI/CD policy checks with Platform Engineering. Detection and incident response: own log pipelines (Cloud Logging, audit logs, Workspace, Okta, CrowdStrike), build detections end to end (log onboarding, SIEM use cases, validation) and manage alert quality, automating triage and enrichment; lead security incidents from triage to root cause and post-mortem, including GCP forensics; maintain playbooks and run tabletop exercises. Vulnerability and attack-surface management: cloud, containers (GKE, Artifact Registry), dependencies and external surface; prioritize findings on exploitability and real exposure; run the technical side of external pentests (scoping, challenging findings, retest) and drive remediation with owning teams and track SLAs. Secure development: threat-model new services with R&D; embed SAST, SCA, secret and container scanning and supply-chain controls in the SDLC; be the security contact for each R&D team. Assurance: produce technical evidence for ISO 27001 audits; answer the technical part of customer security questionnaires and RFPs, including non-standard requests; assess the security of third-party vendors. FinOps: know the cost of the security tooling you deploy, flag cost drifts early and work with Procurement on cost estimates when selecting security vendors. Must-have profile 7+ years in security engineering or SecOps, including 3+ years securing production on a public cloud — GCP strongly preferred, AWS/Azure transferable. Deep GCP security knowledge: IAM model, org policies, VPC-SC, SCC, logging, GKE security. Hands-on experience with cloud-native security platforms such as Google SecOps (Chronicle), Security Command Center (SCC) and Wiz (or similar CNAPPs). Hands-on incident response experience, including leading incidents and cloud forensics. Detection engineering with a SIEM and log pipelines at scale. Infrastructure as code (Terraform) and scripting. Clear written and spoken English and French; able to explain risk to engineers and to customers. Skills in project management Proactive, bring forward proposals and make recommendations Nice to have Kubernetes / GKE hardening and runtime security. Experience in ad tech or other high-throughput, latency-sensitive platforms. Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits from the operations side. Identity and endpoint stack: Okta, Google Workspace, CrowdStrike. Certifications: GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

68e5e539efba.title: High Voltage Electrical Engineer
68e5e539efba.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT In this role, you will tackle some of the most demanding high-voltage engineering challenges in the energy industry, developing electrical systems that enable next-generation plasma heating technologies. Your expertise will directly influence the performance, reliability, and safety of critical plant systems, shaping the electrical backbone of a first-of-a-kind fusion power plant. By advancing high-voltage power conversion, insulation, protection, and system integration, you will help transform cutting-edge scientific concepts into industrial-scale reality. WHAT YOU WILL DO Lead the engineering and integration of high-voltage power systems supporting critical plant operations Define high-voltage electrical architectures, simulate power conversion and selection of electrical components Perform and review key electrical studies, including insulation coordination, transient overvoltage, short-circuit protection, grounding, and safety analyses Develop strategies for high-voltage system monitoring, diagnostics, and condition assessment to improve reliability and maintainability Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of high-voltage systems with plant infrastructure and control systems Oversee testing, commissioning, and validation activities for high-voltage equipment and subsystems Build a safety culture that protects our people first and equipment second, from the dangers inherent in high voltage systems WHO YOU ARE You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field You have experience designing, analyzing, or commissioning high-voltage electrical systems in industrial, utility, research, or energy applications You enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and developing innovative solutions where established approaches may not yet exist Experience in the design and application of insulation systems, electric field management, and creepage and clearance coordination is a plus Familiarity with protection systems, interlocking philosophies, and functional safety concepts for high-energy electrical installations is a plus INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. TEAM & ROLE Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION Impact: Your work will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy. Ownership: As an early member of a growing team, you’ll help define how we test HTS at scale. Development: Build specialist skills at the cutting edge of superconducting magnet technology. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Qualification at Scale Test Planning: Define test strategies, sampling plans and pass/fail criteria for HTS tapes and cables, and help set up production testing at our Magnet Factory. Measurement: Commission test systems and develop measurement processes that ensure reproducible, traceable measurements of critical current (Ic) and related properties, including the effects of manufacturing processes. Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design. Supplier Selection: Compare supplier data with our own measurements and support decisions on which tapes to use in Alpha and future stellarators. 2. R&D HTS Qualification: Run tape and cable qualification test campaigns, both in-house and at external facilities. Analysis & Reporting: Compare results with models and give clear technical recommendations to the design, modelling and manufacturing teams. Equipment Development: Support the development of new test equipment and methods with external partners. 3. Planning, Safety & Team Planning: Plan test campaigns in line with tape deliveries and the Alpha build programme. Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests. Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields. Quality: Ensure results are traceable, well documented and reproducible. WHO YOU ARE An engineer or scientist who enjoys careful, hands-on experimental work as much as planning how we test at scale. You hold an MSc or PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. You have hands-on experience characterising materials or devices, and are comfortable designing experiments. You speak fluent English. You have strong data analysis skills and a solid grasp of measurement uncertainty and statistics. You are happy to travel for test campaigns at external facilities, including internationally. NICE TO HAVE Experience with superconductors, cryogenics or high magnetic fields. Experience with quality control or production testing at scale. Experience designing cryogenic or automated test equipment. Familiarity with HTS tape manufacturing processes and the supplier landscape. German language skills. This role will initially be based in our Zurich office. As the project develops, the position may move to Germany. If that happens, we’ll give you at least six months’ notice and support you through the move. b4920d1fa8e0.description:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways.

The Role

Electra is actively recruiting a Staff Electrical Engineer to help lead the design and development of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems for our 9-passenger eSTOL (electric short takeoff and landing), hybrid-electric aircraft. This position focuses on design, prototyping, integration, and testing, and is based in Olten, Switzerland.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design, analysis, integration, and testing of assigned electrical systems for our hybrid-electric aircraft. This role has the potential to support a number of aircraft electric systems and equipment, including avionics, power distribution (low voltage and high voltage), power electronics, electrical energy storage, and electric machines.
  • Understand program objectives and requirements to conduct trade studies and help define architectures, requirements, and interfaces between systems.
  • Develop and manage requirements for assigned electrical systems and equipment, compatible with program-level safety, performance, certification, and business objectives.
  • Support the evaluation and selection of electrical equipment suppliers, and provide technical review and oversight throughout the development process.

59c13031b78a.description: Maybe you call yourself a Data Specialist, a BI Consultant, a "why-does-this-number-not-match-their-Excel" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data. What you get A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience. €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings. €500 home-office budget and a great laptop. A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then. Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview. Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. About us All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. What the job looks like Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems. Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team. Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source. Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal. Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history. What you bring Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told. Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too. Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job. Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time. Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge . You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards. AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do. Job Details

🚀 Join fiskaly! Help Us Build Trust in Compliance & Security

Every scalable, secure, and efficient product squad relies on a rock-solid infrastructure foundation. We are building resilient network and hardware layers that allow our platforms to operate securely and without avoidable operational disruption. We are looking for a Senior Hybrid Infrastructure Engineer who wants to take ownership of our foundational infrastructure. You will operate at the intersection of physical hardware and cloud environments, bringing reliability, advanced automation, and intelligent design to our core networks and datacenters.

💼 The Role

As a Senior individual contributor, you will be responsible for the design, operation, and evolution of our organization’s foundational infrastructure layers. You will not just maintain the status quo; you will own the standards for hyperscaler organization structure, network segmentation, and infrastructure automation across all environments. You will hold administrative access to cloud landing zones, network devices, core routing services, and bare-metal hosts. Working across both physical and virtual infrastructure layers, you will meticulously plan live system maintenance, verify operational readiness, and ensure that our core network paths and datacenter connectivity remain highly stable with minimal unplanned downtime.

🛠️ What You’ll Do

 

  • Hybrid Connectivity Design: Lead the design and maintenance of hybrid cloud connectivity, enterprise routing, failover patterns, and datacenter-to-hyperscaler interconnects.

  • Standardize & Automate: Own the standards for hyperscaler structures, network segmentation, and infrastructure automation. Maintain accurate infrastructure inventory, topology documentation, and operational runbooks.

  • Datacenter Operations: Guide hardware lifecycle planning, rack readiness, cabling standards, and physical deployment quality across datacenters.

  • Reliability & Capacity Planning: Review and improve system reliability, capacity planning, and risk management. You will proactively scale and document hybrid infrastructure architecture before bottlenecks emerge.

  • Strategic Collaboration: Partner closely with Platform Engineering, Security, and application teams to expose infrastructure capabilities in a secure, consistent, and sustainable way.

  • Disciplined Execution: Execute critical infrastructure changes prioritizing safety and operational readiness. Support structured change reviews, maintenance planning, and rigorous change control practices.

 

✨ What You Bring

 

  • Deep Technical Expertise: Advanced expertise in Linux/Unix administration, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), and enterprise networking protocols (BGP/OSPF).

  • Hybrid Infrastructure Mastery: Strong practical experience with cloud landing zone design, network topology management, hybrid interconnect design, and datacenter hardware operations.

  • Automation & AI Literacy: Proficient in Infrastructure as Code and configuration automation. You intelligently leverage AI-assisted tooling for network diagnostics and automation while maintaining strict review discipline and awareness of AI-generated risks in privileged tooling.

  • Safety-Conscious Ownership: Highly methodical and detail-oriented. You possess a strong sense of ownership and change discipline for live system maintenance and production network changes.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience heavily contributing to production hybrid infrastructure at scale. You have successfully reduced manual effort through standardization and executed low-risk infrastructure projects (such as secure datacenter-to-cloud migrations).

  • Effective Communication & Mentorship: Ability to troubleshoot production-grade issues under pressure. You clearly communicate capacity, risk, and downtime planning with stakeholders and naturally mentor peers in infrastructure best practices.

 

💡 What We Offer

 

  • High-Impact Ownership: Administrative authority over cloud landing zones, network dev

8abaafa2ff56.title: Software Engineer & Architect (All Genders)
8abaafa2ff56.description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Flight Control Systems (FCS) Engineering team designs and delivers the hardware, real-time firmware, and flight software that keep STARK's unmanned aerial vehicles stable, responsive, and mission-ready across multiple platforms. We operate as a tight, cross-disciplinary group spanning hardware owners, real-time operating system (RTOS) engineers, guidance and control specialists, systems engineers, and flight test teams. As SW Engineer & Architect, you sit at the technical centre of that group, defining how the software layers fit together and writing core production code alongside your peers. We work close to real hardware on HIL benches and flight ranges, iterating rapidly while holding hard standards for timing, determinism, and flight safety.

YOUR MISSION

You will own the embedded software architecture and core C++ implementation for STARK's modular Flight Control System family across multiple unmanned aerial vehicle platforms. Every architectural boundary you set directly governs flight stability, real-time determinism, and how rapidly STARK brings new airframes and sensor suites from bench prototype to live deployment. Working across hardware, RTOS, guidance, and flight test teams, you will pair disciplined safety-critical engineering with hands-on code delivery under defence-tech pace.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Define and maintain the layered software architecture for STARK's modular Flight Control System family, separating hardware abstraction, RTOS services, middleware, and flight control applications across multiple UAV platforms.
  • Design, implement, debug, and review deterministic, real-time C and modern C++ flight software, covering state machines, task scheduling, fault handling, and sensor-to-actuator data pipelines on microcontroller targets.
  • Author and align interface control documents (ICDs), timing budgets, memory budgets, and failure-mode behaviour with Platform RTOS, FCS Hardware, Guidance and Control, and Systems Engineering teams.
  • Integrate flight software onto target microcontrollers, sensor interfaces, and embedded communication buses (CAN/CAN-FD, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet), isolating root causes on the hardware bench with debuggers, logic analysers, and oscilloscopes.
  • Build testable software boundaries and automated verification gates across unit tests, static analysis, software-in-the-loop (SIL) simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) rigs ahead of ground and live flight trials.
  • Establish pragmatic MISRA-aligned C/C++ coding guidelines and lead architecture and code reviews so the codebase stays maintainable as the FCS engineering team scales.

5be051089497.description:
Mission Brief 

You will be responsible for the structural analysis of entire assemblies belonging to our rocket’s primary and secondary structures. From trading design concepts to sizing and validating design iterations and examining the impact of manufacturing deviations, you will play an important role in guiding design decisions and pushing performance and reliability of our structures forward.

As a Senior Structural Analysis Engineer you will play a major role in improving our overall analysis and verification workflow by defining standards, sharing technical knowledge and reviewing your colleagues’ results and identifying action points. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Perform detailed stress analysis of aerospace structures and components using both classical hand calculations and advanced finite element methods (FEM), mostly of CFRP structures 
  • Identify failure scenarios and collaborate with design engineers to review and optimize structural designs. 
  • Define applicable load cases, addressing the impact of thermal, quasi-static loads (arising from random vibrations) etc. 
  • Analise and provide possible solutions to manufacturing non-conformities 
  • Develop test plans and support physical testing of components to verify sizing assumptions and qualify hardware.   
  • Prepare comprehensive stress analysis reports and documentation for internal/external use 
  • Improve our standards and toolchain for structural verification 
  • Be familiar with classical design standards and have experience in the use of CAD software 
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers within the team  

 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Degree in the field of Engineering, Aerospace, Mechanical or (Computational) Mechanics, or any other related field. 
  • At least 8 years of experience in analysing aerospace structures 
  • Profound knowledge in classical hand-calculations and advanced FE Modelling of aerospace structures (Hypermesh, Optistruct etc) 
  • Self-motivated, collaborative, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision. 
  • High degree of independence and confidence in assessing and trading design risks 
  • Strong engineering intuition with regards to load paths and failure mechanisms 
  • Holistic perspective on development of structures 
  • Fluent English 

Bonus Skills

  • Practical experience in the space sector (preferably in launch vehicle development program).
  • Previous experience using CAD, preferably with Siemens NX.
  • Good understanding of composite structures’

a257345ed5eb.description: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real world operations. As Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, you will own electromagnetic compatibility across our UGV platforms, starting with our Mandrill UGV: from the grounding and shielding concept on the drawing board to the certificate that puts our vehicles on public roads and into military service. Your goal is one robust E/E design baseline that passes civil homologation (UN ECE R10) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461, AECTP 500) without costly redesign loops. This is a senior engineer role with real ownership and room to grow. You build our EMC capability from the ground up, set the strategy, decide early in the design, and lead campaigns through to certification. You will work at the intersection of high power electronics, vehicle E/E, radios and mission payloads, autonomy compute, suppliers, test houses and authorities. As the platform family and team grow, this role can develop into leading our EMC and compliance function. What is your Day to Day Mission: EMC Strategy and Compliance Ownership Define and own the EMC and E3 compliance strategy for our UGV platforms, covering civil vehicle approval (UN ECE R10, E mark for vehicle and ESA) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461G, MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500 / AECTP 250, MIL-STD-1275). Translate customer, NATO and national requirements into an EMC control plan, requirement matrix and test strategy, and keep them current as configurations evolve. Act as the technical interface to accredited test houses, technical services, type approval authorities and defence customers during qualification and acceptance. EMC by Design Develop and integrate the grounding, bonding, shielding and harness concept for the complete vehicle, with special focus on high voltage and high power electronics: traction inverters, DC/DC converters, battery systems and chargers together with outstanding team of engineers Run EMC design reviews for schematics, PCBs, harnesses, enclosures and connectors; specify filters, transient protection and shielding concepts. Manage RF coexistence on a dense platform: datalinks, GNSS, tactical radios and payload emitters working side by side without degrading each other. Flow down EMC requirements to suppliers, run component level reviews and assess their test evidence. Test, Troubleshooting and Qualification Build our in house pre compliance lab (LISN, spectrum analyser, near field probes, current clamps, automated measurement scripts) so issues are found on the bench, not in the chamber. Plan, witness and lead full compliance campaigns at component, subsystem and vehicle level; drive root cause analysis and verified fixes when tests fail. Use simulation (e.g. FEKO, CST, LTspice) where it saves test iterations. Cross Functional Collaboration and Standards Work closely with payload integration, vehicle E/E, mechanical, autonomy and manufacturing teams so EMC is built in, not bolted on. Create EMC control plans, test procedures, reports and qualification evidence, and turn lessons learned into internal EMC design rules for every future platform and payload. What you bring to the team: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics or a comparable technical field. 8+ years of EMC experience in automotive, commercial vehicle, rail, aerospace or defence , including ownership of at least one product through formal qualification or type approval. Deep knowledge of automotive EMC (e.g. UN ECE R10, CISPR 25, ISO 11452, ISO 7637, ISO 10605) and working knowledge of military EMC (MIL-STD-461; ideally MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500, DEF STAN 59-411 or VG 95370/95373). Strong automotive profiles willing to extend into the military world are very welcome. Solid experience with EMC of high voltage and power electronics systems. Practical measurement expertise at component and vehicle level, and the ability to set up and automate test systems (e.g. Python, Matlab). Structured root cause analysis, ideally backed by methods such as Six Sigma, and audit ready documentation. Confident communication with engineers, suppliers, test labs, authorities and military customers. Fluent in German and English. High ownership, focus on teamwork, pragmatic, and happy to work directly on vehicles and in the workshop. 70fe070c1d31.description: Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) The Essentials Team: Data & Analytics Start date: As soon as possible Location: Berlin / Genoa, hybrid — at least 60% in the office Contract: Fixed-term Working language: English Salary band: Shared before your first interview Your Impact As Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at 7NXT Health Group, you’ll own our data platform end to end — from consuming backend events and APIs to the metrics a stakeholder reads. You’ll work closely with backend engineering, product and the business, and report to the Head of Data & Analytics. Your work directly impacts the data foundation on which ~900,000 subscribers across nine European markets rely every day. We automate anything that repeats. Stakeholders used to ask us “is this number right?” — now they query governed data themselves through our MCP servers and a Slack agent. It’s the part of the job we’re proudest of, and you’ll keep shaping it as a product. What you’ll drive You design, build, test and maintain scalable, reliable and secure data pipelines and architectures You keep integrations healthy as backend teams change their schemas, so the business keeps one version of each number it can defend You ingest new data sources with Airflow and dbt, and lead migrations and KPI restatements when definitions change You develop the governed semantic layer and data catalog across our brands — 7Mind, Gymondo and Buddyfit You build Customer 360 and other cross-brand data products that help teams understand their users You turn tracking knowledge into a tracking plan as code, so every event can be validated against a shared definition You model data around the decisions the business makes, so every KPI traces back to a clear definition You keep BigQuery fast and affordable as data volume grows You collaborate closely with backend engineering, product and the business, and actively shape how we work Our stack: BigQuery · GCS · dbt · Airflow · Python · SQL · GitHub Actions · Cloud Run · Rudderstack · GA4 · Firebase · Tableau · Claude Code · MCP servers · Slack bots What defines you Must-have 4+ years building and running a production data warehouse in an industry context Strong SQL and Python, with dbt and BigQuery in depth Hands-on experience with GCP (BigQuery, GCS) or comparable cloud services Airflow or a similar orchestrator; experience ingesting from application databases and third-party APIs ETL/ELT concepts and experience writing tests that support data governance At least one migration where the upstream system changed and the numbers still had to match Git, CI/CD, and comfort with Bash and Linux scripting Daily use of coding agents and opinions on how to make them reliable Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences; fluent English Nice-to-have Master’s in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering) LLM tools built on top of data — MCP servers, agents or bots Subscription and payment data (Chargebee, Adyen, app receipts, vouchers) Event tracking design and governance (GTM, tracking plans, schema validation) Marketing attribution and CRM data (Braze, GA4, Adjust) Container-based environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and Terraform Tableau or comparable visualisation tools People who make things happen 7NXT Health Group is Europe’s leading platform group for digital fitness and mental wellbeing. Through our brands Gymondo, 7Mind, Buddyfit and Preneo, we reach 20–30 million people per month across 9 European markets, helping them live healthier lives — physically and mentally. Our team of ~170 people grows organically, works at eye level, and genuinely practises what we preach. We believe in trust over rigid structures, smart working over endless meetings — and that sustainability, inclusion and diversity aren’t buzzwords, they’re how we actually operate. Everyone counts We welcome what makes you unique. At 7NXT Health Group we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here. Don’t meet all the criteria? No problem — if you’d like to help shape the future of health & wellbeing with us, we look forward to your application. Need a more accessible process or have questions? Write to us — we’ll find a way. Skip the cover letter. Show us one business process you automated or simplified — the one you’re most proud of. A repo, a script, a write-up or a few sentences are all fine. Tell us what it replaced and what you learned. We’ll go through it together in the interview. f45451280a44.title: Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer
f45451280a44.description:
AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability. It also builds the shared services the estate's own operation depends on, and runs them. Operating the estate every day is what shows how the platform behaves under real load and under failure, and the function works with the engineering teams that build it to turn what it finds into permanent fixes and design improvements. 

Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer

Role Summary 

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer  runs the Kubernetes estate that every product and every tenant runs on: the platform controller layer, the virtual cluster platform tenants are provisioned onto, the Kubernetes environment baselines used across the estate, the GPU integration layer, and the automated tenant onboarding and release pipeline. 

This is a hands-on senior role with deep technical expertise. This role owns the platform lifecycle execution across the fleet: keeping clusters healthy and current across the fleet, keeping tenant workloads running through upgrade and failure, and restoring control planes to service when they degrade. Automation is a first-class part of the role, in the operational tooling, guarded remediation and fleet orchestration that make estate-scale operation possible, delivered as controlled code and reviewed by AI Infrastructure where it affects service behaviour.

ebefe0ba6b8d.description:
Introduction 

We are looking for a Graduate DSP (Digital Signal Processing) Embedded Engineer with a passion for designing and implementing efficient real-time systems to join our team. Our projects span a range of industries and

applications including Communications, Sensors and Audio. 

Successful candidates can join us between May- September 2027.

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  

 

What we can offer

With lots of support from guidance, you will support our signal processing group. Here are some examples of previous projects the team have worked on: 

  • ultra-reliable communications for satellites
  • IP block acceleration of Voice Activity Detection 
  • map based indoor navigation using sensor fusion,
  • development of the communication system for a fleet of moving bots in a challenging indoor environment.

We can provide a huge amount of variety in this role. You may be designing filters for simulation of a system one week, getting hands on with programming for a platform the next, or providing vectors or interpreting results from our hardware test team.  

We take pride in being ahead of the technology curve, working with and developing exciting new technology. Our accolades include being an Arm Approved Design partner collaborating to design cutting edge systems with the latest low-power technologies. The platforms on which we develop solutions includes devices from TI, ARM devices, PicoChip, Dialog, Tensilica HIFI, Ambiq, Cirrus Logic, and custom ASICs developed in-house. 

The wide history of projects previously undertaken by the group have been implemented using a variety of software technologies. For embedded systems: C, C++, Assembler. For scripting and modelling: Matlab, Python, native Windows/Linux scripting languages. Utilising systems and processes: version control systems, issue tracking, continuous integration, test driven development.

 

What you can bring

You’ll have the opportunity to work on a range of projects, each with their own distinct set of challenges. You’ll be able to get involved with everything from first-principles thinking and research through to the design, development and deployment of live systems – utilising knowledge and practical experience attained from your degree.

We are looking for someone who has:

  • a good degree in a relevant subject, such as electronic/electrical/communications engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics
  • programming skills – scripting languages such as Python or Matlab are particularly useful in our day-to-day work, we also use low level languages such as C for implementation so similar experience would be valuable, or of course a willingness to learn!
  • an interest or understanding of the constraints of embedded systems, and how they can be implemented in an optimised way. An understanding of digital signal processing (DSP) concepts/mathematics would also be beneficial

We are a nurturing team, and though not a formal graduate scheme you will be supported throughout to develop your career in the direction you want, with mentoring and training provided.

Please ensure your CV includes your A Level (or equivalent) subjects and grades, as well as any relevant university modules.

Covering statements are advantageous though by no means a necessity.

f6c4c68e282d.description:
Cambridge, UK
UK travel and occasional international travel

Introduction

We’re looking for graduates who are excited by the opportunity to make emerging technologies secure, trustworthy and resilient. You’ll work on real-world engineering challenges across cyber security, artificial intelligence, embedded systems and connected technologies, supporting projects in areas including defence and security, industrial systems and critical national infrastructure.

You’ll need to be curious, willing to learn and comfortable exploring unfamiliar technical problems. In return, we’ll provide the support, mentoring and hands-on experience you need to develop into a confident, well-rounded security engineer working on innovative deep technology.

We’re much more interested in the engineer you can become than the one you are now. We’ll give you the time, support and opportunities to build your security engineering skills and develop the confidence to contribute to challenging client projects. Curiosity, a careful and structured approach to problem solving, and enthusiasm for technology are more important than having experience in every area of cyber security.

 

Overview

Cambridge Consultants develops deep technology across sensing, communications, embedded systems, artificial intelligence and complex systems. Our Trusted AI and Secure Technologies team helps clients understand, design and demonstrate security and trustworthiness in emerging and connected technologies.

You’ll work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside engineers and specialists in electronics, firmware, software, RF, AI and data science, and systems engineering. Projects can span the full engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concepts and requirements through to implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.

Our work includes cyber security, secure-by-design engineering, embedded and connected systems, industrial and critical infrastructure, defence and national security, edge AI, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.

 

Your responsibilities

You’ll work on real client assignments with support and guidance from experienced engineers. You’ll have opportunities to contribute across different stages of the engineering lifecycle and work alongside specialists from across Cambridge Consultants.

You may contribute to projects at different stages of the engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concept development and requirements through to architecture, implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.

You’ll also have opportunities to interact directly with clients, including requirements discussions, technical workshops, progress updates and delivery, with support from experienced engineers where appropriate.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Contributing to threat modelling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments.
  • Helping to identify security requirements and develop secure-by-design system architectures.
  • Supporting vulnerability assessments and security testing, including helping to scope testing activities and track remediation.
  • Investigating vulnerabilities and helping teams understand and address security risks.
  • Contributing to security cases, assurance activities and technical documentation.
  • Analysing systems, software and technical designs to identify potential security weaknesses.
  • Developing prototypes, analysis tools or other technical solutions to investigate security problems.
  • Working with multidisciplinary teams to understand the interaction between security, functionality, safety and system performance.
  • Communicating technical findings clearly to engineers, project teams and customers.
Domains and project types

You could work across a range of applications and technologies, including:

  • Critical national infrastructure: energy, transport, communications and utilities.
  • Industrial systems: ICS, SCADA, OT and industrial IoT.
  • Defence and national security: secure systems and technologies supporting demanding operational environments.
  • Emerging technologies: AI assurance, sensing, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.

 

What you can bring

The below is essential
  • An excellent degree or PhD in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline.
  • 12 months industrial experience, for example through a placement year or relevant postgraduate experience.
  • A good understanding of fundamental engineering, computing or security principles.
  • Practical experience through university, industrial placement, work experience, research or personal projects in at least one or more relevant areas, such as:
    • cyber/security engineering
    • software or application development
    • embedded systems
    • computer or network systems
    • electronics or hardware security
    • AI or data science
    • systems engineering
  • The ability to understand and analyse technical
