da8729713a76.title: Product Engineer
da8729713a76.description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent . We're a 180+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites , with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy. The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards , came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 . Learn more about us on our website . 🚀 The Role We're hiring Product Engineers at Staff, Senior Staff, and Principal level across three of our engines: Buy, Sell and Third Party Access (TPA). A Product Engineer at tem gets handed a problem, not a ticket. You sit inside an engine, next to the account managers, partners and customers who live with the problem. You work out what to build, build it, and stay with it after launch until you can show it moved the metric. Product sets the bet and the guidance, not the feature list, so nobody writes your tickets for you. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management one. We will talk to you about which engine fits you best, and where your experience and interests line up. Buy: Buy is where businesses pay less for clean power. It's the side of tem that runs RED for the UK businesses on it: quotes with every cost up front, bills itemised line by line, and a switch from quote to live in minutes, not days. You'd build the products and systems behind that, from tender to signed contract to a bill with nothing to hide, and make it work just as well for the next thousand sites as it does for the first. Sell: Sell is where generators earn more for what they produce. We contract with UK solar, wind, hydro, anaerobic digestion, biomass and EfW sites, from single farms to multi-site portfolios, through broker partners and direct. You'd build the tools that get generators signed faster, show them exactly what they're earning, and get them paid on time, every time. You'd also open up new kinds of sites we can't contract today, so there's more clean power to put in front of businesses. Third Party Access (TPA): TPA builds the new transaction rails for our partners. It lets brokers, banks, affiliates and generators sell tem's energy under their own brand, running on Rosso, our pricing engine. You'd design and build the partner APIs, branded portals, billing and settlement that make that work, and take a 0 to 1 product from pilot to production. In TPA you'll also be partner-facing, embedding with partners to get them integrated and live. 📆 In your first 12 months, you might: Sit with the account managers, partners and customers in your engine, run discovery calls yourself and turn what you hear into a clear problem to solve. Decide what to build and what to leave out, then design and ship it without waiting for a spec. Ship work that moves a named business metric, and stay with it until you can show the number moved. In TPA, help take partner integrations from pilot to production, live and working. Mentor engineers around you and share what you learn with teams across the business. 🛠️ Responsibilities Own discovery: Work directly with the commercial team, partners and customers to find the real problem, proactively engaging them and running calls autonomously. Turn problems into outcomes: Turn subjective requirements into objective outcomes, deciding what to build, then designing and shipping it yourself. Be accountable for the number: Take full accountability for the business and user metrics that move as a direct result of your technical and customer work. Own it end to end: Stay with it after launch and make sure it moves what it was meant to move within the business. Make the hard calls: Make sound but critical judgement calls on speed versus robustness, and on commercial risk. Spread what you learn: Feed what you learn from partners and customers back into the product, with an impact across departments that aren't your own. Raise the bar: Mentor engineers around you and raise technical standards, helping others accelerate into roles you used to hold. ✅ Requirements Must-Haves Proven technical leadership at Senior, Staff or Senior Staff level, with genuine, statistical evidence of leading complex, ambiguous work to real business impact. Comfort operating without a spec, with several clear-cut examples of how you went against the status quo or ran without guidelines to deliver something impactful. Examples of talking directly to customers and commercial teams to find the real problem, participating in (if not leading) early discovery calls and user feedback interviews. Sound commercial judgement, including an understanding of the revenue impact of the risks you take and whether a headcount investment outweighs its costs. Comfort being the technical voice in front of commercial stakeholders and partners, from our leadership team through to our board members and investors. A hands-on, player-coach approach, and comfort in our stack: Python, TypeScript, AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge) and event-driven architectures. Desirable Experience in energy, fintech or another regulated, high-stakes commercial domain. Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing engineering experien

0f4210716cdb.description: Location: London Contract Type: 12-month contract Day Rate: £650–£750 per day We are looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join our Technology team, working onsite with a Tier 1 Bank in London on an initial 12-month contract. This is a hands-on role focused on designing and delivering scalable, production-ready AI solutions within a complex financial services environment. You will work across business, product, engineering and data teams, taking solutions from initial concept through to deployment and production. You will have particular expertise in Generative AI and LLM technologies, including RAG, agentic AI, document and unstructured data processing, and machine learning. We’re looking for someone who combines strong solution architecture expertise with a pragmatic approach to security, governance, scalability and production delivery. Define APIs, integrations and data contracts across upstream and downstream systems. Ensure security, privacy, resilience and appropriate controls are embedded into solution design. Define non-functional requirements including availability, performance, latency, scalability and cost. Support deployment, monitoring, versioning and ongoing lifecycle management of AI solutions. Work closely with engineering teams to break architecture into deliverable solutions and resolve technical challenges. Strong experience designing end-to-end technology solutions across applications, APIs, integration and data. Good understanding of AI and Generative AI architecture, including LLMs and RAG. Experience taking solutions from initial design through to production. Strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns and data contracts. Experience defining non-functional requirements across performance, resilience, security and scalability. Strong understanding of security, privacy and controls-by-design. Most of our clients now require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home, and accordingly this is also the minimum expectation that Delta Capita require. However, some of our clients have now moved up to 4 days and even 5 days in the office and we require candidates to be flexible to meet our client demands. Who We Are: Delta Capita Group is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology-based mutualised services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services. 708baf2a3bba.description:
Growth at Private Equity Insights

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why Private Equity Insights

Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our maritime family of systems is AI-enabled and built for reliable performance in the harshest seas, delivering NATO a fully integrated hardware–software capability for scalable ISR and strike operations.

YOUR MISSION

As the Lead Software Engineer, you will be responsible for leading complex multi-domain software developments for deployment on our growing fleet of autonomous vessels and ground systems. Interfacing with design teams across the UK and Europe, you will be the single coordination and point of contact for all things Maritime Software. This includes directing the roadmap of existing products, leading new developments and interfacing to 3rd party subcontractors and suppliers. You will need to scale between front-end GUIs, middleware, embedded systems, firmware and deep simulation technologies, working at the forefront of modern technology to increase levels of automation and push frontiers when required.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Lead technical coordination and leadership across multiple product developments.
  • Apply best-practice design and implementation for emergent technology software solutions.
  • Manage and improve software engineering processes and practices.
  • Deliver high-level conceptual designs for new software products at both the application and embedded levels.
  • Conduct make-vs-buy tradeoff studies and negotiate with suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Interface with Systems and Electrical teams to advise on hosting platforms from PCs to embedded systems.
  • Support and participate in regular field testing and demonstrations with defence partners.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Proven experience in leading complex integration and development programmes.
  • Solid Software Engineering principles and best-practices, alongside knowledge of software standards (civilian/automotive/defence).
  • Knowledge of multi-stage Validation & Verification techniques and simulation techniques/targets (from software-regression to Hardware-in-Loop platforms).

977264383ea6.title: Senior Identity Security Engineer
977264383ea6.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Identity Security Engineer to join our Information Security team on a remote basis or hybrid basis if located in Barcelona.  This is a hands-on engineer who will build identity controls that reduce excessive privilege and protect critical operations. You will improve access across employee, player, business partner, and non-human identities by building AI-native identity workflows: agentic systems that handle provisioning, access reviews, and remediation within explicit guardrails, with humans approving what matters. Your work will protect the identities and access that support Scopely’s critical business processes, including essential enterprise functions and game operations.  This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who can operate across AWS, GCP, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Zero Trust access models, identity governance workflows, and modern AI-enabled engineering environments, while building scalable identity systems through Infrastructure as Code, workflow orchestration, and automation-first security engineering.

What You Will Do

Reduce identity attack surface and privilege

  • Reduce standing and excessive access with least-privilege roles, just-in-time and time-bound elevation, and automated access reviews.
  • Build repeatable identity and access workflows that make onboarding, approvals, role changes, reviews, and offboarding consistent, traceable, and timely.
  • Govern non-human identities, including service accounts, workload identities, CI/CD identities, API credentials, and AI agents and their tool integrations: inventory them, assign owners, replace long-lived secrets with short-lived or federated credentials, and rotate or revoke on a schedule and on signal.

Strengthen identity protection and resilience

  • Protect access to critical business processes and systems with phishing-resistant authentication (passkeys/FIDO2), device trust and posture signals, tightly controlled privileged access, and prompt revocation of suspicious sessions or compromised credentials.
  • Threat-model identity platforms, integrations, and access paths to identify exploitable trust relationships, privilege escalation, and credential misuse. 
  • Build identity telemetry and response workflows to detect risky sign-ins, privilege changes, credential misuse, and compromised integrations. 
  • Design and test break-glass and recovery procedures for identity services and cloud access so teams can regain secure access during an outage or compromise.
  • Extend the same patterns to player and partner identities where security owns the controls: platform identity federation (Apple, Google, Steam, console), account linking and recovery, external and vendor access, and defenses against account takeover and credential stuffing.

Build AI-native identity services

  • Build and operate reusable identity controls and services using infrastructure as code, APIs, scripting, and delivery pipelines. Apply code review, testing, drift detection, and audit trails so that every change, whether made by an engineer or an agent, is safe to deploy and easy to investigate.
  • Design and build multi-agent workflows that surface identity risk, run access attestations, and triage and remediate access issues end to end. Engineer the harness those agents run in: scoped tools and permissions, curated context and data access, evals and test cases, orchestration between agents, and observability, so agent behavior is predictable, reviewable, and improvable.
  • Treat agents as identities. Give every agent and MCP integration its own scoped credentials, least-privilege permissions, and bounded data access; validate inputs and outputs; log every action; and require human approval for changes that touch privileged access or production.
  • Work with game and platform stakeholders to adopt shared identity patterns. Measure progress through reduced standing privilege, stale access, and unmanaged identities, and less manual work.
  • Produce audit-ready evidence for access reviews, privileged access, and lifecycle events as a byproduct of the workflows rather than a separate project.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in IAM, or identity-focused cloud/security engineering, including hands-on ownership of production identity controls in complex environments.
  • Strong experience with Okta or a comparable workforce identity platform and AWS/GCP IAM, as well as federation and provisioning protocols such as SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM.
  • Production experience building, testing, and operating identity services or automation using Terraform or comparable infrastructure as code, Python, Go, or TypeScript., APIs, version control, and CI/CD.
  • Strong knowledge of least privilege, just-in-time privileged access, identity lifecycle and governance, authentication controls, and non-human or workload identity risk.
  • Experience threat-modeling identity architectures, integrations, and access paths, and driving remediation with service owners.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-native workflows: systems where agents carry out multi-step work end to end, designed from the start around what agents can be trusted to do and where humans approve. Using a coding assistant does not count.
  • Working fluency with harness engineering and multi-agent development: defining tools and permissions, scoping context and data, writing evals, orchestrating specialized agents, and instrumenting agent runs so failures are diagnosable, plus the judgment to keep those systems inside least-privilege boundaries.
  • Ability to lead technical work from design through deployment and operations,

The team partners closely with Research, Applications, Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure to turn model improvements into measurable downstream impact on the driving stack. 🧠 Your day-to-day Own and lead parts of large-scale training for Gaia (language- or video-style training at scale), from experimentation through productionised training runs. Translate product and evaluation needs into model improvements (e.g. better long-horizon prediction, scenario generation quality, failure-case coverage). Mentor and set technical direction, raising the engineering and research quality bar across the team. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Leading and executing Gaia's post-training and closed-loop pipeline — fine-tuning and aligning the world model through post-training experimentation and targeted data curation. Pushing Gaia's autoregressive generation towards longer, more stable rollouts, and making the model deployment-ready (inference time and reliability included). Contributing to broader model architecture and training-strategy decisions where they intersect with pre- and post-training and the application layer. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews (Programming/Pytorch debugging and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total) Deep-dive technical interviews (Systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total) Final interview : Mission & values alignment (45 mins). DECATHLON DIGITAL 

L'entité Data de Decathlon coordonne l'ensemble des activités visant à l'accélération et la généralisation de l'usage et la valorisation des données.

Decathlon vise à devenir la meilleure plateforme digitale de sport et l'écosystème ouvert le plus performant au monde. Nos équipes digitales à Lille, Paris et Nantes - qui rassemblent plus de 5000 collaborateurs - sont unies pour construire et faire évoluer des produits digitaux avec l'objectif de toujours offrir la meilleure valeur à nos utilisateurs. Présent dans plus de 70 pays, Decathlon est engagé dans l'innovation, la durabilité et la satisfaction des clients.

Tu participeras à des projets qui ont le potentiel de définir l'avenir du sport : une vraie opportunité de façonner l'industrie grâce aux données et à l'IA !

Pour renforcer nos équipes Data & IA, nous recrutons un(e) Stagiaire Data Scientist - Forecast (H/F) pour un stage de fin d'études conventionné de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027, basé à Paris.

LE SUJET DE STAGE

Dans un environnement retail en constante évolution, nos équipes en magasin ont besoin d'outils prédictifs performants pour anticiper leur activité et adapter leur organisation au quotidien. Aujourd'hui, l'optimisation des plannings, la prévision d'affluence et l'anticipation de la charge de travail représentent des défis majeurs d'échelle et de précision.

Au sein de nos équipes Data & IA, ton objectif sera de participer à l'amélioration, à l'évaluation et au passage à l'échelle de nos modèles de prévision déjà en production, en explorant notamment l'apport des nouveaux modèles de fondation temporels et tabulaires.

L'enjeu : réaliser un état de l'art des solutions émergentes, adapter ces modèles à nos problématiques réelles complexes et structurer un framework de benchmark robuste pour valider scientifiquement les meilleures approches.

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur du projet, de la recherche appliquée jusqu'à la mise en production :

  • Veille et état de l'art scientifique : Explorer et évaluer les nouvelles approches de modèles de fondation pour séries temporelles et données tabulaires (TSFM / TabFM).
  • Spécialisation et adaptation : Entraîner, spécialiser (fine-tuning) et adapter ces modèles de fondation aux contraintes opérationnelles réelles du retail.
  • Framework de benchmark et d'évaluation : Concevoir un cadre de test standardisé et structurer des jeux de données réels pour comparer objectivement les performances des différents modèles.
  • Optimisation des modèles prédictifs : Participer à l'amélioration de nos modèles prédictifs actuellement en production.
  • Collaboration et valorisation : Restituer tes travaux de manière claire et évaluer, selon les résultats et tes appétences, l'opportunité d'une publication scientifique ou technique.

Le périmètre technique :

  • Python, SQL
  • PyTorch ou TensorFlow, Hugging Face, benchmarks de modèles de fondation (ex. GIFT-Eval, TIME, fev-bench)
  • Databricks, Spark, dbt
  • Airflow (Astronomer), AWS (S3, ECR, ...)
  • Jupyter, Git, Docker

 CE DONT TU AURAS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 spécialisé en Mathématiques Appliquées, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou équivalent, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois.
  • Socle technique : Tu maîtrises Python, SQL et Git, et tu possèdes de solides bases en statistiques, Machine Learning et Deep Learning.
  • Communication : Tu as d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, analytiques et de présentation, avec la capacité de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes de manière simple pour des équipes métiers.
  • État d'esprit : Tu aimes explorer et résoudre des problèmes, clarifier proactivement les besoins, travailler en autonomie et prendre des responsabilités lorsque cela est nécessaire.
  • Culture : Tu es sensible à l'impact de la pratique du sport et tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif (#Tech4Good).
  • Cerise sur le gâteau : Tu as déjà travaillé sur des problématiques liées au retail ou manipulé des datasets complexes de séries temporelles en environnement réel.

 CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

  • Un environnement de travail moderne dans nos bureaux Decathlon Digital à Paris
  • La possibilité d’innover et d’avoir de l’impact grâce à la data et à la technologie
  • Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows)
  • Une équipe projet locale connectée à un réseau international
  • Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, technologies de pointe, certifications, événements)
  • Formations internes et externes
  • Gratification de stage et possibilité de pré-embauche selon opportunités

3a391fb7b6a0.description:
Pilotez les missions où se jouent les paris IA des grands groupes, et transformez-les en résultats mesurables
L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.

Et tout commence par vous.

 

Missions

En tant qu’AI Strategist Manager, vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions AI Strategy : vous les pilotez en autonomie, en garantissez la qualité, les délais et la rentabilité, faites grandir les consultants qui y sont staffés et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners.

Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.

Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous définissez les processus cibles et la roadmap, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.

 

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA

Vous définissez la vision IA et la roadmap priorisée des cas d’usage, challengez la pertinence de l’IA et assumez les arbitrages. Lorsque c’est pertinent, vous conduisez des refontes de processus de bout en bout, en pensant lean avant de déployer l’IA et en mobilisant les équipes Engineering et AI Adoption pour les livrer. Vous concevez le modèle opératoire cible et sécurisez ses conditions de succès.

II. Analyses, business cases & prototypage

Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse de la mission, business cases inclus, afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits, et vous revoyez le travail de l’équipe. Vous prototypez rapidement des cas d’usage pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.

III. Delivery, livrables & collaboration

Vous dirigez les missions au quotidien en donnant de la visibilité aux sponsors clients : vous découpez chaque mission en streams, anticipez les risques et challengez le client lorsque c’est pertinent. Vous produisez en autonomie des livrables de niveau C-suite et des synthèses exécutives, structurez la storyline et veillez au respect des standards de qualité Artefact. Vous orchestrez les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.

IV. Relation client & développement commercial

Vous êtes l’interlocuteur de confiance des directeurs métiers et des responsables de projets (Comex-1) : vous cartographiez les rapports de force entre les parties prenantes, animez les restitutions pour emporter l’adhésion et maximiser le NPS client, et gérez les tensions et escalades en préservant la confiance. Vous détectez de nouveaux besoins sur le terrain, construisez le plan de développement du compte avec le Directeur ou le Partner et déclenchez de manière proactive des propositions pour développer les comptes existants, en contribuant aux propositions commerciales et aux soutenances.

V. Équipe & connaissances

Vous encadrez et faites grandir les consultants juniors et seniors, êtes counsellor de plusieurs collègues et participez au recrutement des futurs talents. Vous contribuez aussi à la base de connaissances interne par des articles et des retours d’expérience, et animez des formations internes.

 

Profil recherché
Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez piloter des missions exigeantes de bout en bout, faire grandir une équipe et gagner la confiance de dirigeants, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre leurs mains plutôt que leur décrire une vision.

  • 5 à 8 ans d’expérience au sein d’un cabinet de conseil en stratégie, en management ou en transformation data / IA.
  • Une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master, issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.
  • Une expérience de pilotage de missions complexes, de la vision aux résultats, avec des business cases qui résistent à l’examen d’un Comex.
  • Une solide compréhension des enjeux opérationnels de l’IA (IA générative et agentique, gouvernance, cas d’usage métiers), avec la capacité de l’expliquer simplement à des dirigeants.
  • Une expérience de pilotage de projets de refonte de processus métier, avec une maîtrise avérée de certains processus métier.
  • Une expérience du développement commercial (propositions, développement de comptes, relation avec des décideurs de haut niveau).
  • Une expérience d’encadrement d’une équipe de consultants, avec le goût de faire grandir, de déléguer et de tirer l’équipe vers le haut.
  • Un état d’esprit de maker : aisance avec les outils technologiques actuels et capacité à prototyper rapidement des démos fonctionnelles (low-code, no-code, outils agentiques) qui rendent la valeur tangible pour le client.
  • Maîtrise parfaite du français

41c91faa80fb.description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results. Topics for 2027 Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you. Reading invoices and new types of documents with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Knowing when the AI is right : calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions. Evaluating accounting agents : an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring. Learning from accountants' corrections : turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees. Bank reconciliation : matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation. An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets : from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production. Data foundations for AI : evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own. AI will be part of how you work You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Python and SQL, run experiments, write tests and debug. We expect you to give agents the right context and to check their output. You own the result, not the agent. OUR CULTURE You will join a hands-on engineering culture, where two technical co-founders are still among the most active contributors to the codebase. You will work with ML and AI engineers, data specialists, software engineers, product managers and accountants. You will have strong mentorship and a lot of ownership: freedom to test ideas, challenge existing approaches and build things from scratch, with an R&D mindset. The goal is not a demo. It is something the team can trust, reuse and ship. YOU'RE THE RIGHT CANDIDATE IF YOU Are in the final year of a Master's degree or engineering school in machine learning, computer science, statistics or applied mathematics. Research internships of at least 4 months are also considered. Have strong ML foundations and solid Python, and have already trained, fine-tuned or evaluated models in academic, personal or professional projects. Care about evaluation: clean baselines, reproducible experiments and metrics that reflect the real problem. Are comfortable with real-world data: SQL, analysis, messy and imbalanced datasets. Already use AI ambitiously in your projects and can explain how you verify its output. Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary team. No accounting knowledge is required, only curiosity. PRACTICAL INFORMATION Duration: 5 to 6 months (final-year internship). Start date: March or April 2027. Location: Paris office, at least 3 days per week on site, together with your tutor. Supervision: a dedicated tutor from the ML & AI team. Resources: GPUs, API access to frontier models, real data under GDPR-compliant conditions, and our existing evaluation infrastructure. After the internship: an opportunity to join Pennylane full-time on a permanent contract. HOW TO APPLY Please send us: Your CV. Links to relevant projects: GitHub repositories, technical reports, notebooks or papers. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

6b5382d6760d.title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
6b5382d6760d.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs.

What you'll do:

Risk Management

  • Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests
  • Maintain the risk register, keeping entries accurate, current, and well documented
  • Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress
  • Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting
  • Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation

Compliance and Audit

  • Coordinate evidence collection from control owners and chase outstanding requests
  • Help prepare control owners and stakeholders for audit interviews
  • Keep the SOC 2 system description, ISMS documentation, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) up to date
  • Track audit gaps and findings and drive remediation to closure with control owners

Security Program Support

  • Help GRC and partner teams run governance for the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), including tracking adoption, gathering evidence, and maintaining supporting standards
  • Support data classification and data governance efforts by maintaining documentation, tracking adoption, and coordinating with data owners
  • Assist with business impact analysis (BIA) and business continuity/disaster recovery (BC/DR) activities, including plan maintenance, exercise coordination, and follow-up on gaps
  • Track vulnerability management metrics and remediation status, and follow up with system owners on overdue items
  • Help coordinate penetration testing engagements, from scoping and scheduling through findings tracking and remediation follow-up

GRC Operations and Tooling

  • Serve as an administrator for our GRC platform, including users, workflows, integrations, and reporting
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and automate repetitive GRC work
  • Help maintain policies, standards, and supporting documentation

What you'll bring:

  • Experience in cybersecurity, GRC, IT audit, or a related field (typically 2-4 years)
  • Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST
  • Familiarity with risk assessment concepts and the risk management lifecycle
  • Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle many workstreams and deadlines at once

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The role

You will be the Technical Partner of our Account Executives in our France Public Sector district, helping large and strategic public sector organizations make strategic technical decisions. You own the technical win: from first discovery conversation to solution design, proof of concept and closure. You move comfortably between a CIO, CDO or senior public sector leadership conversation and a hands-on architecture review on the same day.

This is a brand new position: we are growing! Our SE team in France is expanding, and as we add Systems Engineers we move closer to one Systems Engineer for every Account Executive. Collaboration is part of how the team works.

What you will do

  • Understand customer business drivers and data strategy, and translate them into clear, future-ready architectures on the Everpure platform.
  • Lead the technical side of complex sales cycles: discovery, solution design, demos, proofs of concept, benchmarks and competitive evaluations.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to executives and to hands-on technical teams.

  • Share what you learn with the team: mentor peers, share best practice and help colleagues win.
  • Represent Everpure at customer events, executive briefings and industry forums.

What you bring (must have)

  • 8+ years of field pre-sales experience (Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect or similar) supporting large, complex customers.
  • Experience supporting large and strategic public sector accounts, or comparable large, complex organizations.
  • Strong enterprise data management knowledge: data platforms, data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, analytics and AI/ML data pipelines, data protection and governance.

  • Business fluent in French and English, able to explain complex architectures clearly in both.
  • A team-first mindset, with a track record of helping colleagues succeed.
  • Able to work from our Paris office and to travel occasionally within France and EMEA.

Nice to have

  • Enterprise storage experience (SAN, NAS, object, NVMe-oF). Not required: we will train you.
  • Background at a modern data platform vendor, a data protection vendor or a systems integrator.
  • Exposure to regulated, high-security or high-compliance environments, and familiarity with public procurement.
  • Existing relationships in the French public sector.


What this role is not

  • It is not a support or post-sales role. You work before the customer buys, on strategic opportunities.
  • It is not an Account Executive role. Your Account Executive owns the commercial relationship, and you own the technical outcome.
  • It is not a role for a single narrow vertical: you will cover large and strategic public sector accounts as a generalist.

6886fc839894.description: Who We Are Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. Who/What is Artefact?
Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible
business impact.
With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

 

The role:
 
We are looking for a Senior Data & AI Architect who combines business strategy and technology across Data and GenAI. You will design the operating model and the organization of the Data & GenAI CoE, define the target architecture, and steer data products from demand through to rollout.
 
Key responsibilities:
 
Operating model and organization
  • Design the Data & AI operating model (centralized, federated, hub-and-spoke) following Data Mesh principles: roles, responsibilities, domain ownership and governance mechanisms.
  • Define the organization of the Data & GenAI CoE: scope, service catalogue, skills, sizing and engagement model with business domains.
  • Design end-to-end processes for demand management, use case prioritization, funding and value tracking.
Architecture and technology choices
  • Define the target data platform architecture on cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and Databricks, including GenAI components (RAG, agents, vector stores, LLMOps).
  • Run make-or-buy analyses and vendor selections: scouting, evaluation criteria, business case, TCO and final recommendation.
  • Check that architecture, security and data governance choices are consistent with enterprise standards and with the operating model.
Data products: from demand to rollout
  • Gather and formalize functional requirements with the business, translating them into data products with owners, consumers, SLAs and quality metrics.
  • Design data products from both a functional angle (use cases, KPIs, impacted processes) and a technical one (data model, pipelines, interfaces, serving layer).
  • Act as design authority during implementation: review system integrator solutions and oversee quality, progress and risks of the rollout.
Requirements:
  • At least 4 years of professional experience in IT.
  • At least 2 years on projects focused on AI/GenAI, Data Mesh and functional requirements gathering.
  • Consulting experience, ideally in strategy consulting, combined with experience at a system integrator or delivery firm.
  • Hands-on experience designing operating models, Data/AI organizations or CoEs.
  • Experience with make-or-buy analyses, vendor selection or target architecture definition.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
Technical and functional skills:
You will not be expected to write code, but you need to know the technologies well enough to assess them, challenge vendors and spot a flawed setup.
  • Data Mesh and governance: domain ownership, data products, federated governance, data contracts, catalogues and lineage (e.g. Unity Catalog, OpenMetadata, Collibra).
  • Cloud: data and AI PaaS services on at least one of Azure, AWS and GCP; security, networking and FinOps principles.
  • Databricks: Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows; ability to assess design and cost.
  • GenAI: RAG and agentic architectures, LLMOps, model evaluation, platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI and Bedrock.
  • Operating model: Data/AI organization, CoE, roles (data owner, data steward, product owner), demand and portfolio processes.
  • Requirements and delivery: requirements gathering, user stories, process modelling, agile methods, programme governance.
  • Business: business cases, TCO, value tracking, and the ability to translate technical choices into economic impact.
Nice to have:
  • German not strictly required.
  • Experience with clients in pharma sector.
  • Cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect, Databricks Data Engineer or Solutions Architect).
  • Experience in tech due diligence or post-merger transformation projects.
  • Prior technical background as an engineer or developer.
What we offer:
  • A role bridging strategy and technology, with direct impact on client decisions.
  • International projects on Data Mesh, data platforms and GenAI.
  • Close collaboration with the Project Lead and a growth path towards programme leadership roles.
  • Location and working model: (Hybrid) Zurich or Lausanne.
  • Highly competitive compensation package

 

This position is based in Zürich.

Don’t worry if you don’t meet all the criteria! We value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else. We’d love to hear from you and learn more about your passion for driving the AI revolution.

05c3d339c7a4.description:
Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

Working closely with IT Operations, Platform Engineering, Software Engineering, and security partners, this position translates security and compliance requirements into reliable technical solutions.   • Implement and improve application security testing, dependency and secrets detection, and vulnerability feedback within software delivery workflows; advance secure development practices, including risk-based release reviews and lifecycle-appropriate controls; and guide engineering teams through remediation and validation of significant findings.

7350917db0a6.title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
7350917db0a6.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs.

What you'll do:

Risk Management

  • Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests
  • Maintain the risk register, keeping entries accurate, current, and well documented
  • Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress
  • Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting
  • Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation

Compliance and Audit

  • Coordinate evidence collection from control owners and chase outstanding requests
  • Help prepare control owners and stakeholders for audit interviews
  • Keep the SOC 2 system description, ISMS documentation, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) up to date
  • Track audit gaps and findings and drive remediation to closure with control owners

Security Program Support

  • Help GRC and partner teams run governance for the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), including tracking adoption, gathering evidence, and maintaining supporting standards
  • Support data classification and data governance efforts by maintaining documentation, tracking adoption, and coordinating with data owners
  • Assist with business impact analysis (BIA) and business continuity/disaster recovery (BC/DR) activities, including plan maintenance, exercise coordination, and follow-up on gaps
  • Track vulnerability management metrics and remediation status, and follow up with system owners on overdue items
  • Help coordinate penetration testing engagements, from scoping and scheduling through findings tracking and remediation follow-up

GRC Operations and Tooling

  • Serve as an administrator for our GRC platform, including users, workflows, integrations, and reporting
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and automate repetitive GRC work
  • Help maintain policies, standards, and supporting documentation

What you'll bring:

  • Experience in cybersecurity, GRC, IT audit, or a related field (typically 2-4 years)
  • Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST
  • Familiarity with risk assessment concepts and the risk management lifecycle
  • Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to juggle many workstreams and deadlines at once

2c6606119726.title: Staff DevOps Engineer, AI Security
2c6606119726.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer, AI Security to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Director, DevOps - AI Security in the AI Guard department. This role owns and evolves the multi-region Kubernetes platform behind Zscaler’s AI Security products, which inspect LLM and agent traffic in real time using ML models on GPU infrastructure. As the senior platform engineer in EMEA, you will set technical direction for infrastructure, delivery, and tooling, and build the automation that lets a small team run a large, globally distributed fleet safely.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Own multi-region infrastructure and delivery, designing and maintaining OpenTofu/Terraform modules, CI/CD pipelines, Helm charts, and GitOps workflows to ensure repeatable, low-risk deployments
  • Keep EKS clusters healthy and cost-efficient across microservices, API gateways, Kafka-based event pipelines, and GPU model serving
  • Build observability and automation into the platform by setting up metrics, logging, tracing, and SLOs while writing Python and Go tooling to reduce operational toil
  • Deliver secure and compliant infrastructure meeting CIS, STIG, and FedRAMP-style controls with hardened minimal images and least-privilege IAM
  • Serve as the EMEA platform lead to improve incident response, mentor engineers, and partner globally on architecture and roadmap

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. true ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and never stop developing yourself, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering with senior/staff-level ownership of production infrastructure
  • 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience, including EKS, VPC networking, IAM, MSK, RDS/Aurora, Route 53, and load balancing
  • Strong Terraform or OpenTofu experience, including module design and state management, plus CI/CD pipeline automation
  • Strong Linux fundamentals and Python and/or Go proficiency for automation, with experience running observability stacks and owning on-call, or equivalent practical experience

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Deep expertise in MLOps automation, including managing GPU workloads on Kubernetes, configuring model serving engines (Ray, KServe, Triton, or SageMaker), and building pipelines for LLM-based applications
  • Experience running multi-region, multi-tenant SaaS with cell-based architecture, Kafka event pipelines, ClickHouse analytical stores, and EU data residency boundaries
  • Strong knowledge of compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, CIS, STIG), hardened container images, and service mesh architectures like Istio or Envoy with mTLS

fbc38f4782df.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security
fbc38f4782df.description: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What You Will Do Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform. Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams. Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build. Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use. Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails. Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior. Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features. Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping. Strengthen our overall security engineering posture alongside the SRE team, contributing to our SOC 2 and compliance efforts (e.g. via Vanta), CI/CD security gates, and the principle that vulnerable code cannot get deployed. Own our vulnerability management process: identify and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, drive remediation across engineering and platform teams, track findings to closure, and fix recurring findings at the root. Strengthen identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption across our products and platform, including the credentials and access that agents and AI integrations depend on. Establish detection, logging, and incident response practices for AI-specific threats, and help the team respond when they occur. Stay ahead of a rapidly evolving threat landscape and continuously raise the bar for how we secure AI. Promote secure development practices through developer guidance and trainings, awareness initiatives, and collaboration with engineering teams. What You Bring Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning security work end to end in production. Strong grounding in application and cloud security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure design, common vulnerability classes, and secure SDLC practices. Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Management. Hands-on experience with identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption implementations. Demonstrated interest and hands-on experience in AI/LLM security, whether through professional work, research, red teaming, CTFs, or personal projects, and familiarity with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS. Solid understanding of how LLM-based and agentic systems work in practice, including prompts, tool/function calling, retrieval, and agent orchestration, and where they break. At Picnic, we're building the most secure milkman on earth. You'll be the engineer in the Security team. Instead of writing policies, you'll write the code that wires our security systems into the rest of Picnic, and you'll help product teams do the right thing by default.

b77a1fcc056d.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An Overview of this role As a Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team, you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. You’ll also support the company-level reporting and GTM performance views that executives use to run the business, covering consumption, ARR, and first orders. What you’ll do Embed yourself with business teams to become a trusted partner supporting insight generation and strategic decision making across GTM. Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover behavioral trends, long-term patterns, and the key drivers and levers behind business performance, and communicate their impact clearly to non-technical audiences. Build and productionize machine learning models - such as propensity, product-qualified lead (PQL) scoring, churn, and expansion models - including training, validation, testing, and feature engineering, using MLOps practices and tooling (CI/CD for ML pipelines, model registries, automated retraining, and monitoring) to move work reliably from notebook to production Design, run, and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experiments) on onboarding, pricing and packaging, and upgrade flows, and measure their impact on activation, conversion, and retention Build and operationalize agentic workflows for analysis, modeling, and pipeline automation, with evaluation and monitoring that keep agent-generated insights accurate, traceable, and trustworthy. Contribute to GitLab’s Semantic Layer enabling stakeholders and agents to self-serve metrics using trusts and tested sources. Write production-grade Python and SQL that meets internal standards for style, maintainability, and performance in a high-scale database environment; maintain and advocate for these standards through code review What you’ll bring 3-5 years of professional experience in GTM analytics, data science, or a similar technical role Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, measurable questions and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders. Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, classification, clustering, and survival analysis Deep, hands-on understanding of SQL in cloud data warehouses (like Snowflake SQL), including working with product usage and event data, and in business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar) Experience using Python for statistical modeling, machine learning, and production data science. With hands-on experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, and related libraries such as LightGBM and XGBoost Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability. Experience working in a B2C company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization About the Team The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab’s Company wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. We work across the business on metrics including First Orders, pipeline, CRR, ARR, and other key indicators, helping leaders make informed decisions and teams understand how their work contributes to GitLab’s growth.
